const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000
const QUOTE_SUBMISSION_BUDGET_MS = 15_000
const MOCK_RESERVES: PoolReserves = {
    reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
    reserveOut: parseEther("1000000")
}

type MockMarketQuote = {
    tokenIn: Address
    tokenOut: Address
    amountIn: bigint
    amountOutMin: bigint
    timestamp: number
}

type MarketDataProvider = {
    fetchMarketData: (
        strategy: AgentStrategy,
        context: { config: AgentSmartAccountConfig; client: PublicClient }
    ) => Promise<MarketSnapshot>
}

type OwnerValidatorProvider = {
    getOwnerValidator: (
        account: Address,
        config: AgentSmartAccountConfig
    ) => Promise<KernelValidator>
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function loadPrivateKey() {
    const key = process.env.AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
    if (!key || !/^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(key)) {
        throw new Error("AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY must be a dedicated 32-byte agent signer key.")
    }
    return privateKeyToAccount(key as `0x${string}`)
}

function readStrategies(config: AgentSmartAccountConfig): AgentStrategy[] {
    const raw = process.env.AGENT_STRATEGIES_JSON
    if (!raw) throw new Error("AGENT_STRATEGIES_JSON must contain the configured account strategies.")

    let parsed: unknown
    try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
    } catch {
        throw new Error("AGENT_STRATEGIES_JSON must be valid JSON.")
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || parsed.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("AGENT_STRATEGIES_JSON must be a non-empty array.")
    }

    return parsed.map((value, index): AgentStrategy => {
        if (!isRecord(value)) throw new Error(`Strategy ${index} must be an object.`)
        const { id, account, targetToken, amountBnb, entryPriceMicros, slippageBps, maxPriceImpactBps } = value
        if (
            typeof id !== "string" || !id.trim()
            || typeof account !== "string" || !isAddress(account)
            || typeof targetToken !== "string" || !isAddress(targetToken)
            || typeof amountBnb !== "string"
            || typeof entryPriceMicros !== "string" || !/^[0-9]+$/.test(entryPriceMicros)
            || typeof slippageBps !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(slippageBps)
            || slippageBps < 1 || slippageBps > 500
            || typeof maxPriceImpactBps !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(maxPriceImpactBps)
            || maxPriceImpactBps < 1 || maxPriceImpactBps > 300
        ) {
            throw new Error(`Strategy ${index} has invalid or missing fields.`)
        }
        if (BigInt(entryPriceMicros) <= BigInt(0)) {
            throw new Error(`Strategy ${id} entryPriceMicros must be greater than zero.`)
        }
        const parsedAmount = parseEther(amountBnb)
        if (parsedAmount <= BigInt(0) || parsedAmount > MAX_TRADE_BNB) {
            throw new Error(`Strategy ${id} trade amount must be greater than zero and at most 0.5 BNB.`)
        }
        const normalizedTarget = getAddress(targetToken)
        if (normalizedTarget !== config.targetTokenAddress) {
            throw new Error(`Strategy ${id} target token must match NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_TARGET_TOKEN_ADDRESS.`)
        }
        return {
            id,
            account: getAddress(account),
            targetToken: normalizedTarget,
            amountBnb: parsedAmount,
            entryPriceMicros: BigInt(entryPriceMicros),
            slippageBps,
            maxPriceImpactBps
        }
    })
}

async function loadProvider<T>(
    modulePath: string | undefined,
    exportName: keyof T,
    errorMessage: string
): Promise<T[keyof T]> {
    if (!modulePath) throw new Error(errorMessage)
    const imported: unknown = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(modulePath)).href)
    if (!isRecord(imported)) throw new Error(`Module ${modulePath} has no named exports.`)
    const provider = imported[exportName as string]
    if (typeof provider !== "function") {
        throw new Error(`Module ${modulePath} must export ${String(exportName)} as a function.`)
    }
    return provider as T[keyof T]
}

export async function fetchMarketData(
    strategy: AgentStrategy,
    config: AgentSmartAccountConfig,
    client: PublicClient,
    marketProvider?: MarketDataProvider["fetchMarketData"]
): Promise<MarketSnapshot & { quote?: MockMarketQuote }> {
    if (marketProvider) {
        const snapshot = await marketProvider(strategy, { config, client })
        return { ...snapshot, receivedAt: Date.now() }
    }

    const receivedAt = Date.now()
    const quote: MockMarketQuote = {
        tokenIn: config.wrappedNativeAddress,
        tokenOut: strategy.targetToken,
        amountIn: strategy.amountBnb,
        amountOutMin: BigInt(1),
        timestamp: receivedAt
    }
    console.info(JSON.stringify({
        event: "mock_market_quote",
        tokenIn: quote.tokenIn,
        tokenOut: quote.tokenOut,
        amountIn: quote.amountIn.toString(),
        amountOutMin: quote.amountOutMin.toString(),
        timestamp: quote.timestamp
    }))

    return {
        priceMicros: strategy.entryPriceMicros + BigInt(1),
        reserves: MOCK_RESERVES,
        observedAt: receivedAt,
        receivedAt,
        quote
    }
}

async function createWorkerRuntime() {
    const config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
    const agentAccount = loadPrivateKey()
    const strategies = readStrategies(config)
    const publicClient = createAgentPublicClient(config)
    const validatorReader = createViemValidatorReader(publicClient, config.policyHookAddress)
    const marketProvider = process.env.AGENT_MARKET_DATA_MODULE
        ? await loadProvider<MarketDataProvider>(
            process.env.AGENT_MARKET_DATA_MODULE,
            "fetchMarketData",
            "AGENT_MARKET_DATA_MODULE is required for live market data."
        )
        : undefined
    const getOwnerValidator = marketProvider
        ? await loadProvider<OwnerValidatorProvider>(
            process.env.AGENT_OWNER_VALIDATOR_MODULE,
            "getOwnerValidator",
            "AGENT_OWNER_VALIDATOR_MODULE must provide the account's owner validator."
        )
        : async () => {
            throw new Error("Owner validator provider is required before live UserOperation submission.")
        }

    const workerReference: { current: AgentWorker | undefined } = { current: undefined }
    const reportExecutionFailure = createWorkerFailureReporter({
        reportExecutionFailure: (strategyId, reasonCode, detail) => {
            workerReference.current?.reportExecutionFailure(strategyId, reasonCode, detail)
        }
    })
    const executor = new AgentExecutor({
        getConfig: () => config,
        resolveAuthorization: async intent => ({
            ownerValidator: await getOwnerValidator(intent.account, config),
            sessionKeySigner: agentAccount
        }),
        maxIntentAgeMs: QUOTE_SUBMISSION_BUDGET_MS,
        log: event => {
            const write = event.event === "userop_failed" ? console.error : console.info
            write(JSON.stringify(event))
        },
        onFailure: reportExecutionFailure
    })

    const worker = new AgentWorker({
        strategies,
        readMarket: strategy => fetchMarketData(
            strategy,
            config,
            publicClient,
            marketProvider
        ),
        readValidator: validatorReader,
        log: event => console.info(JSON.stringify(event)),
        alert: event => console.error(JSON.stringify(event)),
        onIntent: async intent => {
            const quoteReceivedAt = Date.parse(intent.createdAt)
            if (
                !Number.isFinite(quoteReceivedAt)
                || Date.now() - quoteReceivedAt > QUOTE_SUBMISSION_BUDGET_MS
            ) {
                console.warn("Quote stale, aborting")
                worker.acknowledgeIntent(intent.strategyId)
                return
            }
            if (!marketProvider) {
                console.warn("Mock quote produced a signal; UserOperation submission is disabled for mock data.")
                worker.acknowledgeIntent(intent.strategyId)
                return
            }
            try {
                const result = await executor.executeUserOperation(intent)
                console.info(JSON.stringify({
                    event: "agent_trade_submitted",
                    userOpHash: result.userOperationHash,
                    transactionHash: result.transactionHash
                }))
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(JSON.stringify({
                    event: "agent_trade_submission_failed",
                    error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown executor error"
                }))
            } finally {
                worker.acknowledgeIntent(intent.strategyId)
            }
        }
    }, {
        intervalMs: POLL_INTERVAL_MS,
        maxConsecutiveFailures: 3,
        maxMarketAgeMs: 20_000
    })
    workerReference.current = worker

    return worker
}

async function main() {
    const worker = await createWorkerRuntime()
    let shuttingDown = false
    let activePoll: Promise<void> | undefined
    const pollMarkets = async () => {
        if (shuttingDown || activePoll) return
        activePoll = worker.evaluateOnce()
            .catch(error => {
                console.error("Agent market poll failed:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))
            })
            .finally(() => {
                activePoll = undefined
            })
        await activePoll
    }

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
        void pollMarkets()
    }, POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
    void pollMarkets()

    const gracefulShutdown = async (signal: NodeJS.Signals) => {
        if (shuttingDown) return
        shuttingDown = true
        console.info(`Received ${signal}; stopping agent worker.`)
        clearInterval(timer)
        worker.stop()
        await activePoll
        await closeIntentNonceTracker()
        console.info("Agent worker stopped.")
    }
    process.once("SIGINT", () => {
        void gracefulShutdown("SIGINT").catch(error => {
            console.error("Agent worker shutdown failed:", error)
            process.exitCode = 1
        })
    })
    process.once("SIGTERM", () => {
        void gracefulShutdown("SIGTERM").catch(error => {
            console.error("Agent worker shutdown failed:", error)
            process.exitCode = 1
        })
    })
}

const isDirectExecution = process.argv[1] !== undefined
    && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href

if (isDirectExecution) {
    try {
        loadWorkerEnvironment()
        void main().catch(error => {
            console.error("Agent worker failed to start:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))
            process.exitCode = 1
        })
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Agent worker failed to load environment:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))
        process.exitCode = 1
    }
}
import { existsSync } from "node:fs"
import { createRequire } from "node:module"
import { resolve } from "node:path"

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
const { loadEnvConfig } = require("@next/env") as typeof import("@next/env")

export function applyWorkerEnvironmentAliases(env: Record<string, string | undefined>): void {
    const chainId = env.CHAIN_ID ?? env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID ?? env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_CHAIN_ID
    if (chainId && !env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID) {
        env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID = chainId
    }

    if (
        chainId === "97"
        && env.RPC_URL
        && !env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL
    ) {
        env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL = env.RPC_URL
    }
}

export function loadWorkerEnvironment(projectDir = process.cwd()): void {
    loadEnvConfig(projectDir)

    const workerEnvPath = resolve(projectDir, ".env.worker")
    if (existsSync(workerEnvPath)) {
        if (typeof process.loadEnvFile !== "function") {
            throw new Error("Loading .env.worker requires Node.js 20.12.0 or newer.")
        }
        process.loadEnvFile(workerEnvPath)
    }

    applyWorkerEnvironmentAliases(process.env)
}

export type BawExecutionState =
    | "APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
    | "APPROVED"
    | "SUBMITTING"
    | "SUBMITTED"
    | "PENDING"
    | "PARTIALLY_FILLED"
    | "FILLED"
    | "OUTPUT_VERIFIED"
    | "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED"
    | "OUTPUT_MISMATCH"
    | "FAILED"
    | "CANCELLED"
    | "EXPIRED"
    | "UNKNOWN"

export type BawExecutionRecord = {
    executionId: string
    approvalReference: string
    quoteReference: string
    walletAddress: string
    tokenAddress: string
    tokenDecimals: number | null
    fromTokenDecimals: number
    toTokenDecimals: number
    underlyingTicker: string
    tokenSymbol: string
    fromCoinSymbol: string
    toCoinSymbol: string
    direction: "BUY" | "SELL"
    chainId: "56"
    fromTokenAddress: string
    toTokenAddress: string
    requestedInputAmount: string
    expectedOutputAmount: string
    minimumOutputAmount: string
    quoteBinding: string
    quoteFetchedAt: number
    referencePrice: number
    tokenPriceUsd: number
    referenceGapPercent: number | null
    slippageBps: number
    quoteExpiresAt: number
    notionalUsd: number
    state: BawExecutionState
    securityAuditAcknowledged: boolean
    providerOrderId: string | null
    actualExecutedInput: string | null
    actualReceivedOutput: string | null
    refunds: { tokenAddress: string; amount: string; symbol: string }[]
    averageExecutionPrice: string | null
    transactionHash: string | null
    failureReason: string | null
    submittedAt: number | null
    completedAt: number | null
}

export type BawWalletSessionRecord = { address: string; expiresAt: number }

export interface BawExecutionStorePort {
    close(): Promise<void>
    createApproval(record: BawExecutionRecord, tokenHash: string, expiresAt: number, createdAt?: number): Promise<void>
    consumeApproval(executionId: string, tokenHash: string, now: number): Promise<BawExecutionRecord>
    update(record: BawExecutionRecord): Promise<void>
    get(executionId: string): Promise<BawExecutionRecord | null>
    dailyNotionalSince(startOfDay: number, excludeExecutionId?: string): Promise<number>
    createChallenge(nonceHash: string, address: string, expiresAt: number, createdAt: number): Promise<void>
    consumeChallengeAndCreateSession(nonceHash: string, address: string, now: number, sessionId: string, expiresAt: number): Promise<boolean>
    getSession(sessionId: string, now: number): Promise<BawWalletSessionRecord | null>
    revokeSession(sessionId: string, now: number): Promise<void>
}

const ACTIVE_STATES = ["APPROVAL_REQUIRED", "APPROVED", "SUBMITTING", "SUBMITTED", "PENDING", "PARTIALLY_FILLED", "UNKNOWN"]
const MIGRATIONS = [{
    version: 1,
    statements: [
        `CREATE TABLE baw_executions (
            execution_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
            token_hash text NOT NULL,
            token_used boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
            approval_expires_at bigint NOT NULL,
            execution_status text NOT NULL,
            notional_usd numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at bigint NOT NULL,
            record_json jsonb NOT NULL
        )`,
        `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX baw_execution_single_flight
            ON baw_executions ((true))
            WHERE execution_status IN (${ACTIVE_STATES.map((state) => `'${state}'`).join(",")})`,
        "CREATE INDEX baw_execution_daily_limit ON baw_executions (created_at, execution_status)",
        `CREATE TABLE baw_auth_challenges (
            nonce_hash text PRIMARY KEY,
            address text NOT NULL,
            expires_at bigint NOT NULL,
            created_at bigint NOT NULL
        )`,
        `CREATE TABLE baw_auth_sessions (
            session_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
            address text NOT NULL,
            expires_at bigint NOT NULL,
            revoked_at bigint
        )`,
        "CREATE INDEX baw_auth_challenges_expiration ON baw_auth_challenges (expires_at)",
        "CREATE INDEX baw_auth_sessions_expiration ON baw_auth_sessions (expires_at)",
    ],
}]
const MIGRATION_LOCK_ID = 7_891_230_456

export class BawExecutionStoreError extends Error {
    readonly code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "UNSAFE_PATH" | "DUPLICATE" | "NOT_FOUND" | "USED" | "EXPIRED" | "BUSY"

    constructor(code: BawExecutionStoreError["code"]) {
        super(`BAW execution store unavailable: ${code}`)
        this.name = "BawExecutionStoreError"
        this.code = code
    }
}

export class BawExecutionStore implements BawExecutionStorePort {
    private readonly postgres: Sql
    private readonly ready: Promise<void>

    constructor(databaseUrl = process.env.BAW_EXECUTION_DATABASE_URL) {
        if (!databaseUrl) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("NOT_CONFIGURED")
        if (!isPostgresUrl(databaseUrl)) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("UNSAFE_PATH")

        this.postgres = postgres(databaseUrl, {
            max: 1,
            idle_timeout: 20,
            connect_timeout: 5,
            max_lifetime: 300,
            prepare: false,
            ssl: isLocalDevelopmentUrl(databaseUrl) ? false : "verify-full",
        })
        this.ready = this.runMigrations()
    }

    async close(): Promise<void> {
        await this.postgres.end({ timeout: 5 })
    }

    async createApproval(record: BawExecutionRecord, tokenHash: string, expiresAt: number, createdAt = Date.now()): Promise<void> {
        await this.ready
        try {
            await this.postgres.begin(async (transaction) => {
                await transaction`
                    UPDATE baw_executions
                    SET execution_status = 'EXPIRED',
                        record_json = jsonb_set(record_json, '{state}', '"EXPIRED"'::jsonb)
                    WHERE execution_status = 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED' AND approval_expires_at <= ${createdAt}
                `
                await transaction`
                    INSERT INTO baw_executions
                        (execution_id, token_hash, approval_expires_at, execution_status, notional_usd, created_at, record_json)
                    VALUES (${record.executionId}, ${tokenHash}, ${expiresAt}, ${record.state}, 0, ${createdAt}, ${JSON.stringify(record)}::jsonb)
                `
            })
        } catch (error) {
            if (isPostgresConflict(error)) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("BUSY")
            throw error
        }
    }

    async consumeApproval(executionId: string, tokenHash: string, now: number): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
        await this.ready
        const outcome = await this.postgres.begin(async (transaction) => {
            const rows = await transaction`
                SELECT token_hash, token_used, approval_expires_at, execution_status, record_json
                FROM baw_executions WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} FOR UPDATE
            `
            const row = rows[0]
            if (!row) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
            if (
                row.token_used ||
                row.execution_status !== "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" ||
                !safeHashMatch(String(row.token_hash), tokenHash)
            ) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("USED")

            const record = parseRecord(row.record_json)
            if (now >= Number(row.approval_expires_at)) {
                record.state = "EXPIRED"
                await transaction`
                    UPDATE baw_executions
                    SET execution_status = 'EXPIRED', record_json = ${JSON.stringify(record)}::jsonb
                    WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND token_used = false AND execution_status = 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED'
                `
                return { expired: true as const }
            }

            record.state = "APPROVED"
            record.submittedAt = null
            const updated = await transaction`
                UPDATE baw_executions
                SET token_used = true, execution_status = 'APPROVED',
                    notional_usd = ${record.notionalUsd}, record_json = ${JSON.stringify(record)}::jsonb
                WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND token_used = false AND execution_status = 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED'
                RETURNING execution_id
            `
            if (updated.length !== 1) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("USED")
            return { record }
        })
        if ("expired" in outcome) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("EXPIRED")
        return outcome.record
    }

    async update(record: BawExecutionRecord): Promise<void> {
        await this.ready
        const updated = await this.postgres`
            UPDATE baw_executions
            SET execution_status = ${record.state}, record_json = ${JSON.stringify(record)}::jsonb
            WHERE execution_id = ${record.executionId}
            RETURNING execution_id
        `
        if (updated.length !== 1) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
    }

    async get(executionId: string): Promise<BawExecutionRecord | null> {
        await this.ready
        const rows = await this.postgres`
            SELECT record_json FROM baw_executions WHERE execution_id = ${executionId}
        `
        return rows[0] ? parseRecord(rows[0].record_json) : null
    }

    async dailyNotionalSince(startOfDay: number, excludeExecutionId?: string): Promise<number> {
        await this.ready
        const rows = await this.postgres`
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(notional_usd), 0)::text AS total FROM baw_executions
            WHERE created_at >= ${startOfDay}
                AND execution_status NOT IN ('APPROVAL_REQUIRED', 'APPROVED', 'EXPIRED')
                AND (${excludeExecutionId ?? null}::uuid IS NULL OR execution_id <> ${excludeExecutionId ?? null}::uuid)
        `
        return Number(rows[0]?.total ?? 0)
    }

    async createChallenge(nonceHash: string, address: string, expiresAt: number, createdAt: number): Promise<void> {
        await this.ready
        await this.postgres`
            INSERT INTO baw_auth_challenges (nonce_hash, address, expires_at, created_at)
            VALUES (${nonceHash}, ${address}, ${expiresAt}, ${createdAt})
        `
    }

    async consumeChallengeAndCreateSession(
        nonceHash: string,
        address: string,
        now: number,
        sessionId: string,
        expiresAt: number,
    ): Promise<boolean> {
        await this.ready
        return this.postgres.begin(async (transaction) => {
            const consumed = await transaction`
                DELETE FROM baw_auth_challenges
                WHERE nonce_hash = ${nonceHash} AND address = ${address} AND expires_at > ${now}
                RETURNING nonce_hash
            `
            if (consumed.length !== 1) return false
            await transaction`
                INSERT INTO baw_auth_sessions (session_id, address, expires_at, revoked_at)
                VALUES (${sessionId}, ${address}, ${expiresAt}, NULL)
            `
            return true
        })
    }

    async getSession(sessionId: string, now: number): Promise<BawWalletSessionRecord | null> {
        await this.ready
        const rows = await this.postgres`
            SELECT address, expires_at FROM baw_auth_sessions
            WHERE session_id = ${sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > ${now}
        `
        return rows[0] ? { address: String(rows[0].address), expiresAt: Number(rows[0].expires_at) } : null
    }

    async revokeSession(sessionId: string, now: number): Promise<void> {
        await this.ready
        await this.postgres`
            UPDATE baw_auth_sessions SET revoked_at = ${now}
            WHERE session_id = ${sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
        `
    }

    private async runMigrations(): Promise<void> {
        await this.postgres.begin(async (transaction) => {
            await transaction`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(${MIGRATION_LOCK_ID})`
            await transaction`
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS baw_execution_schema_migrations (
                    version integer PRIMARY KEY,
                    applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
                )
            `
            for (const migration of MIGRATIONS) {
                const applied = await transaction`
                    SELECT version FROM baw_execution_schema_migrations WHERE version = ${migration.version}
                `
                if (applied.length) continue
                for (const statement of migration.statements) await transaction.unsafe(statement)
                await transaction`
                    INSERT INTO baw_execution_schema_migrations (version) VALUES (${migration.version})
                `
            }
        })
    }
}

let defaultStore: BawExecutionStore | null = null

export function getDefaultBawExecutionStore(): BawExecutionStore {
    if (!defaultStore) defaultStore = new BawExecutionStore()
    return defaultStore
}

function isPostgresUrl(value: string): boolean {
    try {
        const url = new URL(value)
        return ["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol) &&
            url.hostname.length > 0 &&
            url.username.length > 0 &&
            url.password.length > 0 &&
            !["disable", "allow", "prefer"].includes(url.searchParams.get("sslmode") ?? "")
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

function isPostgresConflict(error: unknown): boolean {
    return typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "code" in error && error.code === "23505"
}

function isLocalDevelopmentUrl(value: string): boolean {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") return false
    try {
        return ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"].includes(new URL(value).hostname)
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

function safeHashMatch(stored: string, requested: string): boolean {
    const storedHash = Buffer.from(stored, "hex")
    const requestedHash = Buffer.from(requested, "hex")
    return storedHash.length === requestedHash.length &&
        storedHash.length > 0 &&
        timingSafeEqual(storedHash, requestedHash)
}

function parseRecord(value: unknown): BawExecutionRecord {
    return (typeof value === "string" ? JSON.parse(value) : value) as BawExecutionRecord
}
import "server-only";

export type AgentAnalysisInput = {
  ticker: string;
  opportunity: {
    spreadPercent: number;
    reason: string;
    evidenceIds: string[];
  };
  observations: Array<{
    observationId: string;
    platform: string;
    price: string;
    currency: string;
    providerTimestamp: string | number;
    verificationStatus: string;
    priceKind: string;
  }>;
  historicalContext: Array<{
    observationId: string;
    price: string;
    source: string;
    providerTimestamp: string | number;
  }>;
  strategyConfiguration: Record<string, unknown>;
  dataFresh: boolean;
};

export type AgentAnalysisResult = {
  modelIdentifier: string;
  modelVersion: string | null;
  interpretation: string;
  opportunityExplanation: string;
  historicalComparison: string;
  upsideScenario: string;
  downsideScenario: string;
  risks: string[];
  dataLimitations: string[];
  invalidatingConditions: string[];
  suggestedNextAction: string;
  evidenceReferences: string[];
  assumptions: string[];
};

export interface AgentAnalysisProvider {
  analyze(input: AgentAnalysisInput): Promise<AgentAnalysisResult>;
}

type ModelConfig = {
  apiKey: string;
  baseUrl: string;
  model: string;
  provider: string;
};

export class AgentAnalysisError extends Error {
  readonly code: "MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED" | "MODEL_UNAVAILABLE" | "INVALID_ANALYSIS";

  constructor(
    code: AgentAnalysisError["code"],
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.code = code;
    this.name = "AgentAnalysisError";
  }
}

export class ConfiguredAgentAnalysisProvider implements AgentAnalysisProvider {
  private readonly config: ModelConfig | null;
  private readonly fetchImplementation: typeof fetch;
  private readonly timeoutMs: number;

  constructor(
    config = resolveModelConfig(),
    fetchImplementation: typeof fetch = fetch,
    timeoutMs = 5_000,
  ) {
    this.config = config;
    this.fetchImplementation = fetchImplementation;
    this.timeoutMs = timeoutMs;
  }

  async analyze(input: AgentAnalysisInput): Promise<AgentAnalysisResult> {
    if (!this.config) {
      throw new AgentAnalysisError("MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED", "No server-side AI analysis provider is configured.");
    }
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await this.fetchImplementation(`${this.config.baseUrl}/chat/completions`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${this.config.apiKey}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: this.config.model,
          temperature: 0,
          max_tokens: 700,
          response_format: { type: "json_object" },
          messages: [
            {
              role: "system",
              content: [
                "Provide a concise, evidence-based market interpretation, not hidden chain-of-thought.",
                "Return only JSON with interpretation, opportunityExplanation, historicalComparison, upsideScenario, downsideScenario, risks, dataLimitations, invalidatingConditions, suggestedNextAction, evidenceReferences, assumptions.",
                "Use only facts present in the evidence. Treat price differences as uncertain, not guaranteed profit.",
                "Do not give permission, override policies, claim calibrated probabilities, or recommend automatic execution.",
                "Return evidenceReferences only from supplied observation IDs.",
              ].join(" "),
            },
            { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify(input) },
          ],
        }),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs),
      });
    } catch {
      throw new AgentAnalysisError("MODEL_UNAVAILABLE", "Configured analysis provider could not be reached.");
    }
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new AgentAnalysisError("MODEL_UNAVAILABLE", `Configured analysis provider returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
    }
    const payload: unknown = await readJson(response);
    const content = readModelContent(payload);
    if (!content) throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", "Analysis provider returned no structured content.");
    let decoded: unknown;
    try {
      decoded = JSON.parse(content);
    } catch {
      throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", "Analysis provider returned malformed structured content.");
    }
    return validateAnalysis(decoded, input, this.config.model);
  }
}

export function validateAnalysis(
  value: unknown,
  input: AgentAnalysisInput,
  modelIdentifier: string,
): AgentAnalysisResult {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", "Analysis output must be an object.");
  const allowedEvidence = new Set([
    ...input.opportunity.evidenceIds,
    ...input.historicalContext.map((entry) => entry.observationId),
  ]);
  const evidenceReferences = stringArray(value.evidenceReferences, "evidenceReferences");
  if (!evidenceReferences.length || evidenceReferences.some((id) => !allowedEvidence.has(id))) {
    throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", "Analysis cited evidence that was not supplied.");
  }
  const risks = stringArray(value.risks, "risks");
  const dataLimitations = stringArray(value.dataLimitations, "dataLimitations");
  const invalidatingConditions = stringArray(value.invalidatingConditions, "invalidatingConditions");
  const assumptions = stringArray(value.assumptions, "assumptions");
  return {
    modelIdentifier,
    modelVersion: null,
    interpretation: requiredText(value.interpretation, "interpretation"),
    opportunityExplanation: requiredText(value.opportunityExplanation, "opportunityExplanation"),
    historicalComparison: requiredText(value.historicalComparison, "historicalComparison"),
    upsideScenario: requiredText(value.upsideScenario, "upsideScenario"),
    downsideScenario: requiredText(value.downsideScenario, "downsideScenario"),
    risks,
    dataLimitations,
    invalidatingConditions,
    suggestedNextAction: requiredText(value.suggestedNextAction, "suggestedNextAction"),
    evidenceReferences: [...new Set(evidenceReferences)],
    assumptions,
  };
}

function resolveModelConfig(): ModelConfig | null {
  const apiKey = process.env.WOLV_AI_API_KEY ?? process.env.GROQ_API_KEY ?? process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) return null;
  const configuredBase = process.env.WOLV_AI_BASE_URL ?? process.env.OPENAI_API_BASE;
  const configuredModel = process.env.WOLV_AI_MODEL;
  const looksLikeGroq = apiKey.startsWith("gsk_") ||
    configuredBase?.includes("api.groq.com") === true ||
    configuredModel?.startsWith("openai/gpt-oss") === true;
  return {
    apiKey,
    baseUrl: (looksLikeGroq
      ? configuredBase && !configuredBase.includes("api.openai.com")
        ? configuredBase
        : "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1"
      : configuredBase ?? "https://api.openai.com/v1").replace(/\/$/, ""),
    model: configuredModel ?? (looksLikeGroq ? "openai/gpt-oss-120b" : "gpt-5-mini"),
    provider: looksLikeGroq ? "groq" : "openai",
  };
}

async function readJson(response: Response): Promise<unknown> {
  try {
    return await response.json() as unknown;
  } catch {
    throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", "Analysis provider returned invalid JSON.");
  }
}

function readModelContent(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !Array.isArray(value.choices) ||
    !isRecord(value.choices[0]) || !isRecord(value.choices[0].message) ||
    typeof value.choices[0].message.content !== "string") return null;
  return value.choices[0].message.content.trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, "").replace(/\s*```$/, "");
}

function requiredText(value: unknown, field: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim() || value.length > 1_000) {
    throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", `Analysis field ${field} is invalid.`);
  }
  return value.trim();
}

function stringArray(value: unknown, field: string): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > 20 ||
    value.some((entry) => typeof entry !== "string" || !entry.trim() || entry.length > 500)) {
    throw new AgentAnalysisError("INVALID_ANALYSIS", `Analysis field ${field} is invalid.`);
  }
  return value.map((entry) => (entry as string).trim());
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

const BAW_CHAIN_ID = "56"
const BAW_NATIVE_BNB_ADDRESS = "0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE"
const APPROVAL_TTL_MS = 15_000
const ORDER_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000
const MAX_ORDER_POLLS = 15
const MAX_CONFIGURED_ORDER_USD = 1_000
const MAX_CONFIGURED_DAILY_USD = 5_000
const MAX_CONFIGURED_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 100
const MIN_BNB_RESERVE = parseUnits("0.01", 18)

export class BawExecutionError extends Error {
    readonly code: string
    readonly status: number

    constructor(
        code: string,
        message: string,
        status = 409,
    ) {
        super(message)
        this.name = "BawExecutionError"
        this.code = code
        this.status = status
    }
}

export type BawExecutionDependencies = {
    store?: BawExecutionStorePort
    runner?: BawRunner
    readSnapshot?: (runner: BawRunner, now: () => number) => Promise<BawWalletSnapshot>
    resolveAsset?: (tokenAddress: string) => Promise<AgentQuoteAsset | null>
    now?: () => number
    sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>
    environment?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv
}

export type BawApprovalResult = {
    executionId: string
    approvalReference: string
    approvalToken: string
    expiresAt: number
    trade: Pick<
        BawExecutionRecord,
        | "walletAddress" | "tokenAddress" | "tokenSymbol" | "direction" | "chainId"
        | "fromTokenAddress" | "toTokenAddress" | "requestedInputAmount"
        | "expectedOutputAmount" | "minimumOutputAmount" | "slippageBps"
        | "quoteExpiresAt" | "referencePrice"
    >
}

export function sanitizeBawExecutionRecord(record: BawExecutionRecord): Omit<BawExecutionRecord, "quoteBinding"> {
    const { quoteBinding: _quoteBinding, ...safeRecord } = record
    void _quoteBinding
    return safeRecord
}

export async function createBawExecutionApproval(
    quoteValue: unknown,
    dependencies: BawExecutionDependencies,
): Promise<BawApprovalResult> {
    const config = getExecutionConfig(dependencies.environment ?? process.env)
    const store = getStore(dependencies.store)
    const now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now
    const runner = dependencies.runner ?? createBawRunner()
    if (!dependencies.resolveAsset) throw new BawExecutionError("ASSET_RESOLVER_UNAVAILABLE", "WOLV spot-asset verification is unavailable.", 503)
    const verified = verifyAgentQuoteResponse(quoteValue, now())
    if (!verified) throw new BawExecutionError("QUOTE_INVALID", "The quote is malformed, expired, or its integrity binding is invalid.", 409)

    const snapshot = await getReadyWalletSnapshot(runner, now, dependencies.readSnapshot)
    const quote = await revalidateQuote(verified.response, runner, snapshot, now, dependencies.resolveAsset)
    validateWalletFunds(snapshot, quote, config.minBnbReserve)
    await validateLimits(store, quote, config, now())

    if (!quote.toTokenMetadata) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN", "The output token's verified decimal metadata is required before a BAW approval can be created.", 422)
    }
    const outputDecimals = quote.toTokenMetadata.decimals
    const amountOut = parsePositiveAmount(quote.toCoinAmount, outputDecimals)
    const minimumOutputAmount = formatUnits(
        amountOut * BigInt(10_000 - quote.slippageBps) / BigInt(10_000),
        outputDecimals,
    )
    const approvalToken = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url")
    const executionId = randomUUID()
    const approvalReference = randomUUID()
    const expiresAt = Math.min(now() + APPROVAL_TTL_MS, quote.expiresAt)
    if (expiresAt <= now()) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("QUOTE_EXPIRED", "The quote expires too soon to approve.", 409)
    }
    const inputAmount = quote.fromCoinAmount
    const notionalUsd = quote.direction === "BUY" ? Number(inputAmount) : Number(quote.toCoinAmount)
    if (!Number.isFinite(notionalUsd) || notionalUsd <= 0) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("INVALID_NOTIONAL", "A valid USDT trade value could not be established.", 422)
    }
    const record: BawExecutionRecord = {
        executionId,
        approvalReference,
        quoteReference: quote.quoteBindingId,
        quoteBinding: quote.quoteBinding,
        quoteFetchedAt: quote.quoteFetchedAt,
        referencePrice: quote.referencePrice,
        tokenPriceUsd: quote.tokenPriceUsd,
        referenceGapPercent: quote.referenceGapPercent,
        walletAddress: quote.walletAddress,
        tokenAddress: quote.tokenAddress,
        tokenDecimals: quote.tokenDecimals,
        fromTokenDecimals: quote.fromTokenMetadata.decimals,
        toTokenDecimals: quote.toTokenMetadata.decimals,
        underlyingTicker: quote.underlyingTicker,
        tokenSymbol: quote.direction === "BUY" ? quote.toCoinSymbol : quote.fromCoinSymbol,
        fromCoinSymbol: quote.fromCoinSymbol,
        toCoinSymbol: quote.toCoinSymbol,
        direction: quote.direction,
        chainId: BAW_CHAIN_ID,
        fromTokenAddress: quote.fromTokenAddress,
        toTokenAddress: quote.toTokenAddress,
        requestedInputAmount: inputAmount,
        expectedOutputAmount: quote.toCoinAmount,
        minimumOutputAmount,
        slippageBps: quote.slippageBps,
        quoteExpiresAt: quote.expiresAt,
        notionalUsd,
        state: "APPROVAL_REQUIRED",
        securityAuditAcknowledged: false,
        providerOrderId: null,
        actualExecutedInput: null,
        actualReceivedOutput: null,
        refunds: [],
        averageExecutionPrice: null,
        transactionHash: null,
        failureReason: null,
        submittedAt: null,
        completedAt: null,
    }
    try {
        await store.createApproval(record, hashSecret(approvalToken), expiresAt, now())
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawExecutionStoreError) {
            throw new BawExecutionError(error.code, "Another BAW execution is active or persistent storage is unavailable.", 409)
        }
        throw error
    }

    return {
        executionId,
        approvalReference,
        approvalToken,
        expiresAt,
        trade: {
            walletAddress: record.walletAddress,
            tokenAddress: record.tokenAddress,
            tokenSymbol: record.tokenSymbol,
            direction: record.direction,
            chainId: record.chainId,
            fromTokenAddress: record.fromTokenAddress,
            toTokenAddress: record.toTokenAddress,
            requestedInputAmount: record.requestedInputAmount,
            expectedOutputAmount: record.expectedOutputAmount,
            minimumOutputAmount: record.minimumOutputAmount,
            slippageBps: record.slippageBps,
            quoteExpiresAt: record.quoteExpiresAt,
            referencePrice: record.referencePrice,
        },
    }
}

export async function executeApprovedBawTrade(
    request: { executionId: string; approvalToken: string; securityAuditAcknowledged: boolean },
    dependencies: BawExecutionDependencies,
): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
    const config = getExecutionConfig(dependencies.environment ?? process.env)
    const store = getStore(dependencies.store)
    const now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now
    const runner = dependencies.runner ?? createBawRunner()
    if (!dependencies.resolveAsset) throw new BawExecutionError("ASSET_RESOLVER_UNAVAILABLE", "WOLV spot-asset verification is unavailable.", 503)
    if (
        !isUuid(request.executionId) ||
        typeof request.approvalToken !== "string" ||
        !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(request.approvalToken) ||
        request.securityAuditAcknowledged !== true
    ) throw new BawExecutionError("APPROVAL_INVALID", "A valid one-time approval is required.", 401)

    let record: BawExecutionRecord
    try {
        record = await store.consumeApproval(request.executionId, hashSecret(request.approvalToken), now())
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawExecutionStoreError) {
            throw new BawExecutionError(`APPROVAL_${error.code}`, "Approval is missing, expired, already used, or another execution is active.", 409)
        }
        throw error
    }

    try {
        record.securityAuditAcknowledged = true
        await store.update(record)
        if (now() >= record.quoteExpiresAt) {
            return await failRecord(store, record, "Quote expired before the order could be submitted.", now())
        }
        const quoteBinding = verifyQuoteBinding(record.quoteBinding, {
            toToken: record.toTokenAddress,
            fromToken: record.fromTokenAddress,
            amount: record.requestedInputAmount,
            wallet: record.walletAddress,
            quoteId: record.quoteReference,
            chainId: record.chainId,
            direction: record.direction,
            slippageBps: record.slippageBps,
        }, now())
        if (!quoteBinding.ok || quoteBinding.issuedAt !== record.quoteFetchedAt) {
            return await failRecord(store, record, "Quote integrity verification failed.", now())
        }

        const snapshot = await getReadyWalletSnapshot(runner, now, dependencies.readSnapshot)
        if (snapshot.addresses.find((address) => address.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID)?.address.toLowerCase()
            !== record.walletAddress.toLowerCase()) {
            return await failRecord(store, record, "The connected BAW operator wallet changed after approval.", now())
        }
        const freshQuote = await getBawQuote({
            direction: record.direction,
            tokenAddress: record.tokenAddress,
            amount: record.requestedInputAmount,
            chainId: record.chainId,
            slippageBps: record.slippageBps,
        }, {
            runner,
            readSnapshot: async () => snapshot,
            resolveAsset: dependencies.resolveAsset,
            now,
        })
        if (!sameApprovedQuote(record, freshQuote)) {
            return await failRecord(store, record, "The live quote changed after approval. Request and approve a new quote.", now())
        }
        validateWalletFunds(snapshot, freshQuote, config.minBnbReserve)
        await validateLimits(store, freshQuote, config, now(), record.executionId)

        const amount = freshQuote.fromCoinAmount
        const slippagePercent = slippageBpsToBawPercent(record.slippageBps)
        const args = buildBawMarketSwapArgs({
            direction: record.direction,
            tokenAddress: record.tokenAddress,
            amount,
            chainId: record.chainId,
            slippagePercent,
        })
        record.state = "SUBMITTING"
        record.submittedAt = now()
        await store.update(record)
        let orderId: string
        try {
            const result = await runner(args)
            orderId = parseBawMarketOrderSubmitOutput(result.stdout)
        } catch (error) {
            const uncertain = !(error instanceof BawCliError) ||
                ["BAW_TIMEOUT", "BAW_COMMAND_FAILED", "INVALID_OUTPUT"].includes(error.code)
            record.state = uncertain ? "UNKNOWN" : "FAILED"
            record.failureReason = error instanceof BawCliError
                ? `BAW submission could not be confirmed (${error.code}).`
                : "BAW submission outcome could not be confirmed."
            record.completedAt = record.state === "FAILED" ? now() : null
            await store.update(record)
            return record
        }
        record.providerOrderId = orderId
        record.state = "SUBMITTED"
        await store.update(record)
        return await monitorBawOrder(record, runner, store, now, dependencies.sleep)
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawExecutionError) {
            record.state = "FAILED"
            record.failureReason = error.message
            record.completedAt = now()
            await store.update(record)
            throw error
        }
        record.state = "FAILED"
        record.failureReason = error instanceof BawCliError
            ? `BAW preflight failed (${error.code}).`
            : "BAW preflight or execution failed."
        record.completedAt = record.state === "FAILED" ? now() : null
        await store.update(record)
        throw error
    }
}

export async function reconcileBawExecution(
    executionId: string,
    dependencies: BawExecutionDependencies,
): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
    const store = getStore(dependencies.store)
    const record = await store.get(executionId)
    if (!record) throw new BawExecutionError("EXECUTION_NOT_FOUND", "Execution record was not found.", 404)
    if (!["APPROVED", "SUBMITTING", "SUBMITTED", "PENDING", "UNKNOWN"].includes(record.state)) return record
    const runner = dependencies.runner ?? createBawRunner()
    if (!record.providerOrderId) {
        if (!record.submittedAt) {
            if (record.state === "APPROVED") {
                record.state = "FAILED"
                record.failureReason = "The process stopped after approval but before recording a submission attempt. No order was submitted."
                record.completedAt = (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)()
                await store.update(record)
                return record
            }
            record.state = "UNKNOWN"
            record.failureReason = "The process stopped before a submission timestamp was recorded; manual reconciliation is required."
            await store.update(record)
            return record
        }
        return reconcileUncertainSubmission(record, runner, store, dependencies.now ?? Date.now, dependencies.sleep)
    }
    return monitorBawOrder(record, runner, store, dependencies.now ?? Date.now, dependencies.sleep)
}

async function reconcileUncertainSubmission(
    record: BawExecutionRecord,
    runner: BawRunner,
    store: BawExecutionStorePort,
    now: () => number,
    sleep: ((milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>) | undefined,
): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
    if (!record.submittedAt) return record
    try {
        const history = await runner(buildBawMarketOrderReconciliationArgs({
            fromToken: record.fromTokenAddress,
            toToken: record.toTokenAddress,
            startTime: record.submittedAt,
            endTime: now(),
        }))
        const candidates = parseBawMarketOrderHistoryOutput(history.stdout).filter((order) =>
            order.chain === record.chainId &&
            order.fromToken.toLowerCase() === record.fromTokenAddress.toLowerCase() &&
            order.toToken.toLowerCase() === record.toTokenAddress.toLowerCase() &&
            BigInt(parseUnits(order.fromTokenQty, 18)) === BigInt(parseUnits(record.requestedInputAmount, 18)) &&
            Date.parse(order.bookTime) >= record.submittedAt! &&
            Date.parse(order.bookTime) <= now()
        )
        if (candidates.length !== 1) {
            record.failureReason = candidates.length
                ? "More than one matching BAW history entry exists; manual reconciliation is required."
                : "No unique matching BAW order was found; do not retry this execution."
            await store.update(record)
            return record
        }
        record.providerOrderId = candidates[0].orderId
        record.state = "SUBMITTED"
        await store.update(record)
        return monitorBawOrder(record, runner, store, now, sleep)
    } catch {
        record.failureReason = "BAW order history could not reconcile the uncertain submission; do not retry."
        await store.update(record)
        return record
    }
}

export function compareBawOutputQuantity(
    actualOutput: string | null | undefined,
): { state: "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED"; reason: string; actualReceivedOutput: string | null } {
    if (actualOutput === null || actualOutput === undefined || actualOutput.trim() === "") {
        return {
            state: "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED",
            reason: "BAW reported FINISHED without actual output quantity; fill status cannot be verified.",
            actualReceivedOutput: null,
        }
    }
    return {
        state: "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED",
        reason: "BAW actual-output units and independent settlement semantics are not documented; fill status cannot be verified.",
        actualReceivedOutput: actualOutput,
    }
}

async function monitorBawOrder(
    record: BawExecutionRecord,
    runner: BawRunner,
    store: BawExecutionStorePort,
    now: () => number,
    sleep: ((milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>) | undefined,
): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
    if (!record.providerOrderId) return record
    const startedAt = now()
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_ORDER_POLLS; attempt += 1) {
        try {
            const response = await runner(buildBawMarketOrderListArgs(record.providerOrderId))
            const order = parseBawMarketOrderListOutput(response.stdout, {
                orderId: record.providerOrderId,
                fromToken: record.fromTokenAddress,
                toToken: record.toTokenAddress,
                amount: record.requestedInputAmount,
            })
            record.actualReceivedOutput = order.toTokenActualQty ?? null
            record.refunds = order.refund ?? []
            record.transactionHash = order.txHash ?? null
            if (order.status === "FAILED") {
                record.state = "FAILED"
                record.failureReason = "BAW reported FAILED."
                record.completedAt = now()
                await store.update(record)
                return record
            }
            if (order.status === "FINISHED") {
                const comparison = compareBawOutputQuantity(order.toTokenActualQty)
                record.actualReceivedOutput = comparison.actualReceivedOutput
                record.state = comparison.state
                record.failureReason = comparison.reason
                record.completedAt = now()
                await store.update(record)
                return record
            }
            record.state = "PENDING"
            await store.update(record)
        } catch {
            record.state = "UNKNOWN"
            record.failureReason = "The BAW order status could not be established; do not submit another order."
            await store.update(record)
            return record
        }
        if (now() - startedAt >= ORDER_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS) break
        await (sleep ?? delay)(2_000)
    }
    record.state = "PENDING"
    await store.update(record)
    return record
}

async function getReadyWalletSnapshot(
    runner: BawRunner,
    now: () => number,
    readSnapshot: BawExecutionDependencies["readSnapshot"],
): Promise<BawWalletSnapshot> {
    const snapshot = await (readSnapshot ?? ((cli, clock) => readWalletSnapshot({ runner: cli, now: clock })))(runner, now)
    if (!snapshot.connected) throw new BawExecutionError("WALLET_DISCONNECTED", "The BAW operator wallet is disconnected.", 409)
    if (snapshot.errors.length) throw new BawExecutionError("WALLET_SNAPSHOT_INCOMPLETE", "BAW wallet status, address, balances, or settings could not be verified.", 503)
    if (!snapshot.chains.some((chain) => chain.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID)) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN", "The connected BAW wallet does not report BNB Smart Chain.", 409)
    }
    const settings = snapshot.settings
    if (!settings || Date.parse(settings.sessionExpireTime) <= now()) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("WALLET_SESSION_EXPIRED", "The BAW operator session is expired or has no verified expiry.", 409)
    }
    const address = snapshot.addresses.find((candidate) => candidate.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID)?.address
    if (!address || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(address)) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("WALLET_ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE", "The BAW operator address for BNB Smart Chain could not be verified.", 409)
    }
    return snapshot
}

async function revalidateQuote(
    original: AgentQuoteResponse,
    runner: BawRunner,
    snapshot: BawWalletSnapshot,
    now: () => number,
    resolveAsset: BawExecutionDependencies["resolveAsset"],
) {
    const fresh = await getBawQuote({
        direction: original.direction,
        tokenAddress: original.tokenAddress,
        amount: original.fromCoinAmount,
        chainId: original.chainId,
        slippageBps: original.slippageBps,
    }, {
        runner,
        readSnapshot: async () => snapshot,
        resolveAsset,
        now,
    })
    if (!sameApprovedQuote({
        walletAddress: original.walletAddress,
        tokenAddress: original.tokenAddress,
        underlyingTicker: original.underlyingTicker,
        direction: original.direction,
        fromTokenAddress: original.fromTokenAddress,
        toTokenAddress: original.toTokenAddress,
        requestedInputAmount: original.fromCoinAmount,
        expectedOutputAmount: original.toCoinAmount,
        slippageBps: original.slippageBps,
        referencePrice: original.referencePrice,
        tokenPriceUsd: original.tokenPriceUsd,
        referenceGapPercent: original.referenceGapPercent,
        fromCoinSymbol: original.fromCoinSymbol,
        toCoinSymbol: original.toCoinSymbol,
        fromTokenDecimals: original.fromTokenMetadata.decimals,
        toTokenDecimals: original.toTokenMetadata.decimals,
    }, fresh)) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("QUOTE_CHANGED", "The live quote changed. Request a new quote before approval.", 409)
    }
    return fresh
}

function sameApprovedQuote(
    record: Pick<BawExecutionRecord,
        | "walletAddress" | "tokenAddress" | "direction" | "fromTokenAddress" | "toTokenAddress"
        | "underlyingTicker" | "requestedInputAmount" | "expectedOutputAmount" | "slippageBps" | "referencePrice"
        | "tokenPriceUsd" | "referenceGapPercent" | "fromCoinSymbol" | "toCoinSymbol"
        | "fromTokenDecimals" | "toTokenDecimals"
    >,
    quote: AgentQuoteResponse,
): boolean {
    return quote.eligibility === "ELIGIBLE" &&
        quote.walletAddress.toLowerCase() === record.walletAddress.toLowerCase() &&
        quote.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() === record.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() &&
        quote.underlyingTicker === record.underlyingTicker &&
        quote.direction === record.direction &&
        quote.fromTokenAddress.toLowerCase() === record.fromTokenAddress.toLowerCase() &&
        quote.toTokenAddress.toLowerCase() === record.toTokenAddress.toLowerCase() &&
        quote.fromCoinAmount === record.requestedInputAmount &&
        quote.toCoinAmount === record.expectedOutputAmount &&
        quote.fromCoinSymbol === record.fromCoinSymbol &&
        quote.toCoinSymbol === record.toCoinSymbol &&
        quote.fromTokenMetadata.decimals === record.fromTokenDecimals &&
        quote.toTokenMetadata.decimals === record.toTokenDecimals &&
        quote.slippageBps === record.slippageBps &&
        quote.referencePrice === record.referencePrice &&
        quote.tokenPriceUsd === record.tokenPriceUsd &&
        quote.referenceGapPercent === record.referenceGapPercent
}

function validateWalletFunds(snapshot: BawWalletSnapshot, quote: AgentQuoteResponse, minimumBnbReserve: string): void {
    const from = quote.direction === "BUY" ? BSC_USDT_ADDRESS : quote.tokenAddress
    const inputBalance = snapshot.balances.find((balance) =>
        balance.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID &&
        balance.contractAddress.toLowerCase() === from.toLowerCase()
    )
    const inputDecimals = quote.fromTokenMetadata.decimals
    const availableInput = inputBalance ? parseBalanceAmount(inputBalance.balance, inputDecimals) : null
    if (availableInput === null || availableInput < parsePositiveAmount(quote.fromCoinAmount, inputDecimals)) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("INSUFFICIENT_TRADE_BALANCE", "BAW does not report sufficient source-token balance.", 409)
    }
    const bnbBalance = snapshot.balances.find((balance) =>
        balance.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID &&
        balance.contractAddress.toLowerCase() === BAW_NATIVE_BNB_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() &&
        balance.symbol.toUpperCase() === "BNB"
    )
    const availableBnb = bnbBalance ? parseBalanceAmount(bnbBalance.balance) : null
    if (availableBnb === null || availableBnb < parsePositiveAmount(minimumBnbReserve)) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("INSUFFICIENT_FEE_RESERVE", "BAW does not report the configured BNB fee reserve.", 409)
    }
    const settings = snapshot.settings
    const notionalUsd = quote.direction === "BUY" ? Number(quote.fromCoinAmount) : Number(quote.toCoinAmount)
    if (!settings || !Number.isFinite(notionalUsd) || notionalUsd > settings.quotaLeft) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("WALLET_DAILY_LIMIT", "The requested trade exceeds BAW's reported remaining daily quota.", 409)
    }
}

async function validateLimits(
    store: BawExecutionStorePort,
    quote: AgentQuoteResponse,
    config: ExecutionConfig,
    now: number,
    excludeExecutionId?: string,
): Promise<void> {
    const notionalUsd = quote.direction === "BUY" ? Number(quote.fromCoinAmount) : Number(quote.toCoinAmount)
    if (!Number.isFinite(notionalUsd) || notionalUsd <= 0 || notionalUsd > config.maxOrderUsd) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("ORDER_LIMIT", "The order exceeds the configured per-order maximum.", 409)
    }
    if (quote.slippageBps > config.maxSlippageBps) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("SLIPPAGE_LIMIT", "The quote exceeds the configured maximum execution slippage.", 409)
    }
    const dayStart = new Date(now)
    dayStart.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
    if (await store.dailyNotionalSince(dayStart.getTime(), excludeExecutionId) + notionalUsd > config.dailyLimitUsd) {
        throw new BawExecutionError("DAILY_LIMIT", "The order exceeds the configured persistent daily execution limit.", 409)
    }
}

type ExecutionConfig = {
    maxOrderUsd: number
    dailyLimitUsd: number
    maxSlippageBps: number
    minBnbReserve: string
}

function getExecutionConfig(environment: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): ExecutionConfig {
    if (environment.VERCEL === "1") {
        throw new BawExecutionError("PERSISTENT_HOST_REQUIRED", "BAW execution is not available on Vercel serverless.", 503)
    }
    if (environment.BAW_EXECUTION_ENABLED !== "true" || environment.BAW_EXECUTION_KILL_SWITCH !== "false") {
        throw new BawExecutionError("EXECUTION_DISABLED", "BAW order execution is disabled or the kill switch is active.", 503)
    }
    const maxOrderUsd = Number(environment.BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_ORDER_USDT)
    const dailyLimitUsd = Number(environment.BAW_EXECUTION_DAILY_LIMIT_USDT)
    const maxSlippageBps = Number(environment.BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS)
    const minBnbReserve = environment.BAW_EXECUTION_MIN_BNB_RESERVE ?? ""
    if (
        !Number.isFinite(maxOrderUsd) || maxOrderUsd <= 0 || maxOrderUsd > MAX_CONFIGURED_ORDER_USD ||
        !Number.isFinite(dailyLimitUsd) || dailyLimitUsd <= 0 || dailyLimitUsd > MAX_CONFIGURED_DAILY_USD ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(maxSlippageBps) || maxSlippageBps < 1 || maxSlippageBps > MAX_CONFIGURED_SLIPPAGE_BPS ||
        !DECIMAL_AMOUNT.test(minBnbReserve) ||
        parsePositiveAmount(minBnbReserve) < MIN_BNB_RESERVE
    ) {
        throw new BawExecutionError(
            "EXECUTION_LIMITS_NOT_CONFIGURED",
            "Per-order, daily, slippage, and minimum BNB reserve limits must be configured within hard caps.",
            503,
        )
    }
    return { maxOrderUsd, dailyLimitUsd, maxSlippageBps, minBnbReserve }
}

function parsePositiveAmount(value: string, decimals = 18): bigint {
    if (!DECIMAL_AMOUNT.test(value)) throw new BawExecutionError("INVALID_AMOUNT", "A BAW amount is malformed.", 422)
    try {
        const amount = parseUnits(value, decimals)
        if (amount <= BigInt(0) || amount > UINT256_MAX) throw new Error("amount out of range")
        return amount
    } catch {
        throw new BawExecutionError("INVALID_AMOUNT", "A BAW amount is outside the supported range.", 422)
    }
}

function parseBalanceAmount(value: string, decimals = 18): bigint | null {
    if (!DECIMAL_AMOUNT.test(value)) return null
    try {
        const amount = parseUnits(value, decimals)
        return amount >= BigInt(0) && amount <= UINT256_MAX ? amount : null
    } catch {
        return null
    }
}

async function failRecord(
    store: BawExecutionStorePort,
    record: BawExecutionRecord,
    reason: string,
    now: number,
): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
    record.state = "FAILED"
    record.failureReason = reason
    record.completedAt = now
    await store.update(record)
    return record
}

function hashSecret(value: string): string {
    return createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex")
}

function getStore(store?: BawExecutionStorePort): BawExecutionStorePort {
    if (store) return store
    try {
        return getDefaultBawExecutionStore()
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawExecutionStoreError) {
            throw new BawExecutionError(
                "PERSISTENT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
                "Durable BAW execution storage is not configured on this host.",
                503,
            )
        }
        throw error
    }
}

function isUuid(value: string): boolean {
    return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(value)
}

function delay(milliseconds: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds))
}
import "server-only";
import {
  call,
  estimateGas,
  getBalance,
  getChainId,
  getGasPrice,
  getBlockNumber,
} from "viem/actions";
import {
  decodeFunctionData,
  getAddress,
  isAddress,
  parseEther,
  type Address,
  type Client,
  type Hex,
} from "viem";
import {
  buildAgentBuyCall,
  createAgentPublicClient,
  getAgentSmartAccountConfig,
  type AgentSmartAccountConfig,
} from "../lib/smartAccount.ts";
import {
  authorizeBawWalletRequest,
  getBawWalletSession,
  readBawWalletAuthJson,
  type BawWalletAuthorization,
} from "./bawWalletAuth.ts";

const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 4_096;
const MAX_TRADE_VALUE = parseEther("0.5");
const MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 100;
const MAX_DEADLINE_SECONDS = 300;
const HEADERS = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" };

const ROUTER_ABI = [
  {
    type: "function",
    name: "swapExactETHForTokens",
    stateMutability: "payable",
    inputs: [
      { name: "amountOutMin", type: "uint256" },
      { name: "path", type: "address[]" },
      { name: "to", type: "address" },
      { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
    ],
    outputs: [{ name: "amounts", type: "uint256[]" }],
  },
] as const;

type SimulationCall = {
  account: Address;
  to: Address;
  value: bigint;
  data: Hex;
};

type SimulationRpc = {
  getChainId(): Promise<number>;
  getBlockNumber(): Promise<bigint>;
  getBalance(account: Address): Promise<bigint>;
  getGasPrice(): Promise<bigint>;
  estimateGas(transaction: SimulationCall): Promise<bigint>;
  call(transaction: SimulationCall): Promise<unknown>;
};

type SimulationInput = {
  amountBnb: string;
  slippageBps: number;
};

export class AgentTransactionSimulationError extends Error {
  readonly code:
    | "INVALID_INPUT"
    | "CONFIG_INVALID"
    | "CHAIN_MISMATCH"
    | "ROUTE_INVALID"
    | "BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT"
    | "RPC_ERROR";
  readonly status: number;

  constructor(
    code: AgentTransactionSimulationError["code"],
    message: string,
    status: number,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AgentTransactionSimulationError";
    this.code = code;
    this.status = status;
  }
}

export type AgentTransactionSimulationDependencies = {
  authorize?: (request: Request) => Promise<BawWalletAuthorization>;
  getOwnerAddress?: (request: Request) => Promise<string | null>;
  getConfig?: () => AgentSmartAccountConfig;
  createPublicClient?: (config: AgentSmartAccountConfig) => Client;
  createRpc?: (config: AgentSmartAccountConfig) => SimulationRpc;
  buildBuyCall?: typeof buildAgentBuyCall;
  now?: () => number;
};

export async function simulateAgentTransaction(
  input: SimulationInput,
  ownerAddress: string,
  dependencies: Pick<
    AgentTransactionSimulationDependencies,
    "getConfig" | "createPublicClient" | "createRpc" | "buildBuyCall" | "now"
  > = {},
) {
  let config: AgentSmartAccountConfig;
  try {
    config = (dependencies.getConfig ?? getAgentSmartAccountConfig)();
  } catch {
    throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
      "CONFIG_INVALID",
      "Agent simulation configuration is unavailable.",
      503,
    );
  }
  if (config.chain.id !== 97) {
    throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
      "CHAIN_MISMATCH",
      "Agent transaction simulation is restricted to BSC testnet (chain ID 97).",
      409,
    );
  }

  if (!isAddress(ownerAddress)) {
    throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
      "INVALID_INPUT",
      "Wallet session address is invalid.",
      401,
    );
  }
  const owner = getAddress(ownerAddress);
  if (
    typeof input.amountBnb !== "string" ||
    !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d{1,18})?$/.test(input.amountBnb)
  ) {
    throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
      "INVALID_INPUT",
      "Simulation amount must be a positive decimal BNB amount.",
      422,
    );
  }
  const amountBnb = parseEther(input.amountBnb);
  if (
    amountBnb <= BigInt(0) ||
    amountBnb > MAX_TRADE_VALUE ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(input.slippageBps) ||
    input.slippageBps < 1 ||
    input.slippageBps > MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS
  ) {
    throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
      "INVALID_INPUT",
      "Simulation amount or slippage is outside the configured limit.",
      422,
    );
  }

  const rpc = (dependencies.createRpc ?? createSimulationRpc)(config);
  try {
    const chainId = await rpc.getChainId();
    if (chainId !== 97) {
      throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
        "CHAIN_MISMATCH",
        "RPC chain does not match BSC testnet (chain ID 97).",
        409,
      );
    }

    const built = await (dependencies.buildBuyCall ?? buildAgentBuyCall)(
      (dependencies.createPublicClient ?? createAgentPublicClient)(config),
      {
        accountAddress: owner,
        amountBnb,
        slippageBps: input.slippageBps,
        maxPriceImpactBps: 300,
      },
      config,
    );
    const decoded = decodeFunctionData({
      abi: ROUTER_ABI,
      data: built.data,
    });
    const [minimumOutput, path, recipient, deadline] = decoded.args;
    const nowSeconds = BigInt(Math.floor((dependencies.now ?? Date.now)() / 1000));
    if (
      built.to.toLowerCase() !== config.routerAddress.toLowerCase() ||
      built.value !== amountBnb ||
      decoded.functionName !== "swapExactETHForTokens" ||
      minimumOutput <= BigInt(0) ||
      minimumOutput !== built.quote.amountOutMin ||
      built.quote.slippageBps !== input.slippageBps ||
      built.quote.priceImpactBps > 300 ||
      path.length !== 2 ||
      path[0].toLowerCase() !== config.wrappedNativeAddress.toLowerCase() ||
      path[1].toLowerCase() !== config.targetTokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
      recipient.toLowerCase() !== owner.toLowerCase() ||
      deadline <= nowSeconds ||
      deadline > nowSeconds + BigInt(MAX_DEADLINE_SECONDS)
    ) {
      throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
        "ROUTE_INVALID",
        "Built transaction does not match the configured router, token path, recipient, or spend limit.",
        422,
      );
    }

    const transaction: SimulationCall = {
      account: owner,
      to: built.to,
      value: built.value,
      data: built.data,
    };
    const [blockNumber, balance, gasPrice, gasEstimate] = await Promise.all([
      rpc.getBlockNumber(),
      rpc.getBalance(owner),
      rpc.getGasPrice(),
      rpc.estimateGas(transaction),
    ]);
    const requiredBalance = built.value + gasEstimate * gasPrice;
    if (balance < requiredBalance) {
      throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
        "BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT",
        "Wallet balance does not cover the trade value and estimated network fee.",
        422,
      );
    }
    await rpc.call(transaction);

    return {
      status: "SIMULATION_PASSED" as const,
      chainId,
      blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
      simulatedAt: (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)(),
      account: owner,
      router: built.to,
      targetToken: config.targetTokenAddress,
      tokenPath: path,
      amountBnb: input.amountBnb,
      expectedAmountOut: built.quote.expectedAmountOut.toString(),
      minimumAmountOut: minimumOutput.toString(),
      slippageBps: built.quote.slippageBps,
      priceImpactBps: built.quote.priceImpactBps,
      estimatedGas: gasEstimate.toString(),
      estimatedGasPriceWei: gasPrice.toString(),
      estimatedNetworkFeeWei: (gasEstimate * gasPrice).toString(),
      execution: {
        signingRequested: false,
        transactionBroadcast: false,
        executionEnabled: false,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AgentTransactionSimulationError) throw error;
    throw new AgentTransactionSimulationError(
      "RPC_ERROR",
      "BSC testnet could not complete the read-only transaction simulation.",
      502,
    );
  }
}

export async function handleAgentTransactionSimulationPost(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentTransactionSimulationDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await (dependencies.authorize ?? ((incoming) =>
    authorizeBawWalletRequest(incoming, process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN)))(request);
  if (authorization !== "authorized") {
    const status = authorization === "not_configured" ||
      authorization === "storage_unavailable" ? 503 : 401;
    return json({
      error: authorization === "not_configured"
        ? "Agent simulation access is not configured."
        : authorization === "storage_unavailable"
          ? "Operator authorization storage is unavailable."
          : "A valid operator authorization is required.",
    }, status);
  }
  if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
    return json({ error: "Content-Type must be application/json." }, 400);
  }

  const parsed = await readBawWalletAuthJson(request, MAX_BODY_BYTES);
  if (!parsed.ok) return json({ error: parsed.message }, parsed.status);
  const input = parseSimulationInput(parsed.value);
  if (!input) {
    return json({
      error: "Simulation request must contain only amountBnb and slippageBps within the configured limits.",
    }, 422);
  }

  let ownerAddress: string | null;
  try {
    ownerAddress = dependencies.getOwnerAddress
      ? await dependencies.getOwnerAddress(request)
      : (await getBawWalletSession(request, process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN))?.address ?? null;
  } catch {
    return json({ error: "Browser-wallet authorization storage is unavailable." }, 503);
  }
  if (!ownerAddress) return json({ error: "A valid operator wallet session is required." }, 401);

  try {
    return json(await simulateAgentTransaction(input, ownerAddress, dependencies));
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AgentTransactionSimulationError) {
      return json({ error: error.message, code: error.code }, error.status);
    }
    console.error("Agent transaction simulation failed:", error);
    return json({
      error: "Agent transaction simulation could not be completed.",
      code: "SIMULATION_FAILED",
    }, 502);
  }
}

function parseSimulationInput(value: unknown): SimulationInput | null {
  if (
    typeof value !== "object" ||
    value === null ||
    Array.isArray(value) ||
    Object.keys(value).length !== 2
  ) return null;
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (
    typeof record.amountBnb !== "string" ||
    !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d{1,18})?$/.test(record.amountBnb) ||
    typeof record.slippageBps !== "number" ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(record.slippageBps) ||
    record.slippageBps < 1 ||
    record.slippageBps > MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS
  ) return null;
  try {
    const amount = parseEther(record.amountBnb);
    if (amount <= BigInt(0) || amount > MAX_TRADE_VALUE) return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  return { amountBnb: record.amountBnb, slippageBps: record.slippageBps };
}

function createSimulationRpc(config: AgentSmartAccountConfig): SimulationRpc {
  const client = createAgentPublicClient(config);
  return {
    getChainId: () => getChainId(client),
    getBlockNumber: () => getBlockNumber(client),
    getBalance: (account) => getBalance(client, { address: account }),
    getGasPrice: () => getGasPrice(client),
    estimateGas: (transaction) => estimateGas(client, transaction),
    call: (transaction) => call(client, transaction),
  };
}

function json(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  return Response.json(body, { status, headers: HEADERS });
}
import "server-only";
import { authorizeBawWalletRequest, getBawWalletSession } from "./bawWalletAuth.ts";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import {
  AgentControlPlaneError,
  validateRiskPolicy,
  type RiskPolicy,
} from "../lib/agentControlPlane.ts";
