import { ConfiguredAgentAnalysisProvider } from "./agentAnalysis.ts";
import { AgentOrchestrator, type AgentRunRequest } from "./agentOrchestrator.ts";
import { MarketCollectorError, MarketDataCollector } from "./marketDataCollector.ts";

const HEADERS = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" };
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 8_192;
const MAX_PERMISSION_TTL_MS = 30 * 60_000;

export type AgentControlHttpDependencies = {
  authorize?: (request: Request) => Promise<"authorized" | "unauthorized" | "not_configured" | "storage_unavailable">;
  getOwnerAddress?: (request: Request) => Promise<string | null>;
  createStore?: () => AgentMemoryStorePort;
  createOrchestrator?: (store: AgentMemoryStorePort) => AgentOrchestrator;
  now?: () => number;
};

export async function handleAgentControlGet(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  const filters = parseActivityFilters(new URL(request.url).searchParams, authorization.ownerAddress);
  if (!filters.ok) return json({ error: filters.error }, 400);
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    const now = (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)();
    await store.expirePendingProposals(now, authorization.ownerAddress);
    await store.expireOpportunities(now, authorization.ownerAddress);
    const [control, activity, proposals, policyRefusals, observations, activePolicy, opportunities, analyses, evaluations] = await Promise.all([
      store.getControlState(now),
      store.listActivity(filters.value),
      store.listProposals(authorization.ownerAddress, 20),
      store.getPolicyRefusals(authorization.ownerAddress, 20),
      store.getRecentObservations({ ownerAddress: authorization.ownerAddress, limit: 20 }),
      store.getActivePolicy(authorization.ownerAddress, "default"),
      store.listOpportunities({ ownerAddress: authorization.ownerAddress, limit: 20 }),
      store.listAnalyses(authorization.ownerAddress, 20),
      store.getStrategyEvaluations({ ownerAddress: authorization.ownerAddress, limit: 20 }),
    ]);
    return json({
      control,
      activity: activity.items,
      nextCursor: activity.nextCursor,
      proposals,
      policyRefusals,
      observations,
      activePolicy,
      opportunities,
      analyses,
      strategyEvaluations: evaluations,
      execution: { enabled: false, status: "EXECUTION_BLOCKED" },
      configuration: {
        orchestrationEnabled: process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED === "true",
        collectorEnabled: process.env.WOLV_MARKET_COLLECTOR_ENABLED === "true",
        databaseConfigured: Boolean(process.env.WOLV_AGENT_DATABASE_URL ?? process.env.WOLV_TRADING_DATABASE_URL),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Agent activity could not be loaded.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

export async function handleAgentControlPost(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  const parsed = await readBoundedJson(request);
  if (!parsed.ok) return json({ error: parsed.error }, parsed.status);
  if (!isRecord(parsed.value)) return json({ error: "Request body must be an object." }, 422);

  const now = (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)();
  const body = parsed.value;
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    if (body.action === "STOP" && hasExactKeys(body, ["action", "reason"]) &&
      typeof body.reason === "string" && body.reason.trim().length > 0) {
      await store.setEmergencyStop({
        ownerAddress: authorization.ownerAddress,
        stopped: true,
        reason: body.reason.trim().slice(0, 500),
        permissionExpiresAt: null,
        updatedAt: now,
        correlationId: randomUUID(),
      });
    } else if (body.action === "ENABLE" && hasExactKeys(body, ["action", "reason", "permissionTtlMs"]) &&
      typeof body.reason === "string" && body.reason.trim().length > 0 &&
      Number.isSafeInteger(body.permissionTtlMs) &&
      Number(body.permissionTtlMs) >= 60_000 && Number(body.permissionTtlMs) <= MAX_PERMISSION_TTL_MS) {
      if (process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED !== "true") {
        return json({ error: "Agent orchestration is disabled by server configuration." }, 503);
      }
      await store.setEmergencyStop({
        ownerAddress: authorization.ownerAddress,
        stopped: false,
        reason: body.reason.trim().slice(0, 500),
        permissionExpiresAt: now + Number(body.permissionTtlMs),
        updatedAt: now,
        correlationId: randomUUID(),
      });
    } else {
      return json({ error: "Control request is invalid." }, 422);
    }
    return json({ control: await store.getControlState(now) });
  } catch (error) {
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Agent control state could not be changed.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

export async function handleAgentProposalPost(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  const parsed = await readBoundedJson(request);
  if (!parsed.ok) return json({ error: parsed.error }, parsed.status);
  if (!isRecord(parsed.value) || !hasExactKeys(parsed.value, ["proposalId", "action"]) ||
    typeof parsed.value.proposalId !== "string" ||
    !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(parsed.value.proposalId) ||
    !["APPROVE", "REJECT", "REVOKE"].includes(String(parsed.value.action))) {
    return json({ error: "Proposal decision is invalid." }, 422);
  }
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    const result = await store.decideProposal(
      parsed.value.proposalId,
      authorization.ownerAddress,
      parsed.value.action as "APPROVE" | "REJECT" | "REVOKE",
      (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)(),
    );
    return json({ proposalId: parsed.value.proposalId, ...result, execution: "BLOCKED" });
  } catch (error) {
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Proposal decision could not be recorded.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

export async function handleAgentPolicyGet(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  const name = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("name") ?? "default";
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(name)) return json({ error: "Policy name is invalid." }, 400);
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    return json({ name, policy: await store.getActivePolicy(authorization.ownerAddress, name) });
  } catch (error) {
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Active risk policy could not be loaded.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

export async function handleAgentPolicyPost(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  const parsed = await readBoundedJson(request);
  if (!parsed.ok) return json({ error: parsed.error }, parsed.status);
  if (!isRecord(parsed.value) || !hasExactKeys(parsed.value, ["name", "policy", "activate"]) ||
    typeof parsed.value.name !== "string" ||
    !/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(parsed.value.name) ||
    typeof parsed.value.activate !== "boolean" ||
    !isRiskPolicy(parsed.value.policy)) {
    return json({ error: "Risk policy request is invalid." }, 422);
  }
  const errors = validateRiskPolicy(parsed.value.policy);
  const now = (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)();
  if (errors.length || parsed.value.policy.permissionExpiresAt <= now) {
    return json({ error: "Risk policy is invalid or its permission has expired.", reasons: errors }, 422);
  }
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    const policyId = await store.savePolicy(
      authorization.ownerAddress,
      parsed.value.name,
      parsed.value.policy,
      now,
      parsed.value.activate,
    );
    return json({ policyId, name: parsed.value.name, version: parsed.value.policy.version, active: parsed.value.activate }, 201);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof TypeError) return json({ error: error.message }, 422);
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Risk policy could not be stored.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

export async function handleAgentRunPost(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  if (process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED !== "true" ||
    process.env.WOLV_MARKET_COLLECTOR_ENABLED !== "true") {
    return json({ error: "Agent orchestration and market collection must be explicitly enabled by the operator." }, 503);
  }
  const parsed = await readBoundedJson(request);
  if (!parsed.ok) return json({ error: parsed.error }, parsed.status);
  if (!isAgentRunRequest(parsed.value)) return json({ error: "Agent run request is invalid." }, 422);
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    const orchestrator = dependencies.createOrchestrator
      ? dependencies.createOrchestrator(store)
      : await createConfiguredOrchestrator(store);
    const result = await orchestrator.run({ ...parsed.value, ownerAddress: authorization.ownerAddress });
    return json(result, 200);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AgentControlPlaneError) {
      const status = error.code === "INVALID_INPUT" ? 422
        : error.code === "EMERGENCY_STOP" ? 423
          : error.code === "UNAVAILABLE" ? 503 : 409;
      return json({ error: error.message, code: error.code }, status);
    }
    if (error instanceof MarketCollectorError) {
      return json({ error: error.message, code: error.code }, error.code === "DISABLED" ? 503 : 502);
    }
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Agent run did not complete.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

export async function handleAgentRunGet(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
  const authorization = await authorize(request, dependencies);
  if (authorization.status !== "authorized") return authResponse(authorization.status);
  const runId = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("runId");
  if (!runId || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(runId)) {
    return json({ error: "A valid runId is required." }, 400);
  }
  let store: AgentMemoryStorePort | undefined;
  try {
    store = createStore(dependencies);
    await store.initialize();
    const result = await store.reconstructRun(runId, authorization.ownerAddress);
    return result ? json(result) : json({ error: "Agent run was not found." }, 404);
  } catch (error) {
    return storeErrorResponse(error, "Agent run history could not be reconstructed.");
  } finally {
    if (store) await store.close();
  }
}

async function createConfiguredOrchestrator(store: AgentMemoryStorePort): Promise<AgentOrchestrator> {
  const { BinanceAgentMarketAdapter } = await import("./binanceAgentMarketAdapter.ts");
  const collector = new MarketDataCollector(store, new BinanceAgentMarketAdapter());
  return new AgentOrchestrator(store, collector, new ConfiguredAgentAnalysisProvider());
}

function createStore(dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies): AgentMemoryStorePort {
  return dependencies.createStore?.() ?? new AgentMemoryStore();
}

async function authorize(
  request: Request,
  dependencies: AgentControlHttpDependencies,
): Promise<{ status: "authorized"; ownerAddress: string } | { status: "unauthorized" | "not_configured" | "storage_unavailable" }> {
  const status = await (dependencies.authorize ?? ((incoming) =>
    authorizeBawWalletRequest(incoming, process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN)))(request);
  if (status !== "authorized") return { status };
  try {
    const address = dependencies.getOwnerAddress
      ? await dependencies.getOwnerAddress(request)
      : (await getBawWalletSession(request, process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN))?.address ?? null;
    if (!address || !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(address)) return { status: "unauthorized" };
    return { status: "authorized", ownerAddress: address.toLowerCase() };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Agent owner session could not be verified.", error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError");
    return { status: "storage_unavailable" };
  }
}

function authResponse(status: "authorized" | "unauthorized" | "not_configured" | "storage_unavailable"): Response {
  if (status === "not_configured") return json({ error: "Operator authorization is not configured." }, 503);
  if (status === "storage_unavailable") return json({ error: "Operator authorization storage is unavailable." }, 503);
  return json({ error: "A valid operator authorization is required." }, 401);
}

function parseActivityFilters(params: URLSearchParams, ownerAddress: string):
  | { ok: true; value: Parameters<AgentMemoryStorePort["listActivity"]>[0] }
  | { ok: false; error: string } {
  const fields = ["limit", "cursor", "agentId", "strategyId", "eventType", "runStatus", "assetId", "since", "until"];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const key of params.keys()) {
    if (!fields.includes(key) || seen.has(key)) return { ok: false, error: "Unsupported or repeated activity filter." };
    seen.add(key);
  }
  const limitValue = params.get("limit");
  const limit = limitValue === null ? undefined : Number(limitValue);
  if (limit !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 100)) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Activity limit must be between 1 and 100." };
  }
  const since = parseTimestampFilter(params.get("since"));
  const until = parseTimestampFilter(params.get("until"));
  const assetId = params.get("assetId") ?? undefined;
  const cursor = params.get("cursor") ?? undefined;
  const textFilters = ["agentId", "strategyId", "eventType", "runStatus"]
    .map((key) => params.get(key))
    .filter((value): value is string => value !== null);
  if (since === false || until === false ||
    (since !== undefined && until !== undefined && since > until) ||
    (assetId !== undefined && !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(assetId)) ||
    (cursor !== undefined && !isValidCursor(cursor)) ||
    textFilters.some((value) => value.length > 64 || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]*$/.test(value))) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Activity time range or asset filter is invalid." };
  }
  const value: Parameters<AgentMemoryStorePort["listActivity"]>[0] = {
    ownerAddress,
    limit,
    cursor,
    agentId: params.get("agentId") ?? undefined,
    strategyId: params.get("strategyId") ?? undefined,
    eventType: params.get("eventType") ?? undefined,
    runStatus: params.get("runStatus") ?? undefined,
    assetId,
    since,
    until,
  };
  return { ok: true, value };
}

function isValidCursor(value: string): boolean {
  if (value.length > 256 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value)) return false;
  try {
    const [timestamp, eventId, extra] = Buffer.from(value, "base64url").toString("utf8").split("\n");
    return extra === undefined &&
      Number.isFinite(Date.parse(timestamp)) &&
      /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(eventId);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function parseTimestampFilter(value: string | null): number | undefined | false {
  if (value === null) return undefined;
  if (!/^(?:\d{10}|\d{13})$/.test(value)) return false;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  const milliseconds = value.length === 10 ? parsed * 1000 : parsed;
  return Number.isSafeInteger(milliseconds) ? milliseconds : false;
}

function isAgentRunRequest(value: unknown): value is Omit<AgentRunRequest, "ownerAddress"> {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !hasExactKeys(value, ["agentId", "watchlist", "strategyConfiguration"]) ||
    typeof value.agentId !== "string" || !Array.isArray(value.watchlist) ||
    !isRecord(value.strategyConfiguration) ||
    !hasExactKeys(value.strategyConfiguration, [
      "minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent",
      "intendedAmount",
      "notionalValue",
      "maximumSlippageBps",
    ])) return false;
  const configuration = value.strategyConfiguration;
  return typeof configuration.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent === "number" &&
    typeof configuration.intendedAmount === "string" &&
    typeof configuration.notionalValue === "string" &&
    typeof configuration.maximumSlippageBps === "number" &&
    value.watchlist.every((item) => typeof item === "string");
}

function isRiskPolicy(value: unknown): value is RiskPolicy {
  return isRecord(value) && hasExactKeys(value, [
    "version",
    "approvedAssets",
    "approvedDirections",
    "maxOrderValue",
    "maxDailyExposure",
    "maxProposalsPerHour",
    "maxSlippageBps",
    "maxReferenceDeviationPercent",
    "allowedSessions",
    "minimumBalance",
    "quoteTtlMs",
    "permissionExpiresAt",
    "emergencyStop",
  ]);
}

async function readBoundedJson(request: Request):
  Promise<{ ok: true; value: unknown } | { ok: false; status: 400 | 413; error: string }> {
  if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
    return { ok: false, status: 400, error: "Content-Type must be application/json." };
  }
  const contentLength = request.headers.get("content-length");
  if (contentLength !== null && (!/^\d+$/.test(contentLength) || Number(contentLength) > MAX_BODY_BYTES)) {
    return { ok: false, status: Number(contentLength) > MAX_BODY_BYTES ? 413 : 400, error: "Request body is invalid or too large." };
  }
  const reader = request.body?.getReader();
  if (!reader) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: "Request body must contain valid JSON." };
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      total += value.byteLength;
      if (total > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
        await reader.cancel();
        return { ok: false, status: 413, error: "Request body exceeds the 8 KB limit." };
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 400, error: "Request body could not be read." };
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  try {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(total);
    let offset = 0;
    for (const chunk of chunks) {
      bytes.set(chunk, offset);
      offset += chunk.byteLength;
    }
    return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes)) as unknown };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 400, error: "Request body must be valid UTF-8 JSON." };
  }
}

function storeErrorResponse(error: unknown, fallback: string): Response {
  if (error instanceof AgentMemoryStoreError) {
    const status = error.code === "RATE_LIMITED" ? 429
      : error.code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404
      : error.code === "INVALID_TRANSITION" || error.code === "DUPLICATE" ||
        error.code === "POLICY_CHANGED" ? 409
        : error.code === "EMERGENCY_STOP" ? 423 : 503;
    return json({ error: fallback, code: error.code }, status);
  }
  console.error("Agent control-plane request failed.", error instanceof Error ? error.name : "UnknownError");
  return json({ error: fallback, code: "AGENT_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE" }, 503);
}

function hasExactKeys(record: Record<string, unknown>, expected: string[]): boolean {
  return Object.keys(record).length === expected.length && expected.every((key) => Object.hasOwn(record, key));
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function json(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  return Response.json(body, { status, headers: HEADERS });
}

export type AgentExecutorErrorCode =
    | "LIVE_SUBMISSION_DISABLED"
    | "MAINNET_SUBMISSION_BLOCKED"
    | "INTENT_INVALID"
    | "INTENT_STALE"
    | "INTENT_NONCE_UNAVAILABLE"
    | "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED"
    | "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED"
    | "ONCHAIN_EXECUTION_REVERTED"
    | "USEROP_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT"
    | "RPC_FAILURE"

export class AgentExecutorError extends Error {
    readonly code: AgentExecutorErrorCode
    readonly cause?: unknown

    constructor(
        code: AgentExecutorErrorCode,
        message: string,
        cause?: unknown
    ) {
        super(message)
        this.name = "AgentExecutorError"
        this.code = code
        this.cause = cause
    }
}

export function isLiveUserOperationSubmissionEnabled(
    env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
) {
    return env.ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION === "true"
}

export function resolveAgentExecutionNetwork(
    configuredChainId: number,
    env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
):
    | { allowed: true; chainId: 97 | 56 }
    | { allowed: false; reason: string } {
    if (configuredChainId === 97) {
        return env.ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION === "true"
            ? { allowed: true, chainId: 97 }
            : { allowed: false, reason: "Live BSC Testnet submission is disabled." };
    }
    if (configuredChainId === 56) {
        if (env.ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION !== "true") {
            return { allowed: false, reason: "Live submission is disabled." };
        }
        if (env.ENABLE_MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING !== "true") {
            return { allowed: false, reason: "Separate mainnet trading authorization is disabled." };
        }
        if (env.MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING_ACK !== "I_ACCEPT_AUTONOMOUS_MAINNET_RISK") {
            return { allowed: false, reason: "Mainnet autonomous-trading acknowledgement is missing." };
        }
        return { allowed: true, chainId: 56 };
    }
    return { allowed: false, reason: `Unsupported agent execution chain ID: ${configuredChainId}.` };
}

export async function readAgentValidatorState(client: Client, account: Address) {
    const config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
    const [paused, installed, revoked, rollingVolume, accountPolicy] = await Promise.all([
        readContract(client, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: VALIDATOR_ABI,
            functionName: "paused"
        }),
        readContract(client, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: VALIDATOR_ABI,
            functionName: "isInitialized",
            args: [account]
        }),
        readContract(client, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: VALIDATOR_ABI,
            functionName: "isRevoked",
            args: [account]
        }),
        readContract(client, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: VALIDATOR_ABI,
            functionName: "getEffectiveRollingVolume",
            args: [account]
        }),
        readContract(client, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: VALIDATOR_ABI,
            functionName: "getAccountPolicy",
            args: [account]
        })
    ])
    const [policyConfigured, policyHash, maxTradeValue, expiresAt, intentSigner] = accountPolicy
    return {
        paused,
        installed,
        revoked,
        rollingVolume,
        policyConfigured,
        policyHash,
        maxTradeValue,
        expiresAt,
        intentSigner
    }
}

export class AgentExecutor {
    private readonly dependencies: AgentExecutorDependencies
    private readonly now: () => number
    private readonly maxIntentAgeMs: number
    private readonly receiptTimeoutMs: number
    private readonly receiptPollingIntervalMs: number

    constructor(dependencies: AgentExecutorDependencies) {
        this.dependencies = dependencies
        this.now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now
        this.maxIntentAgeMs = dependencies.maxIntentAgeMs ?? DEFAULT_MAX_INTENT_AGE_MS
        this.receiptTimeoutMs = dependencies.receiptTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT_MS
        this.receiptPollingIntervalMs =
            dependencies.receiptPollingIntervalMs ?? DEFAULT_RECEIPT_POLLING_INTERVAL_MS
        for (const [name, value] of [
            ["maxIntentAgeMs", this.maxIntentAgeMs],
            ["receiptTimeoutMs", this.receiptTimeoutMs],
            ["receiptPollingIntervalMs", this.receiptPollingIntervalMs]
        ] as const) {
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
                throw new Error(`${name} must be a positive safe integer`)
            }
        }
        if (this.maxIntentAgeMs > DEFAULT_MAX_INTENT_AGE_MS) {
            throw new Error("maxIntentAgeMs cannot exceed 20000ms")
        }
    }

    async executeUserOperation(intent: AgentExecutionIntent) {
        const metadata = {
            strategyId: intent.strategyId,
            account: intent.account,
            targetToken: intent.targetToken,
            amountBnb: intent.amountBnb.toString()
        }
        const log = this.dependencies.log ?? (event => {
            const method = event.event === "userop_failed" ? console.error : console.info
            method(JSON.stringify(event))
        })

        try {
            if (!(this.dependencies.isLiveEnabled ?? isLiveUserOperationSubmissionEnabled)()) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "LIVE_SUBMISSION_DISABLED",
                    "Live UserOperation submission is disabled; set ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION=true to enable it"
                )
            }
            const config = this.dependencies.getConfig?.() ?? getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
            const networkGate = resolveAgentExecutionNetwork(config.chain.id, {
                ...process.env,
                ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION: "true",
            })
            if (!networkGate.allowed) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "MAINNET_SUBMISSION_BLOCKED",
                    networkGate.reason
                )
            }
            this.validateIntent(intent, config)

            const authorization = await this.dependencies.resolveAuthorization(intent)
            const { account, client } = await (
                this.dependencies.createAccountClient ?? createAgentSmartAccountClient
            )(
                authorization.ownerValidator,
                authorization.sessionKeySigner,
                config
            )
            if (getAddress(account.address) !== getAddress(intent.account)) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "INTENT_INVALID",
                    `Resolved smart account ${account.address} does not match intent account ${intent.account}`
                )
            }

            const validator = await (
                this.dependencies.readValidator ?? readAgentValidatorState
            )(client.client, account.address)
            const delegatedSigner = this.dependencies.createIntentSigner
                ? await this.dependencies.createIntentSigner(authorization.sessionKeySigner)
                : await toECDSASigner({ signer: authorization.sessionKeySigner })
            const intentSigner = getAddress(delegatedSigner.getSignerData())
            this.validateValidatorState(validator, intent, intentSigner)

            const expiresAt = validator.expiresAt
            if (expiresAt === undefined) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
                    "On-chain policy expiry is unavailable."
                )
            }
            const nowSeconds = Math.floor(this.now() / 1000)
            const validUntil = Math.min(nowSeconds + INTENT_VALIDITY_SECONDS, Number(expiresAt))
            const deadline = Math.min(
                nowSeconds + AGENT_SWAP_DEADLINE_SECONDS,
                validUntil
            )
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(validUntil) || validUntil <= nowSeconds) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "INTENT_STALE",
                    "On-chain policy expires before this intent can be submitted."
                )
            }
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(deadline) || deadline <= nowSeconds) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "INTENT_STALE",
                    "On-chain policy expires before the swap deadline."
                )
            }
            const call = await (this.dependencies.buildBuyCall ?? buildAgentBuyCall)(
                client.client,
                {
                    accountAddress: account.address,
                    amountBnb: intent.amountBnb,
                    slippageBps: intent.slippageBps,
                    maxPriceImpactBps: intent.maxPriceImpactBps,
                    deadline
                },
                config
            )
            const amountOutMin =
                intent.amountOutMin > call.quote.amountOutMin
                    ? intent.amountOutMin
                    : call.quote.amountOutMin
            const safeCall = amountOutMin === call.quote.amountOutMin
                ? call
                : {
                    ...call,
                    ...(this.dependencies.encodeBuyCall ?? encodeAgentBuyCall)(
                        {
                            accountAddress: account.address,
                            amountBnb: intent.amountBnb,
                            deadline
                        },
                        amountOutMin,
                        config
                    ),
                    quote: { ...call.quote, amountOutMin }
                }
            let intentNonce: Hex
            try {
                intentNonce = await (this.dependencies.getNextIntentNonce ?? getNextIntentNonce)(
                    account.address
                )
            } catch (error) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "INTENT_NONCE_UNAVAILABLE",
                    error instanceof AgentIntentNonceError
                        ? error.message
                        : "Persistent intent nonce allocation failed.",
                    error
                )
            }
            const signedIntent = {
                smartAccount: getAddress(account.address),
                policyHash: intent.policyHash,
                router: getAddress(config.routerAddress),
                tokenIn: getAddress(config.wrappedNativeAddress),
                tokenOut: getAddress(intent.targetToken),
                recipient: getAddress(account.address),
                amountIn: intent.amountBnb,
                amountOutMin: safeCall.quote.amountOutMin,
                deadline: BigInt(deadline),
                slippageBps: intent.slippageBps,
                maxPriceImpactBps: intent.maxPriceImpactBps,
                validUntil: BigInt(validUntil),
                nonce: intentNonce
            }
            let intentSignature: Hex
            try {
                intentSignature = await signTradeIntent(
                    delegatedSigner,
                    {
                        domain: {
                            name: "WolvTradingAgent",
                            version: "1",
                            chainId: config.chain.id,
                            verifyingContract: config.policyHookAddress
                        },
                        types: TRADE_INTENT_TYPES,
                        primaryType: "TradeIntent",
                        message: signedIntent
                    }
                )
            } catch (error) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "INTENT_INVALID",
                    `Delegated intent signer could not sign the on-chain authorization: ${errorMessage(error)}`,
                    error
                )
            }
            this.validateIntent(intent, config)
            const submissionTimeSeconds = Math.floor(this.now() / 1000)
            if (submissionTimeSeconds >= validUntil || submissionTimeSeconds >= deadline) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "INTENT_STALE",
                    "Execution intent expired before UserOperation submission."
                )
            }
            const intentEnvelope = encodeAbiParameters(
                [
                    { type: "bytes32" },
                    { type: "bytes32" },
                    { type: "uint64" },
                    { type: "uint16" },
                    { type: "uint16" },
                    { type: "bytes" }
                ],
                [
                    intent.policyHash,
                    intentNonce,
                    BigInt(validUntil),
                    intent.slippageBps,
                    intent.maxPriceImpactBps,
                    intentSignature
                ]
            )
            const authorizedCall = {
                ...safeCall,
                data: concatHex([safeCall.data, intentEnvelope])
            }

            log({
                event: "userop_prepared",
                ...metadata,
                timestamp: this.timestamp(),
                priceImpactBps: safeCall.quote.priceImpactBps
            })

            let userOperationHash: Hex
            try {
                userOperationHash = await client.sendUserOperation({
                    calls: [{
                        to: authorizedCall.to,
                        value: authorizedCall.value,
                        data: authorizedCall.data
                    }]
                })
            } catch (error) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED",
                    `Bundler rejected UserOperation during submission: ${errorMessage(error)}`,
                    error
                )
            }

            log({
                event: "userop_submitted",
                ...metadata,
                timestamp: this.timestamp(),
                userOperationHash,
                priceImpactBps: safeCall.quote.priceImpactBps
            })

            let receipt: AgentReceipt
            try {
                receipt = await client.waitForUserOperationReceipt({
                    hash: userOperationHash,
                    timeout: this.receiptTimeoutMs,
                    pollingInterval: this.receiptPollingIntervalMs,
                    retryCount: Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.ceil(this.receiptTimeoutMs / this.receiptPollingIntervalMs)
                    )
                })
            } catch (error) {
                const message = errorMessage(error)
                const code = /timeout|timed out/i.test(message)
                    ? "USEROP_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT"
                    : "RPC_FAILURE"
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    code,
                    `Failed while polling UserOperation receipt: ${message}`,
                    error
                )
            }
            if (!receipt.success) {
                throw new AgentExecutorError(
                    "ONCHAIN_EXECUTION_REVERTED",
                    `UserOperation was included but execution reverted: ${receipt.reason ?? "unknown revert reason"}`
                )
            }

            const result = {
                userOperationHash,
                transactionHash: receipt.receipt.transactionHash,
                receipt,
                gasUsed: receipt.actualGasUsed,
                gasCostWei: receipt.actualGasCost,
                status: "success" as const
            }
            log({
                event: "userop_confirmed",
                ...metadata,
                timestamp: this.timestamp(),
                userOperationHash,
                transactionHash: result.transactionHash,
                gasUsed: result.gasUsed.toString(),
                gasCostWei: result.gasCostWei.toString(),
                priceImpactBps: safeCall.quote.priceImpactBps
            })
            return result
        } catch (error) {
            const executorError = error instanceof AgentExecutorError
                ? error
                : new AgentExecutorError(
                    "RPC_FAILURE",
                    errorMessage(error),
                    error
                )
            log({
                event: "userop_failed",
                code: executorError.code,
                ...metadata,
                timestamp: this.timestamp(),
                error: executorError.message
            })
            if (executorError.code !== "LIVE_SUBMISSION_DISABLED") {
                this.dependencies.onFailure?.(intent, executorError.code, executorError)
            }
            throw executorError
        }
    }

    private validateIntent(intent: AgentExecutionIntent, config: AgentSmartAccountConfig) {
        const createdAt = Date.parse(intent.createdAt)
        if (
            !intent.strategyId
            || !Number.isFinite(createdAt)
            || !/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(intent.account)
            || !/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(intent.targetToken)
            || getAddress(intent.targetToken) !== getAddress(config.targetTokenAddress)
            || !/^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(intent.policyHash)
            || intent.amountBnb <= BigInt(0)
            || intent.amountBnb > MAX_TRADE_BNB
            || intent.amountOutMin <= BigInt(0)
            || !Number.isInteger(intent.priceImpactBps)
            || intent.priceImpactBps < 0
            || !Number.isInteger(intent.slippageBps)
            || intent.slippageBps < 1
            || intent.slippageBps > 500
            || !Number.isInteger(intent.maxPriceImpactBps)
            || intent.maxPriceImpactBps < 1
            || intent.maxPriceImpactBps > 300
            || intent.priceImpactBps > intent.maxPriceImpactBps
        ) {
            throw new AgentExecutorError("INTENT_INVALID", "Execution intent failed validation")
        }
        if (createdAt > this.now() || this.now() - createdAt >= this.maxIntentAgeMs) {
            throw new AgentExecutorError("INTENT_STALE", "Execution intent is stale")
        }
    }

    private validateValidatorState(
        validator: {
            paused: boolean
            installed: boolean
            revoked: boolean
            rollingVolume: bigint
            policyConfigured?: boolean
            policyHash?: Hex
            maxTradeValue?: bigint
            expiresAt?: bigint
            intentSigner?: Address
        },
        intent: AgentExecutionIntent,
        signer: Address
    ) {
        const amountBnb = intent.amountBnb
        const policyExpired = validator.policyConfigured === true &&
            (validator.expiresAt === undefined
                || validator.expiresAt === BigInt(0)
                || validator.expiresAt * BigInt(1000) <= BigInt(this.now()))
        const policyCapExceeded = validator.policyConfigured === true &&
            (validator.maxTradeValue === undefined || amountBnb > validator.maxTradeValue)
        const policyHashMismatch = validator.policyConfigured === true &&
            (!intent.policyHash || !validator.policyHash ||
                intent.policyHash.toLowerCase() !== validator.policyHash.toLowerCase())
        const intentSignerMismatch = !validator.intentSigner
            || !/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(validator.intentSigner)
            || getAddress(validator.intentSigner) !== getAddress(signer)
        if (
            validator.paused
            || !validator.installed
            || validator.revoked
            || validator.rollingVolume < BigInt(0)
            || validator.rollingVolume > MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB
            || amountBnb > MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB - validator.rollingVolume
            || policyExpired
            || policyCapExceeded
            || policyHashMismatch
            || intentSignerMismatch
            || validator.policyConfigured !== true
        ) {
            throw new AgentExecutorError(
                "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
                "Validator policy, signer, pause, session state, or rolling-cap check rejected the intent"
            )
        }
    }

    private timestamp() {
        return new Date(this.now()).toISOString()
    }
}

async function signTradeIntent(
    signer: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof toECDSASigner>>,
    typedData: {
        domain: {
            name: string
            version: string
            chainId: number
            verifyingContract: Address
        }
        types: typeof TRADE_INTENT_TYPES
        primaryType: "TradeIntent"
        message: {
            smartAccount: Address
            policyHash: Hex
            router: Address
            tokenIn: Address
            tokenOut: Address
            recipient: Address
            amountIn: bigint
            amountOutMin: bigint
            deadline: bigint
            slippageBps: number
            maxPriceImpactBps: number
            validUntil: bigint
            nonce: Hex
        }
    }
): Promise<Hex> {
    return signer.account.signTypedData(typedData)
}

export function createWorkerFailureReporter(
    worker: {
        reportExecutionFailure: (
            strategyId: string,
            reasonCode: "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED" | "ONCHAIN_EXECUTION_REVERTED" | "USEROP_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT" | "RPC_FAILURE",
            detail: string
        ) => void
    }
) {
    return (
        intent: AgentExecutionIntent,
        code: AgentExecutorErrorCode,
        error: Error
    ) => {
        if (
            code === "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED"
            || code === "ONCHAIN_EXECUTION_REVERTED"
            || code === "USEROP_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT"
            || code === "RPC_FAILURE"
            || code === "INTENT_NONCE_UNAVAILABLE"
        ) {
            worker.reportExecutionFailure(
                intent.strategyId,
                code === "INTENT_NONCE_UNAVAILABLE" ? "RPC_FAILURE" : code,
                error.message
            )
        }
    }
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
        const candidate = error as Error & { shortMessage?: string; details?: string }
        return candidate.shortMessage ?? candidate.details ?? candidate.message
    }
    return "Unknown UserOperation error"
}
import { authorizeBawWalletRequest } from "./bawWalletAuth.ts"
import {
    BawQuoteError,
    parseAgentQuoteInput,
    type AgentQuoteInput,
    type AgentQuoteResponse,
} from "./bawQuote.ts"
import { BawCliError } from "./bawCli.ts"

const MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 8_192
const RESPONSE_HEADERS = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" }

type JsonBodyResult =
    | { ok: true; value: unknown }
    | { ok: false; status: 400 | 413; message: string }

export type BawQuoteHttpDependencies = {
    configuredToken?: string
    quote?: (input: AgentQuoteInput) => Promise<AgentQuoteResponse>
}

export async function handleBawQuotePost(
    request: Request,
    dependencies: BawQuoteHttpDependencies = {},
): Promise<Response> {
    const authorization = await authorizeBawWalletRequest(
        request,
        dependencies.configuredToken ?? process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN,
    )
    if (authorization === "not_configured") {
        return rejected("BAW_ACCESS_NOT_CONFIGURED", "Operator wallet access is not configured on this host.", 503)
    }
    if (authorization === "unauthorized") {
        return rejected("BAW_ACCESS_DENIED", "The operator access token is missing or invalid.", 401)
    }
    if (authorization === "storage_unavailable") {
        return rejected("BAW_AUTH_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE", "Browser-wallet authentication storage is unavailable.", 503)
    }

    if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
        return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", "Content-Type must be application/json.", 400)
    }
    const body = await readBoundedJson(request)
    if (!body.ok) return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", body.message, body.status)

    const parsedInput = parseAgentQuoteInput(body.value)
    if (!parsedInput.ok) return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", parsedInput.reason, 422)

    try {
        const quote = await (dependencies.quote ?? defaultQuoteUnavailable)(parsedInput.input)
        return Response.json(quote, { status: 200, headers: RESPONSE_HEADERS })
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawQuoteError) {
            return rejected(error.code, error.message, error.status)
        }
        if (error instanceof BawCliError) {
            return mapCliError(error)
        }
        console.error("BAW quote request failed:", error)
        return rejected("QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE", "The BAW quote service is temporarily unavailable.", 502)
    }
}

function defaultQuoteUnavailable(): Promise<AgentQuoteResponse> {
    return Promise.reject(new Error("BAW quote service dependency is not configured"))
}

function mapCliError(error: BawCliError): Response {
    if (error.code === "BAW_UNAVAILABLE") {
        return rejected(error.code, "Binance Agentic Wallet CLI is not available on this host.", 503)
    }
    if (error.code === "BAW_TIMEOUT") {
        return rejected(error.code, "Binance Agentic Wallet CLI did not respond in time.", 504)
    }
    if (error.code === "BAW_RATE_LIMITED") {
        return rejected(error.code, "Binance Agentic Wallet rate limit was reached. Retry after a delay.", 429)
    }
    return rejected(error.code, "Binance Agentic Wallet returned an invalid or unsuccessful quote response.", 502)
}

function rejected(code: string, message: string, status: number): Response {
    return Response.json(
        { status: "REJECTED", code, error: message, rejectionReasons: [message] },
        { status, headers: RESPONSE_HEADERS },
    )
}

async function readBoundedJson(request: Request): Promise<JsonBodyResult> {
    const contentLength = request.headers.get("content-length")
    if (contentLength !== null) {
        if (!/^\d+$/.test(contentLength)) {
            return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Content-Length must be a non-negative integer." }
        }
        if (Number(contentLength) > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES) {
            return { ok: false, status: 413, message: "Request body exceeds the 8 KB limit." }
        }
    }

    const reader = request.body?.getReader()
    if (!reader) return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Request body must contain valid JSON." }

    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
    let totalBytes = 0
    try {
        while (true) {
            const { done, value } = await reader.read()
            if (done) break
            totalBytes += value.byteLength
            if (totalBytes > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES) {
                await reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined)
                return { ok: false, status: 413, message: "Request body exceeds the 8 KB limit." }
            }
            chunks.push(value)
        }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Request body could not be read." }
    } finally {
        reader.releaseLock()
    }

    try {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(totalBytes)
        let offset = 0
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
            bytes.set(chunk, offset)
            offset += chunk.byteLength
        }
        const text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes)
        return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(text) as unknown }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Request body must be valid UTF-8 JSON." }
    }
}
import "server-only"
import {
    createPublicClient,
    defineChain,
    getAddress,
    http,
    type Address,
    type PublicClient,
} from "viem"
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN } from "../lib/apiValidation.ts"
import { isSpotEligibleAsset } from "../lib/compliance.ts"
import { resolvePublicRpcUrl } from "../lib/publicRpcUrl.ts"
import type { RwaAssetRecord } from "../lib/spotAssets.ts"

const SUPPORTED_DECIMALS_MAX = 18
const DECIMALS_ABI = [{
    type: "function",
    name: "decimals",
    stateMutability: "view",
    inputs: [],
    outputs: [{ type: "uint8" }],
}] as const
const trustedCatalogueAsset = Symbol("trusted-catalogue-asset")
type TrustedCatalogueAsset = RwaAssetRecord & { [trustedCatalogueAsset]: true }

export type BscTokenDecimalMetadata = {
    chainId: "56"
    tokenAddress: string
    decimals: number
    resolutionSource: "BSC_ETH_CALL"
    blockNumber: string
    resolvedAt: number
    validationStatus: "VALIDATED"
}

export class BscTokenMetadataError extends Error {
    constructor(message: string) {
        super(message)
        this.name = "BscTokenMetadataError"
    }
}

export function selectTrustedBawSpotAsset(
    records: RwaAssetRecord[],
    tokenAddress: string,
): TrustedCatalogueAsset | null {
    if (!EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(tokenAddress)) return null
    const matches = records.filter((asset) =>
        asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase() === tokenAddress.toLowerCase()
    )
    return matches.length === 1 && isSpotEligibleAsset(matches[0])
        ? { ...matches[0], [trustedCatalogueAsset]: true }
        : null
}

export type BscMetadataClient = Pick<
    PublicClient,
    "getChainId" | "getBlockNumber" | "getBytecode" | "readContract"
>

const rpcUrl = process.env.BSC_RPC_URL
    ? requireServerRpcUrl(process.env.BSC_RPC_URL)
    : resolvePublicRpcUrl(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL,
        "https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org",
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL",
    )
const bsc = defineChain({
    id: 56,
    name: "BNB Smart Chain",
    nativeCurrency: { name: "BNB", symbol: "BNB", decimals: 18 },
    rpcUrls: { default: { http: [rpcUrl] } },
})
const defaultClient = createPublicClient({
    chain: bsc,
    transport: http(rpcUrl, { timeout: 5_000 }),
})

function requireServerRpcUrl(value: string): string {
    let url: URL
    try {
        url = new URL(value)
    } catch {
        throw new Error("BSC_RPC_URL must be a valid server-side HTTP(S) RPC URL.")
    }
    if ((url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") || url.hash) {
        throw new Error("BSC_RPC_URL must be a server-side HTTP(S) RPC URL.")
    }
    return url.toString()
}

export async function resolveBscTokenMetadata(
    asset: TrustedCatalogueAsset,
    dependencies: { client?: BscMetadataClient; now?: () => number } = {},
): Promise<{ token: BscTokenDecimalMetadata; usdt: BscTokenDecimalMetadata }> {
    if (
        !asset ||
        asset[trustedCatalogueAsset] !== true ||
        typeof asset.tokenContractAddress !== "string" ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(asset.tokenContractAddress) ||
        !isSpotEligibleAsset(asset)
    ) {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError("The asset is not a valid, eligible BSC catalogue token.")
    }

    const client = dependencies.client ?? defaultClient
    const chainId = await client.getChainId()
    if (chainId !== 56) {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError("The configured read-only RPC is not connected to BNB Smart Chain mainnet.")
    }
    const blockNumber = await client.getBlockNumber()
    const resolvedAt = (dependencies.now ?? Date.now)()
    let tokenAddress: Address
    try {
        tokenAddress = getAddress(asset.tokenContractAddress)
    } catch {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError("The catalogue token address has an invalid checksum.")
    }
    const usdtAddress = getAddress(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS)
    const [token, usdt] = await Promise.all([
        readTokenMetadata(client, tokenAddress, blockNumber, resolvedAt),
        readTokenMetadata(client, usdtAddress, blockNumber, resolvedAt),
    ])
    return { token, usdt }
}

async function readTokenMetadata(
    client: BscMetadataClient,
    tokenAddress: Address,
    blockNumber: bigint,
    resolvedAt: number,
): Promise<BscTokenDecimalMetadata> {
    let code: string | undefined
    try {
        code = await client.getBytecode({ address: tokenAddress, blockNumber })
    } catch {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError(`Contract code could not be verified for ${tokenAddress}.`)
    }
    if (!code || code === "0x") {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError(`No deployed contract code exists at ${tokenAddress}.`)
    }

    let decimals: unknown
    try {
        decimals = await client.readContract({
            address: tokenAddress,
            abi: DECIMALS_ABI,
            functionName: "decimals",
            blockNumber,
        })
    } catch {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError(`The decimals() read failed for ${tokenAddress}.`)
    }
    if (
        typeof decimals !== "number" ||
        !Number.isInteger(decimals) ||
        decimals < 0 ||
        decimals > SUPPORTED_DECIMALS_MAX
    ) {
        throw new BscTokenMetadataError(`The decimals() value for ${tokenAddress} is outside WOLV's supported range.`)
    }

    return {
        chainId: "56",
        tokenAddress,
        decimals,
        resolutionSource: "BSC_ETH_CALL",
        blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
        resolvedAt,
        validationStatus: "VALIDATED",
    }
}
import { createHash, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"
import postgres, { type Sql } from "postgres"
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN, isValidBinanceQuoteId } from "../lib/apiValidation.ts"

export const BROWSER_TRADE_STATES = [
    "CREATED",
    "PREPARED",
    "SUBMISSION_PENDING",
    "SUBMITTED",
    "UNKNOWN",
    "CONFIRMED",
    "OUTPUT_VERIFIED",
    "OUTPUT_MISMATCH",
    "REJECTED",
    "EXPIRED",
    "REVERTED",
] as const

export type BrowserTradeState = typeof BROWSER_TRADE_STATES[number]

export type BrowserTradeIntent = {
    executionId: string
    quoteBindingHash: string
    quoteId: string
    walletAddress: string
    chainId: 56
    direction: "BUY"
    inputTokenAddress: string
    outputTokenAddress: string
    inputAmount: string
    expectedOutputAmount: string
    minimumOutputAmount: string
    slippageBps: number
    quoteFetchedAt: number
    expiresAt: number
    state: BrowserTradeState
    idempotencyKey: string | null
    transactionHash: string | null
    providerOrderId: string | null
    failureCode: string | null
    createdAt: number
    updatedAt: number
}

export interface BrowserTradeIntentStorePort {
    close(): Promise<void>
    initialize(): Promise<void>
    create(intent: BrowserTradeIntent): Promise<void>
    get(executionId: string): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent | null>
    prepare(executionId: string, walletAddress: string, now: number): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent>
    reject(executionId: string, failureCode: string, now: number): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent>
    claimSubmission(executionId: string, idempotencyKey: string, now: number): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent>
    updateSubmission(
        executionId: string,
        state: "SUBMITTED" | "UNKNOWN" | "CONFIRMED" | "OUTPUT_VERIFIED" | "OUTPUT_MISMATCH" | "REVERTED",
        values: { transactionHash?: string; providerOrderId?: string; failureCode?: string },
        now: number,
    ): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent>
}

const MIGRATIONS = [{
    version: 1,
    statements: [
        `CREATE TABLE wolv_trade_intents (
            execution_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
            quote_binding_hash char(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            quote_id text NOT NULL,
            wallet_address text NOT NULL,
            chain_id integer NOT NULL CHECK (chain_id = 56),
            direction text NOT NULL CHECK (direction = 'BUY'),
            input_token_address text NOT NULL,
            output_token_address text NOT NULL,
            input_amount numeric NOT NULL CHECK (input_amount > 0),
            expected_output_amount numeric NOT NULL CHECK (expected_output_amount > 0),
            minimum_output_amount numeric NOT NULL CHECK (minimum_output_amount > 0),
            slippage_bps integer NOT NULL CHECK (slippage_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
            quote_fetched_at bigint NOT NULL,
            expires_at bigint NOT NULL,
            execution_status text NOT NULL CHECK (execution_status IN (${BROWSER_TRADE_STATES.map((state) => `'${state}'`).join(",")})),
            idempotency_key uuid UNIQUE,
            transaction_hash char(66) UNIQUE,
            provider_order_id text,
            failure_code text,
            created_at bigint NOT NULL,
            updated_at bigint NOT NULL
        )`,
        "CREATE INDEX wolv_trade_intents_wallet_created ON wolv_trade_intents (wallet_address, created_at DESC)",
        "CREATE INDEX wolv_trade_intents_status_expiry ON wolv_trade_intents (execution_status, expires_at)",
    ],
}]
const MIGRATION_LOCK_ID = 7_891_230_457
const TERMINAL_STATES: readonly BrowserTradeState[] = ["OUTPUT_VERIFIED", "OUTPUT_MISMATCH", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED", "REVERTED"]

export class BrowserTradeIntentStoreError extends Error {
    code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "INVALID_DATABASE_URL" | "NOT_FOUND" | "EXPIRED" | "CONSUMED" | "INVALID_TRANSITION"

    constructor(code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "INVALID_DATABASE_URL" | "NOT_FOUND" | "EXPIRED" | "CONSUMED" | "INVALID_TRANSITION") {
        super(`Browser trade intent store unavailable: ${code}`)
        this.name = "BrowserTradeIntentStoreError"
        this.code = code
    }
}

export class BrowserTradeIntentStore implements BrowserTradeIntentStorePort {
    private readonly sql: Sql
    private readonly ready: Promise<void>

    constructor(databaseUrl = process.env.WOLV_TRADING_DATABASE_URL) {
        if (!databaseUrl) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_CONFIGURED")
        if (!isSafePostgresUrl(databaseUrl)) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("INVALID_DATABASE_URL")
        this.sql = postgres(databaseUrl, {
            max: 1,
            idle_timeout: 20,
            connect_timeout: 5,
            max_lifetime: 300,
            prepare: false,
            ssl: isLocalDevelopmentUrl(databaseUrl) ? false : "verify-full",
        })
        this.ready = this.runMigrations()
    }

    async close(): Promise<void> {
        await this.sql.end({ timeout: 5 })
    }

    async initialize(): Promise<void> {
        await this.ready
    }

    async create(intent: BrowserTradeIntent): Promise<void> {
        await this.ready
        if (
            intent.state !== "CREATED" ||
            !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(intent.executionId) ||
            !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(intent.quoteBindingHash) ||
            !isValidBinanceQuoteId(intent.quoteId) ||
            !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(intent.walletAddress) ||
            intent.chainId !== 56 ||
            intent.direction !== "BUY" ||
            intent.inputTokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() ||
            !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(intent.outputTokenAddress) ||
            intent.outputTokenAddress.toLowerCase() === intent.inputTokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
            !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(intent.inputAmount) ||
            !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(intent.expectedOutputAmount) ||
            !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(intent.minimumOutputAmount) ||
            BigInt(intent.minimumOutputAmount) > BigInt(intent.expectedOutputAmount) ||
            !Number.isSafeInteger(intent.slippageBps) ||
            intent.slippageBps < 1 ||
            intent.slippageBps > 500 ||
            !Number.isSafeInteger(intent.quoteFetchedAt) ||
            !Number.isSafeInteger(intent.expiresAt) ||
            intent.expiresAt <= intent.quoteFetchedAt
        ) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("INVALID_TRANSITION")
        await this.sql`
            INSERT INTO wolv_trade_intents (
                execution_id, quote_binding_hash, quote_id, wallet_address, chain_id, direction,
                input_token_address, output_token_address, input_amount, expected_output_amount,
                minimum_output_amount, slippage_bps, quote_fetched_at, expires_at, execution_status,
                idempotency_key, transaction_hash, provider_order_id, failure_code, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                ${intent.executionId}, ${intent.quoteBindingHash}, ${intent.quoteId}, ${intent.walletAddress},
                ${intent.chainId}, ${intent.direction}, ${intent.inputTokenAddress}, ${intent.outputTokenAddress},
                ${intent.inputAmount}, ${intent.expectedOutputAmount}, ${intent.minimumOutputAmount},
                ${intent.slippageBps}, ${intent.quoteFetchedAt}, ${intent.expiresAt}, ${intent.state},
                ${intent.idempotencyKey}, ${intent.transactionHash}, ${intent.providerOrderId},
                ${intent.failureCode}, ${intent.createdAt}, ${intent.updatedAt}
            )
        `
    }

    async get(executionId: string): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent | null> {
        await this.ready
        const rows = await this.sql`
            SELECT * FROM wolv_trade_intents WHERE execution_id = ${executionId}
        `
        return rows[0] ? parseIntent(rows[0]) : null
    }

    async prepare(executionId: string, walletAddress: string, now: number): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent> {
        await this.ready
        const outcome = await this.sql.begin(async (transaction) => {
            const rows = await transaction`
                SELECT * FROM wolv_trade_intents WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} FOR UPDATE
            `
            const row = rows[0]
            if (!row) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
            const intent = parseIntent(row)
            if (!safeAddressMatch(intent.walletAddress, walletAddress)) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
            if (intent.expiresAt <= now) {
                if (intent.state === "CREATED") {
                    await transaction`
                        UPDATE wolv_trade_intents SET execution_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = ${now}
                        WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND execution_status = 'CREATED'
                    `
                }
                return { error: "EXPIRED" as const }
            }
            if (intent.state !== "CREATED") return { error: "CONSUMED" as const }
            const updated = await transaction`
                UPDATE wolv_trade_intents
                SET execution_status = 'PREPARED', updated_at = ${now}
                WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND execution_status = 'CREATED' AND expires_at > ${now}
                RETURNING *
            `
            if (updated.length !== 1) return { error: "CONSUMED" as const }
            return { intent: parseIntent(updated[0]) }
        })
        if ("error" in outcome) {
            const errorCode = outcome.error ?? "INVALID_TRANSITION"
            throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError(errorCode)
        }
        return outcome.intent
    }

    async reject(executionId: string, failureCode: string, now: number): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent> {
        return this.transition(executionId, ["PREPARED"], "REJECTED", { failureCode }, now)
    }

    async claimSubmission(executionId: string, idempotencyKey: string, now: number): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent> {
        await this.ready
        if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(idempotencyKey)) {
            throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("INVALID_TRANSITION")
        }
        const outcome = await this.sql.begin(async (transaction) => {
            const rows = await transaction`
                SELECT * FROM wolv_trade_intents WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} FOR UPDATE
            `
            if (!rows[0]) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
            const intent = parseIntent(rows[0])
            if (intent.expiresAt <= now && intent.state === "PREPARED") {
                await transaction`
                    UPDATE wolv_trade_intents SET execution_status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = ${now}
                    WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND execution_status = 'PREPARED'
                `
                return { error: "EXPIRED" as const }
            }
            if (
                intent.idempotencyKey === idempotencyKey &&
                ["SUBMISSION_PENDING", "SUBMITTED", "UNKNOWN", "CONFIRMED", "OUTPUT_VERIFIED", "OUTPUT_MISMATCH", "REVERTED"].includes(intent.state)
            ) return { intent }
            if (intent.state !== "PREPARED" || intent.idempotencyKey !== null) {
                return { error: "CONSUMED" as const }
            }
            const updated = await transaction`
                UPDATE wolv_trade_intents
                SET execution_status = 'SUBMISSION_PENDING', idempotency_key = ${idempotencyKey}, updated_at = ${now}
                WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND execution_status = 'PREPARED' AND idempotency_key IS NULL
                RETURNING *
            `
            if (updated.length !== 1) return { error: "CONSUMED" as const }
            return { intent: parseIntent(updated[0]) }
        })
        if ("error" in outcome) {
            const errorCode = outcome.error ?? "INVALID_TRANSITION"
            throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError(errorCode)
        }
        return outcome.intent
    }

    async updateSubmission(
        executionId: string,
        state: "SUBMITTED" | "UNKNOWN" | "CONFIRMED" | "OUTPUT_VERIFIED" | "OUTPUT_MISMATCH" | "REVERTED",
        values: { transactionHash?: string; providerOrderId?: string; failureCode?: string },
        now: number,
    ): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent> {
        const allowedFrom: Record<typeof state, readonly BrowserTradeState[]> = {
            SUBMITTED: ["SUBMISSION_PENDING", "SUBMITTED", "UNKNOWN"],
            UNKNOWN: ["SUBMISSION_PENDING", "SUBMITTED", "UNKNOWN"],
            CONFIRMED: ["SUBMITTED", "UNKNOWN", "CONFIRMED"],
            OUTPUT_VERIFIED: ["CONFIRMED"],
            OUTPUT_MISMATCH: ["CONFIRMED"],
            REVERTED: ["CONFIRMED"],
        }
        if (
            (state === "SUBMITTED" && !values.transactionHash && !values.providerOrderId) ||
            (["CONFIRMED", "OUTPUT_VERIFIED", "OUTPUT_MISMATCH", "REVERTED"].includes(state) && !values.transactionHash) ||
            (values.transactionHash !== undefined && !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(values.transactionHash)) ||
            (values.providerOrderId !== undefined && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(values.providerOrderId)) ||
            (values.failureCode !== undefined && !/^[A-Z0-9_]{1,64}$/.test(values.failureCode))
        ) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("INVALID_TRANSITION")
        return this.transition(
            executionId,
            allowedFrom[state],
            state,
            values,
            now,
        )
    }

    private async transition(
        executionId: string,
        allowedFrom: readonly BrowserTradeState[],
        state: BrowserTradeState,
        values: { transactionHash?: string; providerOrderId?: string; failureCode?: string },
        now: number,
    ): Promise<BrowserTradeIntent> {
        await this.ready
        const rows = await this.sql`
            UPDATE wolv_trade_intents
            SET execution_status = ${state},
                transaction_hash = COALESCE(${values.transactionHash ?? null}, transaction_hash),
                provider_order_id = COALESCE(${values.providerOrderId ?? null}, provider_order_id),
                failure_code = ${values.failureCode ?? null},
                updated_at = ${now}
            WHERE execution_id = ${executionId} AND execution_status = ANY(${this.sql.array([...allowedFrom])})
            RETURNING *
        `
        if (rows.length !== 1) {
            const current = await this.get(executionId)
            if (!current) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
            throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError(TERMINAL_STATES.includes(current.state) ? "INVALID_TRANSITION" : "CONSUMED")
        }
        return parseIntent(rows[0])
    }

    private async runMigrations(): Promise<void> {
        await this.sql.begin(async (transaction) => {
            await transaction`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(${MIGRATION_LOCK_ID})`
            await transaction`
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wolv_trading_schema_migrations (
                    version integer PRIMARY KEY,
                    applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
                )
            `
            for (const migration of MIGRATIONS) {
                const applied = await transaction`
                    SELECT version FROM wolv_trading_schema_migrations WHERE version = ${migration.version}
                `
                if (applied.length) continue
                for (const statement of migration.statements) await transaction.unsafe(statement)
                await transaction`
                    INSERT INTO wolv_trading_schema_migrations (version) VALUES (${migration.version})
                `
            }
        })
    }
}

let defaultStore: BrowserTradeIntentStore | null = null

export function getDefaultBrowserTradeIntentStore(): BrowserTradeIntentStore {
    if (!defaultStore) defaultStore = new BrowserTradeIntentStore()
    return defaultStore
}

export function hashQuoteBinding(binding: string): string {
    return createHash("sha256").update(binding, "utf8").digest("hex")
}

function isSafePostgresUrl(value: string): boolean {
    try {
        const url = new URL(value)
        return ["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol) &&
            url.hostname.length > 0 &&
            url.username.length > 0 &&
            url.password.length > 0 &&
            !["disable", "allow", "prefer"].includes(url.searchParams.get("sslmode") ?? "")
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

function isLocalDevelopmentUrl(value: string): boolean {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") return false
    try {
        return ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"].includes(new URL(value).hostname)
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

function safeAddressMatch(left: string, right: string): boolean {
    return /^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/.test(left.replace(/^0x/, "")) &&
        /^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/.test(right.replace(/^0x/, "")) &&
        left.toLowerCase() === right.toLowerCase()
}

function parseIntent(row: Record<string, unknown>): BrowserTradeIntent {
    const state = row.execution_status
    if (!BROWSER_TRADE_STATES.includes(state as BrowserTradeState)) {
        throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("INVALID_TRANSITION")
    }
    return {
        executionId: String(row.execution_id),
        quoteBindingHash: String(row.quote_binding_hash).trim(),
        quoteId: String(row.quote_id),
        walletAddress: String(row.wallet_address),
        chainId: 56,
        direction: "BUY",
        inputTokenAddress: String(row.input_token_address),
        outputTokenAddress: String(row.output_token_address),
        inputAmount: String(row.input_amount),
        expectedOutputAmount: String(row.expected_output_amount),
        minimumOutputAmount: String(row.minimum_output_amount),
        slippageBps: Number(row.slippage_bps),
        quoteFetchedAt: Number(row.quote_fetched_at),
        expiresAt: Number(row.expires_at),
        state: state as BrowserTradeState,
        idempotencyKey: row.idempotency_key == null ? null : String(row.idempotency_key),
        transactionHash: row.transaction_hash == null ? null : String(row.transaction_hash).trim(),
        providerOrderId: row.provider_order_id == null ? null : String(row.provider_order_id),
        failureCode: row.failure_code == null ? null : String(row.failure_code),
        createdAt: Number(row.created_at),
        updatedAt: Number(row.updated_at),
    }
}

const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const MAX_PERMISSION_TTL_MS = 30 * 60_000;
export type ProposalStatus =
  | "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL"
  | "USER_REJECTED"
  | "EXPIRED"
  | "REVOKED"
  | "EXECUTION_BLOCKED";

export type AgentEventInput = {
  eventType: string;
  occurredAt: number;
  correlationId: string;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  provenance?: Record<string, unknown>;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
};

export interface AgentMemoryStorePort {
  close(): Promise<void>;
  initialize(): Promise<void>;
  recordAssetVersion(input: AssetVersionInput): Promise<{ assetId: string; created: boolean }>;

  }): Promise<{ candleId: string; created: boolean }>;
  createRun(input: AgentRunInput, runId?: string): Promise<string>;
  transitionRun(runId: string, nextState: AgentState, event: AgentEventInput): Promise<void>;
  appendEvent(runId: string | null, event: AgentEventInput, ownerAddress?: string): Promise<string>;
  recordOpportunity(input: {
    ownerAddress: string;
    opportunityId: string;
    runId: string;
