  async updateExecutionClaim(claimId: string, ownerAddress: string, update: Parameters<AgentMemoryStorePort["updateExecutionClaim"]>[2]): Promise<void> {
    await this.ready;
    const owner = requireOwnerAddress(ownerAddress);
    const result = await this.sql`
      UPDATE wolv_agent_execution_claims SET status = ${update.status},
        intent_hash = COALESCE(${update.intentHash ?? null}, intent_hash),
        receipt_hash = COALESCE(${update.receiptHash ?? null}, receipt_hash),
        failure_code = COALESCE(${update.failureCode ?? null}, failure_code),
        failure_detail = COALESCE(${update.failureDetail ?? null}, failure_detail),
        simulated_at = CASE WHEN ${update.status} = 'SIMULATED' THEN ${new Date(update.at)} ELSE simulated_at END,
        submitted_at = CASE WHEN ${update.status} = 'SUBMITTED' THEN ${new Date(update.at)} ELSE submitted_at END,
        confirmed_at = CASE WHEN ${update.status} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN ${new Date(update.at)} ELSE confirmed_at END,
        failed_at = CASE WHEN ${update.status} IN ('FAILED','STOPPED') THEN ${new Date(update.at)} ELSE failed_at END,
        updated_at = ${new Date(update.at)}
      WHERE claim_id = ${claimId} AND owner_address = ${owner}
    `;
    if (result.count !== 1) throw new AgentMemoryStoreError("NOT_FOUND");
  }

  async consumeIntentNonce(input: Parameters<AgentMemoryStorePort["consumeIntentNonce"]>[0]): Promise<{ consumed: boolean }> {
    await this.ready;
    const owner = requireOwnerAddress(input.ownerAddress);
    const smartAccount = requireOwnerAddress(input.smartAccountAddress);
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{16,128}$/.test(input.nonce) ||
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(input.intentHash)) {
      throw new TypeError("Intent nonce binding is invalid.");
    }
    const rows = await this.sql`
      INSERT INTO wolv_agent_intent_nonces (
        owner_address, smart_account_address, nonce, intent_hash, expires_at, consumed_at
      ) VALUES (
        ${owner}, ${smartAccount}, ${input.nonce}, ${input.intentHash},
        ${new Date(input.expiresAt)}, ${new Date(input.consumedAt)}
      )
      ON CONFLICT (owner_address, nonce) DO NOTHING
      RETURNING nonce
    `;
    return { consumed: rows.length === 1 };
  }

  async recordAlert(input: Parameters<AgentMemoryStorePort["recordAlert"]>[0]): Promise<string> {
    await this.ready;
    const owner = requireOwnerAddress(input.ownerAddress);
    const alertId = randomUUID();
    await this.sql`
      INSERT INTO wolv_agent_alerts (
        alert_id, owner_address, claim_id, severity, kind, message, delivered, created_at
      ) VALUES (
        ${alertId}, ${owner}, ${input.claimId ?? null}, ${input.severity},
        ${input.kind.slice(0, 64)}, ${input.message.slice(0, 2000)}, false, ${new Date(input.createdAt)}
      )
    `;
    return alertId;
  }

  private async runMigrations(): Promise<void> {
    await this.sql.begin(async (transaction) => {
      await transaction`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(${MIGRATION_LOCK_ID})`;
      await transaction`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wolv_agent_memory_migrations (
          version integer PRIMARY KEY,
          applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
        )
      `;
      const existing = await transaction`SELECT version FROM wolv_agent_memory_migrations`;
      const applied = new Set(existing.map((row) => Number(row.version)));
      for (const migration of MIGRATIONS) {
        if (applied.has(migration.version)) continue;
        for (const statement of migration.statements) await transaction.unsafe(statement);
        await transaction`INSERT INTO wolv_agent_memory_migrations (version) VALUES (${migration.version})`;
      }
    });
  }
}

export function getDefaultAgentMemoryStore(): AgentMemoryStore {
  return new AgentMemoryStore();
}

async function appendEventInTransaction(
  sql: Sql | postgres.TransactionSql,
  runId: string | null,
  event: AgentEventInput,
  explicitOwnerAddress?: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const runRows = runId === null
    ? []
    : await sql`SELECT owner_address FROM wolv_agent_runs WHERE run_id = ${runId} FOR UPDATE`;
  if (runId !== null && !runRows[0]) throw new AgentMemoryStoreError("NOT_FOUND");
  const ownerAddress = runRows[0]
    ? String(runRows[0].owner_address)
    : requireOwnerAddress(explicitOwnerAddress);
  if (event.idempotencyKey) {
    const existing = await sql`
      SELECT event_id FROM wolv_agent_events
      WHERE owner_address = ${ownerAddress} AND idempotency_key = ${event.idempotencyKey}
    `;
    if (existing[0]) return String(existing[0].event_id);
  }
  if (runId === null) {
    const rows = await sql`
      INSERT INTO wolv_agent_events (
        event_id, run_id, event_type, occurred_at, sequence_number, correlation_id,
        event_payload, source_provenance, previous_event_id, owner_address, idempotency_key
      ) VALUES (
        ${randomUUID()}, NULL, ${event.eventType}, ${new Date(event.occurredAt)}, 0,
        ${event.correlationId}, ${sql.json(jsonValue(event.payload))}, ${sql.json(jsonValue(event.provenance ?? {}))},
        NULL, ${ownerAddress}, ${event.idempotencyKey ?? null}
      ) RETURNING event_id
    `
    return String(rows[0].event_id);
  }
  const previous = await sql`
    SELECT event_id, sequence_number FROM wolv_agent_events
    WHERE run_id = ${runId} ORDER BY sequence_number DESC LIMIT 1
  `;
  const sequence = previous[0] ? Number(previous[0].sequence_number) + 1 : 1;
  const eventId = randomUUID();
  await sql`
    INSERT INTO wolv_agent_events (
      event_id, run_id, event_type, occurred_at, sequence_number, correlation_id,
      event_payload, source_provenance, previous_event_id, owner_address, idempotency_key
    ) VALUES (
      ${eventId}, ${runId}, ${event.eventType}, ${new Date(event.occurredAt)}, ${sequence},
      ${event.correlationId}, ${sql.json(jsonValue(event.payload))}, ${sql.json(jsonValue(event.provenance ?? {}))},
      ${previous[0]?.event_id ?? null}, ${ownerAddress}, ${event.idempotencyKey ?? null}
    )
  `;
  return eventId;
}

async function transitionRunInTransaction(
  sql: Sql | postgres.TransactionSql,
  runId: string,
  expectedState: AgentState,
  nextState: AgentState,
  occurredAt: number,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<void> {
  const rows = await sql`SELECT run_status FROM wolv_agent_runs WHERE run_id = ${runId} FOR UPDATE`;
  if (!rows[0]) throw new AgentMemoryStoreError("NOT_FOUND");
  const current = String(rows[0].run_status) as AgentState;
  if (current !== expectedState) throw new AgentMemoryStoreError("INVALID_TRANSITION");
  assertAgentTransition(current, nextState);
  const terminal = nextState === "COMPLETED" || nextState === "FAILED" || nextState === "STOPPED";
  await sql`
    UPDATE wolv_agent_runs
    SET run_status = ${nextState},
        ended_at = CASE WHEN ${terminal} THEN ${new Date(occurredAt)} ELSE ended_at END,
        termination_reason = CASE WHEN ${terminal} THEN ${String(payload.reason ?? nextState)} ELSE termination_reason END
    WHERE run_id = ${runId}
  `;
  await appendEventInTransaction(sql, runId, {
    eventType: "STATE_CHANGED",
    occurredAt,
    correlationId: runId,
    payload: { ...payload, from: current, to: nextState },
    provenance: { source: "agent-orchestrator" },
  });
}

function jsonValue(value: unknown): postgres.JSONValue {
  const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);
  if (serialized === undefined) throw new Error("Persisted JSON value is not serializable.");
  return JSON.parse(serialized) as postgres.JSONValue;
}

function hashJson(value: unknown): string {
  return createSnapshotHash(value);
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function requireOwnerAddress(value: string | undefined): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new TypeError("A valid wallet owner is required to access agent memory.");
  }
  return value.toLowerCase();
}

function isPostgresUrl(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return ["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(url.protocol) &&
      Boolean(url.hostname) && Boolean(url.pathname.slice(1));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isLocalDevelopmentUrl(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    return ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"].includes(new URL(value).hostname);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function boundedLimit(value: number | undefined): number {
  if (value === undefined) return 50;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > MAX_PAGE_SIZE) {
    throw new RangeError(`limit must be an integer between 1 and ${MAX_PAGE_SIZE}.`);
  }
  return value;
}

function encodeCursor(timestamp: string, eventId: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(`${timestamp}\n${eventId}`).toString("base64url");
}

function parseCursor(value: string): { timestamp: string; eventId: string } {
  let decoded: string;
  try {
    decoded = Buffer.from(value, "base64url").toString("utf8");
  } catch {
    throw new TypeError("Activity cursor is invalid.");
  }
  const [timestamp, eventId, extra] = decoded.split("\n");
  if (extra !== undefined || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(timestamp)) ||
    !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(eventId)) {
    throw new TypeError("Activity cursor is invalid.");
  }
  return { timestamp, eventId };
}

function normalizeRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row).map(([key, value]) => [
    key,
    value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : value,
  ]));
}

function parseJson<T>(value: unknown): T {
  if (typeof value === "string") return JSON.parse(value) as T;
  if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) return value as T;
  throw new Error("Persisted JSON value is invalid.");
}

function isPostgresConflict(error: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "code" in error &&
    (error.code === "23505" || error.code === "23514");
}
import { timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"
import {
    BawExecutionStoreError,
    type BawExecutionRecord,
    type BawExecutionStorePort,
    type BawWalletSessionRecord,
} from "./bawExecutionStore.ts"

const ACTIVE_STATES = new Set(["APPROVAL_REQUIRED", "APPROVED", "SUBMITTING", "SUBMITTED", "PENDING", "PARTIALLY_FILLED", "UNKNOWN"])

type ApprovalRecord = {
    record: BawExecutionRecord
    tokenHash: string
    tokenUsed: boolean
    expiresAt: number
    createdAt: number
}

export class BawExecutionMemoryTestStore implements BawExecutionStorePort {
    private readonly records = new Map<string, ApprovalRecord>()
    private readonly challenges = new Map<string, { address: string; expiresAt: number }>()
    private readonly sessions = new Map<string, BawWalletSessionRecord & { revokedAt: number | null }>()

    async close(): Promise<void> {
        this.records.clear()
        this.challenges.clear()
        this.sessions.clear()
    }

    async createApproval(record: BawExecutionRecord, tokenHash: string, expiresAt: number, createdAt = Date.now()): Promise<void> {
        for (const [id, value] of this.records) {
            if (value.record.state === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" && value.expiresAt <= createdAt) {
                value.record.state = "EXPIRED"
            }
            if (id === record.executionId || ACTIVE_STATES.has(value.record.state)) {
                throw new BawExecutionStoreError("BUSY")
            }
        }
        this.records.set(record.executionId, {
            record: structuredClone(record),
            tokenHash,
            tokenUsed: false,
            expiresAt,
            createdAt,
        })
    }

    async consumeApproval(executionId: string, tokenHash: string, now: number): Promise<BawExecutionRecord> {
        const approval = this.records.get(executionId)
        if (!approval) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
        if (
            approval.tokenUsed ||
            approval.record.state !== "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" ||
            !safeHashMatch(approval.tokenHash, tokenHash)
        ) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("USED")
        if (now >= approval.expiresAt) {
            approval.record.state = "EXPIRED"
            throw new BawExecutionStoreError("EXPIRED")
        }
        approval.tokenUsed = true
        approval.record.state = "APPROVED"
        approval.record.submittedAt = null
        return structuredClone(approval.record)
    }

    async update(record: BawExecutionRecord): Promise<void> {
        const stored = this.records.get(record.executionId)
        if (!stored) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("NOT_FOUND")
        stored.record = structuredClone(record)
    }

    async get(executionId: string): Promise<BawExecutionRecord | null> {
        const record = this.records.get(executionId)?.record
        return record ? structuredClone(record) : null
    }

    async dailyNotionalSince(startOfDay: number, excludeExecutionId?: string): Promise<number> {
        let total = 0
        for (const [executionId, value] of this.records) {
            if (
                value.createdAt >= startOfDay &&
                !["APPROVAL_REQUIRED", "APPROVED", "EXPIRED"].includes(value.record.state) &&
                executionId !== excludeExecutionId
            ) total += value.record.notionalUsd
        }
        return total
    }

    async createChallenge(nonceHash: string, address: string, expiresAt: number): Promise<void> {
        if (this.challenges.has(nonceHash)) throw new BawExecutionStoreError("DUPLICATE")
        this.challenges.set(nonceHash, { address, expiresAt })
    }

    async consumeChallengeAndCreateSession(
        nonceHash: string,
        address: string,
        now: number,
        sessionId: string,
        expiresAt: number,
    ): Promise<boolean> {
        const challenge = this.challenges.get(nonceHash)
        if (!challenge || challenge.address !== address || challenge.expiresAt <= now) return false
        this.challenges.delete(nonceHash)
        this.sessions.set(sessionId, { address, expiresAt, revokedAt: null })
        return true
    }

    async getSession(sessionId: string, now: number): Promise<BawWalletSessionRecord | null> {
        const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)
        if (!session || session.revokedAt !== null || session.expiresAt <= now) return null
        return { address: session.address, expiresAt: session.expiresAt }
    }

    async revokeSession(sessionId: string, now: number): Promise<void> {
        const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)
        if (session && session.revokedAt === null) session.revokedAt = now
    }
}

function safeHashMatch(stored: string, requested: string): boolean {
    const storedHash = Buffer.from(stored, "hex")
    const requestedHash = Buffer.from(requested, "hex")
    return storedHash.length === requestedHash.length &&
        storedHash.length > 0 &&
        timingSafeEqual(storedHash, requestedHash)
}
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN, isValidBinanceQuoteId } from "../lib/apiValidation.ts"
import { verifyBrowserTradeBinding } from "../lib/browserTradeBinding.ts"
import {
    BrowserTradeIntentStoreError,
    hashQuoteBinding,
    type BrowserTradeIntentStorePort,
} from "./browserTradeIntentStore.ts"

const UUID_V4_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i

export type BrowserTradeBoundaryResult =
    | { ok: true; code: "UNSUPPORTED_SWAP_SCHEMA" | "UNSUPPORTED_APPROVAL_SCHEMA" | "UNSUPPORTED_RFQ_SCHEMA" }
    | { ok: false; status: number; code: string; reason: string }

export async function rejectUnsupportedBrowserExecution(input: {
    executionId: string
    quoteId: string
    quoteBinding: string
    wallet: string
    toToken: string
    amount: string
    operation: "SWAP" | "APPROVAL" | "RFQ"
    now?: number
    store: BrowserTradeIntentStorePort
}): Promise<BrowserTradeBoundaryResult> {
    if (
        !UUID_V4_PATTERN.test(input.executionId) ||
        !isValidBinanceQuoteId(input.quoteId) ||
        typeof input.quoteBinding !== "string" ||
        input.quoteBinding.length > 2_048 ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.wallet) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.toToken) ||
        !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(input.amount)
    ) return { ok: false, status: 400, code: "INVALID_INTENT", reason: "Invalid trade intent parameters." }

    try {
        await input.store.initialize()
        const intent = await input.store.get(input.executionId)
        if (!intent) return { ok: false, status: 404, code: "INTENT_NOT_FOUND", reason: "Trade intent was not found." }
        if (
            intent.quoteId !== input.quoteId ||
            intent.inputAmount !== input.amount ||
            intent.outputTokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== input.toToken.toLowerCase() ||
            intent.inputTokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() ||
            intent.walletAddress.toLowerCase() !== input.wallet.toLowerCase() ||
            hashQuoteBinding(input.quoteBinding) !== intent.quoteBindingHash
        ) return { ok: false, status: 409, code: "INTENT_MISMATCH", reason: "Trade binding does not match the stored intent." }

        const now = input.now ?? Date.now()
        if (intent.expiresAt <= now) {
            await input.store.prepare(intent.executionId, input.wallet, now)
        }
        const binding = verifyBrowserTradeBinding(input.quoteBinding, {
            executionId: intent.executionId,
            quoteId: intent.quoteId,
            wallet: intent.walletAddress,
            chainId: intent.chainId,
            direction: intent.direction,
            fromToken: intent.inputTokenAddress,
            toToken: intent.outputTokenAddress,
            amount: intent.inputAmount,
            slippageBps: intent.slippageBps,
        }, now)
        if (!binding.ok || binding.expiresAt !== intent.expiresAt) {
            return { ok: false, status: 409, code: "INVALID_BINDING", reason: binding.ok ? "Trade binding expiration does not match the stored intent." : binding.reason }
        }

        await input.store.prepare(intent.executionId, input.wallet, now)
        const code = input.operation === "SWAP"
            ? "UNSUPPORTED_SWAP_SCHEMA"
            : input.operation === "APPROVAL"
                ? "UNSUPPORTED_APPROVAL_SCHEMA"
                : "UNSUPPORTED_RFQ_SCHEMA"
        await input.store.reject(intent.executionId, code, now)
        return { ok: true, code }
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BrowserTradeIntentStoreError) {
            const status = error.code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404 : error.code === "EXPIRED" ? 410 : error.code === "CONSUMED" ? 409 : 503
            return { ok: false, status, code: error.code, reason: storeReason(error.code) }
        }
        throw error
    }
}

function storeReason(code: BrowserTradeIntentStoreError["code"]): string {
    switch (code) {
        case "NOT_FOUND": return "Trade intent was not found."
        case "EXPIRED": return "Trade intent has expired."
        case "CONSUMED": return "Trade intent has already been consumed."
        default: return "Durable trade-intent storage is unavailable."
    }
}
import "server-only";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { getAddress } from "viem";
import { isSpotEligibleAsset } from "../lib/compliance.ts";
import {
  detectCrossVenueOpportunity,
  validateMarketObservation,
  type AssetVersionInput,
  type MarketObservationInput,
} from "../lib/agentControlPlane.ts";
import type { AgentMemoryStorePort } from "./agentMemoryStore.ts";

export const MAX_WATCHLIST_ASSETS = 25;
export const MAX_COLLECTION_CONCURRENCY = 3;
export const MAX_MARKET_OBSERVATION_AGE_MS = 60_000;

export type MarketAsset = AssetVersionInput & {
  id: string;
  tokenToShareRatio: string | null;
};

export type CollectorCandle = {
  interval: string;
  open: string;
  high: string;
  low: string;
  close: string;
  volume: string | null;
  openingAt: number;
  closingAt: number;
  provider: string;
  verificationStatus: "VERIFIED" | "UNVERIFIED" | "REJECTED";
  provenance: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export interface MarketDataAdapter {
  readonly providerId: string;
  loadCatalogue(watchlist: readonly string[]): Promise<AssetVersionInput[]>;
  observe?(asset: MarketAsset, now: number): Promise<Omit<MarketObservationInput, "assetId" | "idempotencyKey"> | null>;
  candles?(asset: MarketAsset, intervals: readonly string[], now: number): Promise<CollectorCandle[]>;
}

export type CollectionResult = {
  provider: string;
  assetsVersioned: number;
  observationsStored: number;
  candlesStored: number;
  evidenceLimitations: string[];
  failures: Array<{ address: string; stage: string; reason: string }>;
  completedAt: number;
};

export class MarketCollectorError extends Error {
  readonly code: "DISABLED" | "INVALID_WATCHLIST" | "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE" | "CONTROL_STOPPED";

  constructor(
    code: MarketCollectorError["code"],
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.code = code;
    this.name = "MarketCollectorError";
  }
}

export class MarketDataCollector {
  private readonly store: AgentMemoryStorePort;
  private readonly adapter: MarketDataAdapter;
  private readonly options: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    maxObservationAgeMs?: number;
    now?: () => number;
    intervals?: readonly string[];
  };

  constructor(
    store: AgentMemoryStorePort,
    adapter: MarketDataAdapter,
    options: MarketDataCollector["options"] = {},
  ) {
    this.store = store;
    this.adapter = adapter;
    this.options = options;
  }

  async collectWatchlist(watchlist: readonly string[], ownerAddress: string): Promise<CollectionResult> {
    const now = this.options.now ?? Date.now;
    const startedAt = now();
    const owner = requireOwnerAddress(ownerAddress);
    if (!(this.options.enabled ?? process.env.WOLV_MARKET_COLLECTOR_ENABLED === "true")) {
      throw new MarketCollectorError("DISABLED", "Market collection is disabled; set WOLV_MARKET_COLLECTOR_ENABLED=true to enable an explicit collection request.");
    }
    if (watchlist.length < 1 || watchlist.length > MAX_WATCHLIST_ASSETS ||
      watchlist.some((address) => !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(address)) ||
      new Set(watchlist.map((address) => address.toLowerCase())).size !== watchlist.length) {
      throw new MarketCollectorError("INVALID_WATCHLIST", `Watchlist must contain 1–${MAX_WATCHLIST_ASSETS} unique EVM token addresses.`);
    }
    const control = await this.store.getControlState(now());
    if (control.emergency_stop === true || control.stop_monitoring === true ||
      control.reject_new_opportunities === true || control.permission_active !== true) {
      throw new MarketCollectorError("CONTROL_STOPPED", "Emergency stop is active or control permission is missing or expired.");
    }

    const result: CollectionResult = {
      provider: this.adapter.providerId,
      assetsVersioned: 0,
      observationsStored: 0,
      candlesStored: 0,
      evidenceLimitations: [],
      failures: [],
      completedAt: startedAt,
    };
    const assetIds = new Map<string, MarketAsset>();
    try {
      const catalogue = await this.adapter.loadCatalogue(watchlist);
      const selected = new Set(watchlist.map((address) => address.toLowerCase()));
      const validCatalogue = catalogue.filter((asset) =>
        asset.chainId === 56 &&
        selected.has(asset.tokenAddress.toLowerCase()) &&
        /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(asset.tokenAddress) &&
        asset.ticker.trim().length > 0 &&
        asset.platform.trim().length > 0 &&
        asset.metadataSource.trim().length > 0 &&
        (asset.decimals === null || (Number.isSafeInteger(asset.decimals) && asset.decimals >= 0 && asset.decimals <= 255)) &&
        isRecord(asset.metadata) &&
        isSpotEligibleAsset({
          underlyingTicker: asset.ticker,
          tokenName: typeof asset.metadata.tokenName === "string" ? asset.metadata.tokenName : null,
          underlyingName: typeof asset.metadata.underlyingName === "string" ? asset.metadata.underlyingName : null,
          leverage: typeof asset.metadata.leverage === "string" || typeof asset.metadata.leverage === "number"
            ? asset.metadata.leverage
            : null,
          leverageFactor: typeof asset.metadata.leverageFactor === "string" || typeof asset.metadata.leverageFactor === "number"
            ? asset.metadata.leverageFactor
            : null,
        }),
      );
      for (const address of watchlist) {
        const asset = validCatalogue.find((candidate) =>
          candidate.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() === address.toLowerCase());
        if (!asset) {
          result.failures.push({ address, stage: "CATALOGUE", reason: "Asset is absent from the trusted eligible catalogue." });
          continue;
        }
        try {
          const canonicalAddress = getAddress(asset.tokenAddress);
          const stored = await this.store.recordAssetVersion({ ...asset, tokenAddress: canonicalAddress });
          result.assetsVersioned += Number(stored.created);
          assetIds.set(address.toLowerCase(), {
            ...asset,
            tokenAddress: canonicalAddress,
            id: stored.assetId,
            tokenToShareRatio: typeof asset.shareDenomination?.tokenToShareRatio === "string"
              ? asset.shareDenomination.tokenToShareRatio
              : null,
          });
        } catch (error) {
          result.failures.push({ address, stage: "CATALOGUE_VALIDATION", reason: safeErrorMessage(error) });
        }
      }

      const entries = [...assetIds.values()];
      const observed = await mapBounded(entries, MAX_COLLECTION_CONCURRENCY, async (asset) => {
        if (!this.adapter.observe) {
          result.evidenceLimitations.push(
            `${asset.ticker}: provider adapter does not expose a provider timestamp for price observations.`,
          );
          return;
        }
        try {
          const observation = await this.adapter.observe(asset, now());
          if (!observation) return;
          const complete: MarketObservationInput = {
            ...observation,
            ownerAddress: owner,
            assetId: asset.id,
            ingestedAt: now(),
            idempotencyKey: buildObservationIdempotencyKey(asset.id, observation),
          };
          const errors = validateMarketObservation(
            complete,
            now(),
            this.options.maxObservationAgeMs ?? MAX_MARKET_OBSERVATION_AGE_MS,
          );
          if (errors.length) {
            result.failures.push({ address: asset.tokenAddress, stage: "OBSERVATION_VALIDATION", reason: errors.join(" ") });
            return;
          }
          const stored = await this.store.recordObservation(complete);
          result.observationsStored += Number(stored.created);
        } catch (error) {
          result.failures.push({ address: asset.tokenAddress, stage: "OBSERVATION", reason: safeErrorMessage(error) });
        }
      });
      void observed;

      const intervals = this.options.intervals ?? [];
      if (intervals.length && this.adapter.candles) {
        await mapBounded(entries, MAX_COLLECTION_CONCURRENCY, async (asset) => {
          try {
            const candles = await this.adapter.candles!(asset, intervals, now());
            for (const candle of candles) {
              const invalid = validateCandle(candle, now());
              if (invalid) {
                result.failures.push({ address: asset.tokenAddress, stage: "CANDLE_VALIDATION", reason: invalid });
                continue;
              }
              const stored = await this.store.recordCandle({
                ownerAddress: owner,
                assetId: asset.id,
                ...candle,
              });
              result.candlesStored += Number(stored.created);
            }
          } catch (error) {
            result.failures.push({ address: asset.tokenAddress, stage: "CANDLES", reason: safeErrorMessage(error) });
          }
        });
      }

      result.completedAt = now();
      await this.store.appendEvent(null, {
        eventType: "MARKET_COLLECTION_COMPLETED",
        occurredAt: result.completedAt,
        correlationId: `${this.adapter.providerId}:${startedAt}`,
        payload: {
          provider: result.provider,
          assetsVersioned: result.assetsVersioned,
          observationsStored: result.observationsStored,
          candlesStored: result.candlesStored,
          failureCount: result.failures.length,
          evidenceLimitations: result.evidenceLimitations,
        },
        provenance: { source: "market-data-collector", provider: this.adapter.providerId },
      }, owner);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const reason = safeErrorMessage(error);
      await this.store.appendEvent(null, {
        eventType: "MARKET_COLLECTION_FAILED",
        occurredAt: now(),
        correlationId: `${this.adapter.providerId}:${startedAt}`,
        payload: { provider: this.adapter.providerId, reason },
        provenance: { source: "market-data-collector", provider: this.adapter.providerId },
      }, owner);
      throw new MarketCollectorError("PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE", "Market collection failed; sanitized failure details were recorded.");
    }

    function requireOwnerAddress(value: string): string {
      if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(value)) throw new TypeError("A valid wallet owner is required for market collection.");
      return value.toLowerCase();
    }
  }
}

export function detectPersistedOpportunities(
  observations: Parameters<typeof detectCrossVenueOpportunity>[0]["evidence"],
  now: number,
  minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent: number,
) {
  return detectCrossVenueOpportunity({
    evidence: observations,
    now,
    maxAgeMs: MAX_MARKET_OBSERVATION_AGE_MS,
    minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent,
  });
}

function buildObservationIdempotencyKey(
  assetId: string,
  observation: Omit<MarketObservationInput, "assetId" | "idempotencyKey">,
): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify([
    assetId,
    observation.source,
    observation.providerTimestamp,
    observation.price,
    observation.referencePrice,
    observation.bid,
    observation.ask,
    observation.spreadPercent,
    observation.currency,
    observation.priceKind,
    observation.verificationStatus,
  ])).digest("hex");
}

function validateCandle(candle: CollectorCandle, now: number): string | null {
  const amounts = [candle.open, candle.high, candle.low, candle.close];
  if (amounts.some((value) => !isPositiveDecimal(value))) return "Candle OHLC prices must be positive decimals.";
  if (candle.volume !== null && !isNonnegativeDecimal(candle.volume)) return "Candle volume must be a non-negative decimal.";
  const open = Number(candle.open);
  const high = Number(candle.high);
  const low = Number(candle.low);
  const close = Number(candle.close);
  if (![open, high, low, close].every(Number.isFinite) || low > Math.min(open, close) || high < Math.max(open, close)) {
    return "Candle OHLC values are inconsistent.";
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(candle.openingAt) || !Number.isSafeInteger(candle.closingAt) ||
    candle.openingAt <= 0 || candle.closingAt <= candle.openingAt || candle.closingAt > now + 30_000) {
    return "Candle timestamps are invalid.";
  }
  if (!candle.interval.trim() || !candle.provider.trim() ||
    !["VERIFIED", "UNVERIFIED", "REJECTED"].includes(candle.verificationStatus) ||
    !isRecord(candle.provenance)) return "Candle provenance is incomplete.";
  return null;
}

function isPositiveDecimal(value: string): boolean {
  return /^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value) && Number.isFinite(Number(value)) && Number(value) > 0;
}

function isNonnegativeDecimal(value: string): boolean {
  return /^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value) && Number.isFinite(Number(value));
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

async function mapBounded<T>(
  values: readonly T[],
  concurrency: number,
  operation: (value: T) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, values.length) }, async () => {
    while (true) {
      const index = next++;
      if (index >= values.length) return;
      await operation(values[index]);
    }
  });
  await Promise.all(workers);
}

function safeErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (!(error instanceof Error)) return "Provider returned an unknown error.";
  return error.message
    .replace(/\bhttps?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/gi, "[redacted URL]")
    .replace(/\b(bearer\s+)[^\s,;]+/gi, "$1[redacted]")
    .replace(/\b(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|authorization)\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,;]+/gi, "$1=[redacted]")
    .slice(0, 300);
}

    targetToken: Address

export type AgentCycleReason =
    | "TRIGGER_NOT_MET"
    | "INTENT_PENDING"
    | "CAP_EXCEEDED"
    | "TRADE_CAP_EXCEEDED"
    | "CIRCUIT_BREAKER_PAUSED"
    | "SESSION_REVOKED"
    | "SESSION_NOT_INSTALLED"
    | "POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED"
    | "POLICY_EXPIRED"
    | "SLIPPAGE_HIGH"
    | "VALIDATOR_PASS"
    | "RPC_FAILURE"
    | "WORKER_PANIC_STOP"
    | "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED"
    | "ONCHAIN_EXECUTION_REVERTED"
    | "USEROP_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT"

export type AgentCycleTelemetry = {
    type: "agent_evaluation"
    strategyId: string
    account: Address
    targetToken: Address
    timestamp: string
    currentPriceMicros?: string
    cumulativeVolumeBnb?: string
    attemptedTradeBnb: string
    remainingCapacityBnb?: string

    detail?: string
