export type AgentExecutionIntent = {
    strategyId: string
    account: Address
    targetToken: Address
    amountBnb: bigint
    amountOutMin: bigint
    priceImpactBps: number
    slippageBps: number
    maxPriceImpactBps: number
    sourcePriceMicros: bigint
    createdAt: string
    policyHash: Hex
}

export type AgentWorkerDependencies = {
    strategies: readonly AgentStrategy[]
    readMarket: (strategy: AgentStrategy) => Promise<MarketSnapshot>
    readValidator: (strategy: AgentStrategy) => Promise<ValidatorSnapshot>
    log: (event: AgentCycleTelemetry) => void
    alert: (event: {
        priority: "high"
        reasonCode: "WORKER_PANIC_STOP"
        message: string
        timestamp: string
    }) => void | Promise<void>
    onIntent?: (intent: AgentExecutionIntent) => void | Promise<void>
    now?: () => number
}

export type AgentWorkerOptions = {
    intervalMs: number
    maxConsecutiveFailures: number
    maxMarketAgeMs: number
}

const MAX_MARKET_AGE_MS = 20_000
const DEFAULT_OPTIONS: AgentWorkerOptions = {
    intervalMs: 5_000,
    maxConsecutiveFailures: 3,
    maxMarketAgeMs: MAX_MARKET_AGE_MS
}

const validatorAbi = [
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "paused",
        inputs: [],
        outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
        stateMutability: "view"
    },
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "isInitialized",
        inputs: [{ name: "smartAccount", type: "address" }],
        outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
        stateMutability: "view"
    },
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "isRevoked",
        inputs: [{ name: "smartAccount", type: "address" }],
        outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
        stateMutability: "view"
    },
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "getEffectiveRollingVolume",
        inputs: [{ name: "account", type: "address" }],
        outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }],
        stateMutability: "view"
    },
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "getAccountPolicy",
        inputs: [{ name: "account", type: "address" }],
        outputs: [
            { name: "configured", type: "bool" },
            { name: "policyHash", type: "bytes32" },
            { name: "maxTradeValue", type: "uint192" },
            { name: "expiresAt", type: "uint64" },
            { name: "intentSigner", type: "address" }
        ],
        stateMutability: "view"
    }
] as const

export function createViemValidatorReader(
    client: Client,
    validatorAddress: Address
) {
    return async (strategy: AgentStrategy): Promise<ValidatorSnapshot> => {
        const [paused, installed, revoked, rollingVolume, accountPolicy] = await Promise.all([
            readContract(client, {
                address: validatorAddress,
                abi: validatorAbi,
                functionName: "paused"
            }),
            readContract(client, {
                address: validatorAddress,
                abi: validatorAbi,
                functionName: "isInitialized",
                args: [strategy.account]
            }),
            readContract(client, {
                address: validatorAddress,
                abi: validatorAbi,
                functionName: "isRevoked",
                args: [strategy.account]
            }),
            readContract(client, {
                address: validatorAddress,
                abi: validatorAbi,
                functionName: "getEffectiveRollingVolume",
                args: [strategy.account]
            }),
            readContract(client, {
                address: validatorAddress,
                abi: validatorAbi,
                functionName: "getAccountPolicy",
                args: [strategy.account]
            })
        ])
        const [policyConfigured, policyHash, maxTradeValue, policyExpiresAt, intentSigner] =
            accountPolicy
        return {
            paused,
            installed,
            revoked,
            rollingVolume,
            policyConfigured,
            policyHash,
            maxTradeValue,
            policyExpiresAt,
            intentSigner
        }
    }
}

export class AgentWorker {
    private readonly dependencies: AgentWorkerDependencies
    private readonly options: AgentWorkerOptions
    private interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined
    private running = false
    private halted = false
    private inFlight = false
    private consecutiveFailures = 0
    private generation = 0
    private pendingIntent: AgentExecutionIntent | undefined

    constructor(
        dependencies: AgentWorkerDependencies,
        options: Partial<AgentWorkerOptions> = {}
    ) {
        this.dependencies = dependencies
        this.options = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options }
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(this.options.intervalMs) || this.options.intervalMs < 250) {
            throw new Error("intervalMs must be an integer of at least 250ms")
        }
        if (
            !Number.isSafeInteger(this.options.maxConsecutiveFailures)
            || this.options.maxConsecutiveFailures < 1
        ) {
            throw new Error("maxConsecutiveFailures must be a positive integer")
        }
        if (
            !Number.isSafeInteger(this.options.maxMarketAgeMs)
            || this.options.maxMarketAgeMs < 1
            || this.options.maxMarketAgeMs > MAX_MARKET_AGE_MS
        ) {
            throw new Error("maxMarketAgeMs must be between 1 and 20000")
        }
    }

    get isRunning() {
        return this.running
    }

    get hasPendingIntent() {
        return this.pendingIntent !== undefined
    }

    getPendingIntent() {
        return this.pendingIntent
    }

    acknowledgeIntent(strategyId: string) {
        if (this.pendingIntent?.strategyId !== strategyId) return false
        this.dropIntent()
        return true
    }

    start() {
        if (this.running || this.halted) return
        this.running = true
        this.generation += 1
        this.interval = setInterval(() => {
            void this.evaluateOnce()
        }, this.options.intervalMs)
        void this.evaluateOnce()
    }

    stop() {
        this.running = false
        this.generation += 1
        if (this.interval !== undefined) clearInterval(this.interval)
        this.interval = undefined
        this.dropIntent()
    }

    async runOnce() {
        if (this.running) await this.evaluateOnce()
    }

    async evaluateOnce() {
        if (this.halted || this.inFlight) return
        this.inFlight = true
        const generation = this.generation
        try {
            for (const strategy of this.dependencies.strategies) {
                if (this.halted || generation !== this.generation) break
                await this.evaluate(strategy, generation)
            }
        } finally {
            this.inFlight = false
        }
    }

    private async evaluate(strategy: AgentStrategy, generation: number) {
        const timestamp = this.timestamp()
        let market: MarketSnapshot | undefined
        let validator: ValidatorSnapshot | undefined

        try {
            market = await this.dependencies.readMarket(strategy)
            validator = await this.dependencies.readValidator(strategy)
        } catch (error) {
            if (generation !== this.generation || this.halted) return
            await this.failCycle(strategy, timestamp, "RPC_FAILURE", error)
            return
        }
        if (generation !== this.generation || this.halted) return

        const remainingCapacity = MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB - validator.rollingVolume
        const telemetry = (
            reasonCode: AgentCycleReason,
            detail?: string,
            priceImpactBps?: number
        ): AgentCycleTelemetry => ({
            type: "agent_evaluation",
            strategyId: strategy.id,
            account: strategy.account,
            targetToken: strategy.targetToken,
            timestamp,
            currentPriceMicros: market?.priceMicros.toString(),
            cumulativeVolumeBnb: validator?.rollingVolume.toString(),
            attemptedTradeBnb: strategy.amountBnb.toString(),
            remainingCapacityBnb: (
                remainingCapacity > BigInt(0) ? remainingCapacity : BigInt(0)
            ).toString(),
            priceImpactBps,
            slippageBps: strategy.slippageBps,
            reasonCode,
            detail
        })

        if (market.observedAt > this.now() || this.now() - market.observedAt >= this.options.maxMarketAgeMs) {
            await this.failCycle(
                strategy,
                timestamp,
                "RPC_FAILURE",
                new Error("Market snapshot is stale or has a future timestamp"),
                market,
                validator
            )
            return
        }
        if (validator.paused) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("CIRCUIT_BREAKER_PAUSED"))
            return
        }
        if (validator.revoked) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("SESSION_REVOKED"))
            return
        }
        if (!validator.installed) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("SESSION_NOT_INSTALLED"))
            return
        }
        if (
            !validator.policyConfigured || /^0x0{64}$/i.test(validator.policyHash)
                || /^0x0{40}$/i.test(validator.intentSigner)
        ) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED"))
            return
        }
        if (validator.policyExpiresAt * BigInt(1000) <= BigInt(this.now())) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("POLICY_EXPIRED"))
            return
        }
        if (strategy.amountBnb <= BigInt(0) || strategy.amountBnb > MAX_TRADE_BNB) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("TRADE_CAP_EXCEEDED"))
            return
        }
        if (strategy.amountBnb > validator.maxTradeValue) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("TRADE_CAP_EXCEEDED"))
            return
        }
        if (
            validator.rollingVolume < BigInt(0)
            || validator.rollingVolume > MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB
            || strategy.amountBnb > remainingCapacity
        ) {
            this.rejectCycle(strategy, telemetry("CAP_EXCEEDED"))
            return
        }
        if (market.priceMicros > strategy.entryPriceMicros) {
            this.record(telemetry("TRIGGER_NOT_MET"))
            this.consecutiveFailures = 0
            return
        }
        if (this.pendingIntent) {
            this.record(telemetry("INTENT_PENDING"))
            return
        }

        let quote: ReturnType<typeof calculateDynamicQuote>
        try {
            quote = calculateDynamicQuote(
                strategy.amountBnb,
                market.reserves,
                strategy.slippageBps,
                strategy.maxPriceImpactBps
            )
        } catch (error) {
            const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Quote calculation failed"
            this.rejectCycle(
                strategy,
                telemetry(
                    message.includes("Price impact") ? "SLIPPAGE_HIGH" : "RPC_FAILURE",
                    message
                ),
                message.includes("Price impact")
            )
            return
        }

        this.record(telemetry("VALIDATOR_PASS", undefined, quote.priceImpactBps))
        this.consecutiveFailures = 0
        try {
            const intent: AgentExecutionIntent = {
                strategyId: strategy.id,
                account: strategy.account,
                targetToken: strategy.targetToken,
                amountBnb: strategy.amountBnb,
                amountOutMin: quote.amountOutMin,
                priceImpactBps: quote.priceImpactBps,
                slippageBps: strategy.slippageBps,
                maxPriceImpactBps: strategy.maxPriceImpactBps,
                sourcePriceMicros: market.priceMicros,
                createdAt: new Date(market.receivedAt ?? market.observedAt).toISOString(),
                policyHash: validator.policyHash
            }
            if (generation !== this.generation || this.halted) return
            this.pendingIntent = intent
            await this.dependencies.onIntent?.(intent)
        } catch (error) {
            if (generation !== this.generation || this.halted) return
            await this.failCycle(strategy, timestamp, "RPC_FAILURE", error, market, validator)
        }
    }

    private rejectCycle(
        strategy: AgentStrategy,
        event: AgentCycleTelemetry,
        countsTowardPanic = true
    ) {
        this.record(event)
        if (countsTowardPanic) this.countFailure(strategy, event.detail ?? event.reasonCode)
        else this.consecutiveFailures = 0
    }

    private async failCycle(
        strategy: AgentStrategy,
        timestamp: string,
        reasonCode: "RPC_FAILURE",
        error: unknown,
        market?: MarketSnapshot,
        validator?: ValidatorSnapshot
    ) {
        const detail = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown RPC or worker error"
        this.record({
            type: "agent_evaluation",
            strategyId: strategy.id,
            account: strategy.account,
            targetToken: strategy.targetToken,
            timestamp,
            currentPriceMicros: market?.priceMicros.toString(),
            cumulativeVolumeBnb: validator?.rollingVolume.toString(),
            attemptedTradeBnb: strategy.amountBnb.toString(),
            remainingCapacityBnb: validator
                ? (MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB > validator.rollingVolume
                    ? MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB - validator.rollingVolume
                    : BigInt(0)).toString()
                : undefined,
            slippageBps: strategy.slippageBps,
            reasonCode,
            detail
        })
        this.countFailure(strategy, detail)
    }

    private countFailure(strategy: AgentStrategy, detail: string) {
        this.consecutiveFailures += 1
        if (this.consecutiveFailures < this.options.maxConsecutiveFailures) return
        this.running = false
        this.halted = true
        this.generation += 1
        if (this.interval !== undefined) clearInterval(this.interval)
        this.interval = undefined
        this.dropIntent()
        const timestamp = this.timestamp()
        this.record({
            type: "agent_evaluation",
            strategyId: strategy.id,
            account: strategy.account,
            targetToken: strategy.targetToken,
            timestamp,
            attemptedTradeBnb: strategy.amountBnb.toString(),
            slippageBps: strategy.slippageBps,
            reasonCode: "WORKER_PANIC_STOP",
            detail
        })
        void Promise.resolve(this.dependencies.alert({
            priority: "high",
            reasonCode: "WORKER_PANIC_STOP",
            message: `Agent worker halted after ${this.consecutiveFailures} consecutive policy/RPC failures: ${detail}`,
            timestamp
        })).catch(error => {
            console.error("Failed to deliver agent panic-stop alert", error)
        })
    }

    reportExecutionFailure(
        strategyId: string,
        reasonCode: Extract<
            AgentCycleReason,
            "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED" | "ONCHAIN_EXECUTION_REVERTED" | "USEROP_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT" | "RPC_FAILURE"
        >,
        detail: string
    ) {
        const strategy = this.dependencies.strategies.find(item => item.id === strategyId)
        if (!strategy) {
            throw new Error(`Unknown agent strategy ${strategyId}`)
        }
        if (this.halted) return
        this.record({
            type: "agent_evaluation",
            strategyId,
            account: strategy.account,
            targetToken: strategy.targetToken,
            timestamp: this.timestamp(),
            attemptedTradeBnb: strategy.amountBnb.toString(),
            slippageBps: strategy.slippageBps,
            reasonCode,
            detail
        })
        this.countFailure(strategy, `${reasonCode}: ${detail}`)
    }

    private dropIntent() {
        this.pendingIntent = undefined
    }

    private record(event: AgentCycleTelemetry) {
        this.dependencies.log(event)
    }

    private now() {
        return (this.dependencies.now ?? Date.now)()
    }

    private timestamp() {
        return new Date(this.now()).toISOString()
    }
}
import "server-only";
import { evaluateRiskPolicy, type RiskPolicy } from "../lib/agentControlPlane.ts";

export type AutonomousTradeIntent = {
  ownerAddress: string;
  assetAddress: string;
  direction: "BUY" | "SELL";
  notional: string;
  dailyExposure: string;
  recentProposalCount: number;
  slippageBps: number;
  referenceDeviationPercent: number | null;
  dataFresh: boolean;
  quoteExpiresAt: number | null;
  availableBalance: string | null;
  session: string;
  chainId: 97 | 56;
};

export type AutonomousTradingDecision =
  | { allowed: true; policyVersion: string }
  | { allowed: false; reasons: string[] };

export function evaluateAutonomousTradingGate(
  policy: RiskPolicy | null,
  intent: AutonomousTradeIntent,
  now: number,
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
): AutonomousTradingDecision {
  if (env.WOLV_AUTONOMOUS_TRADING_ENABLED !== "true") {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: ["Autonomous trading is disabled."] };
  }
  if (!policy) {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: ["No active deterministic risk policy is configured."] };
  }
  if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(intent.ownerAddress)) {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: ["Owner wallet address is invalid."] };
  }
  if (env.ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION !== "true") {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: ["Live UserOperation submission is disabled."] };
  }
  if (intent.chainId === 56 &&
    (env.ENABLE_MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING !== "true" ||
      env.MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING_ACK !== "I_ACCEPT_AUTONOMOUS_MAINNET_RISK")) {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: ["Mainnet autonomous trading is not separately authorized."] };
  }
  if (intent.chainId !== 97 && intent.chainId !== 56) {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: ["Unsupported autonomous-trading chain."] };
  }

  const decision = evaluateRiskPolicy({
    policy,
    assetKey: intent.assetAddress.toLowerCase(),
    direction: intent.direction,
    notional: intent.notional,
    dailyExposure: intent.dailyExposure,
    recentProposalCount: intent.recentProposalCount,
    slippageBps: intent.slippageBps,
    referenceDeviationPercent: intent.referenceDeviationPercent,
    dataFresh: intent.dataFresh,
    quoteExpiresAt: intent.quoteExpiresAt,
    availableBalance: intent.availableBalance,
    session: intent.session,
    now,
  });
  if (!decision.accepted) {
    return { allowed: false, reasons: decision.refusalReasons };
  }
  return { allowed: true, policyVersion: decision.policyVersion };
}
import type { getRWATokenList } from "../lib/binance.ts"
import { EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN } from "../lib/apiValidation.ts"
import { parseRwaAssetRecords } from "../lib/rwaAssetResponse.ts"
import {
    resolveBscTokenMetadata,
    selectTrustedBawSpotAsset,
    type BscMetadataClient,
} from "./bscTokenMetadata.ts"

export type ResolvedBawSpotAsset = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof resolveBawSpotAsset>>

export async function resolveBawSpotAsset(
    tokenAddress: string,
    dependencies: {
        getTokenList?: typeof getRWATokenList
        metadataClient?: BscMetadataClient
        now?: () => number
    } = {},
) {
    if (typeof tokenAddress !== "string" || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(tokenAddress)) return null
    const getTokenList = dependencies.getTokenList ?? (await import("../lib/binance.ts")).getRWATokenList
    const records = parseRwaAssetRecords(await getTokenList())
    const asset = selectTrustedBawSpotAsset(records, tokenAddress)
    if (!asset) return null

    const metadata = await resolveBscTokenMetadata(asset, {
        client: dependencies.metadataClient,
        now: dependencies.now,
    })
    return {
        ...asset,
        decimals: metadata.token.decimals,
        decimalMetadata: metadata.token,
        usdtDecimalMetadata: metadata.usdt,
    }
}
import { createHash } from "node:crypto"
import { formatUnits, parseUnits } from "viem"
import {
    BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
    EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN,
    MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT,
} from "../lib/apiValidation.ts"
import { marketLabel } from "../lib/opportunityMath.ts"
import { createQuoteBinding, verifyQuoteBinding } from "../lib/quoteBinding.ts"
import { isFreshQuote, TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS } from "../lib/tradeReadiness.ts"
import { validateQuote } from "../lib/quoteValidation.ts"
import {
    BawCliError,
    buildBawMarketQuoteArgs,
    createBawRunner,
    parseBawMarketQuoteOutput,
    readWalletSnapshot,
    type BawQuoteDirection,
    type BawRunner,
    type BawQuoteOutput,
    type BawWalletSnapshot,
} from "./bawCli.ts"
import { BscTokenMetadataError, type BscTokenDecimalMetadata } from "./bscTokenMetadata.ts"

const BAW_CHAIN_ID = "56"
const UINT256_MAX = (BigInt(1) << BigInt(256)) - BigInt(1)
const AMOUNT_PATTERN = /^\d{1,78}(?:\.\d{1,18})?$/
const SLIPPAGE_BPS_MAX = 500
const DEAD_ADDRESS = "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD"

export type AgentQuoteInput = {
    direction: BawQuoteDirection
    tokenAddress: string
    amount: string
    chainId: string
    slippageBps: number
}

export type AgentQuoteAsset = {
    tokenContractAddress: string
    underlyingTicker: string
    platformId?: string
    symbol?: string
    decimals?: number | null
    decimalMetadata?: BscTokenDecimalMetadata | null
    usdtDecimalMetadata?: BscTokenDecimalMetadata | null
    referencePrice?: string | number | null
    tokenToShareRatio?: string | number | null
    statusInfo?: { marketStatus?: string | null; openState?: boolean | null }
}

export type AgentQuoteResponse = {
    status: "QUOTED"
    eligibility: "ELIGIBLE" | "REJECTED"
    rejectionReasons: string[]
    direction: BawQuoteDirection
    chainId: string
    tokenAddress: string
    underlyingTicker: string
    walletAddress: string
    fromTokenAddress: string
    toTokenAddress: string
    fromTokenMetadata: BscTokenDecimalMetadata
    toTokenMetadata: BscTokenDecimalMetadata
    fromCoinSymbol: string
    fromCoinAmount: string
    toCoinSymbol: string
    toCoinAmount: string
    slippage: number
    slippageBps: number
    tokenPriceUsd: number
    referencePrice: number
    referenceGapPercent: number | null
    tokenDecimals: number | null
    quoteFetchedAt: number
    expiresAt: number
    quoteBindingId: string
    quoteBinding: string
    execution: { transactionSubmitted: false; signingRequested: false }
}

export type VerifiedAgentQuote = {
    input: AgentQuoteInput & { amount: string }
    quote: BawQuoteOutput
    response: AgentQuoteResponse
}

export type BawQuoteErrorCode =
    | "INVALID_REQUEST"
    | "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN"
    | "UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN"
    | "WALLET_DISCONNECTED"
    | "WALLET_ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE"
    | "MARKET_SESSION_CLOSED"
    | "MARKET_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE"
    | "ORDER_BELOW_MINIMUM"
    | "REFERENCE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE"
    | "BAW_UNAVAILABLE"
    | "BAW_TIMEOUT"
    | "BAW_RATE_LIMITED"
    | "BAW_COMMAND_FAILED"
    | "BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED"
    | "INVALID_OUTPUT"
    | "QUOTE_BINDING_UNAVAILABLE"

export class BawQuoteError extends Error {
    readonly code: BawQuoteErrorCode
    readonly status: number

    constructor(code: BawQuoteErrorCode, message: string, status: number) {
        super(message)
        this.name = "BawQuoteError"
        this.code = code
        this.status = status
    }
}

export type ParsedAgentQuoteInput =
    | { ok: true; input: AgentQuoteInput & { amount: string } }
    | { ok: false; reason: string }

export function parseAgentQuoteInput(value: unknown): ParsedAgentQuoteInput {
    if (!isRecord(value)) return { ok: false, reason: "Request body must be a JSON object." }
    const expectedKeys = ["amount", "chainId", "direction", "slippageBps", "tokenAddress"]
    if (!hasExactKeys(value, expectedKeys)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Request must contain only direction, tokenAddress, amount, chainId, and slippageBps." }
    }
    if (value.direction !== "BUY" && value.direction !== "SELL") {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Direction must be BUY or SELL." }
    }
    if (typeof value.tokenAddress !== "string" || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value.tokenAddress)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Token address must be a valid EVM address." }
    }
    if (typeof value.chainId !== "string" || value.chainId !== BAW_CHAIN_ID) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Only BNB Smart Chain mainnet (chain ID 56) is supported." }
    }
    if (typeof value.amount !== "string") {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Amount must be a positive human-readable decimal quantity." }
    }
    const amount = normalizeHumanAmount(value.amount)
    if (!amount) return { ok: false, reason: "Amount must be a positive decimal with no more than 18 decimal places." }
    if (
        typeof value.slippageBps !== "number" ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(value.slippageBps) ||
        value.slippageBps < 1 ||
        value.slippageBps > SLIPPAGE_BPS_MAX
    ) {
        return { ok: false, reason: `slippageBps must be an integer from 1 to ${SLIPPAGE_BPS_MAX}.` }
    }

    return {
        ok: true,
        input: {
            direction: value.direction,
            tokenAddress: value.tokenAddress,
            amount,
            chainId: value.chainId,
            slippageBps: value.slippageBps,
        },
    }
}

export function slippageBpsToBawPercent(slippageBps: number): string {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(slippageBps) || slippageBps < 1 || slippageBps > SLIPPAGE_BPS_MAX) {
        throw new BawQuoteError(
            "INVALID_REQUEST",
            `slippageBps must be an integer from 1 to ${SLIPPAGE_BPS_MAX}.`,
            422,
        )
    }
    return (slippageBps / 100).toFixed(2).replace(/(?:\.0+|(?:(\.\d*?)0+))$/, "$1")
}

export function verifyAgentQuoteResponse(value: unknown, now = Date.now()): VerifiedAgentQuote | null {
    if (!isRecord(value) || !hasExactKeys(value, [
        "status", "eligibility", "rejectionReasons", "direction", "chainId", "tokenAddress",
        "underlyingTicker", "walletAddress", "fromTokenAddress", "toTokenAddress",
        "fromTokenMetadata", "toTokenMetadata", "fromCoinSymbol", "fromCoinAmount",
        "toCoinSymbol", "toCoinAmount", "slippage", "slippageBps", "tokenPriceUsd", "referencePrice",
        "referenceGapPercent", "tokenDecimals", "quoteFetchedAt", "expiresAt", "quoteBindingId", "quoteBinding", "execution",
    ])) return null

    if (
        value.status !== "QUOTED" ||
        value.eligibility !== "ELIGIBLE" ||
        typeof value.underlyingTicker !== "string" ||
        !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,28}$/.test(value.underlyingTicker) ||
        !Array.isArray(value.rejectionReasons) ||
        value.rejectionReasons.length !== 0 ||
        typeof value.walletAddress !== "string" ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value.walletAddress) ||
        (value.tokenDecimals !== null &&
            (typeof value.tokenDecimals !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(value.tokenDecimals) || value.tokenDecimals < 0 || value.tokenDecimals > 18)) ||
        typeof value.quoteFetchedAt !== "number" ||
        typeof value.expiresAt !== "number" ||
        value.expiresAt !== value.quoteFetchedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS ||
        typeof value.quoteBindingId !== "string" ||
        !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value.quoteBindingId) ||
        typeof value.quoteBinding !== "string" ||
        !isRecord(value.execution) ||
        !hasExactKeys(value.execution, ["transactionSubmitted", "signingRequested"]) ||
        value.execution.transactionSubmitted !== false ||
        value.execution.signingRequested !== false ||
        (value.referenceGapPercent !== null &&
            (typeof value.referenceGapPercent !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value.referenceGapPercent)))
    ) return null

    const parsedInput = parseAgentQuoteInput({
        direction: value.direction,
        tokenAddress: value.tokenAddress,
        amount: value.fromCoinAmount,
        chainId: value.chainId,
        slippageBps: value.slippageBps,
    })
    if (!parsedInput.ok) return null
    const input = parsedInput.input
    const fromTokenAddress = input.direction === "BUY" ? BSC_USDT_ADDRESS : input.tokenAddress
    const toTokenAddress = input.direction === "BUY" ? input.tokenAddress : BSC_USDT_ADDRESS
    const fromTokenMetadata = parseBscTokenDecimalMetadata(value.fromTokenMetadata)
    const toTokenMetadata = parseBscTokenDecimalMetadata(value.toTokenMetadata)
    const selectedTokenMetadata = input.direction === "BUY" ? toTokenMetadata : fromTokenMetadata
    if (
        typeof value.fromTokenAddress !== "string" ||
        value.fromTokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== fromTokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
        typeof value.toTokenAddress !== "string" ||
        value.toTokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== toTokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
        !fromTokenMetadata ||
        !toTokenMetadata ||
        !selectedTokenMetadata ||
        fromTokenMetadata.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== fromTokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
        toTokenMetadata.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== toTokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
        value.tokenDecimals !== selectedTokenMetadata.decimals ||
        typeof value.fromCoinSymbol !== "string" ||
        typeof value.toCoinSymbol !== "string"
    ) return null

    let quote: BawQuoteOutput
    try {
        quote = parseBawMarketQuoteOutput(JSON.stringify({
            success: true,
            data: {
                fromCoinSymbol: value.fromCoinSymbol,
                fromCoinAmount: value.fromCoinAmount,
                toCoinSymbol: value.toCoinSymbol,
                toCoinAmount: value.toCoinAmount,
                slippage: value.slippage,
            },
        }), {
            direction: input.direction,
            amount: input.amount,
            slippagePercent: slippageBpsToBawPercent(input.slippageBps),
            tokenSymbol: input.direction === "BUY" ? value.toCoinSymbol : value.fromCoinSymbol,
        })
    } catch {
        return null
    }

    const expectedQuoteId = createHash("sha256")
        .update(JSON.stringify({
            input,
            quote,
            fromTokenMetadata,
            toTokenMetadata,
            tokenDecimals: value.tokenDecimals,
            walletAddress: value.walletAddress,
            quoteFetchedAt: value.quoteFetchedAt,
        }))
        .digest("hex")
    if (expectedQuoteId !== value.quoteBindingId || !isFreshQuote({ quoteFetchedAt: value.quoteFetchedAt }, now)) return null

    const binding = verifyQuoteBinding(value.quoteBinding, {
        toToken: toTokenAddress,
        fromToken: fromTokenAddress,
        amount: input.amount,
        wallet: value.walletAddress,
        quoteId: expectedQuoteId,
        chainId: input.chainId,
        direction: input.direction,
        slippageBps: input.slippageBps,
    }, value.quoteFetchedAt)
    if (!binding.ok) return null

    const tokenDecimals = typeof value.tokenDecimals === "number" ? value.tokenDecimals : null
    const tokenPriceUsd = positiveFinite(value.tokenPriceUsd)
    const referencePrice = positiveFinite(value.referencePrice)
    if (
        tokenPriceUsd === null ||
        referencePrice === null ||
        typeof value.slippage !== "number" ||
        !Number.isFinite(value.slippage)
    ) return null
    const tokenAmount = input.direction === "BUY" ? quote.toCoinAmount : quote.fromCoinAmount
    const usdtAmount = input.direction === "BUY" ? quote.fromCoinAmount : quote.toCoinAmount
    const computedPrice = Number(usdtAmount) / Number(tokenAmount)
    if (!Number.isFinite(computedPrice) || Math.abs(computedPrice - tokenPriceUsd) > Math.max(1e-10, computedPrice * 1e-10)) {
        return null
    }

    return {
        input,
        quote,
        response: {
            status: "QUOTED",
            eligibility: "ELIGIBLE",
            rejectionReasons: [],
            direction: input.direction,
            chainId: input.chainId,
            tokenAddress: input.tokenAddress,
            underlyingTicker: value.underlyingTicker,
            walletAddress: value.walletAddress,
            fromTokenAddress,
            toTokenAddress,
            fromTokenMetadata,
            toTokenMetadata,
            fromCoinSymbol: quote.fromCoinSymbol,
            fromCoinAmount: quote.fromCoinAmount,
            toCoinSymbol: quote.toCoinSymbol,
            toCoinAmount: quote.toCoinAmount,
            slippage: quote.slippage,
            slippageBps: input.slippageBps,
            tokenPriceUsd,
            referencePrice,
            referenceGapPercent: value.referenceGapPercent,
            tokenDecimals,
            quoteFetchedAt: value.quoteFetchedAt,
            expiresAt: value.expiresAt,
            quoteBindingId: expectedQuoteId,
            quoteBinding: value.quoteBinding,
            execution: { transactionSubmitted: false, signingRequested: false },
        },
    }
}

export async function getBawQuote(
    request: AgentQuoteInput,
    dependencies: {
        runner?: BawRunner
        readSnapshot?: (runner: BawRunner, now: () => number) => Promise<BawWalletSnapshot>
        resolveAsset?: (tokenAddress: string) => Promise<AgentQuoteAsset | null>
        now?: () => number
    } = {},
): Promise<AgentQuoteResponse> {
    const parsedRequest = parseAgentQuoteInput(request)
    if (!parsedRequest.ok) throw new BawQuoteError("INVALID_REQUEST", parsedRequest.reason, 422)
    const input = parsedRequest.input
    const now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now
    const runner = dependencies.runner ?? createBawRunner()
    const snapshot = await (dependencies.readSnapshot ?? ((cli, clock) => readWalletSnapshot({ runner: cli, now: clock })))(runner, now)

    if (!snapshot.connected) {
        throw new BawQuoteError("WALLET_DISCONNECTED", "The Binance Agentic Wallet session is not connected.", 409)
    }
    const chainAvailable = snapshot.chains.some((chain) => chain.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID)
    const walletAddress = snapshot.addresses.find((address) => address.binanceChainId === BAW_CHAIN_ID)?.address
    if (!chainAvailable || !walletAddress || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(walletAddress) || walletAddress.toLowerCase() === DEAD_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new BawQuoteError("WALLET_ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE", "A connected BAW wallet address for BNB Smart Chain mainnet is unavailable.", 409)
    }

    const resolveAsset = dependencies.resolveAsset
    if (!resolveAsset) {
        throw new BawQuoteError("UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN", "Spot-token verification is unavailable.", 503)
    }
    let asset: AgentQuoteAsset | null
    try {
        asset = await resolveAsset(input.tokenAddress)
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BscTokenMetadataError) {
            throw new BawQuoteError("UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN", error.message, 422)
        }
        throw error
    }
    if (
        !asset ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(asset.tokenContractAddress) ||
        asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase() !== input.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() ||
        input.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() === BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()
    ) {
        throw new BawQuoteError("UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN", "Only a supported WOLV spot token can be quoted.", 422)
    }

    const marketStatus = marketLabel({ statusInfo: asset.statusInfo })
    if (marketStatus === "closed") {
        throw new BawQuoteError("MARKET_SESSION_CLOSED", "The token's market session is closed.", 422)
    }
    if (marketStatus !== "open" && marketStatus !== "regular") {
        throw new BawQuoteError("MARKET_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE", "The token's market session is not confirmed open.", 422)
    }

    const referencePrice = positiveFinite(asset.referencePrice)
    const tokenToShareRatio = positiveFinite(asset.tokenToShareRatio)
    const tokenMetadata = parseBscTokenDecimalMetadata(asset.decimalMetadata)
    const usdtMetadata = parseBscTokenDecimalMetadata(asset.usdtDecimalMetadata)
    const tokenDecimals = tokenMetadata?.decimals ?? null
    if (
        referencePrice === null ||
        tokenToShareRatio === null ||
        !tokenMetadata ||
        !usdtMetadata ||
        tokenMetadata.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase() ||
        usdtMetadata.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() ||
        (asset.decimals !== undefined && asset.decimals !== tokenMetadata.decimals)
    ) {
        throw new BawQuoteError(
            "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN",
            "Verified on-chain decimal metadata and reference data are required before a valid BAW quote can be created.",
            422,
        )
    }

    const fromTokenAddress = input.direction === "BUY" ? BSC_USDT_ADDRESS : input.tokenAddress
    const toTokenAddress = input.direction === "BUY" ? input.tokenAddress : BSC_USDT_ADDRESS
    const fromTokenMetadata = input.direction === "BUY" ? usdtMetadata : tokenMetadata
    const toTokenMetadata = input.direction === "BUY" ? tokenMetadata : usdtMetadata
    const inputDecimals = fromTokenMetadata.decimals
    let amountWei: bigint
    try {
        amountWei = parseExactAmountUnits(input.amount, inputDecimals)
    } catch {
        throw new BawQuoteError(
            "INVALID_REQUEST",
            `Amount has more fractional digits than the ${input.direction === "BUY" ? "USDT" : "token"} precision allows.`,
            422,
        )
    }
    if (input.direction === "BUY" && amountWei < parseUnits(MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT, inputDecimals)) {
        throw new BawQuoteError(
            "ORDER_BELOW_MINIMUM",
            `Minimum order amount is ${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT} USDT (approximately $${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT}).`,
            422,
        )
    }
    const amountNumber = Number(input.amount)
    const estimatedSellValue = amountNumber * referencePrice
    if (
        input.direction === "SELL" &&
        (!Number.isFinite(amountNumber) || !Number.isFinite(estimatedSellValue) || estimatedSellValue < Number(MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT))
    ) {
        throw new BawQuoteError(
            "ORDER_BELOW_MINIMUM",
            `Estimated sell value must be at least ${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT} USDT using the current reference price.`,
            422,
        )
    }

    const tokenSymbol = getBawTokenSymbol(asset)
    const underlyingTicker = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,28}$/.test(asset.underlyingTicker) ? asset.underlyingTicker : null
    if (!tokenSymbol || !underlyingTicker) {
        throw new BawQuoteError("UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN", "The spot token has no unambiguous supported symbol mapping.", 422)
    }

    const slippagePercent = slippageBpsToBawPercent(input.slippageBps)
    const args = buildBawMarketQuoteArgs({
        direction: input.direction,
        tokenAddress: input.tokenAddress,
        amount: input.amount,
        chainId: input.chainId,
        slippagePercent,
    })
    let stdout: string
    try {
        ({ stdout } = await runner(args))
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawCliError) throw error
        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException)?.code === "ENOENT") {
            throw new BawCliError("BAW_UNAVAILABLE", "quote")
        }
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_FAILED", "quote")
    }
    const quote = parseBawMarketQuoteOutput(stdout, {
        direction: input.direction,
        amount: input.amount,
        slippagePercent,
        tokenSymbol,
    })

    const fromAmount = Number(quote.fromCoinAmount)
    const toAmount = Number(quote.toCoinAmount)
    const tokenAmount = input.direction === "BUY" ? toAmount : fromAmount
    const usdtAmount = input.direction === "BUY" ? fromAmount : toAmount
    const tokenPriceUsd = usdtAmount / tokenAmount
    const rejectionReasons: string[] = []
    let referenceGapPercent: number | null = null

    if (!Number.isFinite(tokenPriceUsd) || tokenPriceUsd <= 0) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote")
    }
    if (input.direction === "SELL") {
        let quotedProceeds: bigint
        try {
            quotedProceeds = parseExactAmountUnits(quote.toCoinAmount, toTokenMetadata.decimals)
        } catch {
            throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote")
        }
        if (quotedProceeds < parseUnits(MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT, toTokenMetadata.decimals)) {
            rejectionReasons.push(`Quoted sell proceeds are below the ${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT} USDT minimum order amount.`)
        }
    }
    const quoteValidation = validateQuote({
        usd: tokenPriceUsd,
        referencePrice,
        tokenToShareRatio,
    })
    if (!quoteValidation.ok) {
        rejectionReasons.push(quoteValidation.reason)
    } else if (quoteValidation.referenceGap === null) {
        rejectionReasons.push("The quote could not be compared with the reference price.")
    } else {
        referenceGapPercent = quoteValidation.referenceGap
    }
    const quoteFetchedAt = now()
    if (!isFreshQuote({ quoteFetchedAt }, now())) {
        rejectionReasons.push("The quote expired before it could be returned.")
    }
    const quoteId = createHash("sha256")
        .update(JSON.stringify({
            input,
            quote,
            fromTokenMetadata,
            toTokenMetadata,
            tokenDecimals,
            walletAddress,
            quoteFetchedAt,
        }))
        .digest("hex")
    const bindingInput = {
        toToken: toTokenAddress,
        fromToken: fromTokenAddress,
        amount: input.amount,
        wallet: walletAddress,
        quoteId,
        chainId: input.chainId,
        direction: input.direction,
        slippageBps: input.slippageBps,
    }
    let quoteBinding: string
    try {
        quoteBinding = createQuoteBinding(bindingInput, quoteFetchedAt)
        const verification = verifyQuoteBinding(quoteBinding, bindingInput, quoteFetchedAt)
        if (!verification.ok) {
            throw new BawQuoteError("QUOTE_BINDING_UNAVAILABLE", "Quote integrity binding could not be verified.", 503)
        }
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawQuoteError) throw error
        throw new BawQuoteError("QUOTE_BINDING_UNAVAILABLE", "Quote integrity binding is not configured.", 503)
    }

    return {
        status: "QUOTED",
        eligibility: rejectionReasons.length === 0 ? "ELIGIBLE" : "REJECTED",
        rejectionReasons,
        direction: input.direction,
        chainId: input.chainId,
        tokenAddress: input.tokenAddress,
        underlyingTicker,
        walletAddress,
        fromTokenAddress,
        toTokenAddress,
        fromTokenMetadata,
        toTokenMetadata,
        fromCoinSymbol: quote.fromCoinSymbol,
        fromCoinAmount: quote.fromCoinAmount,
        toCoinSymbol: quote.toCoinSymbol,
        toCoinAmount: quote.toCoinAmount,
        slippage: quote.slippage,
        slippageBps: input.slippageBps,
        tokenPriceUsd,
        referencePrice,
        referenceGapPercent,
        tokenDecimals,
        quoteFetchedAt,
        expiresAt: quoteFetchedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS,
        quoteBindingId: quoteId,
        quoteBinding,
        execution: { transactionSubmitted: false, signingRequested: false },
    }
}

function normalizeHumanAmount(value: string): string | null {
    if (!AMOUNT_PATTERN.test(value)) return null
    try {
        const units = parseUnits(value, 18)
        if (units <= BigInt(0) || units > UINT256_MAX) return null
        return formatUnits(units, 18).replace(/(\.\d*?)0+$/, "$1").replace(/\.$/, "")
    } catch {
        return null
    }
}

function parseExactAmountUnits(value: string, decimals: number): bigint {
    const fractionalDigits = value.split(".")[1]?.length ?? 0
    if (fractionalDigits > decimals) throw new RangeError("Amount exceeds token precision")
    return parseUnits(value, decimals)
}

function parseBscTokenDecimalMetadata(value: unknown): BscTokenDecimalMetadata | null {
    if (
        !isRecord(value) ||
        value.chainId !== BAW_CHAIN_ID ||
        typeof value.tokenAddress !== "string" ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value.tokenAddress) ||
        typeof value.decimals !== "number" ||
        !Number.isInteger(value.decimals) ||
        value.decimals < 0 ||
        value.decimals > 18 ||
        value.resolutionSource !== "BSC_ETH_CALL" ||
        typeof value.blockNumber !== "string" ||
        !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value.blockNumber) ||
        typeof value.resolvedAt !== "number" ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(value.resolvedAt) ||
        value.resolvedAt <= 0 ||
        value.validationStatus !== "VALIDATED"
    ) return null

    return {
        chainId: "56",
        tokenAddress: value.tokenAddress,
        decimals: value.decimals,
        resolutionSource: "BSC_ETH_CALL",
        blockNumber: value.blockNumber,
        resolvedAt: value.resolvedAt,
        validationStatus: "VALIDATED",
    }
}

function positiveFinite(value: unknown): number | null {
    if (typeof value !== "string" && typeof value !== "number") return null
    const parsed = Number(value)
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null
}

function getBawTokenSymbol(asset: AgentQuoteAsset): string | null {
    if (asset.symbol !== undefined) {
        return typeof asset.symbol === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}$/.test(asset.symbol)
            ? asset.symbol
            : null
    }
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,28}$/.test(asset.underlyingTicker)) return null

    const suffixByPlatform: Record<string, string> = {
        ondo: "on",
        bstock: "B",
        xstock: "x",
        xstocks: "x",
    }
    const suffix = asset.platformId ? suffixByPlatform[asset.platformId.toLowerCase()] : undefined
    return suffix ? `${asset.underlyingTicker}${suffix}` : null
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function hasExactKeys(record: Record<string, unknown>, expected: string[]): boolean {
    const keys = Object.keys(record)
    return keys.length === expected.length && expected.every((key) => Object.hasOwn(record, key))
}
import "server-only";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import {
  AgentControlPlaneError,
  assertAgentTransition,
  createSnapshotHash,
  evaluateRiskPolicy,
  evaluateCrossVenueOpportunities,
  type AgentState,
  type OpportunityEvidence,
} from "../lib/agentControlPlane.ts";
import type { AgentAnalysisProvider, AgentAnalysisResult } from "./agentAnalysis.ts";
import type { AgentMemoryStorePort } from "./agentMemoryStore.ts";
import type { CollectionResult, MarketDataCollector } from "./marketDataCollector.ts";

const STRATEGY_NAME = "cross-venue-spread";
const STRATEGY_VERSION = "1.0.0";
const MAX_HISTORICAL_OBSERVATIONS = 100;
const DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITY_TTL_MS = 5 * 60_000;
const DEFAULT_STALE_RUN_AGE_MS = 5 * 60_000;

export type AgentRunRequest = {
  ownerAddress: string;
  agentId: string;
  watchlist: string[];
  strategyConfiguration: {
    minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent: number;
    intendedAmount: string;
    notionalValue: string;
    maximumSlippageBps: number;
  };
};

export type AgentRunResult = {
  runId: string;
  status: AgentState;
  opportunityId: string | null;
  analysisId: string | null;
  proposalId: string | null;
  refusalReasons: string[];
  collection: CollectionResult;
};

export class AgentOrchestrator {
  private readonly store: AgentMemoryStorePort;
  private readonly collector: MarketDataCollector;
  private readonly analysisProvider: AgentAnalysisProvider;
  private readonly options: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    now?: () => number;
    maxObservationAgeMs?: number;
    opportunityTtlMs?: number;
    policyContext?: (input: {
      evidence: OpportunityEvidence[];
      notionalValue: string;
      now: number;
      dailyExposure: string;
    }) => Promise<{
      slippageBps: number;
      referenceDeviationPercent: number | null;
      dataFresh: boolean;
      quoteExpiresAt: number | null;
      availableBalance: string | null;
      session: string;
      quoteReference: string | null;
      expectedInput: string | null;
      expectedOutput: string | null;
    }>;
  };

  constructor(
    store: AgentMemoryStorePort,
    collector: MarketDataCollector,
    analysisProvider: AgentAnalysisProvider,
    options: AgentOrchestrator["options"] = {},
  ) {
    this.store = store;
    this.collector = collector;
    this.analysisProvider = analysisProvider;
    this.options = options;
  }

  async run(request: AgentRunRequest): Promise<AgentRunResult> {
    const now = this.options.now ?? Date.now;
    if (!(this.options.enabled ?? process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED === "true")) {
      throw new AgentControlPlaneError("UNAVAILABLE", "Agent orchestration is disabled; explicitly configure WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED=true.");
    }
    validateRunRequest(request);
    const startedAt = now();
    await this.store.expirePendingProposals(startedAt, request.ownerAddress);
    await this.store.expireOpportunities(startedAt, request.ownerAddress);
    await this.store.recoverStaleRuns(startedAt, startedAt - DEFAULT_STALE_RUN_AGE_MS, request.ownerAddress);
    const control = await this.store.getControlState(startedAt);
    if (control.emergency_stop === true || control.stop_monitoring === true ||
      control.reject_new_opportunities === true || control.permission_active !== true) {
      throw new AgentControlPlaneError("EMERGENCY_STOP", "Emergency stop is active or control permission is missing or expired.");
    }

    const runId = await this.store.createRun({
      ownerAddress: request.ownerAddress,
      agentId: request.agentId,
      strategyId: STRATEGY_NAME,
      strategyVersion: STRATEGY_VERSION,
      triggerType: "OPERATOR_REQUEST",
      startedAt,
      configuration: request.strategyConfiguration,
    });
    let state: AgentState = "INITIALIZING";
    let opportunityId: string | null = null;
    let analysisId: string | null = null;
    let proposalId: string | null = null;
    let collection: CollectionResult | null = null;
    let refusalReasons: string[] = [];

    try {
      await this.transition(runId, state, "MONITORING", now(), { reason: "Explicit bounded monitoring request." });
      state = "MONITORING";
      collection = await this.collector.collectWatchlist(request.watchlist, request.ownerAddress);
      await this.transition(runId, state, "OBSERVATION_RECORDED", now(), {
        provider: collection.provider,
        observationsStored: collection.observationsStored,
        candlesStored: collection.candlesStored,
      });
      state = "OBSERVATION_RECORDED";

      const recent = await this.store.getOpportunityEvidence({
        ownerAddress: request.ownerAddress,
        since: now() - (this.options.maxObservationAgeMs ?? 60_000),
        limit: MAX_HISTORICAL_OBSERVATIONS,
      });
      const evidence = recent.map(toOpportunityEvidence);
      const detection = evaluateCrossVenueOpportunities({
        evidence,
        now: now(),
        maxAgeMs: this.options.maxObservationAgeMs ?? 60_000,
        minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent: request.strategyConfiguration.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent,
      });
      const opportunities = detection.opportunities;
      if (!opportunities.length) {
        refusalReasons = detection.rejectionReasons;
        await this.store.appendEvent(runId, {
          eventType: "OPPORTUNITY_REJECTED",
          occurredAt: now(),
          correlationId: runId,
          payload: {
            strategyId: STRATEGY_NAME,
            strategyVersion: STRATEGY_VERSION,
            thresholds: request.strategyConfiguration,
            refusalReasons,
          },
          provenance: { source: "deterministic-opportunity-detector" },
        });
        await this.transition(runId, state, "COMPLETED", now(), {
          reason: refusalReasons.join(" ") || "No qualifying cross-venue opportunity was observed.",
        });
        return {
          runId,
          status: "COMPLETED",
          opportunityId,
          analysisId,
          proposalId,
          refusalReasons,
          collection,
        };
      }

      const found = opportunities[0];
      const selectedAsset = [...found.observations].sort((a, b) =>
        Number(a.normalizedSharePrice) - Number(b.normalizedSharePrice))[0];
      const historicalRows = await this.store.getRecentObservations({
        ownerAddress: request.ownerAddress,
        assetId: selectedAsset.assetId,
        since: now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60_000,
        limit: MAX_HISTORICAL_OBSERVATIONS,
      });
      const historicalContext = historicalRows
        .filter((row) => !found.observations.some((entry) => entry.observationId === row.observation_id))
        .map((row) => ({
          observationId: String(row.observation_id),
          observedAt: timestampValue(row.provider_timestamp),
          price: String(row.price),
          source: String(row.source),
        }));
      opportunityId = randomUUID();
      const recordedOpportunity = await this.store.recordOpportunity({
        ownerAddress: request.ownerAddress,
        opportunityId,
        runId,
        assetId: selectedAsset.assetId,
        direction: "BUY",
        strategyId: STRATEGY_NAME,
        strategyVersion: STRATEGY_VERSION,
        detectedAt: now(),
        evidence: {
          observationIds: found.observations.map((entry) => entry.observationId),
          priceKind: found.observations.map((entry) => entry.priceKind),
          reason: found.reason,
        },
        referencePrices: Object.fromEntries(found.observations.map((entry) =>
          [entry.platform, entry.referencePrice])),
        spreadPercent: found.spreadPercent,
        historicalContext: { observations: historicalContext },
        status: "DETECTED",
        expiresAt: now() + (this.options.opportunityTtlMs ?? DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITY_TTL_MS),
        detectionKey: found.detectionKey,
      });
      opportunityId = recordedOpportunity.opportunityId;
      if (!recordedOpportunity.created) {
        await this.transition(runId, state, "COMPLETED", now(), {
          reason: "Matching opportunity was already recorded; duplicate detection was suppressed.",
          opportunityId,
        });
        return {
          runId,
          status: "COMPLETED",
          opportunityId,
          analysisId,
          proposalId,
          refusalReasons: [],
          collection,
        };
      }
      const activeOpportunityId = recordedOpportunity.opportunityId;
      await this.transition(runId, state, "OPPORTUNITY_DETECTED", now(), {
        opportunityId: activeOpportunityId,
        reason: found.reason,
      });
      state = "OPPORTUNITY_DETECTED";
      await this.transition(runId, state, "ANALYZING", now(), { opportunityId: activeOpportunityId });
      state = "ANALYZING";

      const analysis = await this.analysisProvider.analyze({
        ticker: found.ticker,
        opportunity: {
          spreadPercent: found.spreadPercent,
          reason: found.reason,
          evidenceIds: found.observations.map((entry) => entry.observationId),
        },
        observations: found.observations.map((entry) => ({
          observationId: entry.observationId,
          platform: entry.platform,
          price: entry.normalizedSharePrice,
          currency: entry.currency,
          providerTimestamp: entry.providerTimestamp,
          verificationStatus: entry.verificationStatus,
          priceKind: entry.priceKind,
        })),
        historicalContext: historicalContext.map((entry) => ({
          observationId: entry.observationId,
          price: entry.price,
          source: entry.source,
          providerTimestamp: entry.observedAt,
        })),
        strategyConfiguration: request.strategyConfiguration,
        dataFresh: found.observations.every((entry) =>
          now() - entry.providerTimestamp <= entry.freshnessMs),
      });
      const sanitizedAnalysis = validateAnalysisReferences(analysis, found.observations);
      analysisId = randomUUID();
      await this.store.recordAnalysis({
        analysisId,
        runId,
        opportunityId: activeOpportunityId,
        evidenceReferences: sanitizedAnalysis.evidenceReferences,
        modelIdentifier: sanitizedAnalysis.modelIdentifier,
        modelVersion: sanitizedAnalysis.modelVersion,
        analyzedAt: now(),
        reasoningSummary: [
          sanitizedAnalysis.interpretation,
          sanitizedAnalysis.opportunityExplanation,
          sanitizedAnalysis.historicalComparison,
        ].join(" "),
        recommendation: sanitizedAnalysis.suggestedNextAction,
        risks: [...sanitizedAnalysis.risks, ...sanitizedAnalysis.dataLimitations, ...sanitizedAnalysis.assumptions],
        invalidatingConditions: sanitizedAnalysis.invalidatingConditions,
        structuredResult: sanitizedAnalysis as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
      });
      await this.transition(runId, state, "ANALYSIS_COMPLETED", now(), { analysisId });
      state = "ANALYSIS_COMPLETED";
      await this.transition(runId, state, "POLICY_VALIDATION", now(), { opportunityId: activeOpportunityId });
      state = "POLICY_VALIDATION";

      const dailyExposure = await this.store.getDailyExposure(request.ownerAddress, startOfUtcDay(now()));
      const recentProposalCount = await this.store.getRecentProposalCount(
        request.ownerAddress,
        now() - 60 * 60_000,
      );
      const policy = await this.store.getActivePolicy(request.ownerAddress, "default");
      const policyContext = await (this.options.policyContext ?? defaultPolicyContext)({
        evidence: found.observations,
        notionalValue: request.strategyConfiguration.notionalValue,
        now: now(),
        dailyExposure,
      });
      const decision = policy
        ? evaluateRiskPolicy({
          policy,
          assetKey: selectedAsset.tokenAddress.toLowerCase(),
          direction: "BUY",
          notional: request.strategyConfiguration.notionalValue,
          dailyExposure,
          recentProposalCount,
          slippageBps: policyContext.slippageBps,
          referenceDeviationPercent: policyContext.referenceDeviationPercent,
          dataFresh: policyContext.dataFresh,
          quoteExpiresAt: policyContext.quoteExpiresAt,
          availableBalance: policyContext.availableBalance,
          session: policyContext.session,
          now: now(),
        })
        : {
          policyVersion: "UNCONFIGURED",
          inputSnapshotHash: createSnapshotHash({ runId, policy: null, request: request.strategyConfiguration }),
          evaluatedAt: now(),
          accepted: false,
          refusalReasons: ["No active deterministic risk policy is configured."],
        };
      refusalReasons = decision.refusalReasons;
      await this.store.recordPolicyDecision({
        decisionId: randomUUID(),
        runId,
        opportunityId: activeOpportunityId,
        decision,
      });
      if (!decision.accepted) {
        await this.transition(runId, state, "POLICY_REJECTED", now(), { refusalReasons });
        state = "POLICY_REJECTED";
        await this.transition(runId, state, "COMPLETED", now(), { reason: "Policy rejected proposal." });
        return {
          runId,
          status: "COMPLETED",
          opportunityId: activeOpportunityId,
          analysisId,
          proposalId,
          refusalReasons,
          collection,
        };
      }

      await this.transition(runId, state, "POLICY_APPROVED", now(), { policyVersion: decision.policyVersion });
      state = "POLICY_APPROVED";
      proposalId = randomUUID();
      const proposal = await this.store.createProposal({
        runId,
        opportunityId: activeOpportunityId,
        assetId: selectedAsset.assetId,
        direction: "BUY",
        intendedAmount: request.strategyConfiguration.intendedAmount,
        notionalValue: request.strategyConfiguration.notionalValue,
        quoteReference: policyContext.quoteReference,
        expectedInput: policyContext.expectedInput,
        expectedOutput: policyContext.expectedOutput,
        maximumSlippageBps: request.strategyConfiguration.maximumSlippageBps,
        policyDecision: decision,
        analysisId,
        expiresAt: Math.min(
          policyContext.quoteExpiresAt ?? now(),
          now() + (policy?.quoteTtlMs ?? 0),
        ),
        risks: sanitizedAnalysis.risks,
        explanation: "User-review proposal only. No transaction will be signed or submitted.",
      }, proposalId, now());
      await this.transition(runId, state, "PROPOSAL_CREATED", now(), { proposalId, proposalHash: proposal.proposalHash });
      state = "PROPOSAL_CREATED";
      await this.transition(runId, state, "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL", now(), { proposalId });
      return {
        runId,
        status: "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL",
        opportunityId,
        analysisId,
        proposalId,
        refusalReasons: [],
        collection,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        await this.transition(runId, state, "FAILED", now(), {
          reason: safeError(error),
        });
      } catch (transitionError) {
        throw new AggregateError(
          [error, transitionError],
          "Agent run failed and its failure state could not be persisted.",
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async stop(reason: string, ownerAddress: string): Promise<void> {
    const now = (this.options.now ?? Date.now)();
    if (!reason.trim()) throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "A stop reason is required.");
    await this.store.setEmergencyStop({
      ownerAddress,
      stopped: true,
      reason: reason.trim().slice(0, 500),
      permissionExpiresAt: null,
      updatedAt: now,
      correlationId: randomUUID(),
    });
    const activeRuns = await this.store.getActiveRuns(ownerAddress);
    for (const run of activeRuns) {
      const state = String(run.run_status) as AgentState;
      if (state === "COMPLETED" || state === "FAILED" || state === "STOPPED") continue;
      await this.transition(String(run.run_id), state, "STOPPED", now, {
        reason: "Emergency stop activated; unfinished run was stopped.",
      });
    }
  }

  async decideProposal(proposalId: string, ownerAddress: string, action: "APPROVE" | "REJECT" | "REVOKE") {
    const now = (this.options.now ?? Date.now)();
    const result = await this.store.decideProposal(proposalId, ownerAddress, action, now);
    const proposal = await this.store.getProposal(proposalId, ownerAddress);
    if (!proposal) throw new AgentControlPlaneError("NOT_FOUND", "Proposal was not found after its decision.");
    const runId = String(proposal.run_id);
    if (result.decision === "REVOKED") {
      await this.store.appendEvent(runId, {
        eventType: "APPROVED_PROPOSAL_REVOKED",
        occurredAt: now,
        correlationId: proposalId,
        payload: { proposalId, executionBlocked: true },
        provenance: { source: "approval-manager" },
      });
    }
    return result;
  }

  private async transition(
    runId: string,
    current: AgentState,
    next: AgentState,
    now: number,
    payload: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<void> {
    assertAgentTransition(current, next);
    await this.store.transitionRun(runId, next, {
      eventType: "STATE_CHANGED",
      occurredAt: now,
      correlationId: runId,
      payload,
      provenance: { source: "agent-orchestrator", strategyVersion: STRATEGY_VERSION },
    });
  }
}

async function defaultPolicyContext(input: {
  evidence: OpportunityEvidence[];
  notionalValue: string;
  now: number;
  dailyExposure: string;
}) {
  const isFresh = input.evidence.length >= 2 && input.evidence.every((evidence) =>
    evidence.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" &&
    input.now - evidence.providerTimestamp <= Math.min(evidence.freshnessMs, 60_000));
  return {
    slippageBps: 0,
    referenceDeviationPercent: null,
    dataFresh: isFresh,
    quoteExpiresAt: null,
    availableBalance: null,
    session: "UNKNOWN",
    quoteReference: null,
    expectedInput: null,
    expectedOutput: null,
  };
}

function validateRunRequest(request: AgentRunRequest): void {
  if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(request.ownerAddress) ||
    !/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(request.agentId) ||
    !Array.isArray(request.watchlist) ||
    request.watchlist.length === 0 ||
    request.watchlist.length > 25) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "Agent ID or watchlist is invalid.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(request.strategyConfiguration.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent) ||
    request.strategyConfiguration.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent < 0 ||
    !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(request.strategyConfiguration.intendedAmount) ||
    Number(request.strategyConfiguration.intendedAmount) <= 0 ||
    !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(request.strategyConfiguration.notionalValue) ||
    Number(request.strategyConfiguration.notionalValue) <= 0 ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(request.strategyConfiguration.maximumSlippageBps) ||
    request.strategyConfiguration.maximumSlippageBps < 0 ||
    request.strategyConfiguration.maximumSlippageBps > 10_000) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "Strategy thresholds and proposal amounts are invalid.");
  }
}

function toOpportunityEvidence(row: Record<string, unknown>): OpportunityEvidence {
  return {
    observationId: String(row.observation_id),
    assetId: String(row.asset_id),
    tokenAddress: String(row.token_address),
    ticker: String(row.ticker),
    platform: String(row.platform),
    currency: String(row.currency),
    normalizedSharePrice: String(row.normalized_share_price),
    referencePrice: row.reference_price == null ? null : String(row.reference_price),
    providerTimestamp: timestampValue(row.provider_timestamp),
    ingestedAt: timestampValue(row.ingested_at),
    freshnessMs: Number(row.freshness_ms),
    verificationStatus: String(row.verification_status) as OpportunityEvidence["verificationStatus"],
    priceKind: String(row.price_kind) as OpportunityEvidence["priceKind"],
  };
}

function validateAnalysisReferences(
  analysis: AgentAnalysisResult,
  evidence: OpportunityEvidence[],
): AgentAnalysisResult {
  const allowed = new Set(evidence.map((entry) => entry.observationId));
  if (!analysis.evidenceReferences.length ||
    analysis.evidenceReferences.some((id) => !allowed.has(id))) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "AI analysis references missing or unsupported evidence.");
  }
  return analysis;
}

function timestampValue(value: unknown): number {
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.getTime();
  if (typeof value === "number") return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const parsed = Date.parse(value);
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) return parsed;
  }
  throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "Persisted provider timestamp is malformed.");
}

function startOfUtcDay(now: number): number {
  const date = new Date(now);
  date.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return date.getTime();
}

function safeError(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message.slice(0, 300);
  return "Unknown agent workflow error.";
}
import "server-only";
import { createPublicClient, formatUnits, http } from "viem";
import { bsc } from "viem/chains";
import type { DynamicMarketMetrics } from "../lib/dynamicStrategy.ts";

const WBNB_ADDRESS = "0xbb4CdB9CBd36B01bD1cBaEBF2De08d9173bc095c";
const USDT_ADDRESS = "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955";
const PAIR_ABI = [
  { type: "function", name: "getReserves", stateMutability: "view", inputs: [], outputs: [
    { name: "reserve0", type: "uint112" }, { name: "reserve1", type: "uint112" }, { name: "blockTimestampLast", type: "uint32" },
  ] },
  { type: "function", name: "token0", stateMutability: "view", inputs: [], outputs: [{ type: "address" }] },
  { type: "function", name: "token1", stateMutability: "view", inputs: [], outputs: [{ type: "address" }] },
] as const;

export type LiveDynamicMetricSource = {
  observedAt: number;
  metrics: DynamicMarketMetrics;
  provenance: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type DynamicStrategyProviderDependencies = {
  rpcUrl?: string;
  pairAddress?: string;
  assetAddress?: string;
  baselineLiquidityUsd?: number;
  now?: () => number;
  readCandles?: (assetAddress: string, chainId: string, bar: string, limit: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  readGasPriceGwei?: (rpcUrl: string, now: number) => Promise<number>;
  readPairLiquidityUsd?: (rpcUrl: string, pairAddress: string, now: number) => Promise<{ usd: number; reserveTimestamp: number }>;
};

export class DynamicStrategyProviderError extends Error {
  readonly code: "PROVIDER_DISABLED" | "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE" | "INVALID_PROVENANCE";
  constructor(code: "PROVIDER_DISABLED" | "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE" | "INVALID_PROVENANCE", message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.code = code;
    this.name = "DynamicStrategyProviderError";
  }
}

export async function collectLiveDynamicMetrics(
  dependencies: DynamicStrategyProviderDependencies = {},
): Promise<LiveDynamicMetricSource> {
  const rpcUrl = dependencies.rpcUrl ?? process.env.BSC_RPC_URL ?? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL;
  const pairAddress = dependencies.pairAddress ?? process.env.WOLV_DYNAMIC_PANCAKE_PAIR_ADDRESS;
  const assetAddress = dependencies.assetAddress ?? process.env.WOLV_DYNAMIC_ASSET_ADDRESS;
  const now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now;
  const observedAt = now();

  if (!rpcUrl || !pairAddress) {
    throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError(
      "PROVIDER_DISABLED",
      "Live dynamic metrics require BSC_RPC_URL and WOLV_DYNAMIC_PANCAKE_PAIR_ADDRESS.",
    );
  }
  if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(pairAddress)) {
    throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError("INVALID_PROVENANCE", "The configured PancakeSwap pair address is invalid.");
  }
  if (!assetAddress || !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(assetAddress)) {
    throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError(
      "PROVIDER_DISABLED",
      "Live dynamic volatility requires WOLV_DYNAMIC_ASSET_ADDRESS.",
    );
  }
  const baselineLiquidityUsd = dependencies.baselineLiquidityUsd;
  if (!Number.isFinite(baselineLiquidityUsd) || !baselineLiquidityUsd || baselineLiquidityUsd <= 0) {
    throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError(
      "INVALID_PROVENANCE",
      "A verified liquidity baseline is unavailable.",
    );
  }

  try {
    const [gasPriceGwei, pair] = await Promise.all([
      dependencies.readGasPriceGwei ? dependencies.readGasPriceGwei(rpcUrl, observedAt) : readGasPriceGwei(rpcUrl),
      dependencies.readPairLiquidityUsd
        ? dependencies.readPairLiquidityUsd(rpcUrl, pairAddress, observedAt)
        : readPairLiquidityUsd(rpcUrl, pairAddress, observedAt),
    ]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(pair.usd) || pair.usd <= 0 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(pair.reserveTimestamp) || pair.reserveTimestamp <= 0 ||
      observedAt - pair.reserveTimestamp > 60_000 ||
      pair.reserveTimestamp > observedAt + 30_000) {
      throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError(
        "INVALID_PROVENANCE",
        "PancakeSwap liquidity is missing, stale, or contradictory.",
      );
    }
    const candleResponse = await (dependencies.readCandles ?? readCandles)(assetAddress, "56", "1h", "48");
    const atrBps = calculateAtrBps(candleResponse, observedAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(atrBps) || atrBps < 0) {
      throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError("INVALID_PROVENANCE", "ATR could not be verified from Binance candle data.");
    }
    const metrics = {
      observedAt,
      pancakeLiquidityUsd: pair.usd,
      baselineLiquidityUsd,
      gasPriceGwei,
      atrBps,
    };
    return {
      observedAt,
      metrics,
      provenance: {
        chainId: 56,
        gasSource: rpcUrl.replace(/\/\/[^@]*@/, "//redacted@"),
        liquiditySource: `PancakeSwap pair ${pairAddress}`,
        liquidityReserveTimestamp: pair.reserveTimestamp,
        baselineSource: "previous_verified_dynamic_cycle_or_explicit_environment_baseline",
        atrSource: "binance_web3_market_api_candles_1h",
        assetAddress,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof DynamicStrategyProviderError) throw error;
    throw new DynamicStrategyProviderError(
      "PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0, 500) : "Live dynamic providers were unavailable.",
    );
  }
}

async function readGasPriceGwei(rpcUrl: string): Promise<number> {
  const client = createPublicClient({ chain: bsc, transport: http(rpcUrl, { timeout: 8_000 }) });
  const gas = await client.getGasPrice();
  return Number(formatUnits(gas, 9));
}

async function readCandles(
  assetAddress: string,
  chainId: string,
  bar: string,
  limit: string,
): Promise<unknown> {
  const url = new URL("https://web3.binance.com/build/api/v1/dex/market/candles");
  url.searchParams.set("binanceChainId", chainId);
  url.searchParams.set("tokenContractAddress", assetAddress);
  url.searchParams.set("bar", bar);
  url.searchParams.set("limit", limit);
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
    cache: "no-store",
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Binance candle provider returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  return await response.json();
}

async function readPairLiquidityUsd(rpcUrl: string, pairAddress: string, now: number): Promise<{ usd: number; reserveTimestamp: number }> {
  const client = createPublicClient({ chain: bsc, transport: http(rpcUrl, { timeout: 8_000 }) });
  const [token0, token1, reserves] = await Promise.all([
    client.readContract({ address: pairAddress as `0x${string}`, abi: PAIR_ABI, functionName: "token0" }),
    client.readContract({ address: pairAddress as `0x${string}`, abi: PAIR_ABI, functionName: "token1" }),
    client.readContract({ address: pairAddress as `0x${string}`, abi: PAIR_ABI, functionName: "getReserves" }),
  ]);
  const addresses = new Set([token0.toLowerCase(), token1.toLowerCase()]);
  if (!addresses.has(USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) || !addresses.has(WBNB_ADDRESS.toLowerCase())) {
    throw new Error("PancakeSwap pair must contain USDT and WBNB.");
  }
  const [reserve0, reserve1, reserveTimestamp] = reserves;
  if (token0.toLowerCase() !== USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() &&
    token0.toLowerCase() !== WBNB_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error("PancakeSwap pair contains unsupported assets.");
  }
  if (token0.toLowerCase() === USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) {
    const usdtReserve = Number(formatUnits(reserve0, 18));
    const reserveTimestampMs = Number(reserveTimestamp) * 1000;
    if (now - reserveTimestampMs > 60_000 || reserveTimestampMs > now + 30_000) {
      throw new Error("PancakeSwap reserves are stale or contradictory.");
    }
    return { usd: usdtReserve * 2, reserveTimestamp: reserveTimestampMs };
  }
  const usdtReserve = Number(formatUnits(reserve1, 18));
  const reserveTimestampMs = Number(reserveTimestamp) * 1000;
  if (now - reserveTimestampMs > 60_000 || reserveTimestampMs > now + 30_000) {
    throw new Error("PancakeSwap reserves are stale or contradictory.");
  }
  return { usd: usdtReserve * 2, reserveTimestamp: reserveTimestampMs };
}

function calculateAtrBps(response: unknown, now: number): number {
  const rows = Array.isArray(response)
    ? response
    : isRecord(response) && Array.isArray(response.data)
      ? response.data
      : isRecord(response) && isRecord(response.data) && Array.isArray(response.data.klineInfos)
        ? response.data.klineInfos
        : isRecord(response) && Array.isArray(response.klineInfos)
          ? response.klineInfos
          : [];
  let latestTimestamp = 0;
  const candles = rows.slice(-48).flatMap((row) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length < 6) return [];
    const high = numeric(row[1]);
    const low = numeric(row[2]);
    const close = numeric(row[3]);
    const timestamp = numeric(row[5]);
    if (high === null || low === null || close === null || timestamp === null || high <= 0 || low <= 0 || close <= 0 || low > high) return [];
    const ms = timestamp < 10_000_000_000 ? timestamp * 1000 : timestamp;
    latestTimestamp = Math.max(latestTimestamp, ms);
    return ms <= now + 30_000 ? [{ high, low, close }] : [];
  });
  if (candles.length < 14) return Number.NaN;
  if (latestTimestamp < now - 90 * 60_000 || latestTimestamp > now + 30_000) return Number.NaN;
  let total = 0;
  let previousClose = candles[0].close;
  for (let index = 1; index < candles.length; index += 1) {
    const candle = candles[index];
    const trueRange = Math.max(
      candle.high - candle.low,
      Math.abs(candle.high - previousClose),
      Math.abs(candle.low - previousClose),
    );
    if (previousClose > 0) total += (trueRange / previousClose) * 10_000;
    previousClose = candle.close;
  }
  return total / (candles.length - 1);
}

function numeric(value: unknown): number | null {
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" ? Number(value) : Number.NaN;
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000
const MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES = 1_000_000
const SOLANA_ADDRESS_PATTERN = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/
const DECIMAL_PATTERN = /^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/
const BAW_QUOTE_AMOUNT_PATTERN = /^\d{1,78}(?:\.\d{1,18})?$/
const BAW_QUOTE_SLIPPAGE_PATTERN = /^(?:0\.(?:0[1-9]|[1-9]\d?)|[1-4](?:\.\d{1,2})?|5(?:\.0{1,2})?)$/
const BAW_ORDER_ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/
const UINT256_MAX = (BigInt(1) << BigInt(256)) - BigInt(1)

    | "wallet status"

    | "wallet balance"
    | "wallet settings"

export type BawMarketOrder = {
    orderId: string
    chain: string
    fromToken: string
    fromTokenQty: string
    toToken: string
    status: "PENDING" | "FINISHED" | "FAILED"
    toTokenActualQty?: string
    txHash?: string | null
    refund?: { tokenAddress: string; amount: string; symbol: string }[]
    bookTime?: string
}

function isPositiveBawAmount(value: string): boolean {
    if (!BAW_QUOTE_AMOUNT_PATTERN.test(value)) return false
    try {
        const [whole, fraction = ""] = value.split(".")
        const units = BigInt(`${whole}${fraction.padEnd(18, "0")}`)
        return units > BigInt(0) && units <= UINT256_MAX
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

export function buildBawMarketSwapArgs(input: BawMarketOrderInput): readonly string[] {
    const quoteArgs = buildBawMarketQuoteArgs(input)
    return [
        "market-order", "swap", ...quoteArgs.slice(2, 12),
        "--mev", "true",
        "--gasLevel", "MEDIUM",
        "--json",
    ]
}
