    if (!BAW_ORDER_ID_PATTERN.test(orderId)) {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "market-order")
    }
    return ["market-order", "list", "--orderId", orderId, "--json"]
}

export function buildBawMarketOrderReconciliationArgs(input: {
    fromToken: string
    toToken: string
    startTime: number
    endTime: number
}): readonly string[] {
    if (
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.fromToken) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.toToken) ||
        input.fromToken.toLowerCase() === input.toToken.toLowerCase() ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(input.startTime) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(input.endTime) ||
        input.startTime < 0 ||
        input.endTime < input.startTime
    ) throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "market-order")
    return [
        "market-order", "list",
        "--fromToken", input.fromToken,
        "--toToken", input.toToken,
        "--startTime", String(input.startTime),
        "--endTime", String(input.endTime),
        "--binanceChainId", "56",
        "--json",
    ]
}

        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(args[3]) ||

export function parseBawMarketOrderSubmitOutput(stdout: string): string {
    let parsed: unknown
    try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(stdout)
    } catch {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    }
    if (
        !isRecord(parsed) ||
        !hasExactKeys(parsed, ["success", "data"]) ||
        parsed.success !== true ||
        !isRecord(parsed.data) ||
        !hasExactKeys(parsed.data, ["orderId"]) ||
        typeof parsed.data.orderId !== "string" ||
        !BAW_ORDER_ID_PATTERN.test(parsed.data.orderId)
    ) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    return parsed.data.orderId
}

export function parseBawMarketOrderListOutput(stdout: string, expected: {
    orderId: string
    fromToken: string
    toToken: string
    amount: string
}): BawMarketOrder {
    let parsed: unknown
    try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(stdout)
    } catch {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    }
    if (!isRecord(parsed) || !hasExactKeys(parsed, ["success", "data"]) || parsed.success !== true ||
        !isRecord(parsed.data) || !Array.isArray(parsed.data.list)) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    }
    const matches = parsed.data.list.filter((order): order is Record<string, unknown> =>
        isRecord(order) && order.orderId === expected.orderId
    )
    if (matches.length !== 1) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    const order = matches[0]
    if (
        order.orderType !== "market" ||
        order.chain !== "56" ||
        typeof order.fromToken !== "string" ||
        order.fromToken.toLowerCase() !== expected.fromToken.toLowerCase() ||
        typeof order.toToken !== "string" ||
        order.toToken.toLowerCase() !== expected.toToken.toLowerCase() ||
        typeof order.fromTokenQty !== "string" ||
        quoteAmountUnits(order.fromTokenQty) !== quoteAmountUnits(expected.amount) ||
        (order.status !== "PENDING" && order.status !== "FINISHED" && order.status !== "FAILED")
    ) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")

    const result: BawMarketOrder = {
        orderId: expected.orderId,
        chain: "56",
        fromToken: order.fromToken,
        fromTokenQty: order.fromTokenQty,
        toToken: order.toToken,
        status: order.status,
    }
    if (order.toTokenActualQty !== undefined) {
        const quantity = validQuoteAmount(order.toTokenActualQty)
        if (!quantity) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
        result.toTokenActualQty = quantity
    }
    if (order.txHash !== undefined) {
        if (order.txHash !== null && (typeof order.txHash !== "string" || !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(order.txHash))) {
            throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
        }
        result.txHash = order.txHash as string | null
    }
    if (order.refund !== undefined) {
        if (!Array.isArray(order.refund)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
        result.refund = order.refund.map((refund) => {
            if (!isRecord(refund)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
            const tokenAddress = boundedString(refund.tokenAddress, 64)
            const amount = validQuoteAmount(refund.amount)
            const symbol = validCoinSymbol(refund.symbol)
            if (!tokenAddress || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(tokenAddress) || !amount || !symbol) {
                throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
            }
            return { tokenAddress, amount, symbol }
        })
    }
    return result
}

export function parseBawMarketOrderHistoryOutput(stdout: string): {
    orderId: string
    chain: string
    fromToken: string
    fromTokenQty: string
    toToken: string
    status: "PENDING" | "FINISHED" | "FAILED"
    bookTime: string
}[] {
    let parsed: unknown
    try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(stdout)
    } catch {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    }
    if (!isRecord(parsed) || !hasExactKeys(parsed, ["success", "data"]) || parsed.success !== true ||
        !isRecord(parsed.data) || !Array.isArray(parsed.data.list)) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
    }
    return parsed.data.list.map((value) => {
        if (
            !isRecord(value) ||
            value.orderType !== "market" ||
            typeof value.orderId !== "string" ||
            !BAW_ORDER_ID_PATTERN.test(value.orderId) ||
            value.chain !== "56" ||
            typeof value.fromToken !== "string" ||
            !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value.fromToken) ||
            typeof value.toToken !== "string" ||
            !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value.toToken) ||
            typeof value.fromTokenQty !== "string" ||
            !isPositiveBawAmount(value.fromTokenQty) ||
            (value.status !== "PENDING" && value.status !== "FINISHED" && value.status !== "FAILED") ||
            typeof value.bookTime !== "string" ||
            !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value.bookTime))
        ) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "market-order")
        return {
            orderId: value.orderId,
            chain: "56",
            fromToken: value.fromToken,
            fromTokenQty: value.fromTokenQty,
            toToken: value.toToken,
            status: value.status,
            bookTime: value.bookTime,
        }
    })
}

function quoteAmountUnits(value: string): string | null {
    if (!isPositiveBawAmount(value)) return null
    const [whole, fraction = ""] = value.split(".")
    return BigInt(`${whole}${fraction.padEnd(18, "0")}`).toString()
}

function validQuoteAmount(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === "string" && isPositiveBawAmount(value) ? value : null
}

function validCoinSymbol(value: unknown): string | null {
    return typeof value === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}$/.test(value) ? value : null
}

function hasExactKeys(record: Record<string, unknown>, expected: string[]): boolean {
    const keys = Object.keys(record)
    return keys.length === expected.length && expected.every((key) => Object.hasOwn(record, key))
}

    | "BAW_UNAVAILABLE"
    | "BAW_TIMEOUT"
    | "BAW_RATE_LIMITED"
    | "BAW_COMMAND_FAILED"
    | "BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED"
    | "INVALID_OUTPUT"

export class BawCliError extends Error {
    readonly code: BawCliErrorCode
    readonly section: string

    constructor(code: BawCliErrorCode, section: string) {
        super(`Binance Agentic Wallet read failed: ${code} (${section})`)
        this.name = "BawCliError"
        this.code = code
        this.section = section
    }
}

export function buildBawMarketQuoteArgs(input: BawQuoteCommandInput): readonly string[] {
    if (input.direction !== "BUY" && input.direction !== "SELL") {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "quote")
    }
    if (input.chainId !== "56" || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.tokenAddress)) {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "quote")
    }
    const token = input.tokenAddress.toLowerCase()
    if (token === BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() || !isPositiveBawAmount(input.amount)) {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "quote")
    }
    if (!BAW_QUOTE_SLIPPAGE_PATTERN.test(input.slippagePercent)) {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "quote")
    }

    const fromToken = input.direction === "BUY" ? BSC_USDT_ADDRESS : input.tokenAddress
    const toToken = input.direction === "BUY" ? input.tokenAddress : BSC_USDT_ADDRESS
    return [
        "market-order", "quote",
        "--fromTokenQty", input.amount,
        "--fromToken", fromToken,
        "--toToken", toToken,
        "--binanceChainId", input.chainId,
        "--slippage", input.slippagePercent,
        "--json",
    ]
}

export function parseBawMarketQuoteArgs(args: readonly string[]): BawQuoteCommandInput | null {
    if (
        args.length !== 13 ||
        args[0] !== "market-order" ||
        args[1] !== "quote" ||
        args[2] !== "--fromTokenQty" ||
        args[4] !== "--fromToken" ||
        args[6] !== "--toToken" ||
        args[8] !== "--binanceChainId" ||
        args[10] !== "--slippage" ||
        args[12] !== "--json"
    ) return null

    const amount = args[3]
    const fromToken = args[5]
    const toToken = args[7]
    const chainId = args[9]
    const slippagePercent = args[11]
    if (
        chainId !== "56" ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(fromToken) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(toToken) ||
        fromToken.toLowerCase() === toToken.toLowerCase() ||
        !isPositiveBawAmount(amount) ||
        !BAW_QUOTE_SLIPPAGE_PATTERN.test(slippagePercent)
    ) return null

    const fromIsUsdt = fromToken.toLowerCase() === BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()
    const toIsUsdt = toToken.toLowerCase() === BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()
    if (fromIsUsdt === toIsUsdt) return null

    return {
        direction: fromIsUsdt ? "BUY" : "SELL",
        tokenAddress: fromIsUsdt ? toToken : fromToken,
        amount,
        chainId,
        slippagePercent,
    }
}

export function parseBawMarketQuoteOutput(
    stdout: string,
    expected: { direction: BawQuoteDirection; amount: string; slippagePercent: string; tokenSymbol: string }
): BawQuoteOutput {
    let parsed: unknown
    try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(stdout)
    } catch {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote")
    }
    if (!isRecord(parsed)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote")
    if (
        parsed.success !== true &&
        (parsed.code === 42900 || /42900|rate.?limit/i.test(String(parsed.msg ?? parsed.message ?? "")))
    ) {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_RATE_LIMITED", "quote")
    }
    if (
        !hasExactKeys(parsed, ["success", "data"]) ||
        parsed.success !== true ||
        !isRecord(parsed.data) ||
        !hasExactKeys(parsed.data, ["fromCoinSymbol", "fromCoinAmount", "toCoinSymbol", "toCoinAmount", "slippage"])
    ) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote")
    }

    const data = parsed.data
    const fromCoinSymbol = validCoinSymbol(data.fromCoinSymbol)
    const toCoinSymbol = validCoinSymbol(data.toCoinSymbol)
    const fromCoinAmount = validQuoteAmount(data.fromCoinAmount)
    const toCoinAmount = validQuoteAmount(data.toCoinAmount)
    const expectedFromSymbol = expected.direction === "BUY" ? "USDT" : expected.tokenSymbol
    const expectedToSymbol = expected.direction === "BUY" ? expected.tokenSymbol : "USDT"
    const expectedSlippage = Number(expected.slippagePercent) / 100
    const slippage = data.slippage
    if (
        !fromCoinSymbol ||
        !toCoinSymbol ||
        !fromCoinAmount ||
        !toCoinAmount ||
        fromCoinSymbol.toUpperCase() !== expectedFromSymbol.toUpperCase() ||
        toCoinSymbol.toUpperCase() !== expectedToSymbol.toUpperCase() ||
        quoteAmountUnits(fromCoinAmount) !== quoteAmountUnits(expected.amount) ||
        typeof slippage !== "number" ||
        !Number.isFinite(slippage) ||
        Math.abs(slippage - expectedSlippage) > 1e-12
    ) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote")
    }

    return { fromCoinSymbol, fromCoinAmount, toCoinSymbol, toCoinAmount, slippage }
}

export function createBawRunner(
    env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
    timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
): BawRunner {
    const binary = env.BAW_BIN?.trim() || "baw"
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(timeoutMs) || timeoutMs <= 0) {
        throw new Error("timeoutMs must be a positive safe integer")
    }
    return args => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const command: BawExecutableCommand | undefined = (Object.entries(COMMAND_ARGS) as [BawCommand, readonly string[]][])
            .find(([, allowedArgs]) =>
                allowedArgs.length === args.length
                && allowedArgs.every((allowedArg, index) => allowedArg === args[index])
            )?.[0]
            ?? (parseBawMarketQuoteArgs(args) ? "market-order quote" : undefined)
            ?? (parseBawMarketSwapArgs(args) ? "market-order swap" : undefined)
            ?? (parseBawMarketOrderListArgs(args) ? "market-order list" : undefined)
            ?? (isBawMarketOrderReconciliationArgs(args) ? "market-order list" : undefined)
        if (!command) {
            return reject(new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED", "command"))
        }

        execFile(
            binary,
            [...args],
            { timeout: timeoutMs, maxBuffer: MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES, windowsHide: true, encoding: "utf8" },
            (error, stdout) => {
                if (error) {
                    const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code
                    const section = command.startsWith("market-order") ? "market-order" : command.split(" ")[1]
                    if (code === "ENOENT") return reject(new BawCliError("BAW_UNAVAILABLE", section))
                    if ((error as { killed?: boolean }).killed || code === "ETIMEDOUT") {
                        return reject(new BawCliError("BAW_TIMEOUT", section))
                    }
                    return reject(new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_FAILED", section))
                }
                if (typeof stdout !== "string" || stdout.length > MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES) {
                    return reject(new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", command.startsWith("market-order") ? "market-order" : command.split(" ")[1]))
                }
                resolve({ stdout })
            }
        )
    })
}

let queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve()

function serialize<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const next = queue.then(task, task)
    queue = next.then(() => undefined, () => undefined)
    return next
}

async function runJson(
    runner: BawRunner,
    command: BawCommand,
    section: string
): Promise<unknown> {
    let stdout: string
    try {
        ({ stdout } = await serialize(() => runner(COMMAND_ARGS[command])))
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BawCliError) {
            throw new BawCliError(error.code, section)
        }
        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException)?.code === "ENOENT") {
            throw new BawCliError("BAW_UNAVAILABLE", section)
        }
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_FAILED", section)
    }

    let parsed: unknown
    try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(stdout)
    } catch {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", section)
    }
    if (!isRecord(parsed) || parsed.success !== true) {
        throw new BawCliError("BAW_COMMAND_FAILED", section)
    }
    return parsed.data
}

export async function readWalletSnapshot(
    dependencies: { runner?: BawRunner; now?: () => number } = {}
): Promise<BawWalletSnapshot> {
    const runner = dependencies.runner ?? createBawRunner()
    const now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now
    const snapshot: BawWalletSnapshot = {
        connected: false,
        fetchedAt: new Date(now()).toISOString(),
        chains: [],
        addresses: [],
        balances: [],
        settings: null,
        errors: []
    }

    const status = parseWalletStatus(await runJson(runner, "wallet status", "status"))
    snapshot.connected = status === "CONNECTED"
    if (!snapshot.connected) return snapshot

    await readSection(snapshot, "chains", async () => {
        snapshot.chains = parseChains(await runJson(runner, "wallet chains", "chains"))
    })
    await readSection(snapshot, "addresses", async () => {
        snapshot.addresses = parseAddresses(await runJson(runner, "wallet address", "addresses"))
    })
    await readSection(snapshot, "balances", async () => {
        snapshot.balances = parseBalances(await runJson(runner, "wallet balance", "balances"))
    })
    await readSection(snapshot, "settings", async () => {
        snapshot.settings = parseSettings(await runJson(runner, "wallet settings", "settings"))
    })

    return snapshot
}

async function readSection(
    snapshot: BawWalletSnapshot,
    section: string,
    read: () => Promise<void>
) {
    try {
        await read()
    } catch (error) {
        const code = error instanceof BawCliError ? error.code : "INVALID_OUTPUT"
        snapshot.errors.push({ section, code })
    }
}

export function parseWalletStatus(data: unknown): "CONNECTED" | "UNCONNECTED" | "CREATING" {
    if (!isRecord(data)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "status")
    if (data.status === "CONNECTED" || data.status === "UNCONNECTED" || data.status === "CREATING") {
        return data.status
    }
    throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "status")
}

export function parseChains(data: unknown): BawChain[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "chains")
    return data.map(value => {
        if (!isRecord(value)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "chains")
        const binanceChainId = boundedString(value.binanceChainId, 16)
        const name = boundedString(value.name, 64)
        const simpleName = boundedString(value.simpleName, 64)
        if (!binanceChainId || !/^(?:\d{1,16}|CT_501)$/.test(binanceChainId) || !name || !simpleName) {
            throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "chains")
        }
        return { binanceChainId, name, simpleName }
    })
}

export function parseAddresses(data: unknown): BawAddress[] {
    if (!isRecord(data) || !Array.isArray(data.addresses)) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "addresses")
    }
    return data.addresses.map(value => {
        if (!isRecord(value)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "addresses")
        const binanceChainId = boundedString(value.binanceChainId, 16)
        const chainName = boundedString(value.chainName, 64)
        const address = boundedString(value.address, 64)
        if (!binanceChainId || !chainName || !address || !isWalletAddress(binanceChainId, address)) {
            throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "addresses")
        }
        return { binanceChainId, chainName, address }
    })
}

export function parseBalances(data: unknown): BawBalance[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "balances")
    return data.map(value => {
        if (!isRecord(value)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "balances")
        const symbol = boundedString(value.symbol, 32)
        const contractAddress = boundedString(value.address, 64)
        const binanceChainId = boundedString(value.binanceChainId, 16)
        const balance = decimalString(value.balance)
        const priceUsd = decimalString(value.price)
        const valueUsd = decimalString(value.value)
        if (!symbol || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}$/.test(symbol)
            || !contractAddress || !binanceChainId
            || !isWalletAddress(binanceChainId, contractAddress) || balance === null
            || priceUsd === null || valueUsd === null) {
            throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "balances")
        }
        return { symbol, contractAddress, binanceChainId, balance, priceUsd, valueUsd }
    })
}

export function parseSettings(data: unknown): BawSafeSettings {
    if (!isRecord(data)) throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "settings")
    const abnormalTxnHandling = boundedString(data.abnormalTxnHandling, 32)
    const sessionExpireTime = boundedString(data.sessionExpireTime, 64)
    if (
        (abnormalTxnHandling !== "AutoReject" && abnormalTxnHandling !== "NeedConfirmation")
        || typeof data.tradeAllTokens !== "boolean"
        || typeof data.predictionEnabled !== "boolean"
        || !sessionExpireTime
        || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(sessionExpireTime))
    ) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "settings")
    }

    return {
        dailyLimit: requiredFiniteNumber(data.dailyLimit, "settings"),
        quotaUsed: requiredFiniteNumber(data.quotaUsed, "settings"),
        quotaLeft: requiredFiniteNumber(data.quotaLeft, "settings"),
        abnormalTxnHandling,
        tradeAllTokens: data.tradeAllTokens,
        predictionEnabled: data.predictionEnabled,
        sessionExpireTime
    }
}

function isWalletAddress(binanceChainId: string, address: string): boolean {
    if (binanceChainId === "CT_501") return SOLANA_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(address)
    if (/^\d+$/.test(binanceChainId)) return EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(address)
    return false
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function boundedString(value: unknown, maxLength: number): string | null {
    return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 && value.length <= maxLength
        && !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(value)
        ? value
        : null
}

function decimalString(value: unknown): string | null {
    const text = typeof value === "number" ? String(value) : value
    return typeof text === "string" && text.length <= 80 && DECIMAL_PATTERN.test(text)
        ? text
        : null
}

function requiredFiniteNumber(value: unknown, section: string): number {
    if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
        throw new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", section)
    }
    return value
}
import { authorizeBawWalletRequest } from "./bawWalletAuth.ts"
import { BawCliError } from "./bawCli.ts"
import {
    BawExecutionError,
    createBawExecutionApproval,
    executeApprovedBawTrade,
    sanitizeBawExecutionRecord,
    type BawExecutionDependencies,
} from "./bawExecution.ts"

const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16_384
const HEADERS = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" }

export async function handleBawApprovalPost(
    request: Request,
    dependencies: BawExecutionDependencies & { configuredToken?: string },
): Promise<Response> {
    const authorization = await authorizeBawWalletRequest(
        request,
        dependencies.configuredToken ?? process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN,
    )
    if (authorization !== "authorized") return authError(authorization)
    if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
        return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", "Content-Type must be application/json.", 400)
    }
    const parsedBody = await readBoundedJson(request)
    if (!parsedBody.ok) return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", parsedBody.message, parsedBody.status)
    if (!isRecord(parsedBody.value) || !hasExactKeys(parsedBody.value, ["quote"])) {
        return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", "Request must contain only the quote to approve.", 422)
    }
    try {
        const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(parsedBody.value.quote, dependencies)
        return Response.json({ status: "APPROVAL_REQUIRED", ...approval }, { status: 201, headers: HEADERS })
    } catch (error) {
        return executionError(error)
    }
}

export async function handleBawExecutionAction(
    request: Request,
    body: unknown,
    dependencies: BawExecutionDependencies & { configuredToken?: string },
): Promise<Response> {
    const authorization = await authorizeBawWalletRequest(
        request,
        dependencies.configuredToken ?? process.env.BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN,
    )
    if (authorization !== "authorized") return authError(authorization)
    if (
        !isRecord(body) ||
        !hasExactKeys(body, ["action", "executionId", "approvalToken", "securityAuditAcknowledged"]) ||
        body.action !== "executeBaw" ||
        typeof body.executionId !== "string" ||
        typeof body.approvalToken !== "string" ||
        body.securityAuditAcknowledged !== true
    ) return rejected("INVALID_REQUEST", "A valid one-time approval token and execution ID are required.", 422)
    try {
        const execution = await executeApprovedBawTrade({
            executionId: body.executionId,
            approvalToken: body.approvalToken,
            securityAuditAcknowledged: body.securityAuditAcknowledged,
        }, dependencies)
        return Response.json({ execution: sanitizeBawExecutionRecord(execution) }, { headers: HEADERS })
    } catch (error) {
        return executionError(error)
    }
}

function authError(authorization: "authorized" | "unauthorized" | "not_configured" | "storage_unavailable"): Response {
    if (authorization === "not_configured") {
        return rejected("BAW_ACCESS_NOT_CONFIGURED", "Operator wallet access is not configured on this host.", 503)
    }
    if (authorization === "storage_unavailable") {
        return rejected("BAW_AUTH_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE", "Browser-wallet authentication storage is unavailable.", 503)
    }
    return rejected("BAW_ACCESS_DENIED", "The operator access token is missing or invalid.", 401)
}

function executionError(error: unknown): Response {
    if (error instanceof BawExecutionError) {
        return rejected(error.code, error.message, error.status)
    }
    if (error instanceof BawCliError) {
        if (error.code === "BAW_TIMEOUT") {
            return rejected(error.code, "The BAW CLI did not respond before its timeout.", 504)
        }
        if (error.code === "BAW_RATE_LIMITED") {
            return rejected(error.code, "The BAW rate limit was reached; no alternate slippage or execution path will be used.", 429)
        }
        if (error.code === "BAW_UNAVAILABLE") {
            return rejected(error.code, "The BAW CLI is unavailable on this host.", 503)
        }
        return rejected(error.code, "The BAW CLI response could not be validated.", 502)
    }
    console.error("BAW execution request failed:", error)
    return rejected("EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE", "BAW execution could not be completed safely.", 502)
}

function rejected(code: string, message: string, status: number): Response {
    return Response.json({ status: "REJECTED", code, error: message }, { status, headers: HEADERS })
}

type JsonBodyResult =
    | { ok: true; value: unknown }
    | { ok: false; status: 400 | 413; message: string }

async function readBoundedJson(request: Request): Promise<JsonBodyResult> {
    const contentLength = request.headers.get("content-length")
    if (contentLength !== null && (!/^\d+$/.test(contentLength) || Number(contentLength) > MAX_BODY_BYTES)) {
        return {
            ok: false,
            status: Number(contentLength) > MAX_BODY_BYTES ? 413 : 400,
            message: "Request body is invalid or exceeds the 16 KB limit.",
        }
    }
    const reader = request.body?.getReader()
    if (!reader) return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Request body must contain valid JSON." }
    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
    let total = 0
    try {
        while (true) {
            const { done, value } = await reader.read()
            if (done) break
            total += value.byteLength
            if (total > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
                await reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined)
                return { ok: false, status: 413, message: "Request body exceeds the 16 KB limit." }
            }
            chunks.push(value)
        }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Request body could not be read." }
    } finally {
        reader.releaseLock()
    }
    try {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(total)
        let offset = 0
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
            bytes.set(chunk, offset)
            offset += chunk.byteLength
        }
        return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes)) as unknown }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Request body must be valid UTF-8 JSON." }
    }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function hasExactKeys(record: Record<string, unknown>, expected: string[]): boolean {
    return Object.keys(record).length === expected.length && expected.every((key) => Object.hasOwn(record, key))
}
import "server-only";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { getAddress, isAddress, verifyMessage } from "viem";

export type PolicyExecutionIntent = {
  intentType: "WOLV_TESTNET_TRADE_INTENT";
  version: 1;
  ownerAddress: string;
  chainId: 97;
  smartAccountAddress: string;
  policyHash: string;
  targetTokenAddress: string;
  direction: "BUY" | "SELL";
  amountWei: string;
  slippageBps: number;
  maxPriceImpactBps: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  nonce: string;
};

export function createPolicyIntentMessage(intent: PolicyExecutionIntent): string {
  return `WOLV_POLICY_INTENT_V1:${JSON.stringify({
    ...intent,
    ownerAddress: getAddress(intent.ownerAddress),
    smartAccountAddress: getAddress(intent.smartAccountAddress),
    targetTokenAddress: getAddress(intent.targetTokenAddress),
  })}`;
}

export function hashPolicyIntent(intent: PolicyExecutionIntent): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(createPolicyIntentMessage(intent)).digest("hex");
}

export function validatePolicyExecutionIntent(intent: PolicyExecutionIntent, now = Date.now()) {
  const invalid: string[] = [];
  if (intent.intentType !== "WOLV_TESTNET_TRADE_INTENT" || intent.version !== 1) invalid.push("Unsupported intent type.");
  if (intent.chainId !== 97) invalid.push("Intent is restricted to BSC Testnet.");
  if (![intent.ownerAddress, intent.smartAccountAddress, intent.targetTokenAddress].every((value) => isAddress(value))) {
    invalid.push("Intent addresses are invalid.");
  }
  if (!/^(?:[1-9]\d*)$/.test(intent.amountWei) || BigInt(intent.amountWei) > BigInt("500000000000000000")) {
    invalid.push("Intent amount exceeds the 0.5 BNB limit.");
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(intent.slippageBps) || intent.slippageBps < 1 || intent.slippageBps > 100) {
    invalid.push("Intent slippage is outside the 1-100 bps limit.");
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(intent.maxPriceImpactBps) || intent.maxPriceImpactBps < 1 || intent.maxPriceImpactBps > 300) {
    invalid.push("Intent price impact is outside the configured limit.");
  }
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(intent.policyHash) || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{16,128}$/.test(intent.nonce)) {
    invalid.push("Intent policy binding or nonce is invalid.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(intent.expiresAt) || intent.expiresAt <= now || intent.expiresAt > now + 300_000) {
    invalid.push("Intent expiration is invalid or expired.");
  }
  return invalid;
}

export async function verifyPolicyIntentSignature(
  intent: PolicyExecutionIntent,
  signature: string,
  now = Date.now(),
) {
  const invalid = validatePolicyExecutionIntent(intent, now);
  if (invalid.length) return { ok: false as const, reason: invalid.join(" ") };
  if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{130}$/.test(signature)) return { ok: false as const, reason: "Intent signature is malformed." };
  const valid = await verifyMessage({
    address: getAddress(intent.ownerAddress),
    message: createPolicyIntentMessage(intent),
    signature: signature as `0x${string}`,
  });
  return valid ? { ok: true as const, intentHash: hashPolicyIntent(intent) } : { ok: false as const, reason: "Intent signature does not match the owner." };
}
import "server-only";
import { getRWATokenList } from "../lib/binance.ts";
import { isSpotEligibleAsset } from "../lib/compliance.ts";
import { isRwaAssetListResponse, parseRwaAssetRecords } from "../lib/rwaAssetResponse.ts";
import type { AssetVersionInput } from "../lib/agentControlPlane.ts";
import type { MarketDataAdapter } from "./marketDataCollector.ts";

export class BinanceAgentMarketAdapter implements MarketDataAdapter {
  readonly providerId = "binance-web3-rwa-catalogue";

  async loadCatalogue(watchlist: readonly string[]): Promise<AssetVersionInput[]> {
    const response: unknown = await getRWATokenList();
    if (!isRwaAssetListResponse(response)) {
      throw new Error("Binance RWA catalogue response did not match the documented asset-list contract.");
    }
    const selected = new Set(watchlist.map((address) => address.toLowerCase()));
    return parseRwaAssetRecords(response).flatMap((asset) => {
      if (!selected.has(asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase()) ||
        !isSpotEligibleAsset(asset)) return [];
      const ratio = decimalString(asset.tokenToShareRatio);
      return [{
        chainId: 56,
        tokenAddress: asset.tokenContractAddress,
        ticker: asset.underlyingTicker,
        platform: asset.platformId,
        decimals: null,
        shareDenomination: ratio ? { tokenToShareRatio: ratio } : null,
        metadataSource: this.providerId,
        observedAt: Date.now(),
        blockNumber: null,
        blockHash: null,
        metadata: {
          symbol: asset.symbol ?? null,
          tokenName: asset.tokenName ?? null,
          underlyingName: asset.underlyingName ?? null,
          tokenToShareRatio: ratio,
          tokenPrice: scalarString(asset.tokenPrice),
          referencePrice: scalarString(asset.referencePrice),
          marketStatus: asset.statusInfo?.marketStatus ?? null,
          openState: asset.statusInfo?.openState ?? null,
        },
      }];
    });
  }
}

function decimalString(value: string | number | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const parsed = String(value);
  return /^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(parsed) && Number.isFinite(Number(parsed)) && Number(parsed) > 0
    ? parsed
    : null;
}

function scalarString(value: string | number | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const parsed = String(value);
  return /^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(parsed) && Number.isFinite(Number(parsed))
    ? parsed
    : null;
}
import Redis from "ioredis"
import { getAddress, padHex, toHex, type Address, type Hex } from "viem"

export class AgentIntentNonceError extends Error {
    readonly cause?: unknown

    constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
        super(message)
        this.name = "AgentIntentNonceError"
        this.cause = cause
    }
}

let redisClient: Redis | undefined
let redisUrl: string | undefined
let redisConnection: Promise<void> | undefined

function getRedisClient(url: string): Redis {
    if (redisClient && redisUrl !== url) {
        throw new AgentIntentNonceError("Redis URL cannot change while the nonce tracker is active.")
    }
    if (!redisClient) {
        redisUrl = url
        redisClient = new Redis(url, {
            lazyConnect: true,
            connectTimeout: 5_000,
            enableOfflineQueue: false,
            maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
            retryStrategy: retries => retries > 2 ? null : Math.min(retries * 250, 1_000)
        })
    }
    return redisClient
}

export function createIntentNonceAllocator(
    increment: (key: string) => Promise<number>
) {
    return async (smartAccount: Address): Promise<Hex> => {
        let account: Address
        try {
            account = getAddress(smartAccount)
        } catch (error) {
            throw new AgentIntentNonceError("Smart-account address is invalid.", error)
        }
        let sequence: number
        try {
            sequence = await increment(`wolv:agent:intent-nonce:${account.toLowerCase()}`)
        } catch (error) {
            throw new AgentIntentNonceError("Persistent intent nonce allocation failed.", error)
        }
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(sequence) || sequence <= 0) {
            throw new AgentIntentNonceError("Persistent intent nonce counter is outside its safe range.")
        }
        return padHex(toHex(BigInt(sequence)), { size: 32 })
    }
}

export async function getNextIntentNonce(smartAccount: Address): Promise<Hex> {
    const url = process.env.REDIS_URL
    if (!url) throw new AgentIntentNonceError("REDIS_URL is required for persistent intent nonce allocation.")

    const client = getRedisClient(url)
    if (client.status === "wait") {
        redisConnection ??= client.connect().finally(() => {
            redisConnection = undefined
        })
        try {
            await redisConnection
        } catch (error) {
            throw new AgentIntentNonceError("Persistent intent nonce store is unavailable.", error)
        }
    }
    return createIntentNonceAllocator(key => client.incr(key))(smartAccount)
}

export async function closeIntentNonceTracker(): Promise<void> {
    const client = redisClient
    if (!client) return

    redisClient = undefined
    redisUrl = undefined
    redisConnection = undefined
    if (client.status === "ready") {
        await client.quit()
    } else {
        client.disconnect()
    }
}

export class BrowserTradeQuoteError extends Error {
    code: "INVALID_INPUT" | "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN" | "QUOTE_REJECTED" | "STORE_UNAVAILABLE"
    status: number

    constructor(
        code: "INVALID_INPUT" | "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN" | "QUOTE_REJECTED" | "STORE_UNAVAILABLE",
        message: string,
        status: number,
    ) {
        super(message)
        this.name = "BrowserTradeQuoteError"
        this.code = code
        this.status = status
    }
}

export async function createBrowserTradeQuote(
    input: { toToken: string; amount: string; wallet: string },
    dependencies: BrowserTradeQuoteDependencies,
) {
    const now = dependencies.now ?? Date.now
    const executionId = (dependencies.createExecutionId ?? randomUUID)()

    if (
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.toToken) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.wallet) ||
        !isPositiveUint256(input.amount) ||
        input.wallet.toLowerCase() === DEAD_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()
    ) throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("INVALID_INPUT", "Invalid token, wallet, or amount", 400)

    const amount = normalizeUint256(input.amount)
    if (!amount || BigInt(amount) < MINIMUM_ORDER_WEI) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("INVALID_INPUT", `Minimum order amount is ${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT} USDT (approximately $${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT}).`, 400)
    }
    const store = typeof dependencies.store === "function" ? dependencies.store() : dependencies.store
    if (!await dependencies.isSpotToken(input.toToken)) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN", "Only supported spot tokenized assets can be quoted", 400)
    }

    try {
        await store.initialize()
    } catch (error) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError(
            "STORE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "Durable trade-intent storage is unavailable; quote retrieval is disabled.",
            503,
        )
    }
    try {
        assertBrowserTradeBindingAvailable()
    } catch {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError(
            "STORE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "Quote integrity signing is not configured; quote retrieval is disabled.",
            503,
        )
    }

    const result = await dependencies.getQuote(input.toToken, amount, input.wallet)
    const response = isRecord(result) ? result : null
    const quote = response && Array.isArray(response.data) && isRecord(response.data[0])
        ? response.data[0]
        : null
    if (!quote) throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("QUOTE_REJECTED", "No quote returned from aggregator", 502)

    const rawQuoteId = isValidBinanceQuoteId(quote.quoteId) ? quote.quoteId : null
    if (!rawQuoteId) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("QUOTE_REJECTED", "Quote response is missing a valid quote ID", 502)
    }
    const providerFromToken = isRecord(quote.fromToken) ? quote.fromToken : null
    const providerToToken = isRecord(quote.toToken) ? quote.toToken : null
    const fromTokenAmount = providerIntegerAmount(quote.fromTokenAmount)
    const toTokenAmount = providerIntegerAmount(quote.toTokenAmount)
    const outputAmount = toTokenAmount ? normalizeUint256(toTokenAmount) : null
    if (
        quote.binanceChainId !== "56" ||
        quote.executionMode !== "RFQ" ||
        !matchesTokenAddress(providerFromToken?.tokenContractAddress, BSC_USDT_ADDRESS) ||
        !matchesTokenAddress(providerToToken?.tokenContractAddress, input.toToken) ||
        typeof providerFromToken?.decimal !== "string" ||
        typeof providerToToken?.decimal !== "string" ||
        !fromTokenAmount ||
        !outputAmount ||
        BigInt(outputAmount) <= BigInt(0)
    ) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("QUOTE_REJECTED", "Quote response does not match the documented BSC RWA quote contract", 502)
    }

    const quoteValidation = validateQuote({
        fromTokenAmount,
        toTokenAmount,
        fromTokenDecimals: providerFromToken.decimal,
        toTokenDecimals: providerToToken.decimal,
        tokenUnitPrice: providerFromToken.tokenUnitPrice,
        expectedFromTokenAmount: amount,
    })
    if (!quoteValidation.ok) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("QUOTE_REJECTED", `Quote rejected: ${quoteValidation.reason}`, 502)
    }

    const assetResponse = await dependencies.getAssetList()
    const assets = isRecord(assetResponse) && Array.isArray(assetResponse.data) ? assetResponse.data : []
    const asset = assets.find((candidate) =>
        isRecord(candidate) &&
        typeof candidate.tokenContractAddress === "string" &&
        candidate.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase() === input.toToken.toLowerCase()
    )
    if (
        !isRecord(asset) ||
        !isPositiveScalar(asset.referencePrice) ||
        !isPositiveScalar(asset.tokenToShareRatio)
    ) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("QUOTE_REJECTED", "Quote rejected: asset reference data is unavailable", 502)
    }
    const referenceValidation = validateQuote({
        usd: quoteValidation.usd,
        referencePrice: asset.referencePrice,
        tokenToShareRatio: asset.tokenToShareRatio,
    })
    if (!referenceValidation.ok || referenceValidation.referenceGap === null) {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError(
            "QUOTE_REJECTED",
            `Quote rejected: ${referenceValidation.ok ? "asset reference data is unavailable" : referenceValidation.reason}`,
            502,
        )
    }

    const quoteFetchedAt = now()
    const expiresAt = quoteFetchedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS
    const fromToken = BSC_USDT_ADDRESS
    const bindingInput = {
        executionId,
        quoteId: rawQuoteId,
        wallet: input.wallet,
        chainId: 56 as const,
        direction: "BUY" as const,
        fromToken,
        toToken: input.toToken,
        amount,
        slippageBps: SLIPPAGE_BPS,
    }
    const quoteBinding = createBrowserTradeBinding(bindingInput, quoteFetchedAt)
    const minimumOutputAmount = (BigInt(outputAmount) * BigInt(10_000 - SLIPPAGE_BPS) / BigInt(10_000)).toString()
    if (minimumOutputAmount === "0") {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError("QUOTE_REJECTED", "Quote rejected: minimum output rounds to zero", 502)
    }

    const intent: BrowserTradeIntent = {
        executionId,
        quoteBindingHash: hashQuoteBinding(quoteBinding),
        quoteId: rawQuoteId,
        walletAddress: input.wallet,
        chainId: 56,
        direction: "BUY",
        inputTokenAddress: fromToken,
        outputTokenAddress: input.toToken,
        inputAmount: amount,
        expectedOutputAmount: outputAmount,
        minimumOutputAmount,
        slippageBps: SLIPPAGE_BPS,
        quoteFetchedAt,
        expiresAt,
        state: "CREATED",
        idempotencyKey: null,
        transactionHash: null,
        providerOrderId: null,
        failureCode: null,
        createdAt: quoteFetchedAt,
        updatedAt: quoteFetchedAt,
    }
    try {
        await store.create(intent)
    } catch {
        throw new BrowserTradeQuoteError(
            "STORE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "Durable trade-intent storage is unavailable; quote retrieval is disabled.",
            503,
        )
    }

    return {
        ...quote,
        quoteId: rawQuoteId,
        status: "QUOTED",
        executionEligibility: "NOT_AVAILABLE",
        quoteFetchedAt,
        executionIntentId: executionId,
        quoteBinding,
        quoteExpiresAt: expiresAt,
        tradeIntent: {
            direction: "BUY",
            chainId: 56,
            fromTokenAddress: fromToken,
            toTokenAddress: input.toToken,
            inputAmount: amount,
            expectedOutputAmount: outputAmount,
            minimumOutputAmount,
            slippageBps: SLIPPAGE_BPS,
        },
    }
}

export async function handleBrowserTradeQuoteRequest(
    request: Request,
    dependencies: BrowserTradeQuoteDependencies,
): Promise<{ status: number; body: Record<string, unknown> }> {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
    const toToken = searchParams.get("toToken")
    const amount = searchParams.get("amount")
    const wallet = searchParams.get("userWalletAddress")
    if (!toToken || !amount || !wallet) {
        return {
            status: 400,
            body: { error: "Missing required parameters: toToken, amount, userWalletAddress" },
        }
    }

    try {
        return {
            status: 200,
            body: await createBrowserTradeQuote({ toToken, amount, wallet }, dependencies),
        }
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof BrowserTradeQuoteError) {
            return { status: error.status, body: { error: error.message, code: error.code } }
        }
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : ""
        if (/API error 40375:/i.test(message)) {
            return {
                status: 400,
                body: { error: `Minimum order amount is ${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT} USDT (approximately $${MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT}).` },
            }
        }
        return { status: 502, body: { error: "Quote service is temporarily unavailable" } }
    }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function isPositiveScalar(value: unknown): boolean {
    if (typeof value !== "string" && typeof value !== "number") return false
    const parsed = Number(value)
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0
}

function providerIntegerAmount(value: unknown): string | null {
    if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) return null
    return normalizeUint256(value)
}

function matchesTokenAddress(value: unknown, expected: string): boolean {
    return typeof value === "string" &&
        EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value) &&
        value.toLowerCase() === expected.toLowerCase()
}
import { createHash, createHmac, randomBytes, randomUUID, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"
import { getAddress, isAddress, verifyMessage, type Hex } from "viem"
import { EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN } from "../lib/apiValidation.ts"
import {
    getDefaultBawExecutionStore,
    type BawExecutionStorePort,
} from "./bawExecutionStore.ts"

const MIN_TOKEN_BYTES = 32
const MAX_TOKEN_BYTES = 512
const TOKEN_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+=*$/
const SECURE_SESSION_COOKIE = "__Host-wolv-baw-session"
const LOCAL_SESSION_COOKIE = "wolv-baw-session"
const SESSION_TTL_MS = 15 * 60_000
const CHALLENGE_TTL_MS = 2 * 60_000

type WalletSession = { address: string; expiresAt: number; sessionId: string }
type SessionChallenge = { address: string; message: string; expiresAt: number }
type AuthOptions = {
    store?: BawExecutionStorePort
    authorizedWallets?: string
    now?: number
}
export type BawWalletJsonResult =
    | { ok: true; value: unknown }
    | { ok: false; status: 400 | 413; message: string }

export type BawWalletAuthorization = "authorized" | "unauthorized" | "not_configured" | "storage_unavailable"

export function isBawWalletServerTokenConfigured(value: string | undefined): value is string {
    return isValidToken(value)
}

export function isBawBrowserWalletAllowlistConfigured(value = process.env.BAW_AUTHORIZED_BROWSER_WALLETS): boolean {
    if (!value) return false
    const addresses = value.split(",").map((address) => address.trim())
    return addresses.length > 0 && addresses.every(isValidBawWalletAddress)
}

export async function readBawWalletAuthJson(request: Request, maxBytes: number): Promise<BawWalletJsonResult> {
    const contentLength = request.headers.get("content-length")
    if (contentLength !== null && (!/^\d+$/.test(contentLength) || Number(contentLength) > maxBytes)) {
        return {
            ok: false,
            status: Number(contentLength) > maxBytes ? 413 : 400,
            message: "Authentication request is invalid or too large.",
        }
    }
    const reader = request.body?.getReader()
    if (!reader) return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "A valid JSON authentication request is required." }
    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
    let total = 0
    try {
        while (true) {
            const { done, value } = await reader.read()
            if (done) break
            total += value.byteLength
            if (total > maxBytes) {
                await reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined)
                return { ok: false, status: 413, message: "Authentication request is too large." }
            }
            chunks.push(value)
        }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Authentication request could not be read." }
    } finally {
        reader.releaseLock()
    }
    try {
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(total)
        let offset = 0
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
            bytes.set(chunk, offset)
            offset += chunk.byteLength
        }
        return {
            ok: true,
            value: JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes)) as unknown,
        }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, status: 400, message: "Authentication request must be valid UTF-8 JSON." }
    }
}

export async function authorizeBawWalletRequest(
    request: Request,
    configuredToken: string | undefined,
    options: AuthOptions = {},
): Promise<BawWalletAuthorization> {
    if (!isValidToken(configuredToken)) return "not_configured"

    const authorization = request.headers.get("authorization")
    if (authorization !== null) {
        const providedToken = authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")
            ? authorization.slice("Bearer ".length)
            : ""
        if (!isValidToken(providedToken)) return "unauthorized"
        return timingSafeTokenMatch(providedToken, configuredToken) ? "authorized" : "unauthorized"
    }

    if (!isSafeMethod(request.method) && !isSameOriginRequest(request)) return "unauthorized"
    try {
        return await getBawWalletSession(request, configuredToken, options) ? "authorized" : "unauthorized"
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("BAW browser session authorization storage failed:", error)
        return "storage_unavailable"
    }
}

export function isSameOriginRequest(request: Request): boolean {
    const origin = request.headers.get("origin")
    if (!origin) return false
    try {
        return new URL(origin).origin === new URL(request.url).origin
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

export async function createBawWalletSessionChallenge(
    address: string,
    request: Request,
    configuredToken: string | undefined,
    options: AuthOptions = {},
): Promise<SessionChallenge | null> {
    if (!isValidToken(configuredToken) || !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(address) || !isSameOriginRequest(request)) {
        return null
    }
    if (!isValidBawWalletAddress(address)) return null
    const canonicalAddress = getAddress(address).toLowerCase()
    if (!isAuthorizedBrowserWallet(canonicalAddress, options.authorizedWallets ?? process.env.BAW_AUTHORIZED_BROWSER_WALLETS)) {
        return null
    }
    const now = options.now ?? Date.now()
    const issuedAt = now
    const expiresAt = now + CHALLENGE_TTL_MS
    const origin = new URL(request.url).origin
    const nonce = randomBytes(32).toString("hex")
    const challengeBody = [
        "WOLV BAW application access",
        `Origin: ${origin}`,
        `Address: ${canonicalAddress}`,
        `Nonce: ${nonce}`,
        `Issued At: ${issuedAt}`,
        `Expires At: ${expiresAt}`,
    ].join("\n")
    await getStore(options.store).createChallenge(hashNonce(nonce), canonicalAddress, expiresAt, issuedAt)
    return {
        address: canonicalAddress,
        message: `${challengeBody}\nChallenge: ${sign(challengeBody, configuredToken)}`,
        expiresAt,
    }
}

export async function createBawWalletSession(
    input: { address: string; message: string; signature: string },
    request: Request,
    configuredToken: string | undefined,
    options: AuthOptions = {},
): Promise<{ address: string; expiresAt: number; cookie: string } | null> {
    if (!isValidToken(configuredToken) || !isSameOriginRequest(request)) return null
    if (!EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.address) || !/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{130}$/.test(input.signature)) return null
    const match = input.message.match(
        /^WOLV BAW application access\nOrigin: (https?:\/\/[^/\n]+)\nAddress: (0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40})\nNonce: ([0-9a-f]{64})\nIssued At: (\d{13})\nExpires At: (\d{13})\nChallenge: ([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/,
    )
    if (!match) return null
    const [, challengeOrigin, challengeAddress, nonce, issuedAtRaw, expiresAtRaw, challengeSignature] = match
    const now = options.now ?? Date.now()
    const issuedAt = Number(issuedAtRaw)
    const challengeExpiresAt = Number(expiresAtRaw)
    const challengeBody = input.message.slice(0, input.message.lastIndexOf("\nChallenge:"))
    if (!timingSafeTokenMatch(challengeSignature, sign(challengeBody, configuredToken))) return null
    if (!isValidBawWalletAddress(input.address)) return null
    const canonicalAddress = getAddress(input.address).toLowerCase()
    if (!isAuthorizedBrowserWallet(canonicalAddress, options.authorizedWallets ?? process.env.BAW_AUTHORIZED_BROWSER_WALLETS)) {
        return null
    }
    if (
        challengeOrigin !== new URL(request.url).origin ||
        challengeAddress.toLowerCase() !== canonicalAddress ||
        issuedAt > now + 10_000 ||
        now >= challengeExpiresAt ||
        challengeExpiresAt - issuedAt !== CHALLENGE_TTL_MS
    ) return null

    let signatureValid = false
    try {
        signatureValid = await verifyMessage({
            address: getAddress(input.address),
            message: input.message,
            signature: input.signature as Hex,
        })
    } catch {
        return null
    }
    if (!signatureValid) return null

    const expiresAt = now + SESSION_TTL_MS
    const sessionId = randomUUID()
    const created = await getStore(options.store).consumeChallengeAndCreateSession(
        hashNonce(nonce),
        canonicalAddress,
        now,
        sessionId,
        expiresAt,
    )
    if (!created) return null
    const payload = encodeSession({ address: canonicalAddress, expiresAt, sessionId })
    const signature = sign(payload, configuredToken)
    const cookieName = getSessionCookieName(request)
    return {
        address: canonicalAddress,
        expiresAt,
        cookie: `${cookieName}=${payload}.${signature}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=${Math.floor(SESSION_TTL_MS / 1000)}${isSecureRequest(request) ? "; Secure" : ""}`,
    }
}

export async function getBawWalletSession(
    request: Request,
    configuredToken: string | undefined,
    options: AuthOptions = {},
): Promise<WalletSession | null> {
    if (!isValidToken(configuredToken)) return null
    const cookieHeader = request.headers.get("cookie")
    const cookieName = getSessionCookieName(request)
    const cookie = cookieHeader?.split(";").map((part) => part.trim())
        .find((part) => part.startsWith(`${cookieName}=`))
    if (!cookie) return null
    const value = cookie.slice(cookieName.length + 1)
    const [payload, providedSignature, ...extra] = value.split(".")
    if (!payload || !providedSignature || extra.length) return null
    const expectedSignature = sign(payload, configuredToken)
    if (!timingSafeTokenMatch(providedSignature, expectedSignature)) return null
    let session: Partial<WalletSession>
    try {
        session = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as Partial<WalletSession>
    } catch {
        return null
    }
    const now = options.now ?? Date.now()
    if (
        typeof session.address !== "string" ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(session.address) ||
        typeof session.expiresAt !== "number" ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(session.expiresAt) ||
        session.expiresAt <= now ||
        typeof session.sessionId !== "string" ||
        !isUuid(session.sessionId) ||
        !isAuthorizedBrowserWallet(session.address, options.authorizedWallets ?? process.env.BAW_AUTHORIZED_BROWSER_WALLETS)
    ) return null
    const stored = await getStore(options.store).getSession(session.sessionId, now)
    if (
        !stored ||
        stored.address.toLowerCase() !== session.address.toLowerCase() ||
        stored.expiresAt !== session.expiresAt
    ) return null
    return { address: session.address, expiresAt: session.expiresAt, sessionId: session.sessionId }
}

export async function revokeBawWalletSession(
    request: Request,
    configuredToken: string | undefined,
    options: AuthOptions = {},
): Promise<void> {
    if (!isValidToken(configuredToken)) return
    const cookieHeader = request.headers.get("cookie")
    const cookieName = getSessionCookieName(request)
    const cookie = cookieHeader?.split(";").map((part) => part.trim())
        .find((part) => part.startsWith(`${cookieName}=`))
    if (!cookie) return
    const value = cookie.slice(cookieName.length + 1)
    const [payload, providedSignature, ...extra] = value.split(".")
    if (!payload || !providedSignature || extra.length) return
    if (!timingSafeTokenMatch(providedSignature, sign(payload, configuredToken))) return
    try {
        const session = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as Partial<WalletSession>
        if (typeof session.sessionId === "string" && isUuid(session.sessionId)) {
            await getStore(options.store).revokeSession(session.sessionId, options.now ?? Date.now())
        }
    } catch {
        throw new Error("BAW browser session could not be revoked.")
    }
}

export function clearBawWalletSessionCookie(request: Request): string {
    return `${getSessionCookieName(request)}=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0${isSecureRequest(request) ? "; Secure" : ""}`
}

export function isValidBawWalletAddress(value: string): boolean {
    return EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value) && isAddress(value)
}

function isValidToken(value: string | undefined): value is string {
    if (value === undefined) return false
    const token = Buffer.from(value)
    return token.length >= MIN_TOKEN_BYTES
        && token.length <= MAX_TOKEN_BYTES
        && TOKEN_PATTERN.test(value)
}

function timingSafeTokenMatch(provided: string, expected: string): boolean {
    const providedBytes = Buffer.from(provided)
    const expectedBytes = Buffer.from(expected)
    return providedBytes.length === expectedBytes.length && timingSafeEqual(providedBytes, expectedBytes)
}

function encodeSession(session: WalletSession): string {
    return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(session), "utf8").toString("base64url")
}

function isAuthorizedBrowserWallet(address: string, configuredAddresses: string | undefined): boolean {
    if (!configuredAddresses || !isBawBrowserWalletAllowlistConfigured(configuredAddresses)) return false
    const addresses = configuredAddresses.split(",").map((value) => value.trim())
    const canonicalAddress = address.toLowerCase()
    return addresses.some((value) => getAddress(value).toLowerCase() === canonicalAddress)
}

function hashNonce(nonce: string): string {
    return createHash("sha256").update(nonce).digest("hex")
}

function getStore(store?: BawExecutionStorePort): BawExecutionStorePort {
    return store ?? getDefaultBawExecutionStore()
}

function isUuid(value: string): boolean {
    return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(value)
}

function sign(payload: string, configuredToken: string): string {
    const key = createHmac("sha256", configuredToken).update("wolv-baw-session-v1", "utf8").digest()
    return createHmac("sha256", key).update(payload, "utf8").digest("base64url")
}

function isSafeMethod(method: string): boolean {
    return method === "GET" || method === "HEAD" || method === "OPTIONS"
}

function isSecureRequest(request: Request): boolean {
    return new URL(request.url).protocol === "https:" || process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
}

function getSessionCookieName(request: Request): string {
    return isSecureRequest(request) ? SECURE_SESSION_COOKIE : LOCAL_SESSION_COOKIE
}
import "server-only";

export type UsMarketCalendarDay = {
  date: string;
  session: "OPEN" | "CLOSED" | "EARLY_CLOSE";
  sessionStartUtcMinutes?: number;
  sessionEndUtcMinutes?: number;
  providerTimestamp: string;
};

export class UsMarketCalendarError extends Error {
  readonly code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "MALFORMED" | "STALE";
  constructor(code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "MALFORMED" | "STALE", message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "UsMarketCalendarError";
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export async function fetchVerifiedUsMarketCalendar(date: string, now = Date.now(), fetchImpl = fetch) {
  const url = process.env.WOLV_US_MARKET_CALENDAR_URL?.trim();
  if (!url || !/^https:\/\//i.test(url)) throw new UsMarketCalendarError("NOT_CONFIGURED", "A verified HTTPS US market calendar provider is required.");
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, cache: "no-store", signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5_000) });
  } catch {
    throw new UsMarketCalendarError("UNAVAILABLE", "The verified US market calendar provider is unavailable.");
  }
  if (!response.ok) throw new UsMarketCalendarError("UNAVAILABLE", "The verified US market calendar provider returned an error.");
  let payload: unknown;
  try { payload = await response.json(); } catch { throw new UsMarketCalendarError("MALFORMED", "The market calendar response is not valid JSON."); }
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || !Array.isArray((payload as { days?: unknown }).days)) {
    throw new UsMarketCalendarError("MALFORMED", "The market calendar response schema is invalid.");
  }
  const day = (payload as { days: unknown[] }).days.find((item) =>
    item && typeof item === "object" && (item as { date?: unknown }).date === date) as Partial<UsMarketCalendarDay> | undefined;
  if (!day || !["OPEN", "CLOSED", "EARLY_CLOSE"].includes(String(day.session)) ||
    typeof day.providerTimestamp !== "string") {
    throw new UsMarketCalendarError("MALFORMED", "The requested date is missing or malformed.");
  }
  const providerTime = Date.parse(day.providerTimestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(providerTime) || Math.abs(now - providerTime) > 24 * 60 * 60_000) {
    throw new UsMarketCalendarError("STALE", "The verified market calendar data is stale.");
  }
  if (day.session === "OPEN" || day.session === "EARLY_CLOSE") {
    if (!Number.isInteger(day.sessionStartUtcMinutes) || !Number.isInteger(day.sessionEndUtcMinutes) ||
      (day.sessionStartUtcMinutes ?? -1) < 0 || (day.sessionStartUtcMinutes ?? 1441) >= 1440 ||
      (day.sessionEndUtcMinutes ?? 0) <= 0 || (day.sessionEndUtcMinutes ?? 1440) > 1440 ||
      (day.sessionEndUtcMinutes ?? 0) <= (day.sessionStartUtcMinutes ?? -1)) {
      throw new UsMarketCalendarError("MALFORMED", "The market session times are malformed.");
    }
  }
  return {
    date,
    session: day.session as "OPEN" | "CLOSED" | "EARLY_CLOSE",
    sessionStartUtcMinutes: day.sessionStartUtcMinutes,
    sessionEndUtcMinutes: day.sessionEndUtcMinutes,
    providerTimestamp: day.providerTimestamp,
  } satisfies UsMarketCalendarDay;
}
import {
    encodePacked,
    getAddress,
    keccak256,
    type Address,
    type Hex
} from "viem"

export type AgentPolicyHashInput = {
    targetToken: Address
    maxTradeValue: bigint
    expiresAt: bigint
    intentSigner: Address
}

const MAX_TRADE_VALUE = BigInt("500000000000000000")
const MAX_UINT64 = (BigInt(1) << BigInt(64)) - BigInt(1)
const MAX_UINT192 = (BigInt(1) << BigInt(192)) - BigInt(1)

export function hashAgentPolicy(input: AgentPolicyHashInput): Hex {
    const targetToken = getAddress(input.targetToken)
    const intentSigner = getAddress(input.intentSigner)
    if (
        targetToken === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
        || intentSigner === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
    ) {
        throw new TypeError("Policy token and intent signer must be nonzero addresses.")
    }
    if (input.maxTradeValue <= BigInt(0) || input.maxTradeValue > MAX_TRADE_VALUE || input.maxTradeValue > MAX_UINT192) {
        throw new RangeError("Policy maximum trade value must be between 1 wei and 0.5 BNB.")
    }
    if (input.expiresAt <= BigInt(0) || input.expiresAt > MAX_UINT64) {
        throw new RangeError("Policy expiry must fit uint64 and be greater than zero.")
    }

    return keccak256(encodePacked(
        ["address", "uint192", "uint64", "address"],
        [targetToken, input.maxTradeValue, input.expiresAt, intentSigner]
    ))
}
import "server-only";
import type { Address, PublicClient } from "viem";
import { getAddress } from "viem";
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN } from "./apiValidation.ts";
import {
  markInvalidRpcResponse,
  runRpcRead,
  type RpcRequestDiagnostic,

export const RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK = BigInt(131014770);
export const RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH =
  "0x993c869807f1090f1642ef6f9a607770eb051406fcd6d9ab03cc310a676fd36e";
export const RECORDED_PROBE_TOKEN_ADDRESSES = [
  "0xe614e2fc6c787035ff51f452e8e826bfd32d5283",
  "0x282973969118f9fe39bf2ff3d8dd1efee82ccb11",
] as const;

const DECIMALS_ABI = [{
  type: "function",
  name: "decimals",
  stateMutability: "view",
  inputs: [],
  outputs: [{ type: "uint8" }],
}] as const;
const MAX_SUPPORTED_DECIMALS = 18;

export type RecordedProbeTarget = {
  label: "USDT" | "previously-successful" | "previously-failed";
  address: Address;
};

export type RecordedProbeRpcClient = Pick<
  PublicClient,
  "getChainId" | "getBlock" | "getBytecode" | "readContract"
>;

export type RecordedProbeResult = {
  status: "MOCK_VERIFIED" | "LIVE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_RPC" | "UNVERIFIED";
  chainId: number | null;
  blockNumber: string;
  expectedBlockHash: string;
  observedBlockHash: string | null;
  rpcVerificationCount: 1;
  requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[];
  targets: Array<{
    label: RecordedProbeTarget["label"];
    tokenAddress: string;
    status: "VERIFIED" | "UNSUPPORTED" | "UNVERIFIED";
    contractCodePresent: boolean | null;
    decimals: number | null;
    errorClassification: string | null;
    requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[];
  }>;
  errorClassification: string | null;
};

export function getRecordedProbeTargets(audit: unknown): RecordedProbeTarget[] {
  if (!isRecord(audit) || !Array.isArray(audit.assets) ||
    audit.blockNumber !== RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK.toString() ||
    audit.blockHash !== RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH) {
    throw new Error("Recorded audit does not match the approved block provenance.");
  }
  const auditedAddresses = new Set(
    audit.assets.flatMap((asset) =>
      isRecord(asset) && typeof asset.tokenAddress === "string"
        ? [asset.tokenAddress.toLowerCase()]
        : [],
    ),
  );
  for (const address of RECORDED_PROBE_TOKEN_ADDRESSES) {
    if (!auditedAddresses.has(address)) {
      throw new Error("A fixed diagnostic token is absent from the recorded audit.");
    }
  }
  if (typeof audit.usdt !== "object" || audit.usdt === null ||
    !isRecord(audit.usdt) ||
    typeof audit.usdt.tokenAddress !== "string" ||
    audit.usdt.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error("Configured USDT does not match the recorded audit target.");
  }
  return [
    { label: "USDT", address: getAddress(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS) },
    ...RECORDED_PROBE_TOKEN_ADDRESSES.map((address, index) => ({
      label: index === 0 ? "previously-successful" as const : "previously-failed" as const,
      address: getAddress(address),
    })),
  ];
}

export async function probeRecordedBlock(input: {
  client: RecordedProbeRpcClient;
  targets: RecordedProbeTarget[];
  maxRetries?: number;
  sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
  random?: () => number;
}): Promise<RecordedProbeResult> {
  validateTargets(input.targets);
  const requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [];
  const base = {
    chainId: null as number | null,
    blockNumber: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK.toString(),
    expectedBlockHash: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH,
    observedBlockHash: null as string | null,
    rpcVerificationCount: 1 as const,
    requestDiagnostics,
  };
  const retryOptions = {
    maxRetries: input.maxRetries,
    sleep: input.sleep,
    random: input.random,
  };
  const chainRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_chainId",
    stage: "BLOCK",
    operation: () => input.client.getChainId(),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  requestDiagnostics.push(...chainRead.diagnostics);
  if (!chainRead.ok) {
    return {
      ...base,
      status: "UNVERIFIED",
      targets: input.targets.map((target) => emptyTarget(target, "UNVERIFIED", chainRead.diagnostic.errorClass)),
      errorClassification: chainRead.diagnostic.errorClass,
    };
  }
  if (chainRead.value !== 56) {
    return {
      ...base,
      status: "UNVERIFIED",
      chainId: chainRead.value,
      targets: input.targets.map((target) => emptyTarget(target, "UNVERIFIED", "CHAIN_ID_MISMATCH")),
      errorClassification: "CHAIN_ID_MISMATCH",
    };
  }

  const blockRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_getBlockByNumber",
    stage: "BLOCK",
    operation: () => input.client.getBlock({ blockNumber: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK }),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  requestDiagnostics.push(...blockRead.diagnostics);
  if (!blockRead.ok) {
    return {
      ...base,
      status: "UNVERIFIED",
      chainId: 56,
      targets: input.targets.map((target) => emptyTarget(target, "UNVERIFIED", blockRead.diagnostic.errorClass)),
      errorClassification: blockRead.diagnostic.errorClass,
    };
  }
  const observedBlockHash = normalizeBlockHash(blockRead.value.hash);
  if (!observedBlockHash || observedBlockHash !== RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH) {
    return {
      ...base,
      status: "UNVERIFIED",
      chainId: 56,
      observedBlockHash,
      targets: input.targets.map((target) => emptyTarget(
        target,
        "UNVERIFIED",
        observedBlockHash ? "BLOCK_HASH_MISMATCH" : "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
      )),
      errorClassification: observedBlockHash ? "BLOCK_HASH_MISMATCH" : "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
    };
  }

  const targets = [];
  for (const target of input.targets) {
    const targetDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [];
    const codeRead = await runRpcRead({
      method: "eth_getCode",
      stage: "BYTECODE",
      operation: () => input.client.getBytecode({
        address: target.address,
        blockNumber: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK,
      }),
      ...retryOptions,
    });
    targetDiagnostics.push(...codeRead.diagnostics);
    if (!codeRead.ok) {
      targets.push(emptyTarget(target, "UNVERIFIED", codeRead.diagnostic.errorClass, targetDiagnostics));
      continue;
    }
    const code = codeRead.value;
    if (typeof code !== "string" || !/^0x(?:[a-fA-F0-9]{2})*$/.test(code)) {
      targets.push(emptyTarget(
        target,
        "UNVERIFIED",
        "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
        markInvalidRpcResponse(targetDiagnostics),
      ));
      continue;
    }
    if (code === "0x") {
      targets.push(emptyTarget(target, "UNSUPPORTED", "MISSING_CONTRACT_CODE", targetDiagnostics, false));
      continue;
    }
    const decimalsRead = await runRpcRead({
      method: "eth_call",
      stage: "DECIMALS",
      operation: () => input.client.readContract({
        address: target.address,
        abi: DECIMALS_ABI,
        functionName: "decimals",
        blockNumber: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK,
      }),
      ...retryOptions,
    });
    targetDiagnostics.push(...decimalsRead.diagnostics);
    if (!decimalsRead.ok) {
      targets.push(emptyTarget(target, "UNVERIFIED", decimalsRead.diagnostic.errorClass, targetDiagnostics, true));
      continue;
    }
    const decimals: unknown = decimalsRead.value;
    if (typeof decimals !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals < 0 || decimals > 255) {
      targets.push(emptyTarget(
        target,
        "UNVERIFIED",
        "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
        markInvalidRpcResponse(targetDiagnostics),
        true,
      ));
      continue;
    }
    if (decimals > MAX_SUPPORTED_DECIMALS) {
      targets.push({
        ...emptyTarget(target, "UNSUPPORTED", "DECIMALS_OUTSIDE_WOLV_RANGE", targetDiagnostics, true),
        decimals,
      });
      continue;
    }
    targets.push({
      ...emptyTarget(target, "VERIFIED", null, targetDiagnostics, true),
      decimals,
    });
  }

  return {
    ...base,
    status: targets.every((target) => target.status === "VERIFIED")
      ? "LIVE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_RPC"
      : "UNVERIFIED",
    chainId: 56,
    observedBlockHash,
    targets,
    errorClassification: targets.find((target) => target.errorClassification)?.errorClassification ?? null,
  };
}

function validateTargets(targets: RecordedProbeTarget[]): void {
  const expected = new Map<string, RecordedProbeTarget["label"]>([
    [BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase(), "USDT"],
    [RECORDED_PROBE_TOKEN_ADDRESSES[0], "previously-successful"],
    [RECORDED_PROBE_TOKEN_ADDRESSES[1], "previously-failed"],
  ]);
  if (targets.length !== 3 ||
    new Set(targets.map((target) => target.address.toLowerCase())).size !== 3 ||
    targets.some((target) =>
      !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(target.address) ||
      expected.get(target.address.toLowerCase()) !== target.label
    )) {
    throw new Error("Probe targets must be the fixed USDT and two audit-confirmed catalogue assets.");
  }
}

function emptyTarget(
  target: RecordedProbeTarget,
  status: RecordedProbeResult["targets"][number]["status"],
  errorClassification: string | null,
  requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [],
  contractCodePresent: boolean | null = null,
) {
  return {
    label: target.label,
    tokenAddress: target.address,
    status,
    contractCodePresent,
    decimals: null,
    errorClassification,
    requestDiagnostics,
  };
}

function normalizeBlockHash(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(value)
    ? value.toLowerCase()
    : null;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

export type AgentChain = typeof bsc | typeof bscTestnet

export type AgentSmartAccountConfig = {
    chain: AgentChain
    rpcUrl: string
    bundlerRpcUrl: string

    policyHookAddress: Address
    targetTokenAddress: Address
    wrappedNativeAddress: Address

export function getAgentSmartAccountConfig(): AgentSmartAccountConfig {
    const chainId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID
    const chain = getAgentChain(chainId)
    const rpcUrl =
        chain.id === bsc.id
            ? process.env.BSC_RPC_URL ?? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL
            : process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL
    if (!rpcUrl) {
        throw new Error(
            `Missing RPC URL for BSC chain ${chain.id}`
        )
    }
    const resolvedRpcUrl = chain.id === bsc.id && process.env.BSC_RPC_URL
        ? requireServerRpcUrl(process.env.BSC_RPC_URL)
        : resolvePublicRpcUrl(
            rpcUrl,
            rpcUrl,
            chain.id === bsc.id ? "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL" : "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL",
        )
    const bundlerRpcUrl =
        chain.id === bsc.id
            ? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_BUNDLER_RPC_URL
            : process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_BUNDLER_RPC_URL

    return {
        chain,
        rpcUrl: resolvedRpcUrl,
        bundlerRpcUrl: requirePublicUrl(
            bundlerRpcUrl,
            chain.id === bsc.id
                ? "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_BUNDLER_RPC_URL"
                : "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_BUNDLER_RPC_URL"
        ),
        routerAddress: requireAddress(
            process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ROUTER_ADDRESS,
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_ROUTER_ADDRESS"
        ),
        policyHookAddress: requireAddress(
            process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POLICY_HOOK_ADDRESS,
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_POLICY_HOOK_ADDRESS"
        ),
        targetTokenAddress: requireAddress(
            process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_TARGET_TOKEN_ADDRESS,
            "NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_TARGET_TOKEN_ADDRESS"
        ),
        wrappedNativeAddress: chain.id === bsc.id ? MAINNET_WBNB : TESTNET_WBNB
    }
}
