export type PoolReserves = {
    reserveIn: bigint
    reserveOut: bigint
}

export type DynamicQuote = {
    expectedAmountOut: bigint
    amountOutMin: bigint
    priceImpactBps: number
    slippageBps: number
    poolAddress: Address
}

export function calculateDynamicQuote(
    amountIn: bigint,
    reserves: PoolReserves,
    slippageBps = DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS,
    maxPriceImpactBps = DEFAULT_MAX_PRICE_IMPACT_BPS
) {
    if (amountIn <= BigInt(0)) throw new Error("amountIn must be greater than zero")
    if (reserves.reserveIn <= BigInt(0) || reserves.reserveOut <= BigInt(0)) {
        throw new Error("Pool reserves must both be greater than zero")
    }
    validateBasisPoints(slippageBps, MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS, "slippageBps")
    validateBasisPoints(maxPriceImpactBps, MAX_PRICE_IMPACT_BPS, "maxPriceImpactBps")

    const amountInWithFee = amountIn * FEE_NUMERATOR
    const expectedAmountOut =
        amountInWithFee * reserves.reserveOut
        / (reserves.reserveIn * FEE_DENOMINATOR + amountInWithFee)
    if (expectedAmountOut <= BigInt(0)) {
        throw new Error("Pool quote rounds to zero output")
    }

    const spotAmountOut = amountIn * reserves.reserveOut / reserves.reserveIn
    if (spotAmountOut <= BigInt(0)) {
        throw new Error("Spot quote rounds to zero output")
    }
    const priceImpactBps = Number(
        (spotAmountOut - expectedAmountOut) * BPS / spotAmountOut
    )
    if (priceImpactBps > maxPriceImpactBps) {
        throw new Error(
            `Price impact ${priceImpactBps} bps exceeds maximum ${maxPriceImpactBps} bps`
        )
    }

    const amountOutMin =
        expectedAmountOut * BigInt(10_000 - slippageBps) / BPS
    if (amountOutMin <= BigInt(0)) {
        throw new Error("Calculated minimum output must be greater than zero")
    }
    return { expectedAmountOut, amountOutMin, priceImpactBps, slippageBps }
}

export async function buildAgentBuyCall(
    publicClient: Client,
    request: {
        accountAddress: Address
        amountBnb: bigint
        slippageBps?: number
        maxPriceImpactBps?: number
        deadline?: number
    },
    config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
) {
    if (request.amountBnb <= BigInt(0) || request.amountBnb > MAX_TRADE_VALUE) {
        throw new Error("amountBnb must be greater than zero and at most 0.5 BNB")
    }

    const factory = await readContract(publicClient, {
        address: config.routerAddress,
        abi: routerFactoryAbi,
        functionName: "factory"
    })
    const poolAddress = await readContract(publicClient, {
        address: factory,
        abi: factoryPairAbi,
        functionName: "getPair",
        args: [config.wrappedNativeAddress, config.targetTokenAddress]
    })
    if (poolAddress === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000") {
        throw new Error("No PancakeSwap V2 pool exists for the configured route")
    }

    const [token0, reserves] = await Promise.all([
        readContract(publicClient, {
            address: poolAddress,
            abi: pairReserveAbi,
            functionName: "token0"
        }),
        readContract(publicClient, {
            address: poolAddress,
            abi: pairReserveAbi,
            functionName: "getReserves"
        })
    ])
    const [reserve0, reserve1] = reserves
    const token0IsWrapped = token0.toLowerCase() === config.wrappedNativeAddress.toLowerCase()
    const token0IsTarget = token0.toLowerCase() === config.targetTokenAddress.toLowerCase()
    if (!token0IsWrapped && !token0IsTarget) {
        throw new Error("Pool token ordering does not match the configured WBNB/token route")
    }
    const isWrappedNativeToken0 =
        token0IsWrapped
    const quote = calculateDynamicQuote(
        request.amountBnb,
        isWrappedNativeToken0
            ? { reserveIn: reserve0, reserveOut: reserve1 }
            : { reserveIn: reserve1, reserveOut: reserve0 },
        request.slippageBps,
        request.maxPriceImpactBps
    )

    return {
        ...encodeAgentBuyCall(
            request,
            quote.amountOutMin,
            config
        ),
        quote: { ...quote, poolAddress: getAddress(poolAddress) }
    }
}

export function encodeAgentBuyCall(
    request: {
        accountAddress: Address
        amountBnb: bigint
        deadline?: number
    },
    amountOutMin: bigint,
    config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
) {
    if (request.amountBnb <= BigInt(0) || request.amountBnb > MAX_TRADE_VALUE) {
        throw new Error("amountBnb must be greater than zero and at most 0.5 BNB")
    }
    if (amountOutMin <= BigInt(0)) {
        throw new Error("amountOutMin must be greater than zero")
    }
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
    const deadline = request.deadline ?? now + SWAP_DEADLINE_SECONDS
    if (
        !Number.isSafeInteger(deadline)
        || deadline <= now
        || deadline > now + SWAP_DEADLINE_SECONDS
    ) {
        throw new Error("deadline must be within the next 15 seconds")
    }

    return {
        to: config.routerAddress,
        value: request.amountBnb,
        data: encodeFunctionData({
            abi: routerBuyAbi,
            functionName: "swapExactETHForTokens",
            args: [
                amountOutMin,
                [config.wrappedNativeAddress, config.targetTokenAddress],
                getAddress(request.accountAddress),
                BigInt(deadline)
            ]
        })
    }
}

export async function buildAgentKernelPluginManager(
    publicClient: Client,
    ownerValidator: KernelValidator,
    sessionKeySigner: Signer,
    config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
): Promise<KernelPluginManager<"0.7">> {
    const actualChainId = await getChainId(publicClient)
    if (actualChainId !== config.chain.id) {
        throw new Error(
            `RPC chain mismatch: expected ${config.chain.id}, received ${actualChainId}`
        )
    }

    const hookBytecode = await getBytecode(publicClient, {
        address: config.policyHookAddress
    })
    if (!hookBytecode || hookBytecode === "0x") {
        throw new Error(
            `No custom policy hook deployed at ${config.policyHookAddress}`
        )
    }

    const [
        approvedRouter,
        entryPoint,
        deploymentChainId,
        wrappedNativeToken,
        targetTokenCode
    ] = await Promise.all([
        readContract(publicClient, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: hookReadAbi,
            functionName: "approvedRouter"
        }),
        readContract(publicClient, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: hookReadAbi,
            functionName: "entryPoint"
        }),
        readContract(publicClient, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: hookReadAbi,
            functionName: "deploymentChainId"
        }),
        readContract(publicClient, {
            address: config.policyHookAddress,
            abi: hookReadAbi,
            functionName: "wrappedNativeToken"
        }),
        getBytecode(publicClient, {
            address: config.targetTokenAddress
        })
    ])

    if (approvedRouter.toLowerCase() !== config.routerAddress.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Configured router ${config.routerAddress} does not match hook router ${approvedRouter}`
        )
    }
    if (entryPoint.toLowerCase() !== ENTRY_POINT.address.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Hook EntryPoint ${entryPoint} does not match ZeroDev EntryPoint ${ENTRY_POINT.address}`
        )
    }
    if (deploymentChainId !== BigInt(config.chain.id)) {
        throw new Error(
            `Hook was deployed for chain ${deploymentChainId}, not ${config.chain.id}`
        )
    }
    if (wrappedNativeToken.toLowerCase() !== config.wrappedNativeAddress.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Hook wrapped-native token ${wrappedNativeToken} does not match configured route ${config.wrappedNativeAddress}`
        )
    }
    if (!targetTokenCode || targetTokenCode === "0x") {
        throw new Error(
            `No target token contract deployed at ${config.targetTokenAddress}`
        )
    }

    const signer = await toECDSASigner({ signer: sessionKeySigner })
    const sessionValidator = await toPermissionValidator(publicClient, {
        entryPoint: ENTRY_POINT,
        kernelVersion: KERNEL_V3_1,
        signer,
        policies: [
            toCallPolicy({
                policyVersion: CallPolicyVersion.V0_0_5,
                permissions: [
                    {
                        callType: CallType.CALL,
                        target: config.routerAddress,
                        selector: BUY_SELECTOR,
                        valueLimit: MAX_TRADE_VALUE
                    }
                ]
            })
        ]
    })

    const executionHook: KernelValidatorHook = {
        getIdentifier: () => config.policyHookAddress,
        getEnableData: async () => concatHex([
            "0x00",
            encodeAbiParameters([{ type: "address" }], [config.targetTokenAddress])
        ])
    }

    return toKernelPluginManager(publicClient, {
        sudo: ownerValidator,
        regular: sessionValidator,
        hook: executionHook,
        entryPoint: ENTRY_POINT,
        kernelVersion: KERNEL_V3_1,
        validUntil: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_VALIDITY_SECONDS
    })
}

export async function createAgentSmartAccountClient(
    ownerValidator: KernelValidator,
    sessionKeySigner: Signer,
    config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig()
) {
    const publicClient = createAgentPublicClient(config)
    const plugins = await buildAgentKernelPluginManager(
        publicClient,
        ownerValidator,
        sessionKeySigner,
        config
    )
    const account = await createKernelAccount(publicClient, {
        plugins,
        entryPoint: ENTRY_POINT,
        kernelVersion: KERNEL_V3_1
    })
    const client = createKernelAccountClient({
        account,
        chain: config.chain,
        client: publicClient,
        bundlerTransport: http(config.bundlerRpcUrl)
    })

    return { account, client }
}

export type AgentTelemetryRecord = {
    event: "attempted" | "submitted" | "succeeded" | "rejected"
    reasonCode?: string
    account: Address
    targetToken: Address
    amountBnb: string
    timestamp: string
    userOperationHash?: Hex
    transactionHash?: Hex
    priceImpactBps?: number
    slippageBps?: number
    error?: string
}

export type AgentExecutionResult = {
    userOperationHash: Hex
    receipt: {
        success: boolean
        reason?: string
        receipt: { transactionHash: Hex }
    }
    quote?: Pick<DynamicQuote, "priceImpactBps" | "slippageBps">
}

export async function runAgentExecutionWithTelemetry(
    metadata: {
        account: Address
        targetToken: Address
        amountBnb: bigint
    },
    run: (onSubmitted: (hash: Hex, quote?: AgentExecutionResult["quote"]) => void) =>
        Promise<AgentExecutionResult>,
    log: (record: AgentTelemetryRecord) => void = record => {
        const method = record.event === "rejected" ? console.error : console.info
        method(JSON.stringify(record))
    }
) {
    const common = {
        account: metadata.account,
        targetToken: metadata.targetToken,
        amountBnb: metadata.amountBnb.toString(),
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }
    let submitted: { hash: Hex; quote?: AgentExecutionResult["quote"] } | undefined
    log({ event: "attempted", ...common })

    try {
        const result = await run((hash, quote) => {
            submitted = { hash, quote }
            log({
                event: "submitted",
                ...common,
                userOperationHash: hash,
                priceImpactBps: quote?.priceImpactBps,
                slippageBps: quote?.slippageBps
            })
        })
        if (!result.receipt.success) {
            throw new Error(result.receipt.reason || "UserOperation execution reverted")
        }
        log({
            event: "succeeded",
            ...common,
            userOperationHash: result.userOperationHash,
            transactionHash: result.receipt.receipt.transactionHash,
            priceImpactBps: result.quote?.priceImpactBps,
            slippageBps: result.quote?.slippageBps
        })
        return result
    } catch (error) {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown execution error"
        log({
            event: "rejected",
            reasonCode: classifyAgentError(message),
            ...common,
            userOperationHash: submitted?.hash,
            priceImpactBps: submitted?.quote?.priceImpactBps,
            slippageBps: submitted?.quote?.slippageBps,
            error: message
        })
        throw error
    }
}

export async function executeAgentBuy(
    accountClient: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createAgentSmartAccountClient>>["client"],
    request: {
        amountBnb: bigint
        slippageBps?: number
        maxPriceImpactBps?: number
        deadline?: number
    },
    config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig(),
    log: (record: AgentTelemetryRecord) => void = record => {
        const method = record.event === "rejected" ? console.error : console.info
        method(JSON.stringify(record))
    }
) {
    if (process.env.ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION !== "true") {
        throw new Error(
            "Live UserOperation submission is disabled; set ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION=true to enable it"
        )
    }
    if (config.chain.id !== 97 && config.chain.id !== bsc.id) {
        throw new Error("Agent UserOperation submission supports only BSC Testnet or BSC Mainnet")
    }
    if (
        config.chain.id === bsc.id &&
        (
            process.env.ENABLE_MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING !== "true"
            || process.env.MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING_ACK !== "I_ACCEPT_AUTONOMOUS_MAINNET_RISK"
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error("Mainnet autonomous trading is not separately authorized")
    }
    const account = accountClient.account
    return runAgentExecutionWithTelemetry(
        {
            account: account.address,
            targetToken: config.targetTokenAddress,
            amountBnb: request.amountBnb
        },
        async onSubmitted => {
        const call = await buildAgentBuyCall(
            accountClient.client,
            { ...request, accountAddress: account.address },
            config
        )
        const userOperationHash = await accountClient.sendUserOperation({
            calls: [{
                to: call.to,
                value: call.value,
                data: call.data
            }]
        })
        onSubmitted(userOperationHash, call.quote)
        const result = await accountClient.waitForUserOperationReceipt({
            hash: userOperationHash
        })
        return {
            userOperationHash,
            receipt: result,
            quote: call.quote
        }
        },
        log
    )
}

function classifyAgentError(message: string) {
    if (message.includes("Price impact")) return "PRICE_IMPACT_EXCEEDED"
    if (message.includes("slippageBps")) return "SLIPPAGE_CONFIGURATION_INVALID"
    if (message.includes("pool") || message.includes("Pool")) return "POOL_UNAVAILABLE"
    if (message.includes("reverted")) return "USER_OPERATION_REVERTED"
    return "EXECUTION_FAILED"
}

function validateBasisPoints(value: number, maximum: number, name: string) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0 || value > maximum) {
        throw new Error(`${name} must be an integer between 1 and ${maximum}`)
    }
}

function getAgentChain(chainId: string | undefined): AgentChain {
    if (chainId === String(bsc.id)) return bsc
    if (chainId === String(bscTestnet.id)) return bscTestnet
    throw new Error(
        "NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID must be 56 (BSC) or 97 (BSC testnet)"
    )
}

function requireAddress(
    value: string | undefined,
    variableName: string
): Address {
    if (!value || !isAddress(value)) {
        throw new Error(`${variableName} must be a valid EVM address`)
    }
    return getAddress(value)
}

function requirePublicUrl(value: string | undefined, variableName: string) {
    if (!value) {
        throw new Error(`${variableName} must be a public bundler RPC URL`)
    }

    let url: URL
    try {
        url = new URL(value)
    } catch {
        throw new Error(`${variableName} must be a valid public HTTP(S) URL`)
    }
    if (
        (url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:")
        || url.username
        || url.password
        || url.hash
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            `${variableName} must be a public HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials or fragments`
        )
    }
    return url.toString()
}

function requireServerRpcUrl(value: string): string {
    let url: URL
    try {
        url = new URL(value)
    } catch {
        throw new Error("BSC_RPC_URL must be a valid server-side HTTP(S) RPC URL.")
    }
    if ((url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") || url.hash) {
        throw new Error("BSC_RPC_URL must be a server-side HTTP(S) RPC URL.")
    }
    return url.toString()
}
import "server-only";
import crypto from "node:crypto";

export function makeBinanceAuthHeaders(
  method: string,
  path: string,
  body = "",
  options: {
    apiKey?: string;
    secretKey?: string;
    now?: () => Date;
  } = {},
) {
  const apiKey = options.apiKey ?? process.env.BINANCE_API_KEY;
  const secretKey = options.secretKey ?? process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!apiKey || !secretKey) {
    throw new Error("Binance Web3 API credentials are not configured.");
  }
  const timestamp = (options.now ?? (() => new Date()))().toISOString();
  const requestPath = "/build" + path;
  const preHash = timestamp + method.toUpperCase() + requestPath + body;
  const signature = crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", secretKey)
    .update(preHash, "utf8")
    .digest("base64");
  return {
    "X-OC-APIKEY": apiKey,
    "X-OC-TIMESTAMP": timestamp,
    "X-OC-SIGN": signature,
    "X-OC-RECV-WINDOW": "60000",
  };
}
import "server-only";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { PublicClient } from "viem";
import {
  RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK,
  RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH,
  type RecordedProbeTarget,
} from "./bscMetadataProbe.ts";
import {
  markInvalidRpcResponse,
  runRpcRead,
  type RpcRequestDiagnostic,
} from "./bscRpcReliability.ts";

const DECIMALS_ABI = [{
  type: "function",
  name: "decimals",
  stateMutability: "view",
  inputs: [],
  outputs: [{ type: "uint8" }],
}] as const;
const MAX_SUPPORTED_DECIMALS = 18;

export type ArchiveProbeRpcClient = Pick<
  PublicClient,
  "getChainId" | "getBlockNumber" | "getBlock" | "getBytecode" | "readContract"
>;

type EndpointProbe = {
  chainId: number | null;
  latestBlockNumber: string | null;
  latestBlockHash: string | null;
  historicalBlockHash: string | null;
  requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[];
  targets: Array<{
    label: RecordedProbeTarget["label"];
    tokenAddress: string;
    current: ProbeRead;
    historical: ProbeRead;
  }>;
  errorClassification: string | null;
};

type ProbeRead = {
  contractCodePresent: boolean | null;
  contractCodeSha256: string | null;
  decimals: number | null;
  status: "VERIFIED" | "UNSUPPORTED" | "UNVERIFIED";
  errorClassification: string | null;
  requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[];
};

export type ArchiveStateProbeResult = {
  status: "HISTORICAL_STATE_ACCESS_VERIFIED_FOR_PROBE_TARGETS" |
    "HISTORICAL_STATE_CROSS_VERIFIED_FOR_PROBE_TARGETS" |
    "ARCHIVE_STATE_ACCESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED";
  targetBlockNumber: string;
  targetBlockHash: string;
  primaryRpcIdentity: string;
  archiveRpcIdentity: string | null;
  providerIndependence: "OPERATOR_ATTESTED_INDEPENDENT" | "NOT_ESTABLISHED";
  primary: EndpointProbe;
  archive: EndpointProbe | null;
  targetComparisons: Array<{
    label: RecordedProbeTarget["label"];
    tokenAddress: string;
    currentState: ProbeRead;
    primaryHistorical: ProbeRead;
    archiveHistorical: ProbeRead | null;
    providersAgree: boolean | null;
  }>;
};

export async function diagnoseArchiveState(input: {
  primary: {
    client: ArchiveProbeRpcClient;
    identity: string;
    operator: string;
  };
  archive?: {
    client: ArchiveProbeRpcClient;
    identity: string;
    operator: string;
    independenceAttested?: boolean;
  };
  targets: RecordedProbeTarget[];
  sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
  random?: () => number;
}): Promise<ArchiveStateProbeResult> {
  validateTargets(input.targets);
  const retryOptions = { maxRetries: 0, sleep: input.sleep, random: input.random };
  const primary = await probeEndpoint(input.primary.client, input.targets, true, retryOptions);
  const archive = input.archive
    ? await probeEndpoint(input.archive.client, input.targets, false, retryOptions)
    : null;
  const independent = Boolean(
    input.archive?.operator.trim() &&
    input.primary.operator.trim() &&
    input.archive.operator.trim().toLowerCase() !== input.primary.operator.trim().toLowerCase() &&
    input.archive.independenceAttested === true,
  );
  const blockConsistent = Boolean(
    archive &&
    primary.historicalBlockHash === RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH &&
    archive.historicalBlockHash === RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH,
  );
  const targetComparisons = input.targets.map((target, index) => {
    const currentState = primary.targets[index].current;
    const primaryHistorical = primary.targets[index].historical;
    const archiveHistorical = archive?.targets[index].historical ?? null;
    const providersAgree = archiveHistorical && independent && blockConsistent
      ? readsAgree(primaryHistorical, archiveHistorical)
      : null;
    return {
      label: target.label,
      tokenAddress: target.address,
      currentState,
      primaryHistorical,
      archiveHistorical,
      providersAgree,
    };
  });
  const allPrimaryHistoricalVerified = primary.historicalBlockHash === RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH &&
    primary.targets.every((target) => stateReadEstablished(target.historical));
  const allArchiveHistoricalVerified = Boolean(
    archive &&
    archive.historicalBlockHash === RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH &&
    archive.targets.every((target) => stateReadEstablished(target.historical)),
  );
  const status = allPrimaryHistoricalVerified
    ? "HISTORICAL_STATE_ACCESS_VERIFIED_FOR_PROBE_TARGETS"
    : allArchiveHistoricalVerified
      ? "HISTORICAL_STATE_ACCESS_VERIFIED_FOR_PROBE_TARGETS"
      : "ARCHIVE_STATE_ACCESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED";
  const crossVerified = independent && blockConsistent && targetComparisons.every((target) =>
    target.providersAgree === true
  );
  return {
    status: crossVerified
      ? "HISTORICAL_STATE_CROSS_VERIFIED_FOR_PROBE_TARGETS"
      : status,
    targetBlockNumber: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK.toString(),
    targetBlockHash: RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH,
    primaryRpcIdentity: input.primary.identity,
    archiveRpcIdentity: input.archive?.identity ?? null,
    providerIndependence: independent ? "OPERATOR_ATTESTED_INDEPENDENT" : "NOT_ESTABLISHED",
    primary,
    archive,
    targetComparisons,
  };
}

async function probeEndpoint(
  client: ArchiveProbeRpcClient,
  targets: RecordedProbeTarget[],
  includeLatest: boolean,
  retryOptions: {
    maxRetries: number;
    sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
    random?: () => number;
  },
): Promise<EndpointProbe> {
  const requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [];
  const chainRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_chainId",
    stage: "BLOCK",
    operation: () => client.getChainId(),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  requestDiagnostics.push(...chainRead.diagnostics);
  if (!chainRead.ok || chainRead.value !== 56) {
    const error = chainRead.ok ? "CHAIN_ID_MISMATCH" : chainRead.diagnostic.errorClass;
    return failedEndpoint(targets, error, chainRead.ok ? chainRead.value : null, requestDiagnostics);
  }

  let latestBlockNumber: bigint | null = null;
  let latestBlockHash: string | null = null;
  if (includeLatest) {
    const latestRead = await runRpcRead({
      method: "eth_blockNumber",
      stage: "BLOCK",
      operation: () => client.getBlockNumber(),
      ...retryOptions,
    });
    requestDiagnostics.push(...latestRead.diagnostics);
    if (!latestRead.ok) {
      return failedEndpoint(targets, latestRead.diagnostic.errorClass, 56, requestDiagnostics);
    }
    latestBlockNumber = latestRead.value;
    const latestHeader = await readBlock(client, latestBlockNumber, requestDiagnostics, retryOptions);
    if (!latestHeader.ok) {
      return failedEndpoint(targets, latestHeader.error, 56, requestDiagnostics);
    }
    latestBlockHash = latestHeader.hash;
  }

  const historicHeader = await readBlock(
    client,
    RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK,
    requestDiagnostics,
    retryOptions,
  );
  const historicalBlockHash = historicHeader.hash;
  const targetsResult = [];
  for (const target of targets) {
    const current = includeLatest && latestBlockNumber !== null
      ? await readCodeAndDecimals(client, target, latestBlockNumber, false, retryOptions)
      : emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", "NOT_REQUESTED");
    const historical = historicHeader.ok
      ? await readCodeAndDecimals(client, target, RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK, true, retryOptions)
      : emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", historicHeader.error);
    targetsResult.push({ label: target.label, tokenAddress: target.address, current, historical });
  }
  return {
    chainId: 56,
    latestBlockNumber: latestBlockNumber?.toString() ?? null,
    latestBlockHash,
    historicalBlockHash,
    requestDiagnostics,
    targets: targetsResult,
    errorClassification: historicHeader.ok ? null : historicHeader.error,
  };
}

async function readBlock(
  client: ArchiveProbeRpcClient,
  blockNumber: bigint,
  diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[],
  retryOptions: {
    maxRetries: number;
    sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
    random?: () => number;
  },
): Promise<{ ok: true; hash: string } | { ok: false; error: string; hash: string | null }> {
  const blockRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_getBlockByNumber",
    stage: "BLOCK",
    operation: () => client.getBlock({ blockNumber }),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  diagnostics.push(...blockRead.diagnostics);
  if (!blockRead.ok) return { ok: false, error: blockRead.diagnostic.errorClass, hash: null };
  const hash = normalizeBlockHash(blockRead.value.hash);
  if (!hash) {
    const invalid = markInvalidRpcResponse([blockRead.diagnostics.at(-1)!])[0];
    diagnostics[diagnostics.length - 1] = invalid;
    return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE", hash: null };
  }
  if (blockNumber === RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK && hash !== RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH) {
    return { ok: false, error: "BLOCK_HASH_MISMATCH", hash };
  }
  return { ok: true, hash };
}

async function readCodeAndDecimals(
  client: ArchiveProbeRpcClient,
  target: RecordedProbeTarget,
  blockNumber: bigint,
  readDecimals: boolean,
  retryOptions: {
    maxRetries: number;
    sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
    random?: () => number;
  },
): Promise<ProbeRead> {
  const diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [];
  const codeRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_getCode",
    stage: "BYTECODE",
    operation: () => client.getBytecode({ address: target.address, blockNumber }),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  diagnostics.push(...codeRead.diagnostics);
  if (!codeRead.ok) return emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", codeRead.diagnostic.errorClass, diagnostics);
  const code = codeRead.value;
  if (typeof code !== "string" || !/^0x(?:[a-fA-F0-9]{2})*$/.test(code)) {
    return emptyRead(
      "UNVERIFIED",
      "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
      markInvalidRpcResponse(diagnostics),
    );
  }
  if (code === "0x") {
    return {
      ...emptyRead("UNSUPPORTED", "MISSING_CONTRACT_CODE", diagnostics),
      contractCodePresent: false,
    };
  }
  const contractCodeSha256 = createHash("sha256").update(code).digest("hex");
  if (!readDecimals) {
    return {
      contractCodePresent: true,
      contractCodeSha256,
      decimals: null,
      status: "VERIFIED",
      errorClassification: null,
      requestDiagnostics: diagnostics,
    };
  }
  const decimalRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_call",
    stage: "DECIMALS",
    operation: () => client.readContract({
      address: target.address,
      abi: DECIMALS_ABI,
      functionName: "decimals",
      blockNumber,
    }),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  diagnostics.push(...decimalRead.diagnostics);
  if (!decimalRead.ok) {
    return {
      ...emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", decimalRead.diagnostic.errorClass, diagnostics),
      contractCodePresent: true,
      contractCodeSha256,
    };
  }
  const decimals: unknown = decimalRead.value;
  if (typeof decimals !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals < 0 || decimals > 255) {
    return {
      ...emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE", markInvalidRpcResponse(diagnostics)),
      contractCodePresent: true,
      contractCodeSha256,
    };
  }
  if (decimals > MAX_SUPPORTED_DECIMALS) {
    return {
      ...emptyRead("UNSUPPORTED", "DECIMALS_OUTSIDE_WOLV_RANGE", diagnostics),
      contractCodePresent: true,
      contractCodeSha256,
      decimals,
    };
  }
  return {
    contractCodePresent: true,
    contractCodeSha256,
    decimals,
    status: "VERIFIED",
    errorClassification: null,
    requestDiagnostics: diagnostics,
  };
}

function failedEndpoint(
  targets: RecordedProbeTarget[],
  error: string,
  chainId: number | null,
  requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[],
): EndpointProbe {
  return {
    chainId,
    latestBlockNumber: null,
    latestBlockHash: null,
    historicalBlockHash: null,
    requestDiagnostics,
    targets: targets.map((target) => ({
      label: target.label,
      tokenAddress: target.address,
      current: emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", error),
      historical: emptyRead("UNVERIFIED", error),
    })),
    errorClassification: error,
  };
}

function emptyRead(
  status: ProbeRead["status"],
  errorClassification: string,
  requestDiagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [],
): ProbeRead {
  return {
    contractCodePresent: null,
    contractCodeSha256: null,
    decimals: null,
    status,
    errorClassification,
    requestDiagnostics,
  };
}

function readsAgree(first: ProbeRead, second: ProbeRead): boolean {
  return stateReadEstablished(first) &&
    stateReadEstablished(second) &&
    first.contractCodeSha256 === second.contractCodeSha256 &&
    first.contractCodePresent === second.contractCodePresent &&
    first.decimals === second.decimals;
}

function stateReadEstablished(read: ProbeRead): boolean {
  return read.status === "VERIFIED" ||
    (read.status === "UNSUPPORTED" &&
      (read.errorClassification === "MISSING_CONTRACT_CODE" ||
        read.errorClassification === "DECIMALS_OUTSIDE_WOLV_RANGE"));
}

function validateTargets(targets: RecordedProbeTarget[]): void {
  const allowed = new Set([
    "0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955",
    "0xe614e2fc6c787035ff51f452e8e826bfd32d5283",
    "0x282973969118f9fe39bf2ff3d8dd1efee82ccb11",
  ]);
  if (targets.length !== 3 || new Set(targets.map((target) => target.address.toLowerCase())).size !== 3 ||
    targets.some((target) => !allowed.has(target.address.toLowerCase()))) {
    throw new Error("Archive probe accepts only the three fixed Phase 3.15 addresses.");
  }
}

function normalizeBlockHash(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(value)
    ? value.toLowerCase()
    : null;
}

export type DynamicStrategyMode = "PEAK_DEFENSE" | "OFF_HOURS_ALPHA";
export type DynamicStrategyAction = "MONITOR" | "PROPOSE";

export type DynamicMarketMetrics = {
  observedAt: number;
  pancakeLiquidityUsd: number;
  baselineLiquidityUsd: number;
  gasPriceGwei: number;
  atrBps: number;
};

export type DynamicStrategyProfile = {
  mode: DynamicStrategyMode;
  maxSlippageBps: number;
  maxOrderBnb: number;
  cooldownSeconds: number;
  action: DynamicStrategyAction;
};

export type DynamicStrategyDecision = {
  mode: DynamicStrategyMode;
  liquidityChangePercent: number;
  marketSession: "US_REGULAR" | "US_CLOSED";
  profile: DynamicStrategyProfile;
  action: DynamicStrategyAction;
  accepted: boolean;
  reasons: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  executionEnabled: false;
};

const MAX_METRIC_AGE_MS = 60_000;
const PEAK_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 30;
const ALPHA_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 100;
const HARD_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 100;

export function validateDynamicMarketMetrics(
  metrics: DynamicMarketMetrics,
  now: number = Date.now(),
): string[] {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(metrics.observedAt) || metrics.observedAt <= 0 || now - metrics.observedAt > MAX_METRIC_AGE_MS) {
    errors.push("Market metrics timestamp is missing, invalid, or stale.");
  }
  if (metrics.observedAt > now + 30_000) errors.push("Market metrics timestamp is in the future.");
  if (!Number.isFinite(metrics.pancakeLiquidityUsd) || metrics.pancakeLiquidityUsd <= 0) {
    errors.push("PancakeSwap liquidity is missing or invalid.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(metrics.baselineLiquidityUsd) || metrics.baselineLiquidityUsd <= 0) {
    errors.push("Liquidity baseline is missing or invalid.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(metrics.gasPriceGwei) || metrics.gasPriceGwei <= 0) {
    errors.push("Gas price is missing or invalid.");
  } else if (metrics.gasPriceGwei > 20) {
    errors.push("Gas price exceeds the conservative execution threshold.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(metrics.atrBps) || metrics.atrBps < 0 || metrics.atrBps > 10_000) {
    errors.push("ATR volatility is missing or invalid.");
  }
  return errors;
}

export function isUSRegularMarketSession(observedAt: number): boolean {
  const date = new Date(observedAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return false;
  const day = date.getUTCDay();
  if (day === 0 || day === 6) return false;
  const minutes = date.getUTCHours() * 60 + date.getUTCMinutes();
  return minutes >= 14 * 60 + 30 && minutes < 21 * 60;
}

export function evaluateDynamicStrategy(
  metrics: DynamicMarketMetrics,
  now: number = Date.now(),
): DynamicStrategyDecision {
  const reasons = validateDynamicMarketMetrics(metrics, now);
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const marketSession = isUSRegularMarketSession(metrics.observedAt) ? "US_REGULAR" : "US_CLOSED";
  const liquidityChangePercent =
    metrics.baselineLiquidityUsd > 0
      ? ((metrics.pancakeLiquidityUsd - metrics.baselineLiquidityUsd) / metrics.baselineLiquidityUsd) * 100
      : 0;

  if (reasons.length === 0 && marketSession === "US_REGULAR") {
    if (metrics.atrBps > 300) reasons.push("Volatility exceeds the peak-defense threshold.");
    if (liquidityChangePercent < -15) reasons.push("Liquidity dropped sharply during the US regular session.");
  }

  const mode: DynamicStrategyMode =
    marketSession === "US_REGULAR" ? "PEAK_DEFENSE" : "OFF_HOURS_ALPHA";
  warnings.push("US exchange holidays and half-days are approximated by weekday UTC time only; no independent verified holiday calendar is currently connected.");
  const profile: DynamicStrategyProfile =
    mode === "PEAK_DEFENSE"
      ? {
        mode,
        maxSlippageBps: PEAK_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS,
        maxOrderBnb: 0.5,
        cooldownSeconds: 300,
        action: "PROPOSE",
      }
      : {
        mode,
        maxSlippageBps: ALPHA_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS,
        maxOrderBnb: 0.5,
        cooldownSeconds: 60,
        action: "MONITOR",
      };

  if (profile.maxSlippageBps > HARD_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS) {
    reasons.push("Profile slippage exceeds the hard policy cap.");
  }
  if (mode === "OFF_HOURS_ALPHA") {
    warnings.push("Off-hours mode starts in monitoring-only mode; cross-DEX sweep execution remains disabled.");
    if (liquidityChangePercent < -15) {
      warnings.push("Liquidity is more than 15 percent below baseline.");
    } else {
      reasons.push("Off-hours mode requires verified liquidity degradation before accumulation scanning.");
    }
  }

  return {
    mode,
    liquidityChangePercent: Number(liquidityChangePercent.toFixed(4)),
    marketSession,
    profile,
    action: reasons.length === 0 ? profile.action : "MONITOR",
    accepted: reasons.length === 0,
    reasons,
    warnings,
    executionEnabled: false,
  };
}
const SPOT_TRADING_ONLY_BLACKLIST = new Set(["SOXL", "KORU", "MUU"]);
const LEVERAGED_ASSET_PATTERN = /\b(?:leveraged?|inverse|daily\s+(?:long|short)|\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*x(?:\s*(?:long|short))?)\b/i;

export type SpotAssetIdentity = {
  underlyingTicker?: string | null;
  symbol?: string | null;
  underlyingName?: string | null;
  tokenName?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  leverage?: number | string | null;
  leverageFactor?: number | string | null;
};

export function isAssetCompliant(symbol: string): boolean {
  if (typeof symbol !== "string") return false;

  const normalized = symbol.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!normalized) return false;

  return !SPOT_TRADING_ONLY_BLACKLIST.has(normalized);
}

export function isSpotEligibleAsset(asset: SpotAssetIdentity | string): boolean {
  if (typeof asset === "string") return isAssetCompliant(asset);

  const symbol = asset.underlyingTicker ?? asset.symbol ?? "";
  if (!isAssetCompliant(symbol)) return false;

  const description = [
    asset.tokenName,
    asset.underlyingName,
    asset.name,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  if (LEVERAGED_ASSET_PATTERN.test(description)) return false;

  for (const value of [asset.leverage, asset.leverageFactor]) {
    if (value != null) {
      const leverage = Number(value);
      if (!Number.isFinite(leverage) || Math.abs(leverage) > 1) return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}

export function filterSpotEligibleAssets<T extends SpotAssetIdentity>(assets: T[]): T[] {
  return assets.filter(isSpotEligibleAsset);
}

// Preserve the original export for existing callers while tightening its spot-only behavior.
export function filterCompliantAssets<T extends SpotAssetIdentity>(assets: T[]): T[] {
  return filterSpotEligibleAssets(assets);
}

export type RwaAssetListResponse = { data: Record<string, unknown>[] };

type RwaScalar = string | number | null;

export type RwaAssetRecord = SpotAssetIdentity & {
  tokenContractAddress: string;
  underlyingTicker: string;
  platformId: string;
  underlyingName?: string;
  tokenName?: string;
  symbol?: string;
  name?: string;
  tokenLogoUrl?: string;
  tokenToShareRatio?: RwaScalar;
  tokenPrice?: RwaScalar;
  referencePrice?: RwaScalar;
  volume24H?: RwaScalar;
  marketCap?: RwaScalar;
  peRatioTTM?: RwaScalar;
  statusInfo?: { openState?: boolean; marketStatus?: string | null };
  tags?: string[];
};

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function stringOrNull(value: unknown): string | null | undefined {
  return typeof value === "string" || value === null ? value : undefined;
}

function optionalString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined;
}

function scalar(value: unknown): RwaScalar | undefined {
  return typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" || value === null
    ? value
    : undefined;
}

export function isRwaAssetListResponse(
  value: unknown,
  options: { allowEmpty?: boolean } = {}
): value is RwaAssetListResponse {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !Array.isArray(value.data)) return false;
  if (value.data.length === 0) return options.allowEmpty === true;

  return value.data.every((asset) =>
    isRecord(asset) &&
    typeof asset.tokenContractAddress === "string" && asset.tokenContractAddress.trim().length > 0 &&
    typeof asset.underlyingTicker === "string" && asset.underlyingTicker.trim().length > 0 &&
    typeof asset.platformId === "string" && asset.platformId.trim().length > 0
  );
}

export function parseRwaAssetRecords(response: unknown): RwaAssetRecord[] {
  if (!isRwaAssetListResponse(response)) return [];

  return response.data.flatMap((value) => {
    if (
      !isRecord(value) ||
      typeof value.tokenContractAddress !== "string" ||
      typeof value.underlyingTicker !== "string" ||
      typeof value.platformId !== "string"
    ) return [];

    const status = isRecord(value.statusInfo) ? value.statusInfo : null;
    const tags = Array.isArray(value.tags)
      ? value.tags.filter((tag): tag is string => typeof tag === "string")
      : undefined;

    return [{
      tokenContractAddress: value.tokenContractAddress,
      underlyingTicker: value.underlyingTicker,
      platformId: value.platformId,
      tokenLogoUrl: typeof value.tokenLogoUrl === "string" ? value.tokenLogoUrl : undefined,
      underlyingName: optionalString(value.underlyingName),
      tokenName: optionalString(value.tokenName),
      name: optionalString(value.name),
      symbol: optionalString(value.symbol),
      leverage: scalar(value.leverage),
      leverageFactor: scalar(value.leverageFactor),
      tokenToShareRatio: scalar(value.tokenToShareRatio),
      tokenPrice: scalar(value.tokenPrice),
      referencePrice: scalar(value.referencePrice),
      volume24H: scalar(value.volume24H),
      marketCap: scalar(value.marketCap),
      peRatioTTM: scalar(value.peRatioTTM),
      statusInfo: status ? {
        openState: typeof status.openState === "boolean" ? status.openState : undefined,
        marketStatus: stringOrNull(status.marketStatus),
      } : undefined,
      tags,
    }];
  });
}

export type RwaPlatformRecord = { platformId: string; logoUrl?: string };

export function parseRwaPlatformRecords(response: unknown): RwaPlatformRecord[] {
  if (!isRecord(response) || !Array.isArray(response.data)) return [];
  return response.data.flatMap((value) => {
    if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.platformId !== "string") return [];
    return [{
      platformId: value.platformId,
      logoUrl: typeof value.logoUrl === "string" ? value.logoUrl : undefined,
    }];
  });
}

type RwaTokenRecord = SpotAssetIdentity & { tokenContractAddress?: string };

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function stringField(record: Record<string, unknown>, field: string): string | undefined {
  return typeof record[field] === "string" ? record[field] : undefined;
}

function numericField(record: Record<string, unknown>, field: string): number | string | undefined {
  const value = record[field];
  return typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined;
}

function toSpotIdentity(record: Record<string, unknown>): RwaTokenRecord {
  return {
    tokenContractAddress: stringField(record, "tokenContractAddress"),
    underlyingTicker: stringField(record, "underlyingTicker"),
    symbol: stringField(record, "symbol"),
    underlyingName: stringField(record, "underlyingName"),
    tokenName: stringField(record, "tokenName"),
    name: stringField(record, "name"),
    leverage: numericField(record, "leverage"),
    leverageFactor: numericField(record, "leverageFactor"),
  };
}

export async function isSpotRwaTokenAddress(address: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(address)) return false;

  const response: unknown = await getRWATokenList();
  if (!isRwaAssetListResponse(response)) return false;

  const token = response.data.find((value) => {
    if (!isRecord(value)) return false;
    return stringField(value, "tokenContractAddress")?.toLowerCase() === address.toLowerCase();
  });
  if (!isRecord(token)) return false;

  const identity = toSpotIdentity(token);
  return Boolean(identity.tokenContractAddress) && isSpotEligibleAsset(identity);
}
import { parseUnits } from "viem";

const UINT256_MAX = BigInt(2) ** BigInt(256) - BigInt(1);

export const BSC_USDT_ADDRESS = "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955";
export const EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN = /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/;
export const MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT = "5";
export const MINIMUM_ORDER_WEI = parseUnits(MINIMUM_ORDER_USDT, 18);

export function isValidBinanceQuoteId(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/i.test(value);
}

export function isPositiveUint256(value: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeUint256(value);
  return normalized !== null && BigInt(normalized) > BigInt(0);
}

export function normalizeUint256(value: string): string | null {
  if (!/^(?:\d{1,78}|0x[a-fA-F0-9]{1,64})$/.test(value)) return null;
  const amount = BigInt(value);
  return amount <= UINT256_MAX ? amount.toString() : null;
}

export function usdtAmountToWei(value: string): string {
  const amount = value.trim();
  if (!/^(?:\d+\.?\d{0,18}|\.\d{1,18})$/.test(amount)) {
    throw new Error("Enter a positive USDT amount with no more than 18 decimal places");
  }
  const normalized = amount.startsWith(".") ? `0${amount}` : amount;
  const parsed = parseUnits(normalized.endsWith(".") ? normalized.slice(0, -1) : normalized, 18);
  if (parsed <= BigInt(0)) throw new Error("USDT amount must be greater than zero");
  return parsed.toString();
}

export function isValidUsdtAmount(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    usdtAmountToWei(value);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function meetsMinimumOrderAmount(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    return BigInt(usdtAmountToWei(value)) >= MINIMUM_ORDER_WEI;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function isSafeOrderId(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(value);
}
import crypto from "crypto";
import { EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN } from "./apiValidation.ts";

const QUOTE_BINDING_TTL_MS = 30_000;

type QuoteBindingPayload = {
  toToken: string;
  fromToken?: string;
  amount: string;
  wallet: string;
  quoteId: string;
  chainId?: string;
  direction?: "BUY" | "SELL";
  slippageBps?: number;
  approveTarget?: string;
  issuedAt: number;
};

function bindingSecret(): string {
  const secret = process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
  if (!secret) throw new Error("Quote binding secret is not configured");
  return secret;
}

function sign(payload: string): string {
  return crypto.createHmac("sha256", bindingSecret()).update(payload, "utf8").digest("base64url");
}

export function createQuoteBinding(input: Omit<QuoteBindingPayload, "issuedAt">, issuedAt = Date.now()): string {
  const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...input, issuedAt }), "utf8").toString("base64url");
  return `${payload}.${sign(payload)}`;
}

export function verifyQuoteBinding(
  binding: string,
  expected: Omit<QuoteBindingPayload, "issuedAt">,
  now = Date.now()
): { ok: true; issuedAt: number; approveTarget?: string } | { ok: false; reason: string } {
  try {
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(binding)) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Malformed quote binding" };
    }
    const [encodedPayload, providedSignature] = binding.split(".");
    const expectedSignature = sign(encodedPayload);
    const provided = Buffer.from(providedSignature, "base64url");
    const expectedBytes = Buffer.from(expectedSignature, "base64url");
    if (provided.length !== expectedBytes.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(provided, expectedBytes)) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding signature mismatch" };
    }

    const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(encodedPayload, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as Partial<QuoteBindingPayload>;
    if (
      typeof payload.toToken !== "string" ||
      typeof payload.amount !== "string" ||
      typeof payload.wallet !== "string" ||
      typeof payload.quoteId !== "string" ||
      typeof payload.issuedAt !== "number"
    ) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Incomplete quote binding" };
    }
    if (now - payload.issuedAt < 0 || now - payload.issuedAt >= QUOTE_BINDING_TTL_MS) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding expired" };
    }
    if (
      payload.toToken.toLowerCase() !== expected.toToken.toLowerCase() ||
      payload.amount !== expected.amount ||
      payload.wallet.toLowerCase() !== expected.wallet.toLowerCase() ||
      payload.quoteId !== expected.quoteId
    ) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding does not match this trade" };
    }
    if (
      payload.fromToken !== expected.fromToken ||
      payload.chainId !== expected.chainId ||
      payload.direction !== expected.direction ||
      payload.slippageBps !== expected.slippageBps
    ) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding does not match the quoted route" };
    }
    if (
      (payload.fromToken !== undefined && !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(payload.fromToken)) ||
      (payload.chainId !== undefined && payload.chainId !== "56") ||
      (payload.direction !== undefined && payload.direction !== "BUY" && payload.direction !== "SELL") ||
      (payload.slippageBps !== undefined &&
        (!Number.isSafeInteger(payload.slippageBps) || payload.slippageBps < 1 || payload.slippageBps > 500))
    ) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding contains invalid route parameters" };
    }
    if (payload.approveTarget !== undefined && !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(payload.approveTarget)) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding contains an invalid spender" };
    }
    if (expected.approveTarget !== undefined && payload.approveTarget?.toLowerCase() !== expected.approveTarget.toLowerCase()) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding spender mismatch" };
    }
    return { ok: true, issuedAt: payload.issuedAt, approveTarget: payload.approveTarget };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: "Invalid quote binding" };
  }
}
export const TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS = 30_000;

export function isFreshQuote(quote: { quoteFetchedAt?: number } | null, now: number): boolean {
  return !!quote?.quoteFetchedAt && now - quote.quoteFetchedAt < TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS;
}

export type WalletConnectionFacts = {
  isHydrated: boolean;
  isInitializing: boolean;
  isConnecting: boolean;
  isConnected: boolean;
  hasError: boolean;
};

export type WalletConnectionView = "checking" | "connecting" | "error" | "disconnected" | "connected";

export function walletConnectionView(state: WalletConnectionFacts): WalletConnectionView {
  if (!state.isHydrated || state.isInitializing) return "checking";
  if (state.isConnecting) return "connecting";
  if (state.hasError) return "error";
  if (!state.isConnected) return "disconnected";
  return "connected";
}

export function displayOrderStatus(status: string): string {
  switch (status.toUpperCase()) {
    case "FILLED": return "confirmed";
    case "FAILED": return "failed";
    default: return status.toLowerCase();
  }
}

export function humanTransactionStatus(status: string): string {
  switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
    case "pending": return "Waiting for confirmation";
    case "confirmed": return "Confirmed";
    case "failed": return "Failed";
    case "unverified": return "Needs verification";
    default: return status;
  }
}

export type TradePhase = "idle" | "signing" | "confirming" | "submitting";

export function tradePhaseMessage(phase: TradePhase): string {
  switch (phase) {
    case "signing": return "Waiting for wallet confirmation...";
    case "submitting": return "Submitting signed RFQ order...";
    case "confirming": return "Waiting for transaction/order confirmation...";
    default: return "";
  }
}

export function tradeErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  const message = error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : fallback;
  if (/unknown rpc|failed to publish payload|user rejected|user denied/i.test(message)) {
    return "Your wallet could not approve this request. Check that it is connected to BSC Mainnet, then try again.";
  }
  if (/timeout|temporarily unavailable|network request failed|fetch failed/i.test(message)) {
    return "The service is taking too long to respond. No transaction was sent; please try again.";
  }
  return message;
}

  isSubmitting: boolean;
  isApproving: boolean;
  hasTransactionStatus: boolean;
  hasApprovalError: boolean;
  hasApprovalData: boolean;
  requiresTypedDataSignature: boolean;
  hasUserSignature: boolean;
};

/**
 * The exact conditions for enabling a trade submission. This is presentation
 * gating only; every server and wallet validation remains authoritative.
 */
export function canExecuteTrade(state: TradeReadiness): boolean {
  return state.isConnected &&
    state.isCorrectNetwork &&
    state.hasAddress &&
    state.hasProvider &&
    state.hasQuote &&
    state.hasSwapData &&
    state.quoteIsFresh &&
    (state.executionMode !== "SWAP" || state.swapSimulationStatus?.toUpperCase() === "SUCCESS") &&
    !state.requiresFreshQuote &&
    !state.isLoading &&
    !state.isSubmitting &&
    !state.isApproving &&
    !state.hasTransactionStatus &&
    !state.hasApprovalError &&
    !state.hasApprovalData &&
    (!state.requiresTypedDataSignature || state.hasUserSignature);
}
export type RouterQuoteCandidate = { effectiveUsd: number | null; selectable?: boolean };

export function selectBestRouterQuote<T extends RouterQuoteCandidate>(rows: readonly T[]): T | undefined {
  return rows
    .filter((row) => row.selectable !== false && row.effectiveUsd != null && Number.isFinite(row.effectiveUsd) && row.effectiveUsd > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.effectiveUsd ?? Infinity) - (b.effectiveUsd ?? Infinity))[0];
}
