const TRANSFER_TOPIC = "0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef"
const ADDRESS_PATTERN = /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/
const UINT256_PATTERN = /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/

export type SwapOutcome =
    | { state: "REVERTED"; receivedAmount: "0"; reason: string }
    | { state: "OUTPUT_VERIFIED"; receivedAmount: string; reason: null }
    | { state: "OUTPUT_MISMATCH"; receivedAmount: string; reason: string }
    | { state: "UNKNOWN"; receivedAmount: null; reason: string }

export function verifySwapReceiptOutput(input: {
    receipt: unknown
    tokenAddress: string
    recipientAddress: string
    minimumOutputAmount: string
}): SwapOutcome {
    if (
        !ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.tokenAddress) ||
        !ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.recipientAddress) ||
        !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(input.minimumOutputAmount) ||
        BigInt(input.minimumOutputAmount) <= BigInt(0)
    ) return { state: "UNKNOWN", receivedAmount: null, reason: "Trade output verification parameters are invalid." }
    if (!isRecord(input.receipt) || !Array.isArray(input.receipt.logs)) {
        return { state: "UNKNOWN", receivedAmount: null, reason: "Transaction receipt or logs are unavailable." }
    }
    if (input.receipt.status === "reverted") {
        return { state: "REVERTED", receivedAmount: "0", reason: "Transaction receipt reports a revert." }
    }
    if (input.receipt.status !== "success") {
        return { state: "UNKNOWN", receivedAmount: null, reason: "Transaction receipt status is not confirmed." }
    }

    let received = BigInt(0)
    for (const value of input.receipt.logs) {
        if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.address !== "string" || !Array.isArray(value.topics)) continue
        if (value.address.toLowerCase() !== input.tokenAddress.toLowerCase()) continue
        const [topic, fromTopic, toTopic] = value.topics
        if (typeof topic !== "string" || topic.toLowerCase() !== TRANSFER_TOPIC) continue
        if (
            typeof fromTopic !== "string" || !UINT256_PATTERN.test(fromTopic) ||
            typeof toTopic !== "string" || !UINT256_PATTERN.test(toTopic) ||
            typeof value.data !== "string" || !UINT256_PATTERN.test(value.data)
        ) return { state: "UNKNOWN", receivedAmount: null, reason: "A matching token Transfer event is malformed." }
        const recipient = `0x${toTopic.slice(-40)}`
        if (recipient.toLowerCase() === input.recipientAddress.toLowerCase()) {
            received += BigInt(value.data)
        }
    }

    const receivedAmount = received.toString()
    if (received < BigInt(input.minimumOutputAmount)) {
        return {
            state: "OUTPUT_MISMATCH",
            receivedAmount,
            reason: received === BigInt(0)
                ? "No expected-token transfer to the connected wallet was found."
                : "Verified output is below the approved minimum.",
        }
    }
    return { state: "OUTPUT_VERIFIED", receivedAmount, reason: null }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}
export type RpcErrorClass =
  | "NONE"
  | "HTTP_RATE_LIMIT"
  | "HTTP_SERVER_ERROR"
  | "HTTP_ERROR"
  | "TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT"
  | "DNS_FAILURE"
  | "CONNECTION_RESET"
  | "CONNECTION_REFUSED"
  | "TRANSPORT_ERROR"
  | "RPC_INVALID_PARAMETERS"
  | "RPC_HEADER_NOT_FOUND"
  | "RPC_HISTORICAL_STATE_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "RPC_PROVIDER_ERROR"
  | "JSON_RPC_ERROR"
  | "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE";

export type RpcReadStage = "BLOCK" | "BYTECODE" | "DECIMALS";

export type RpcRequestDiagnostic = {
  method: string;
  stage: RpcReadStage;
  errorClass: RpcErrorClass;
  providerErrorCode: number | string | null;
  httpStatus: number | null;
  attempt: number;
  requestDurationMs: number;
  validRpcResponse: boolean;
  retryable: boolean;
  retryAfterMs: number | null;
  providerMessage: string | null;
  succeeded: boolean;
  causeChain: Array<{ name: string; code: number | string | null }>;
};

type RetryDependencies = {
  maxRetries?: number;
  now?: () => number;
  random?: () => number;
  sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
};

type RpcReadSuccess<T> = { ok: true; value: T; diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] };
type RpcReadFailure = { ok: false; diagnostic: RpcRequestDiagnostic; diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] };

const MAX_RETRIES = 2;
const MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 60_000;
export const MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY = 4;
const SAFE_TRANSPORT_CODES = new Set([
  "ETIMEDOUT",
  "UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT",
  "ENOTFOUND",
  "EAI_AGAIN",
  "EAI_FAIL",
  "ECONNRESET",
  "UND_ERR_SOCKET",
  "EPIPE",
  "ECONNREFUSED",
]);
const SAFE_ERROR_NAMES = new Set([
  "Error",
  "TypeError",
  "RangeError",
  "TimeoutError",
  "HttpRequestError",
  "RpcRequestError",
  "BaseError",
  "SocketError",
]);

export function markInvalidRpcResponse(
  diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[],
): RpcRequestDiagnostic[] {
  const updated = [...diagnostics];
  const last = updated.at(-1);
  if (last?.succeeded) {
    updated[updated.length - 1] = {
      ...last,
      errorClass: "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
      validRpcResponse: false,
      retryable: false,
      succeeded: false,
    };
  }
  return updated;
}

export async function mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  items: readonly T[],
  concurrency: number,
  operation: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
  if (!Number.isInteger(concurrency) || concurrency < 1 || concurrency > MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY) {
    throw new RangeError(`concurrency must be an integer between 1 and ${MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY}.`);
  }
  const results = new Array<R>(items.length);
  let nextIndex = 0;
  const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, items.length) }, async () => {
    while (true) {
      const index = nextIndex;
      nextIndex += 1;
      if (index >= items.length) return;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index], index);
    }
  });
  await Promise.all(workers);
  return results;
}

export async function runRpcRead<T>(
  input: {
    method: string;
    stage: RpcReadStage;
    operation: () => Promise<T>;
  } & RetryDependencies,
): Promise<RpcReadSuccess<T> | RpcReadFailure> {
  const maxRetries = input.maxRetries ?? MAX_RETRIES;
  if (!Number.isInteger(maxRetries) || maxRetries < 0 || maxRetries > MAX_RETRIES) {
    throw new RangeError(`maxRetries must be an integer between 0 and ${MAX_RETRIES}.`);
  }
  const now = input.now ?? Date.now;
  const random = input.random ?? Math.random;
  const sleep = input.sleep ?? ((milliseconds: number) =>
    new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds)));
  const diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [];

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries + 1; attempt += 1) {
    const startedAt = now();
    try {
      const value = await input.operation();
      const duration = Math.max(0, now() - startedAt);
      return {
        ok: true,
        value,
        diagnostics: [...diagnostics, {
          method: input.method,
          stage: input.stage,
          errorClass: "NONE",
          providerErrorCode: null,
          httpStatus: null,
          attempt,
          requestDurationMs: duration,
          validRpcResponse: true,
          retryable: false,
          retryAfterMs: null,
          providerMessage: null,
          succeeded: true,
          causeChain: [],
        }],
      };
    } catch (error) {
      const diagnostic = classifyRpcFailure(error, {
        method: input.method,
        stage: input.stage,
        attempt,
        requestDurationMs: Math.max(0, now() - startedAt),
      });
      diagnostics.push(diagnostic);
      if (!diagnostic.retryable || attempt > maxRetries) {
        return { ok: false, diagnostic, diagnostics };
      }

      const backoffBase = Math.min(250 * 2 ** (attempt - 1), 5_000);
      const jitter = Math.floor(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, random())) * backoffBase * 0.25);
      const delay = Math.max(backoffBase + jitter, diagnostic.retryAfterMs ?? 0);
      if (delay > MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS) {
        return { ok: false, diagnostic, diagnostics };
      }
      await sleep(delay);
    }
  }

  throw new Error("Unreachable RPC retry state.");
}

export function classifyRpcFailure(
  error: unknown,
  request: {
    method: string;
    stage: RpcReadStage;
    attempt: number;
    requestDurationMs: number;
  },
): RpcRequestDiagnostic {
  const causes = collectCauses(error);
  const messages = causes.map((cause) => readStringProperty(cause, "shortMessage") ??
    readStringProperty(cause, "message") ?? "").join(" ").toLowerCase();
  const providerMessage = findSafeProviderMessage(causes);
  const httpStatus = findHttpStatus(causes);
  const providerErrorCode = findProviderErrorCode(causes);
  const codeNames = causes.map((cause) => readStringProperty(cause, "code") ?? "");

  let errorClass: RpcErrorClass;
  let validRpcResponse = false;
  let retryable = false;
  if (httpStatus === 429) {
    errorClass = "HTTP_RATE_LIMIT";
    retryable = true;
  } else if (httpStatus !== null && httpStatus >= 500 && httpStatus <= 599) {
    errorClass = "HTTP_SERVER_ERROR";
    retryable = true;
  } else if (httpStatus !== null) {
    errorClass = "HTTP_ERROR";
  } else if (codeNames.includes("ETIMEDOUT") || codeNames.includes("UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT") ||
    causes.some((cause) => readStringProperty(cause, "name") === "TimeoutError" ||
      readStringProperty(cause, "name") === "AbortError") ||
    /timed?\s*out|timeout/.test(messages)) {
    errorClass = "TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT";
    retryable = true;
  } else if (codeNames.includes("EAI_AGAIN") || codeNames.includes("ENOTFOUND") ||
    codeNames.includes("EAI_FAIL")) {
    errorClass = "DNS_FAILURE";
    retryable = codeNames.includes("EAI_AGAIN");
  } else if (codeNames.includes("ECONNRESET") || codeNames.includes("UND_ERR_SOCKET") ||
    codeNames.includes("EPIPE")) {
    errorClass = "CONNECTION_RESET";
    retryable = true;
  } else if (codeNames.includes("ECONNREFUSED")) {
    errorClass = "CONNECTION_REFUSED";
    retryable = true;
  } else if (typeof providerErrorCode === "number") {
    validRpcResponse = true;
    const rpcMessage = providerMessage?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
    if (/missing or invalid parameters|invalid params|invalid parameter|invalid argument/.test(rpcMessage)) {
      errorClass = "RPC_INVALID_PARAMETERS";
    } else if (/header not found|unknown header|header .*not found/.test(rpcMessage)) {
      errorClass = "RPC_HEADER_NOT_FOUND";
    } else if (/historical|archive|missing trie|pruned|state unavailable|unknown block|block not found/.test(rpcMessage)) {
      errorClass = "RPC_HISTORICAL_STATE_UNAVAILABLE";
    } else if (providerErrorCode === -32000) {
      errorClass = "RPC_PROVIDER_ERROR";
    } else {
      errorClass = "JSON_RPC_ERROR";
    }
    retryable = (errorClass === "RPC_HISTORICAL_STATE_UNAVAILABLE" ||
      errorClass === "RPC_PROVIDER_ERROR") &&
      /temporar|unavailable|timeout|busy/.test(rpcMessage);
  } else if (causes.some((cause) => readStringProperty(cause, "name") === "HttpRequestError" ||
    readStringProperty(cause, "name") === "RpcRequestError")) {
    validRpcResponse = causes.some((cause) => readStringProperty(cause, "name") === "RpcRequestError");
    errorClass = validRpcResponse ? "JSON_RPC_ERROR" : "TRANSPORT_ERROR";
  } else {
    errorClass = "TRANSPORT_ERROR";
  }

  return {
    method: request.method,
    stage: request.stage,
    errorClass,
    providerErrorCode,
    httpStatus,
    attempt: request.attempt,
    requestDurationMs: request.requestDurationMs,
    validRpcResponse,
    retryable,
    retryAfterMs: findRetryAfterMs(causes),
    providerMessage,
    succeeded: false,
    causeChain: causes.slice(0, 6).map((cause) => ({
      name: safeName(readStringProperty(cause, "name")),
      code: safeCode(readProperty(cause, "code")),
    })),
  };
}

export function sanitizeProviderMessage(message: string): string | null {
  const sanitized = message
    .replace(/\bhttps?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/gi, "[redacted URL]")
    .replace(/\b(bearer\s+)[^\s,;]+/gi, "$1[redacted]")
    .replace(/\b(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|authorization)\s*[:=]\s*[^\s,;]+/gi, "$1=[redacted]")
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 240);
  return sanitized || null;
}

function findSafeProviderMessage(causes: Record<string, unknown>[]): string | null {
  for (const cause of causes) {
    const message = readStringProperty(cause, "shortMessage") ??
      readStringProperty(cause, "message");
    if (!message) continue;
    const sanitized = sanitizeProviderMessage(message);
    if (sanitized) return sanitized;
  }
  return null;
}

function collectCauses(error: unknown): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const causes: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  let current: unknown = error;
  const seen = new Set<object>();
  while (isRecord(current) && causes.length < 6 && !seen.has(current)) {
    seen.add(current);
    causes.push(current);
    current = current.cause;
  }
  return causes;
}

function findHttpStatus(causes: Record<string, unknown>[]): number | null {
  for (const cause of causes) {
    for (const key of ["status", "statusCode"]) {
      const value = cause[key];
      if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 100 && value <= 599) {
        return value;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function findProviderErrorCode(causes: Record<string, unknown>[]): number | string | null {
  for (const cause of causes) {
    const code = cause.code;
    if (typeof code === "number" && Number.isInteger(code) && code < 0) return code;
    if (typeof code === "string" && SAFE_TRANSPORT_CODES.has(code)) return code;
    const nestedError = cause.error;
    if (isRecord(nestedError) && typeof nestedError.code === "number" &&
      Number.isInteger(nestedError.code) && nestedError.code < 0) return nestedError.code;
  }
  return null;
}

function findRetryAfterMs(causes: Record<string, unknown>[]): number | null {
  for (const cause of causes) {
    const headers = cause.headers;
    let value: string | null = null;
    if (headers instanceof Headers) {
      value = headers.get("retry-after");
    } else if (isRecord(headers) && typeof headers["retry-after"] === "string") {
      value = headers["retry-after"];
    }
    if (!value) continue;
    if (/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value.trim())) {
      const milliseconds = Number(value.trim()) * 1_000;
      if (Number.isFinite(milliseconds)) return milliseconds;
      continue;
    }
    const timestamp = Date.parse(value);
    if (Number.isFinite(timestamp)) return Math.max(0, timestamp - Date.now());
  }
  return null;
}

function readProperty(value: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): unknown {
  return value[key];
}

function readStringProperty(value: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): string | null {
  const property = value[key];
  return typeof property === "string" ? property : null;
}

function safeName(value: string | null): string {
  return value && SAFE_ERROR_NAMES.has(value) ? value : "Error";
}

function safeCode(value: unknown): number | string | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isInteger(value) && value < 0) return value;
  return typeof value === "string" && SAFE_TRANSPORT_CODES.has(value) ? value : null;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}
import { getRWAQuote } from "@/lib/binance";
import { OPPORTUNITY_QUOTE_TTL_MS } from "@/lib/opportunityMath";
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN, isPositiveUint256 } from "./apiValidation";
import { validateQuote } from "@/lib/quoteValidation";

export type QuoteSuccess = {
  ok: true;
  usd: number;
  walletBound?: boolean;
  mode: string;
  vendor: string;
  impact: number | null;
  ts: number;
};

export type QuoteFailure = {
  ok: false;
  err: string;
  ts: number;
};

export type Q = QuoteSuccess | QuoteFailure;

type QuoteRoute = {
  binanceChainId?: string;
  fromTokenAmount?: string;
  toTokenAmount?: string | number;
  fromToken?: { tokenContractAddress?: string; tokenUnitPrice?: string | number; decimal?: string };
  toToken?: { tokenContractAddress?: string; decimal?: string };
  executionMode?: string;
  vendorName?: string;
  priceImpactPercent?: string | number;
};

const cache = new Map<string, Q>();
const marketCache = new Map<string, Q>();
export const QUOTE_TTL_MS = OPPORTUNITY_QUOTE_TTL_MS;
let last = 0;
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function isQuoteRoute(value: unknown): value is QuoteRoute {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function asFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function isProviderIntegerAmount(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^\d+$/.test(value) && isPositiveUint256(value);
}

function matchesTokenAddress(value: unknown, expected: string): boolean {
  return typeof value === "string" &&
    EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(value) &&
    value.toLowerCase() === expected.toLowerCase();
}

export function quoteAgeSeconds(quote: Q, now = Date.now()): number {
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - quote.ts) / 1000));
}

export function isQuoteFresh(quote: Q, now = Date.now()): boolean {
  return now - quote.ts < QUOTE_TTL_MS;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

// USD price of ONE TOKEN, from what `usdt` USDT actually buys (best route).
export async function quoteUsd(addr: string, usdt = 100): Promise<Q> {
  const hit = cache.get(addr);
  if (hit && isQuoteFresh(hit)) return hit;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt += 1) {
    const wait = Math.max(0, last + 300 - Date.now());
    if (wait) await sleep(wait);
    last = Date.now();

    try {
      const requestedAmount = String(usdt) + "0".repeat(18);
      const response: unknown = await getRWAQuote(addr, requestedAmount);
      const routes = isRecord(response) && Array.isArray(response.data)
        ? response.data.filter((route): route is QuoteRoute =>
            isQuoteRoute(route) && isProviderIntegerAmount(route.toTokenAmount)
          )
        : [];
      routes.sort((a, b) => Number(b.toTokenAmount ?? 0) - Number(a.toTokenAmount ?? 0));
      const best = routes[0];
      const output = asFiniteNumber(best?.toTokenAmount);
      if (
        !best ||
        output == null ||
        output <= 0 ||
        best.binanceChainId !== "56" ||
        best.executionMode !== "RFQ" ||
        best.fromTokenAmount !== requestedAmount ||
        !matchesTokenAddress(best.fromToken?.tokenContractAddress, BSC_USDT_ADDRESS) ||
        !matchesTokenAddress(best.toToken?.tokenContractAddress, addr) ||
        typeof best.fromToken?.decimal !== "string" ||
        typeof best.toToken?.decimal !== "string"
      ) {
        const message = isRecord(response) && typeof response.msg === "string" ? response.msg : "no route";
        throw new Error(message);
      }

      const validation = validateQuote({
        fromTokenAmount: best.fromTokenAmount,
        toTokenAmount: best.toTokenAmount,
        fromTokenDecimals: best.fromToken.decimal,
        toTokenDecimals: best.toToken.decimal,
        tokenUnitPrice: best.fromToken.tokenUnitPrice,
        expectedFromTokenAmount: requestedAmount,
      });
      if (!validation.ok) throw new Error(validation.reason);
      const impact = asFiniteNumber(best.priceImpactPercent);
      const quote: QuoteSuccess = {
        ok: true,
        usd: validation.usd,
        walletBound: false,
        mode: best.executionMode ?? "unknown",
        vendor: best.vendorName ?? "unknown",
        impact,
        ts: Date.now(),
      };
      cache.set(addr, quote);
      return quote;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      if (attempt === 0 && msg.includes("42900")) { await sleep(1200); continue; }
      const q: Q = { ok: false, err: msg.slice(0, 140), ts: Date.now() };
      cache.set(addr, q);
      return q;
    }
  }

  return { ok: false, err: "rate limited", ts: Date.now() };
}

// Public market-monitor price. This validates route identity and price math, but
// deliberately does not apply wallet-execution authorization or reference-gap policies.
export async function marketQuoteUsd(addr: string, usdt = 100): Promise<Q> {
  const hit = marketCache.get(addr);
  if (hit && isQuoteFresh(hit)) return hit;

  const requestedAmount = String(usdt) + "0".repeat(18);
  try {
    const response: unknown = await getRWAQuote(addr, requestedAmount);
    const routes = isRecord(response) && Array.isArray(response.data)
      ? response.data.filter((route): route is QuoteRoute =>
          isQuoteRoute(route) && isProviderIntegerAmount(route.toTokenAmount)
        )
      : [];
    routes.sort((a, b) => Number(b.toTokenAmount ?? 0) - Number(a.toTokenAmount ?? 0));
    const best = routes[0];
    if (
      !best ||
      best.binanceChainId !== "56" ||
      best.fromTokenAmount !== requestedAmount ||
      !matchesTokenAddress(best.fromToken?.tokenContractAddress, BSC_USDT_ADDRESS) ||
      !matchesTokenAddress(best.toToken?.tokenContractAddress, addr) ||
      typeof best.fromToken?.decimal !== "string" ||
      typeof best.toToken?.decimal !== "string"
    ) {
      const message = isRecord(response) && typeof response.msg === "string" ? response.msg : "no valid market route";
      throw new Error(message);
    }

    const validation = validateQuote({
      fromTokenAmount: best.fromTokenAmount,
      toTokenAmount: best.toTokenAmount,
      fromTokenDecimals: best.fromToken.decimal,
      toTokenDecimals: best.toToken.decimal,
      tokenUnitPrice: best.fromToken.tokenUnitPrice,
      expectedFromTokenAmount: requestedAmount,
    });
    if (!validation.ok) throw new Error(validation.reason);

    const quote: QuoteSuccess = {
      ok: true,
      usd: validation.usd,
      walletBound: false,
      mode: best.executionMode ?? "unknown",
      vendor: best.vendorName ?? "unknown",
      impact: asFiniteNumber(best.priceImpactPercent),
      ts: Date.now(),
    };
    marketCache.set(addr, quote);
    return quote;
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const q: Q = {
      ok: false,
      err: error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0, 140) : String(error).slice(0, 140),
      ts: Date.now(),
    };
    marketCache.set(addr, q);
    return q;
  }
}
export type AgentStrategy = {
  ticker: string;
  side: "buy" | "sell";
  amount: string;
  amountUnit: "BNB" | "token";
  triggerPercent: number;
  triggerDirection: "drop" | "rise";
  maxSlippagePercent: number;
};

export type StrategyParseResult =
  | { ok: true; strategy: AgentStrategy }
  | { ok: false; error: string };

export type MockTriggerResult =
  | { ok: true; triggered: boolean; changePercent: number }
  | { ok: false; error: string };

const TICKER_PATTERN = /^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.-]{0,9}$/;
const DECIMAL_PATTERN = /^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/;
const MAX_STRATEGY_BNB = 10;

function parseDecimal(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value !== "number" && typeof value !== "string") return null;
  const text = String(value).trim();
  if (!DECIMAL_PATTERN.test(text)) return null;
  const parsed = Number(text);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function parseNaturalLanguage(input: string): StrategyParseResult {
  const match = input.match(
    /^\s*(?:auto-swap|buy)\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+bnb\s+into\s+([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,9})(?:\s+tokenized stock)?\s+when\s+(?:the\s+)?price\s+(?:drops?|falls?)\s+(?:by\s+)?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%(?:\s+max\s+slippage\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%)?\s*$/i
  );
  if (!match) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: "Use a supported buy rule such as: Auto-swap 0.1 BNB into AAPL tokenized stock when price drops 2%.",
    };
  }

  return validateStrategy({
    ticker: match[2],
    side: "buy",
    amountBnb: match[1],
    triggerPercent: match[3],
    triggerDirection: "drop",
    maxSlippagePercent: match[4] ?? "0.5",
  });
}

function validateStrategy(input: Record<string, unknown>): StrategyParseResult {
  const ticker = typeof input.ticker === "string"
    ? input.ticker.trim().toUpperCase()
    : typeof input.targetTicker === "string"
      ? input.targetTicker.trim().toUpperCase()
      : "";
  if (!TICKER_PATTERN.test(ticker)) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Ticker must be 1–10 letters, numbers, dots, or hyphens." };
  }

  const side = input.side;
  if (side !== "buy" && side !== "sell") {
    return { ok: false, error: "Side must be buy or sell." };
  }

  const amountUnit = side === "buy" ? "BNB" : "token";
  const amountValue = side === "buy"
    ? input.amountBnb ?? (input.amountUnit === "BNB" ? input.amount : undefined)
    : input.amountToken ?? (input.amountUnit === "token" ? input.amount : undefined);
  const amountText = typeof amountValue === "string" || typeof amountValue === "number"
    ? String(amountValue).trim()
    : "";
  const amount = parseDecimal(amountText);
  const maximumAmount = side === "buy" ? MAX_STRATEGY_BNB : 1_000_000_000;
  if (amount === null || amount <= 0 || amount > maximumAmount) {
    const unitLabel = side === "buy" ? " BNB" : " tokens";
    return { ok: false, error: `Amount must be greater than 0 and no more than ${maximumAmount}${unitLabel}.` };
  }

  const triggerPercent = parseDecimal(input.triggerPercent);
  if (triggerPercent === null || triggerPercent <= 0 || triggerPercent > 100) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Trigger percentage must be greater than 0 and no more than 100." };
  }

  const maxSlippagePercent = parseDecimal(input.maxSlippagePercent);
  if (maxSlippagePercent === null || maxSlippagePercent < 0 || maxSlippagePercent > 5) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Maximum slippage must be between 0 and 5 percent." };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    strategy: {
      ticker,
      side,
      amount: amountText,
      amountUnit,
      triggerPercent,
      triggerDirection: side === "buy" ? "drop" : "rise",
      maxSlippagePercent,
    },
  };
}

export function parseAgentStrategy(input: unknown): StrategyParseResult {
  if (typeof input === "string") return parseNaturalLanguage(input);
  if (typeof input !== "object" || input === null || Array.isArray(input)) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Provide a strategy sentence or structured strategy fields." };
  }
  return validateStrategy(input as Record<string, unknown>);
}

export function evaluateMockTrigger(
  strategy: AgentStrategy,
  referencePrice: unknown,
  currentPrice: unknown
): MockTriggerResult {
  const reference = parseDecimal(referencePrice);
  const current = parseDecimal(currentPrice);
  if (reference === null || current === null || reference <= 0 || current <= 0) {
    return { ok: false, error: "Reference and current prices must be positive finite numbers." };
  }

  const changePercent = ((current - reference) / reference) * 100;
  const triggered = strategy.triggerDirection === "drop"
    ? changePercent <= -strategy.triggerPercent
    : changePercent >= strategy.triggerPercent;

  return { ok: true, triggered, changePercent };
}
// Transaction persistence for trade state recovery
// Versioned storage key format
const STORAGE_VERSION = "v1";
const PENDING_TRADES_KEY = `wolv:pending-trades:${STORAGE_VERSION}`;

/**
 * Get all persisted pending trades from localStorage
 */
export function getPendingTrades(): Array<{
  transactionHash: string;
  walletAddress: string;
  chainId: number;
  tokenAddress: string;
  symbol: string;
  tradeMode: string;
  usdtAmount: string;
  quotedTokenAmount?: string;
  quoteId?: string;
  timestamp: number;
  status: 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'failed';
  submitError?: string;
}> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];

  try {
    const data = window.localStorage.getItem(PENDING_TRADES_KEY);
    if (!data) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to parse pending trades from localStorage:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Save a pending trade to localStorage
 */
export function savePendingTrade(trade: Omit<{
  transactionHash: string;
  walletAddress: string;
  chainId: number;
  tokenAddress: string;
  symbol: string;
  tradeMode: string;
  usdtAmount: string;
  quotedTokenAmount?: string;
  quoteId?: string;
  timestamp: number;
  status: 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'failed';
  submitError?: string;
}, 'submitError'>): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  try {
    const trades = getPendingTrades();
    // Remove any existing trade with same hash to avoid duplicates
    const filtered = trades.filter(t => t.transactionHash !== trade.transactionHash);
    // Add new trade
    filtered.push(trade);
    // Keep only last 10 trades to prevent storage bloat
    const limited = filtered.slice(-10);
    window.localStorage.setItem(PENDING_TRADES_KEY, JSON.stringify(limited));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to save pending trade to localStorage:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Update the status of a trade in localStorage
 */
export function updateTradeStatus(transactionHash: string, updates: Partial<{
  status: 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'failed';
  submitError?: string;
}>): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  try {
    const trades = getPendingTrades();
    const updated = trades.map(trade =>
      trade.transactionHash === transactionHash
        ? { ...trade, ...updates }
        : trade
    );
    window.localStorage.setItem(PENDING_TRADES_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to update trade status in localStorage:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Remove resolved trades (confirmed/failed) from storage
 */
export function clearResolvedTrades(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  try {
    const trades = getPendingTrades();
    const pendingOnly = trades.filter(t => t.status === 'pending');
    window.localStorage.setItem(PENDING_TRADES_KEY, JSON.stringify(pendingOnly));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to clear resolved trades from localStorage:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Get a specific pending trade by hash
 */
export function getPendingTradeByHash(transactionHash: string):
  | ({
      transactionHash: string;
      walletAddress: string;
      chainId: number;
      tokenAddress: string;
      symbol: string;
      tradeMode: string;
      usdtAmount: string;
      quotedTokenAmount?: string;
      quoteId?: string;
      timestamp: number;
      status: 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'failed';
      submitError?: string;
    } | undefined) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return undefined;

  try {
    const trades = getPendingTrades();
    return trades.find(t => t.transactionHash === transactionHash);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get pending trade by hash:', error);
    return undefined;
  }

export const AGENT_SESSION_TESTNET_CHAIN_ID = 97;
export const AGENT_SESSION_VALIDITY_SECONDS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;
export const AGENT_SESSION_MAX_VALUE_WEI = "500000000000000000";
export const AGENT_SESSION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 100;
export const AGENT_SESSION_MAX_PRICE_IMPACT_BPS = 300;

export type AgentSessionPlan = {
  provider: "zerodev";
  mode: "simulation-only";
  status: "not-granted";
  chainId: 97;
  ownerAddress: string | null;
  permissions: {
    targetType: "router";
    selector: "swapExactETHForTokens";
    targetAddress: string | null;
    assetAllowlist: string[];
    nativeValueLimitWei: typeof AGENT_SESSION_MAX_VALUE_WEI;
    validitySeconds: typeof AGENT_SESSION_VALIDITY_SECONDS;
    slippageBps: typeof AGENT_SESSION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS;
    maxPriceImpactBps: typeof AGENT_SESSION_MAX_PRICE_IMPACT_BPS;
  };
  prohibited: string[];
  executionEnabled: false;
  humanApprovalRequired: true;
  successfulSimulationRequired: true;
  reason: string;
};

export type AgentSessionPlanInput = {
  ownerAddress?: string | null;
  routerAddress?: string | null;
  targetTokenAddress?: string | null;
  liveSubmissionEnabled?: boolean;
  emergencyStopEnabled?: boolean;
};

export type AgentSessionLifecycleStatus =
  | "PREPARED"
  | "REVOKED"
  | "EXPIRED";

export function canTransitionAgentSessionStatus(
  current: AgentSessionLifecycleStatus,
  next: AgentSessionLifecycleStatus,
): boolean {
  if (current === "REVOKED" || current === "EXPIRED") return false;
  return current === "PREPARED" && next !== "PREPARED";
}

export function createAgentSessionPlan(
  input: AgentSessionPlanInput = {},
): AgentSessionPlan {
  const ownerAddress = input.ownerAddress?.trim() || null;
  if (ownerAddress && !isAddress(ownerAddress)) {
    throw new Error("AGENT_SESSION_OWNER_INVALID");
  }
  const routerAddress = input.routerAddress?.trim() || null;
  const targetTokenAddress = input.targetTokenAddress?.trim() || null;
  if (
    (routerAddress && !isAddress(routerAddress)) ||
    (targetTokenAddress && !isAddress(targetTokenAddress)) ||
    Boolean(routerAddress) !== Boolean(targetTokenAddress)
  ) {
    throw new Error("AGENT_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID");
  }
  const reason = input.emergencyStopEnabled
    ? "Global emergency stop remains active; no scoped session grant is permitted."
    : input.liveSubmissionEnabled
      ? "Live submission is enabled, but scoped session grants are not implemented; signing and UserOperation submission remain blocked."
      : routerAddress && targetTokenAddress
        ? "A restricted router and token scope is recorded for review; no session grant, signing, or UserOperation submission is enabled."
        : "No approved router and token scope is configured; wallet signing and UserOperation submission remain blocked.";

  return {
    provider: "zerodev",
    mode: "simulation-only",
    status: "not-granted",
    chainId: AGENT_SESSION_TESTNET_CHAIN_ID,
    ownerAddress,
    permissions: {
      targetType: "router",
      selector: "swapExactETHForTokens",
      targetAddress: routerAddress,
      assetAllowlist: targetTokenAddress ? [targetTokenAddress.toLowerCase()] : [],
      nativeValueLimitWei: AGENT_SESSION_MAX_VALUE_WEI,
      validitySeconds: AGENT_SESSION_VALIDITY_SECONDS,
      slippageBps: AGENT_SESSION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS,
      maxPriceImpactBps: AGENT_SESSION_MAX_PRICE_IMPACT_BPS,
    },
    prohibited: [
      "arbitrary-contract-calls",
      "token-approvals",
      "token-transfers",
      "native-token-withdrawals",
      "withdrawals",
      "mainnet-submission",
      "signature-generation",
    ],
    executionEnabled: false,
    humanApprovalRequired: true,
    successfulSimulationRequired: true,
    reason,
  };
}
import "server-only";
import { unstable_cache } from "next/cache";
import { isRwaAssetListResponse } from "./rwaAssetResponse";
import { makeBinanceAuthHeaders } from "./binanceAuth";

let lastCall = 0;
let rateLimitQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
async function rateLimit() {
  const scheduled = rateLimitQueue.then(async () => {
    const wait = Math.max(0, lastCall + 250 - Date.now());
    if (wait) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, wait));
    lastCall = Date.now();
  });
  rateLimitQueue = scheduled.catch(() => undefined);
  await scheduled;
}

const BASE_URL = "https://web3.binance.com/build";
const UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

function makeHeaders(method: string, path: string, body = "") {
  return makeBinanceAuthHeaders(method, path, body);
}

async function get(path: string, params: Record<string, string> = {}, noStore = false) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
  const fullPath = query ? `${path}?${query}` : path;
  const headers = makeHeaders("GET", fullPath);
  await rateLimit();
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${fullPath}`, {
    headers,
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS),
    ...(noStore ? { cache: "no-store" as const } : { next: { revalidate: 60 } }),
  });
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!json.success && json.code !== 0) {
    throw new Error(`API error ${json.code}: ${json.msg}`);
  }
  return json;
}

async function post(path: string, payload: unknown) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const headers = {
    ...makeHeaders("POST", path, body),
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  };
  await rateLimit();
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: "no-store",
  });
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok || (!json.success && json.code !== 0)) {
    throw new Error(`API error ${json.code ?? res.status}: ${json.msg ?? "Request failed"}`);
  }
  return json;
}

import { MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT } from "./marketThresholds.js";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";

export type QuoteValidationInput = {
  fromTokenAmount?: unknown;
  toTokenAmount?: unknown;
  fromTokenDecimals?: unknown;
  toTokenDecimals?: unknown;
  tokenUnitPrice?: unknown;
  usd?: unknown;
  expectedFromTokenAmount?: unknown;
  referencePrice?: unknown;
  tokenToShareRatio?: unknown;
  maxReferenceGapPercent?: number;
};

export type QuoteValidationResult =
  | { ok: true; usd: number; referenceGap: number | null }
  | { ok: false; reason: string };

function finitePositive(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() === "") return null;
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
}

function positiveIntegerString(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value <= 0)) return null;
  const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!/^(?:\d+|0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)$/.test(text)) return null;
  try {
    const amount = BigInt(text);
    return amount > BigInt(0) ? amount.toString() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function tokenDecimals(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isInteger(value)) {
    return value >= 0 && value <= 255 ? value : null;
  }
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value)) return null;
  const decimals = Number(value);
  return Number.isInteger(decimals) && decimals <= 255 ? decimals : null;
}

function referencePerShare(referencePrice: unknown, tokenToShareRatio: unknown): number | null {
  const reference = finitePositive(referencePrice);
  const ratio = finitePositive(tokenToShareRatio);
  if (reference == null || ratio == null) return null;
  const result = reference / ratio;
  return Number.isFinite(result) && result > 0 ? result : null;
}

export function validateQuote(input: QuoteValidationInput): QuoteValidationResult {
  let usd: number | null = null;

  if (input.usd !== undefined) {
    usd = finitePositive(input.usd);
    if (usd == null) return { ok: false, reason: "Quote price is not a finite positive number" };
  } else {
    const fromAmount = positiveIntegerString(input.fromTokenAmount);
    const toAmount = positiveIntegerString(input.toTokenAmount);
    const expectedFrom = input.expectedFromTokenAmount === undefined
      ? null
      : positiveIntegerString(input.expectedFromTokenAmount);
    const fromDecimals = tokenDecimals(input.fromTokenDecimals);
    const toDecimals = tokenDecimals(input.toTokenDecimals);
    const unitPrice = finitePositive(input.tokenUnitPrice);
    if (!fromAmount || !toAmount || fromDecimals == null || toDecimals == null || unitPrice == null) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote route contains invalid token amounts, decimals, or unit price" };
    }
    if (input.expectedFromTokenAmount !== undefined && !expectedFrom) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Requested input amount is invalid" };
    }
    if (expectedFrom && fromAmount !== expectedFrom) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote route does not match the requested input amount" };
    }
    const outputTokens = Number(formatUnits(BigInt(toAmount), toDecimals));
    const inputUsdt = Number(formatUnits(BigInt(fromAmount), fromDecimals));
    usd = (inputUsdt * unitPrice) / outputTokens;
    if (!Number.isFinite(usd) || usd <= 0) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "Quote route produces an invalid token price" };
    }
  }

  const ref = referencePerShare(input.referencePrice, input.tokenToShareRatio);
  const executablePerShare = input.tokenToShareRatio === undefined
    ? usd
    : (() => {
        const ratio = finitePositive(input.tokenToShareRatio);
        return ratio == null ? null : usd! / ratio;
      })();
  const referenceGap = ref != null && executablePerShare != null
    ? (executablePerShare / ref - 1) * 100
    : null;
  const maxGap = input.maxReferenceGapPercent ?? MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT;
  if (referenceGap != null && (!Number.isFinite(referenceGap) || Math.abs(referenceGap) > maxGap)) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "Quote deviates too far from the reference price" };
  }

  return { ok: true, usd: usd!, referenceGap };
}

export function isQuoteReferenceReliable(usd: unknown, referencePrice: unknown, tokenToShareRatio: unknown): boolean {
  return validateQuote({ usd, referencePrice, tokenToShareRatio }).ok;
}
export function createSingleFlightGate(
  busyMessage = "A wallet transaction request is already in progress in this tab. Finish or dismiss that wallet prompt before trying again."
): <T>(operation: () => Promise<T>) => Promise<T> {
  let inFlight = false;

  return async function run<T>(operation: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    if (inFlight) throw new Error(busyMessage);
    inFlight = true;
    try {
      return await operation();
    } finally {
      inFlight = false;
    }
  };
}
import { MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT } from "./marketThresholds.js";

export type AnalysisRequest = { ticker: string };

export type VenueAnalysisInput = {
  platform: string;
  status: string;
  referencePerShare: number | null;
  executablePerShare: number | null;
  referenceGap: number | null;
  quoteAgeSeconds: number | null;
  stale: boolean;
  unreliable: boolean;
  quoteAvailable: boolean;
};

export type MarketAnalysisInput = {
  ticker: string;
  spread: number | null;
  statusMismatch: boolean;
  statuses: string[];
  venues: VenueAnalysisInput[];
};

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

export function parseAnalysisRequest(value: unknown): AnalysisRequest | null {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return null;
  const ticker = value.ticker;
  if (typeof ticker !== "string") return null;
  const normalized = ticker.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.^-]{0,15}$/.test(normalized)) return null;
  return { ticker: normalized };
}

export function normalizeModelSummary(value: unknown, authoritativeText: string, input?: MarketAnalysisInput): string {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.summary !== "string") {
    throw new Error("AI analysis returned an invalid summary");
  }
  const summary = value.summary.trim().slice(0, 500);
  if (!summary) throw new Error("AI analysis returned an empty summary");
  if (/\b(buy|sell|short|long|purchase|recommend(?:ation)?|invest|profit|guarantee|risk[- ]free|can\'t lose|cannot lose|will rise|will fall|will increase|will decrease)\b/i.test(summary)) {
    throw new Error("AI analysis returned prohibited trading language");
  }
  // Allow numbers that appear in the input venue data (dollar prices, gaps)
  const inputNumbers = input ? input.venues.flatMap((v) => [
    v.referencePerShare, v.executablePerShare, v.referenceGap, v.quoteAgeSeconds,
    v.referencePerShare != null && v.executablePerShare != null ? v.executablePerShare - v.referencePerShare : null,
  ]).filter((n): n is number => n != null).map(String) : [];
  const numericKey = (token: string) => {
    const percentage = token.endsWith("%");
    const value = Number(token.replace(/[%,+]/g, ""));
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? `${value}${percentage ? "%" : ""}` : null;
  };
  const allowedNumbers = new Set([
    ...(authoritativeText.match(/[+-]?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?%?/g) ?? []).map(numericKey).filter((v): v is string => v !== null),
    ...inputNumbers.map(numericKey).filter((v): v is string => v !== null),
  ]);
  const introducedNumber = (summary.match(/[+-]?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?%?/g) ?? [])
    .some((token) => {
      const key = numericKey(token);
      return key !== null && !allowedNumbers.has(key);
    });
  if (introducedNumber) throw new Error("AI analysis introduced an unsupported number");
  return summary;
}

export function buildRulesAnalysis(input: MarketAnalysisInput) {
  const fresh = input.venues.filter((venue) =>
    venue.quoteAvailable &&
    !venue.stale &&
    !venue.unreliable &&
    venue.referencePerShare != null &&
    venue.executablePerShare != null
  );
  const outliers = input.venues.filter((venue) => venue.unreliable);
  const missing = input.venues.filter((venue) => !venue.quoteAvailable || venue.referencePerShare == null || venue.executablePerShare == null);
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  let verdict = "Wait for a clearer comparison";
  let tone: "positive" | "caution" | "neutral" = "neutral";

  const statusList = input.statuses.join(" vs ");
  const venueNames = input.venues.map((v) => v.platform).join(" and ");

  if (input.statusMismatch) {
    const openVenues = input.venues.filter((v) => v.status === "open" || v.status === "regular").map((v) => v.platform);
    const closedVenues = input.venues.filter((v) => v.status !== "open" && v.status !== "regular").map((v) => v.platform);
    reasons.push(`${venueNames} report different market sessions (${statusList}). ${openVenues.length ? openVenues.join(", ") + " is trading" : "No venue is in regular session"}${closedVenues.length ? " while " + closedVenues.join(", ") + " is in " + (closedVenues.length === 1 ? input.venues.find(v => closedVenues.includes(v.platform))?.status ?? "a different session" : "off-hours") : ""}.`);
    reasons.push("Price gaps between sessions reflect different trading states, not an executable arbitrage. Wait for both venues to align before comparing spreads.");
    verdict = "Session mismatch — check again when venues align";
    tone = "caution";
  } else if (outliers.length > 0) {
    reasons.push(`${outliers.length} quote${outliers.length === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} outside WOLV's ±${MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT}% reliability cap and excluded. This usually means thin liquidity or a stale reference price on that venue.`);
    verdict = "Caution — an outlier is excluded";
    tone = "caution";
  } else if (fresh.length >= 2 && input.spread != null) {
    const spreadAbs = Math.abs(input.spread);
    const spreadDir = input.spread >= 0 ? "above" : "below";
    const signedSpread = `${input.spread >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${input.spread.toFixed(3)}%`;
    reasons.push(`${fresh.length} fresh venue quotes are comparable after per-share normalization. ${input.ticker} is quoted ${signedSpread} ${spreadDir} reference price on the more expensive venue.`);
    reasons.push(`This ${signedSpread} spread is pre-fees. BSC gas, DEX slippage, and the quote-size effect (${100} USDT) all reduce the net difference. Request a live quote on the trade screen to see the exact execution price.`);
    verdict = spreadAbs < 0.5 ? "Tight spread — verify execution costs" : spreadAbs < 2 ? "Visible spread — check execution costs before acting" : "Wide spread — review carefully";
    tone = spreadAbs < 0.5 ? "neutral" : "positive";
  } else {
    reasons.push("There are not enough fresh, reference-backed quotes to produce a reliable comparison right now.");
    reasons.push("This can happen during low-liquidity periods or when a venue's reference price is not updating. Try again in a few minutes.");
    tone = "caution";
  }

  if (missing.length > 0) reasons.push(`${missing.length} venue${missing.length === 1 ? " has" : "s have"} missing or unusable comparison data.`);

  return {
    source: "WOLV rules · server verified",
    headline: `${input.ticker}: ${verdict}`,
    summary: `${input.ticker} is assessed from market data fetched on the server. This is informational context, not a guaranteed profit or investment recommendation.`,
    reasons,
    nextStep: tone === "caution" ? "Refresh the data before trading." : "Open the asset, request a fresh quote, and run the pre-check before wallet approval.",
    tone,
  };
}

export async function readBoundedJson(
  request: Request,
  maxBytes: number
): Promise<{ ok: true; value: unknown } | { ok: false; status: 400 | 413 }> {
  const contentLength = Number(request.headers.get("content-length"));
  if (Number.isFinite(contentLength) && contentLength > maxBytes) {
    return { ok: false, status: 413 };
  }
  if (!request.body) return { ok: false, status: 400 };

  const reader = request.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let byteLength = 0;
  let body = "";

  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      byteLength += value.byteLength;
      if (byteLength > maxBytes) {
        await reader.cancel();
        return { ok: false, status: 413 };
      }
      body += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    }
    body += decoder.decode();
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 400 };
  }

  try {
    return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(body) as unknown };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 400 };
  }
}

export function createStrictAgentPolicyTemplate(input: {
  approvedAssets: readonly string[];
  now?: number;
  version?: string;
}): RiskPolicy {
  const approvedAssets = input.approvedAssets.map((address) => address.trim().toLowerCase());
  if (approvedAssets.length === 0 || approvedAssets.length > 500 ||
    approvedAssets.some((address) => !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(address)) ||
    new Set(approvedAssets).size !== approvedAssets.length) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError(
      "INVALID_INPUT",
      "Strict policy approval requires a non-empty list of unique asset addresses.",
    );
  }
  const now = input.now ?? Date.now();
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now <= 0) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "Strict policy timestamp is invalid.");
  }
  return {
    version: input.version ?? "strict-testnet-1",
    approvedAssets,
    approvedDirections: ["BUY"],
    maxOrderValue: "0.5",
    maxDailyExposure: "1",
    maxProposalsPerHour: 1,
    maxSlippageBps: 100,
    maxReferenceDeviationPercent: 1,
    allowedSessions: ["US_REGULAR"],
    minimumBalance: "0",
    quoteTtlMs: 30_000,
    permissionExpiresAt: now + 15 * 60_000,
    emergencyStop: false,
  };
}

const TRANSITIONS: Record<AgentState, readonly AgentState[]> = {
  IDLE: ["INITIALIZING"],
  INITIALIZING: ["MONITORING", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  MONITORING: ["OBSERVATION_RECORDED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  OBSERVATION_RECORDED: ["OPPORTUNITY_DETECTED", "ANALYZING", "COMPLETED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  OPPORTUNITY_DETECTED: ["ANALYZING", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  ANALYZING: ["ANALYSIS_COMPLETED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  ANALYSIS_COMPLETED: ["POLICY_VALIDATION", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  POLICY_VALIDATION: ["POLICY_APPROVED", "POLICY_REJECTED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  POLICY_APPROVED: ["PROPOSAL_CREATED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  POLICY_REJECTED: ["COMPLETED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  PROPOSAL_CREATED: ["AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL", "EXECUTION_BLOCKED", "FAILED", "STOPPED"],
  AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL: ["USER_APPROVED", "USER_REJECTED", "EXPIRED", "STOPPED"],
  USER_APPROVED: ["EXECUTION_BLOCKED"],
  USER_REJECTED: ["COMPLETED"],
  EXPIRED: ["COMPLETED"],
  EXECUTION_BLOCKED: ["COMPLETED"],
  COMPLETED: [],
  FAILED: [],
  STOPPED: [],
};

export class AgentControlPlaneError extends Error {
  readonly code: "INVALID_TRANSITION" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "POLICY_REJECTED" | "EMERGENCY_STOP" | "NOT_FOUND" | "UNAVAILABLE";

  constructor(
    code: AgentControlPlaneError["code"],
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.code = code;
    this.name = "AgentControlPlaneError";
  }
}

export function canTransitionAgentState(from: AgentState, to: AgentState): boolean {
  return TRANSITIONS[from].includes(to);
}

export function assertAgentTransition(from: AgentState, to: AgentState): void {
  if (!canTransitionAgentState(from, to)) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_TRANSITION", `Agent run cannot transition from ${from} to ${to}.`);
  }
}

export function createSnapshotHash(value: unknown): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(stableJson(value)).digest("hex");
}

export function createIdempotencyKey(parts: readonly (string | number)[]): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(parts.map(String).join("\n")).digest("hex");
}

export function createRunId(): string {
  return randomUUID();
}

export function detectCrossVenueOpportunity(input: {
  evidence: OpportunityEvidence[];
  now: number;
  maxAgeMs: number;
  minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent: number;
}) {
  return evaluateCrossVenueOpportunities(input).opportunities;
}

export function evaluateCrossVenueOpportunities(input: {
  evidence: OpportunityEvidence[];
  now: number;
  maxAgeMs: number;
  minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent: number;
}): {
  opportunities: Array<{
  ticker: string;
  currency: string;
  observations: OpportunityEvidence[];
  spreadPercent: number;
  reason: string;
  detectionKey: string;
  }>;
  rejectionReasons: string[];
} {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.maxAgeMs) || input.maxAgeMs <= 0 ||
    !Number.isFinite(input.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent) || input.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent < 0) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "Opportunity thresholds are invalid.");
  }
  const grouped = new Map<string, OpportunityEvidence[]>();
  for (const evidence of input.evidence) {
    const key = `${evidence.ticker.trim().toUpperCase()}:${evidence.currency.trim().toUpperCase()}`;
    grouped.set(key, [...(grouped.get(key) ?? []), evidence]);
  }
  const opportunities: Array<{
    ticker: string;
    currency: string;
    observations: OpportunityEvidence[];
    spreadPercent: number;
    reason: string;
    detectionKey: string;
  }> = [];
  const rejectionReasons: string[] = [];
  for (const entries of grouped.values()) {
    const eligible = entries.filter((entry) => {
      const age = input.now - entry.providerTimestamp;
      return entry.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" &&
        entry.providerTimestamp > 0 &&
        age >= 0 &&
        age <= Math.min(entry.freshnessMs, input.maxAgeMs) &&
        parseFiniteDecimal(entry.normalizedSharePrice) !== null &&
        Number(entry.normalizedSharePrice) > 0;
    });
    if (eligible.length < 2) {
      rejectionReasons.push("Fewer than two fresh, verified observations are available for this asset.");
      continue;
    }
    const priceKinds = new Map<string, OpportunityEvidence[]>();
    for (const entry of eligible) {
      priceKinds.set(entry.priceKind, [...(priceKinds.get(entry.priceKind) ?? []), entry]);
    }
    let comparablePairFound = false;
    for (const [priceKind, kindEntries] of priceKinds) {
      const byPlatform = new Map<string, OpportunityEvidence>();
      for (const entry of kindEntries) {
        if (!byPlatform.has(entry.platform)) byPlatform.set(entry.platform, entry);
      }
      if (byPlatform.size < 2) continue;
      comparablePairFound = true;
      const selected = [...byPlatform.values()].sort((first, second) =>
        first.platform.localeCompare(second.platform));
      const prices = selected.map((entry) => Number(entry.normalizedSharePrice));
      const low = Math.min(...prices);
      const high = Math.max(...prices);
      const spreadPercent = (high / low - 1) * 100;
      if (spreadPercent < input.minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent) {
        rejectionReasons.push(`Observed ${priceKind.toLowerCase()} spread is below the configured detection threshold.`);
        continue;
      }
      if (spreadPercent > MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT) {
        rejectionReasons.push(`Observed spread exceeds WOLV's ${MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT}% reliability cap.`);
        continue;
      }
      const ticker = selected[0].ticker.trim().toUpperCase();
      const detectionKey = createIdempotencyKey([
        "cross-venue",
        ticker,
        selected.map((entry) => entry.observationId).sort().join(","),
      ]);
      opportunities.push({
        ticker,
        currency: selected[0].currency,
        observations: selected,
        spreadPercent,
        reason: `Observed ${spreadPercent.toFixed(4)}% ${priceKind.toLowerCase()} price difference across ${selected.map((entry) => entry.platform).join(" and ")}. This is not guaranteed profit.`,
        detectionKey,
      });
    }
    if (!comparablePairFound) {
      rejectionReasons.push("Observations do not include two distinct venues with a comparable price type.");
    }
  }
  if (grouped.size === 0) rejectionReasons.push("No market observations are available for this watchlist.");
  return { opportunities, rejectionReasons: [...new Set(rejectionReasons)] };
}

export function validateMarketObservation(
  observation: MarketObservationInput,
  now: number,
  maxAgeMs: number,
): string[] {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!isPositiveDecimal(observation.price)) errors.push("Observed price must be a positive decimal.");
  for (const [label, value] of [
    ["reference price", observation.referencePrice],
    ["bid", observation.bid],
    ["ask", observation.ask],
    ["spread", observation.spreadPercent],
  ] as const) {
    if (value !== null && !isFiniteDecimal(value)) errors.push(`${label} must be a finite decimal.`);
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(observation.providerTimestamp) || observation.providerTimestamp <= 0 ||
    observation.providerTimestamp > now + 30_000) errors.push("Provider timestamp is invalid.");
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(observation.ingestedAt) || observation.ingestedAt < observation.providerTimestamp) {
    errors.push("Ingestion timestamp must be valid and no earlier than provider time.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(observation.freshnessMs) || observation.freshnessMs <= 0) {
    errors.push("Freshness duration must be positive.");
  } else if (now - observation.providerTimestamp > Math.min(observation.freshnessMs, maxAgeMs)) {
    errors.push("Market observation is stale.");
  }
  if (observation.priceKind === "EXECUTABLE" && observation.bid === null && observation.ask === null) {
    errors.push("Executable price observations require a supplied bid or ask.");
  }
  if (observation.priceKind !== "INDICATIVE" && observation.priceKind !== "EXECUTABLE") {
    errors.push("Price kind is unsupported.");
  }
  if (!["VERIFIED", "UNVERIFIED", "REJECTED"].includes(observation.verificationStatus)) {
    errors.push("Verification status is unsupported.");
  }
  if (!observation.source.trim() || !observation.currency.trim() || !observation.idempotencyKey.trim()) {
    errors.push("Market observation provenance and idempotency key are required.");
  }
  return errors;
}

export function evaluateRiskPolicy(input: {
  policy: RiskPolicy;
  assetKey: string;
  direction: AgentDirection;
  notional: string;
  dailyExposure: string;
  recentProposalCount: number;
  slippageBps: number;
  referenceDeviationPercent: number | null;
  dataFresh: boolean;
  quoteExpiresAt: number | null;
  availableBalance: string | null;
  session: string;
  now: number;
}): PolicyDecision {
  const { policy } = input;
  const refusalReasons: string[] = [];
  if (validateRiskPolicy(policy, input.now).length > 0) {
    refusalReasons.push("Risk policy configuration is invalid.");
  }
  if (policy.emergencyStop) refusalReasons.push("Emergency stop is active.");
  if (input.now >= policy.permissionExpiresAt) refusalReasons.push("Policy permission has expired.");
  if (!Array.isArray(policy.approvedAssets) ||
    !policy.approvedAssets.some((asset) =>
      typeof asset === "string" && asset.toLowerCase() === input.assetKey.toLowerCase())) {
    refusalReasons.push("Asset is not approved by policy.");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(policy.approvedDirections) || !policy.approvedDirections.includes(input.direction)) {
    refusalReasons.push("Direction is not approved by policy.");
  }
  const notional = parseDecimalUnits(input.notional);
  const dailyExposure = parseDecimalUnits(input.dailyExposure);
  const maxOrder = parseDecimalUnits(policy.maxOrderValue);
  const maxDaily = parseDecimalUnits(policy.maxDailyExposure);
  if (notional === null || notional <= ZERO_DECIMAL_UNITS ||
    maxOrder === null || notional > maxOrder) {
    refusalReasons.push("Order value is invalid or exceeds the policy maximum.");
  }
  if (dailyExposure === null || maxDaily === null || dailyExposure < ZERO_DECIMAL_UNITS ||
    notional === null || dailyExposure + notional > maxDaily) {
    refusalReasons.push("Daily exposure would exceed the policy maximum.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.recentProposalCount) || input.recentProposalCount < 0 ||
    input.recentProposalCount >= policy.maxProposalsPerHour) {
    refusalReasons.push("Hourly proposal frequency limit would be exceeded.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.slippageBps) || input.slippageBps < 0 ||
    input.slippageBps > policy.maxSlippageBps) refusalReasons.push("Slippage exceeds the policy maximum.");
  if (input.referenceDeviationPercent === null ||
    !Number.isFinite(input.referenceDeviationPercent) ||
    Math.abs(input.referenceDeviationPercent) > policy.maxReferenceDeviationPercent) {
    refusalReasons.push("Reference-price deviation is unavailable or exceeds the policy maximum.");
  }
  if (!input.dataFresh) refusalReasons.push("Required market data is unavailable or stale.");
  if (!input.session || !Array.isArray(policy.allowedSessions) || !policy.allowedSessions.includes(input.session)) {
    refusalReasons.push("Current market session is not permitted by policy.");
  }
  if (input.quoteExpiresAt === null || input.quoteExpiresAt <= input.now ||
    input.quoteExpiresAt - input.now > policy.quoteTtlMs) {
    refusalReasons.push("Quote is missing, expired, or outside the permitted freshness window.");
  }
  const availableBalance = input.availableBalance === null ? null : parseDecimalUnits(input.availableBalance);
  const minimumBalance = parseDecimalUnits(policy.minimumBalance);
  if (availableBalance === null || minimumBalance === null || availableBalance < minimumBalance) {
    refusalReasons.push("Available balance is unavailable or below the policy minimum.");
  }
  const snapshot = {
    assetKey: input.assetKey.toLowerCase(),
    direction: input.direction,
    notional: input.notional,
    dailyExposure: input.dailyExposure,
    recentProposalCount: input.recentProposalCount,
    slippageBps: input.slippageBps,
    referenceDeviationPercent: input.referenceDeviationPercent,
    dataFresh: input.dataFresh,
    quoteExpiresAt: input.quoteExpiresAt,
    availableBalance: input.availableBalance,
    session: input.session,
    now: input.now,
  };
  return {
    policyVersion: policy.version,
    inputSnapshotHash: createSnapshotHash(snapshot),
    evaluatedAt: input.now,
    accepted: refusalReasons.length === 0,
    refusalReasons,
  };
}

export function validateRiskPolicy(policy: RiskPolicy, now = Date.now()): string[] {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!policy || typeof policy !== "object") return ["Risk policy must be an object."];
  if (typeof policy.version !== "string" || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(policy.version)) {
    errors.push("Policy version is invalid.");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(policy.approvedAssets) || policy.approvedAssets.length > 500 ||
    policy.approvedAssets.some((asset) => typeof asset !== "string" || !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(asset)) ||
    (Array.isArray(policy.approvedAssets) &&
      new Set(policy.approvedAssets.map((asset) => typeof asset === "string" ? asset.toLowerCase() : asset)).size !== policy.approvedAssets.length)) {
    errors.push("Approved asset list is invalid.");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(policy.approvedDirections) || policy.approvedDirections.length === 0 ||
    policy.approvedDirections.some((direction) => direction !== "BUY" && direction !== "SELL") ||
    (Array.isArray(policy.approvedDirections) && new Set(policy.approvedDirections).size !== policy.approvedDirections.length)) {
    errors.push("Approved direction list is invalid.");
  }
  const maxOrder = parseDecimalUnits(policy.maxOrderValue);
  const maxDaily = parseDecimalUnits(policy.maxDailyExposure);
  const minimumBalance = parseDecimalUnits(policy.minimumBalance);
  if (maxOrder === null || maxOrder <= ZERO_DECIMAL_UNITS) errors.push("Maximum order value is invalid.");
  if (maxDaily === null || maxDaily <= ZERO_DECIMAL_UNITS) errors.push("Maximum daily exposure is invalid.");
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(policy.maxProposalsPerHour) ||
    policy.maxProposalsPerHour < 1 || policy.maxProposalsPerHour > 12) {
    errors.push("Maximum hourly proposal frequency must be between 1 and 12.");
  }
  if (minimumBalance === null || minimumBalance < ZERO_DECIMAL_UNITS) errors.push("Minimum balance is invalid.");
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(policy.maxSlippageBps) || policy.maxSlippageBps < 0 || policy.maxSlippageBps > 10_000) {
    errors.push("Maximum slippage is invalid.");
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(policy.maxReferenceDeviationPercent) || policy.maxReferenceDeviationPercent < 0) {
    errors.push("Maximum reference-price deviation is invalid.");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(policy.allowedSessions) || policy.allowedSessions.length === 0 ||
    policy.allowedSessions.some((session) => typeof session !== "string" || !/^[A-Z0-9_-]{1,32}$/.test(session)) ||
    (Array.isArray(policy.allowedSessions) && new Set(policy.allowedSessions).size !== policy.allowedSessions.length)) {
    errors.push("Allowed market sessions are invalid.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(policy.quoteTtlMs) || policy.quoteTtlMs < 1_000 || policy.quoteTtlMs > 300_000) {
    errors.push("Quote time-to-live must be between 1 second and 5 minutes.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(policy.permissionExpiresAt) || policy.permissionExpiresAt <= 0) {
    errors.push("Permission expiration is invalid.");
  } else if (policy.permissionExpiresAt <= now ||
    policy.permissionExpiresAt > now + MAX_POLICY_PERMISSION_MS) {
    errors.push("Policy permission must be future-dated and no more than 30 minutes.");
  }
  if (typeof policy.emergencyStop !== "boolean") errors.push("Emergency-stop policy must be explicit.");
  return errors;
}

export function buildEvidenceBackedAnalysis(input: {
  opportunity: { id: string; assetId: string; spreadPercent: number; detectionReason: string };
  evidenceIds: string[];
  historicalComparisons: Array<{ observationId: string; observedAt: number; price: string; source: string }>;
  dataFresh: boolean;
  assumptions?: string[];
}) {
  if (input.evidenceIds.length === 0) {
    throw new AgentControlPlaneError("INVALID_INPUT", "Analysis requires evidence references.");
  }
  return {
    marketInterpretation: `Observed cross-venue spread: ${input.opportunity.spreadPercent.toFixed(4)}%.`,
    opportunityExplanation: input.opportunity.detectionReason,
    historicalComparison: input.historicalComparisons.length
      ? `Compared with ${input.historicalComparisons.length} stored historical observation(s).`
      : "No prior observations are available for comparison.",
    upsideScenario: "A price difference may narrow; this is a scenario, not a forecast.",
    downsideScenario: "The difference may widen or disappear before an executable quote is available.",
    executionRisks: ["Fees, slippage, liquidity, and market-session differences may eliminate the observed spread."],
    dataLimitations: input.dataFresh
      ? ["Historical coverage may be incomplete."]
      : ["One or more required observations are stale or unavailable."],
    invalidatingConditions: ["A fresh executable quote does not confirm the observed price difference."],
    suggestedNextAction: "Obtain fresh verified market evidence and policy review; no order is submitted.",
    evidenceReferences: [...new Set(input.evidenceIds)],
    assumptions: input.assumptions ?? [],
    conclusionType: "MODEL_INTERPRETATION",
    chainOfThoughtStored: false,
  };
}

function isPositiveDecimal(value: string): boolean {
  const parsed = parseFiniteDecimal(value);
  return parsed !== null && parsed > 0;
}

function isFiniteDecimal(value: string): boolean {
  return parseFiniteDecimal(value) !== null;
}

function parseFiniteDecimal(value: string): number | null {
  if (!/^-?(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value)) return null;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function parseDecimalUnits(value: unknown): bigint | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length > 64 ||
    !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d{1,18})?$/.test(value)) return null;
  const [whole, fraction = ""] = value.split(".");
  try {
    return BigInt(whole) * DECIMAL_SCALE + BigInt(fraction.padEnd(18, "0"));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function stableJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return JSON.stringify(value) ?? "undefined";
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(stableJson).join(",")}]`;
  const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)
    .sort(([first], [second]) => first.localeCompare(second));
  return `{${entries.map(([key, child]) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${stableJson(child)}`).join(",")}}`;
}

const HOOK_MODULE_TYPE = BigInt(4)
const MAX_TRADE_VALUE = BigInt("500000000000000000")

export const AGENT_POLICY_HOOK_ABI = [
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "paused",
        stateMutability: "view",
        inputs: [],
        outputs: [{ type: "bool" }]
    },
    {
        type: "function",
        name: "isInitialized",

        ]

            { name: "policyHash", type: "bytes32" },
            { name: "maxTradeValue", type: "uint192" },
            { name: "expiresAt", type: "uint64" }
        ],
        outputs: []
    }
] as const

const kernelModuleInstallAbi = [{
    type: "function",
    name: "installModule",
    stateMutability: "payable",
    inputs: [
        { name: "moduleType", type: "uint256" },
        { name: "module", type: "address" },
        { name: "initData", type: "bytes" }
    ],
    outputs: []
}] as const

type PolicyKernelAccount = SmartAccount
type PolicyKernelClient = KernelAccountClient<Transport, Chain, PolicyKernelAccount>

export type ConfigureAgentPolicyInput = {
    ownerKernelClient: PolicyKernelClient
    publicClient: PublicClient
    validatorAddress: Address
    targetToken: Address
    intentSigner: Address
    maxTradeValue: bigint
    expiresAt: bigint
    onUserOperationSubmitted?: (step: "install" | "policy", hash: Hex) => void
}

export type ConfigureAgentPolicyResult = {
    account: Address
    policyHash: Hex
    installUserOperationHash?: Hex
    policyUserOperationHash: Hex
}

export async function configureAgentPolicy(
    input: ConfigureAgentPolicyInput
): Promise<ConfigureAgentPolicyResult> {
    const account = getAddress(input.ownerKernelClient.account.address)
    const validatorAddress = getAddress(input.validatorAddress)
    const targetToken = getAddress(input.targetToken)
    const intentSigner = getAddress(input.intentSigner)
    const chainId = input.publicClient.chain?.id
    if (chainId !== 56 && chainId !== 97) {
        throw new Error("Agent policy configuration supports only BSC or BSC testnet.")
    }
    if (input.ownerKernelClient.chain?.id !== chainId) {
        throw new Error("Kernel account client and public client must use the same chain.")
    }
    if (input.maxTradeValue <= BigInt(0) || input.maxTradeValue > MAX_TRADE_VALUE) {
        throw new RangeError("Policy maximum trade value must be between 1 wei and 0.5 BNB.")
    }
    const nowSeconds = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000))
    if (input.expiresAt <= nowSeconds || input.expiresAt > (BigInt(1) << BigInt(64)) - BigInt(1)) {
        throw new RangeError("Policy expiry must be a future Unix timestamp that fits uint64.")
    }

    const policyHash = hashAgentPolicy({
        targetToken,
        maxTradeValue: input.maxTradeValue,
        expiresAt: input.expiresAt,
        intentSigner
    })
    let installed = await input.publicClient.readContract({
        address: validatorAddress,
        abi: AGENT_POLICY_HOOK_ABI,
        functionName: "isInitialized",
        args: [account]
    })
    let installUserOperationHash: Hex | undefined
    if (!installed) {
        const hookData = concatHex([
            "0x00",
            encodeAbiParameters([{ type: "address" }], [targetToken])
        ])
        const installCall = encodeFunctionData({
            abi: kernelModuleInstallAbi,
            functionName: "installModule",
            args: [HOOK_MODULE_TYPE, validatorAddress, hookData]
        })
        installUserOperationHash = await input.ownerKernelClient.sendUserOperation({
            calls: [{ to: account, value: BigInt(0), data: installCall }]
        })
        input.onUserOperationSubmitted?.("install", installUserOperationHash)
        const installReceipt = await input.ownerKernelClient.waitForUserOperationReceipt({
            hash: installUserOperationHash
        })
        if (!installReceipt.success) {
            throw new Error(`Hook installation UserOperation reverted: ${installUserOperationHash}`)
        }
        installed = await input.publicClient.readContract({
            address: validatorAddress,
            abi: AGENT_POLICY_HOOK_ABI,
            functionName: "isInitialized",
            args: [account]
        })
        if (!installed) {
            throw new Error("Hook installation UserOperation succeeded but the hook is not initialized.")
        }
    }

    const installedTarget = await input.publicClient.readContract({
        address: validatorAddress,
        abi: AGENT_POLICY_HOOK_ABI,
        functionName: "getTargetToken",
        args: [account]
    })
    if (getAddress(installedTarget) !== targetToken) {
        throw new Error("Configured target token does not match the installed policy hook.")
    }

    const policyCall = encodeFunctionData({
        abi: AGENT_POLICY_HOOK_ABI,
        functionName: "setAccountPolicy",
        args: [account, intentSigner, policyHash, input.maxTradeValue, input.expiresAt]
    })
    const policyUserOperationHash = await input.ownerKernelClient.sendUserOperation({
        calls: [{ to: validatorAddress, value: BigInt(0), data: policyCall }]
    })
    input.onUserOperationSubmitted?.("policy", policyUserOperationHash)
    const policyReceipt = await input.ownerKernelClient.waitForUserOperationReceipt({
        hash: policyUserOperationHash
    })
    if (!policyReceipt.success) {
        throw new Error(`Policy configuration UserOperation reverted: ${policyUserOperationHash}`)
    }
    const policyState = await input.publicClient.readContract({
        address: validatorAddress,
        abi: AGENT_POLICY_HOOK_ABI,
        functionName: "getAccountPolicy",
        args: [account]
    })
    if (
        !policyState[0]
        || policyState[1].toLowerCase() !== policyHash.toLowerCase()
        || policyState[2] !== input.maxTradeValue
        || policyState[3] !== input.expiresAt
        || getAddress(policyState[4]) !== intentSigner
    ) {
        throw new Error("On-chain policy readback did not match the requested configuration.")
    }

    return {
        account,
        policyHash,
        installUserOperationHash,
        policyUserOperationHash
    }
}

  | "RPC_DIVERGENCE"
