export class BscMetadataAuditError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "BscMetadataAuditError";
  }
}

export async function auditBscCatalogueMetadata(
  catalogueResponse: unknown,
  options: {
    primary: BscAuditRpc;
    secondary?: BscAuditRpc;
    now?: () => number;
    evidenceMode?: "LIVE" | "MOCK";
    maxRetries?: number;
    sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
    random?: () => number;
    concurrency?: number;
  },
): Promise<BscMetadataAuditResult> {
  const concurrency = options.concurrency ?? 1;
  if (!Number.isInteger(concurrency) || concurrency < 1 || concurrency > MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError(`Audit concurrency must be between 1 and ${MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY}.`);
  }
  if (!isRwaAssetListResponse(catalogueResponse, { allowEmpty: true })) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The RWA catalogue response has an unexpected shape.");
  }
  const rawRecords = catalogueResponse.data;
  const records = parseRwaAssetRecords(catalogueResponse);
  const eligible = records.filter(isSpotEligibleAsset);
  const eligibleAddressCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const asset of eligible) {
    const key = asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase();
    eligibleAddressCounts.set(key, (eligibleAddressCounts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const duplicates = new Set(
    [...eligibleAddressCounts].filter(([, count]) => count > 1).map(([address]) => address),
  );
  const rawByAddress = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>[]>();
  for (const raw of rawRecords) {
    if (!isRecord(raw) || typeof raw.tokenContractAddress !== "string") continue;
    const key = raw.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase();
    rawByAddress.set(key, [...(rawByAddress.get(key) ?? []), raw]);
  }
  const snapshot = records.map((asset) => ({
    tokenContractAddress: asset.tokenContractAddress,
    underlyingTicker: asset.underlyingTicker,
    platformId: asset.platformId,
    symbol: asset.symbol ?? null,
    eligible: isSpotEligibleAsset(asset),
    ...(rawCatalogueDecimals(rawByAddress.get(asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase()) ?? []).present
      ? { catalogueDecimals: rawCatalogueDecimals(rawByAddress.get(asset.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase()) ?? []).value }
      : {}),
  }));
  const catalogueSnapshotSha256 = createHash("sha256")
    .update(JSON.stringify(snapshot))
    .digest("hex");
  const primary = options.primary;
  const primaryChainId = await primary.client.getChainId();
  if (primaryChainId !== 56) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The primary RPC did not report BSC mainnet chain ID 56.");
  }
  const blockNumber = await primary.client.getBlockNumber();
  const primaryBlock = await primary.client.getBlock({ blockNumber });
  const primaryBlockHash = normalizeBlockHash(primaryBlock.hash);
  if (!primaryBlockHash) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The primary RPC did not return a valid hash for the audit block.");
  }

  const secondary = hasIndependentOperator(primary, options.secondary)
    ? options.secondary
    : undefined;
  let secondaryBlockHash: string | null = null;
  let secondaryFailure: string | null = null;
  let networkDivergence = false;
  if (secondary) {
    try {
      if (await secondary.client.getChainId() !== 56) {
        secondaryFailure = "SECONDARY_CHAIN_ID_MISMATCH";
        networkDivergence = true;
      } else {
        const secondaryBlock = await secondary.client.getBlock({ blockNumber });
        secondaryBlockHash = normalizeBlockHash(secondaryBlock.hash);
        if (!secondaryBlockHash) {
          secondaryFailure = "SECONDARY_BLOCK_HASH_MISSING";
          networkDivergence = true;
        } else if (secondaryBlockHash !== primaryBlockHash) {
          secondaryFailure = "BLOCK_HASH_MISMATCH";
          networkDivergence = true;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      secondaryFailure = "SECONDARY_BLOCK_READ_FAILED";
    }
  }

  const sameBlock = Boolean(secondary && !secondaryFailure && !networkDivergence);
  const rpcBlockHashes: Record<string, string | null> = {
    [primary.id]: primaryBlockHash,
    ...(secondary ? { [secondary.id]: secondaryBlockHash } : {}),
  };
  const assets = await mapWithConcurrency(eligible, concurrency, async (asset) => {
    const address = asset.tokenContractAddress;
    const addressKey = address.toLowerCase();
    if (duplicates.has(addressKey)) {
      return emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, "UNSUPPORTED", "DUPLICATE_ELIGIBLE_ADDRESS", 0);
    }
    const catalogueDecimal = rawCatalogueDecimals(rawByAddress.get(addressKey) ?? []);
    let checksummedAddress: Address;
    try {
      if (!EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(address)) throw new Error("invalid");
      checksummedAddress = getAddress(address);
    } catch {
      return emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, "UNSUPPORTED", "INVALID_CATALOGUE_ADDRESS", 0);
    }
    const primaryResult = await readAtBlock(primary.client, checksummedAddress, blockNumber, {
      maxRetries: options.maxRetries,
      sleep: options.sleep,
      random: options.random,
    });
    if (primaryResult.error) {
      const status = primaryResult.error === "MISSING_CONTRACT_CODE" ||
        primaryResult.error === "DECIMALS_OUTSIDE_WOLV_RANGE"
        ? "UNSUPPORTED"
        : "UNVERIFIED";
      return {
        ...emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, status, primaryResult.error, 1),
        chainId: 56,
        blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
        blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
        contractCodePresent: primaryResult.contractCodePresent,
        contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
        decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
        rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
        catalogueDecimals: catalogueDecimal.present ? catalogueDecimal.value : null,
      };
    }
    if (catalogueDecimal.present && !metadataMatchesCatalogue(primaryResult.decimals!, catalogueDecimal.value)) {
      return {
        ...emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, "UNSUPPORTED", "CATALOGUE_DECIMALS_CONFLICT", 1),
        chainId: 56,
        blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
        blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
        contractCodePresent: true,
        contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
        decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
        rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
        catalogueDecimals: catalogueDecimal.value,
      };
    }
    if (networkDivergence) {
      return {
        ...emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, "RPC_DIVERGENCE", secondaryFailure, 1),
        chainId: 56,
        blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
        blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
        contractCodePresent: true,
        contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
        decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
        rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
        catalogueDecimals: catalogueDecimal.present ? catalogueDecimal.value : null,
      };
    }
    if (sameBlock && secondary) {
      const secondaryResult = await readAtBlock(secondary.client, checksummedAddress, blockNumber, {
        maxRetries: options.maxRetries,
        sleep: options.sleep,
        random: options.random,
      });
      if (secondaryResult.error) {
        return {
          ...emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, "UNVERIFIED", `SECONDARY_${secondaryResult.error}`, 1),
          chainId: 56,
          blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
          blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
          contractCodePresent: true,
          contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
          decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
          rpcDiagnostics: [...primaryResult.diagnostics, ...secondaryResult.diagnostics],
          catalogueDecimals: catalogueDecimal.present ? catalogueDecimal.value : null,
        };
      }
      if (secondaryResult.contractCodeSha256 !== primaryResult.contractCodeSha256 ||
          secondaryResult.decimals !== primaryResult.decimals) {
        return {
          ...emptyContractResult(asset.symbol ?? null, address, "RPC_DIVERGENCE", secondaryResult.error ?? "CONTRACT_RESULT_MISMATCH", 2),
          chainId: 56,
          blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
          blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
          contractCodePresent: true,
          contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
          decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
          rpcDiagnostics: [...primaryResult.diagnostics, ...secondaryResult.diagnostics],
          catalogueDecimals: catalogueDecimal.present ? catalogueDecimal.value : null,
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      symbol: asset.symbol ?? null,
      tokenAddress: address,
      eligibility: "ELIGIBLE" as const,
      status: verifiedStatus(options.evidenceMode, sameBlock),
      chainId: 56,
      blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
      blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
      contractCodePresent: true,
      contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
      decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
      rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
      rpcVerificationCount: sameBlock ? 2 : 1,
      errorClassification: secondaryFailure,
      catalogueDecimals: catalogueDecimal.present ? catalogueDecimal.value : null,
    };
  });

  const usdt = await auditUsdt({
    primary,
    secondary,
    sameBlock,
    networkDivergence,
    secondaryFailure,
    blockNumber,
    blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
    evidenceMode: options.evidenceMode,
    maxRetries: options.maxRetries,
    sleep: options.sleep,
    random: options.random,
  });
  const statuses = [...assets.map((asset) => asset.status), usdt.status];
  const resultStatus: BscMetadataAuditResult["status"] = statuses.includes("RPC_DIVERGENCE")
    ? "RPC_DIVERGENCE"
    : statuses.every((status) => status === "MOCK_VERIFIED")
      ? "MOCK_VERIFIED"
      : statuses.every((status) => status === "LIVE_VERIFIED_CROSS_RPC")
        ? "LIVE_VERIFIED_CROSS_RPC"
        : statuses.every((status) => status === "LIVE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_RPC")
          ? "LIVE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_RPC"
          : "UNVERIFIED";

  return {
    status: resultStatus,
    auditTimestamp: new Date((options.now ?? Date.now)()).toISOString(),
    catalogueSource: "Binance Web3 RWA token catalogue GET /build/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens",
    catalogueSnapshotSha256,
    eligibleAssetCount: eligible.length,
    duplicateEligibleAddressCount: duplicates.size,
    chainId: 56,
    blockNumber: blockNumber.toString(),
    blockHash: primaryBlockHash,
    primaryRpcId: primary.id,
    secondaryRpcId: secondary?.id ?? null,
    rpcVerificationCount: secondary ? 2 : 1,
    concurrency,
    rpcBlockHashes,
    assets,
    usdt,
  };
}

async function auditUsdt(options: {
  primary: BscAuditRpc;
  secondary?: BscAuditRpc;
  sameBlock: boolean;
  networkDivergence: boolean;
  secondaryFailure: string | null;
  blockNumber: bigint;
  blockHash: string;
  evidenceMode?: "LIVE" | "MOCK";
  maxRetries?: number;
  sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
  random?: () => number;
}): Promise<BscMetadataAuditContract> {
  const address = getAddress(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS);
  const primaryResult = await readAtBlock(options.primary.client, address, options.blockNumber, options);
  if (primaryResult.error) {
    const status = primaryResult.error === "MISSING_CONTRACT_CODE" ||
      primaryResult.error === "DECIMALS_OUTSIDE_WOLV_RANGE"
      ? "UNSUPPORTED"
      : "UNVERIFIED";
    return {
      ...emptyContractResult("USDT", BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, status, primaryResult.error, 1, "USDT_AUDIT_TARGET"),
      chainId: 56,
      blockNumber: options.blockNumber.toString(),
      blockHash: options.blockHash,
      contractCodePresent: primaryResult.contractCodePresent,
      contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
      decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
      rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
    };
  }
  if (options.networkDivergence) {
    return {
      ...emptyContractResult("USDT", BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, "RPC_DIVERGENCE", options.secondaryFailure, 1, "USDT_AUDIT_TARGET"),
      chainId: 56,
      blockNumber: options.blockNumber.toString(),
      blockHash: options.blockHash,
      contractCodePresent: true,
      contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
      decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
      rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
    };
  }
  if (options.sameBlock && options.secondary) {
    const second = await readAtBlock(options.secondary.client, address, options.blockNumber, options);
    if (second.error) {
      return {
        ...emptyContractResult("USDT", BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, "UNVERIFIED", `SECONDARY_${second.error}`, 1, "USDT_AUDIT_TARGET"),
        chainId: 56,
        blockNumber: options.blockNumber.toString(),
        blockHash: options.blockHash,
        contractCodePresent: true,
        contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
        decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
        rpcDiagnostics: [...primaryResult.diagnostics, ...second.diagnostics],
      };
    }
    if (second.contractCodeSha256 !== primaryResult.contractCodeSha256 || second.decimals !== primaryResult.decimals) {
      return {
        ...emptyContractResult("USDT", BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, "RPC_DIVERGENCE", second.error ?? "CONTRACT_RESULT_MISMATCH", 2, "USDT_AUDIT_TARGET"),
        chainId: 56,
        blockNumber: options.blockNumber.toString(),
        blockHash: options.blockHash,
        contractCodePresent: true,
        contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
        decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
        rpcDiagnostics: [...primaryResult.diagnostics, ...second.diagnostics],
      };
    }
  }
  return {
    symbol: "USDT",
    tokenAddress: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
    eligibility: "USDT_AUDIT_TARGET",
    status: verifiedStatus(options.evidenceMode, options.sameBlock),
    chainId: 56,
    blockNumber: options.blockNumber.toString(),
    blockHash: options.blockHash,
    contractCodePresent: true,
    contractCodeSha256: primaryResult.contractCodeSha256,
    decimals: primaryResult.decimals,
    rpcDiagnostics: primaryResult.diagnostics,
    rpcVerificationCount: options.sameBlock ? 2 : 1,
    errorClassification: options.secondaryFailure,
    catalogueDecimals: null,
  };
}

async function readAtBlock(
  client: BscAuditRpcClient,
  address: Address,
  blockNumber: bigint,
  retryOptions: {
    maxRetries?: number;
    sleep?: (milliseconds: number) => Promise<void>;
    random?: () => number;
  } = {},
) {
  const codeRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_getCode",
    stage: "BYTECODE",
    operation: () => client.getBytecode({ address, blockNumber }),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  if (!codeRead.ok) {
    return failedRead(codeRead.diagnostic.errorClass, null, null, null, codeRead.diagnostics);
  }
  const bytecode = codeRead.value;
  if (typeof bytecode !== "string" || !/^0x(?:[a-fA-F0-9]{2})*$/.test(bytecode)) {
    return failedRead("INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE", null, null, null, markInvalidRpcResponse(codeRead.diagnostics));
  }
  if (bytecode === "0x") return failedRead("MISSING_CONTRACT_CODE", false, null, null, codeRead.diagnostics);
  const contractCodeSha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytecode).digest("hex");
  const decimalRead = await runRpcRead({
    method: "eth_call",
    stage: "DECIMALS",
    operation: () => client.readContract({
      address,
      abi: DECIMALS_ABI,
      functionName: "decimals",
      blockNumber,
    }),
    ...retryOptions,
  });
  if (!decimalRead.ok) {
    return failedRead(decimalRead.diagnostic.errorClass, true, contractCodeSha256, null, [
      ...codeRead.diagnostics,
      ...decimalRead.diagnostics,
    ]);
  }
  const decimals: unknown = decimalRead.value;
  const diagnostics = [...codeRead.diagnostics, ...decimalRead.diagnostics];
  if (typeof decimals !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals < 0 || decimals > 255) {
    return failedRead("INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE", true, contractCodeSha256, null, markInvalidRpcResponse(diagnostics));
  }
  if (decimals > MAX_SUPPORTED_DECIMALS) {
    return failedRead("DECIMALS_OUTSIDE_WOLV_RANGE", true, contractCodeSha256, decimals, diagnostics);
  }
  return { error: null, contractCodePresent: true, contractCodeSha256, decimals, diagnostics };
}

function failedRead(
  error: string,
  contractCodePresent: boolean | null,
  contractCodeSha256: string | null,
  decimals: number | null = null,
  diagnostics: RpcRequestDiagnostic[] = [],
) {
  return { error, contractCodePresent, contractCodeSha256, decimals, diagnostics };
}

function emptyContractResult(
  symbol: string | null,
  tokenAddress: string,
  status: BscMetadataAuditStatus,
  errorClassification: string | null,
  rpcVerificationCount: number,
  eligibility: "ELIGIBLE" | "USDT_AUDIT_TARGET" = "ELIGIBLE",
): BscMetadataAuditContract {
  return {
    symbol,
    tokenAddress,
    eligibility,
    status,
    chainId: null,
    blockNumber: null,
    blockHash: null,
    contractCodePresent: null,
    contractCodeSha256: null,
    decimals: null,
    rpcVerificationCount,
    errorClassification,
    rpcDiagnostics: [],
    catalogueDecimals: null,
  };
}

function rawCatalogueDecimals(records: Record<string, unknown>[]) {
  const values = records
    .filter((record) => Object.hasOwn(record, "decimals"))
    .map((record) => record.decimals);
  if (values.length === 0) return { present: false, value: null };
  return {
    present: true,
    value: values.length === 1 && values[0] !== undefined
      ? values[0]
      : values,
  };
}

function metadataMatchesCatalogue(chainDecimals: number, catalogueDecimals: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof catalogueDecimals === "number") {
    return Number.isInteger(catalogueDecimals) && catalogueDecimals === chainDecimals;
  }
  return typeof catalogueDecimals === "string" &&
    /^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(catalogueDecimals) &&
    Number(catalogueDecimals) === chainDecimals;
}

function normalizeBlockHash(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(value)
    ? value.toLowerCase()
    : null;
}

function hasIndependentOperator(primary: BscAuditRpc, secondary?: BscAuditRpc): secondary is BscAuditRpc {
  return Boolean(
    secondary &&
    primary.operator.trim() &&
    secondary.operator.trim() &&
    primary.operator.trim().toLowerCase() !== secondary.operator.trim().toLowerCase(),
  );
}

function verifiedStatus(
  evidenceMode: "LIVE" | "MOCK" | undefined,
  crossRpc: boolean,
): BscMetadataAuditStatus {
  if (evidenceMode === "MOCK") return "MOCK_VERIFIED";
  if (evidenceMode !== "LIVE") return "UNVERIFIED";
  return crossRpc ? "LIVE_VERIFIED_CROSS_RPC" : "LIVE_VERIFIED_SINGLE_RPC";
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}
export type NormalizedCandle = {
  timestamp: number;
  time: string;
  value: number;
};

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function numberValue(value: unknown): number | null {
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" ? Number(value) : NaN;
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function timestampMs(value: unknown): number | null {
  const parsed = numberValue(value);
  if (parsed == null) return null;
  // Accept seconds defensively, although Binance documents milliseconds.
  const milliseconds = parsed < 10_000_000_000 ? parsed * 1000 : parsed;
  return milliseconds > 0 ? milliseconds : null;
}

function displayTime(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}

function extractRecords(response: unknown): unknown[] {
  if (Array.isArray(response)) return response;
  if (!isRecord(response)) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(response.data)) return response.data;
  if (isRecord(response.data) && Array.isArray(response.data.klineInfos)) return response.data.klineInfos;
  if (Array.isArray(response.klineInfos)) return response.klineInfos;
  return [];
}

/**
 * Normalize Binance Web3 Market API /api/v1/dex/market/candles data.
 *
 * That endpoint documents each array as:
 * [open, high, low, close, volume, timestampMs, tradeCount]
 * This is intentionally different from Binance's standard spot kline order.
 */
export function normalizeCandles(response: unknown, anchorPrice?: number | null): NormalizedCandle[] {
  const points = extractRecords(response).flatMap((record): NormalizedCandle[] => {
    if (Array.isArray(record)) {
      const open = numberValue(record[0]);
      const high = numberValue(record[1]);
      const low = numberValue(record[2]);
      const close = numberValue(record[3]);
      const timestamp = timestampMs(record[5]);
      if (open == null || high == null || low == null || close == null || timestamp == null) return [];
      if (open <= 0 || high <= 0 || low <= 0 || close <= 0 || low > high) return [];
      return [{ timestamp, time: displayTime(timestamp), value: close }];
    }

    if (isRecord(record)) {
      const close = numberValue(record.close ?? record.closePrice ?? record.c);
      const timestamp = timestampMs(record.timestamp ?? record.time ?? record.openTime ?? record.closeTime);
      if (close == null || close <= 0 || timestamp == null) return [];
      return [{ timestamp, time: displayTime(timestamp), value: close }];
    }

    return [];
  }).sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);

  if (points.length < 2) return [];
  if (!points.every((point) => Number.isFinite(point.value) && point.value > 0)) return [];

  if (anchorPrice != null && Number.isFinite(anchorPrice) && anchorPrice > 0) {
    const values = points.map((point) => point.value).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const median = values[Math.floor(values.length / 2)];
    if (Math.abs(median / anchorPrice - 1) > 0.5) return [];
  }

  return points;
}
import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";

export type PublicAssetDirectory =
  | "branding"
  | "companies"
  | "platforms"
  | "backgrounds"
  | "icons"
  | "illustrations";

const extensions = ["svg", "webp", "png", "jpg", "jpeg"] as const;

export function getPublicAssetPath(
  directory: PublicAssetDirectory,
  name: string
): string | undefined {
  const assetName = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
  if (!assetName) return undefined;

  for (const extension of extensions) {
    const filePath = join(process.cwd(), "public", "assets", directory, `${assetName}.${extension}`);
    if (existsSync(filePath)) {
      return `/assets/${directory}/${assetName}.${extension}`;
    }
  }

  return undefined;
}
import "server-only";
import {
  classifyRpcFailure,
  sanitizeProviderMessage,
} from "./bscRpcReliability.ts";

type JsonRpcRequest = {
  id?: unknown;
  method?: unknown;
  params?: unknown;
};

type RpcWireRecord = {
  method: string | null;
  parameterCount: number | null;
  targetAddress: string | null;
  blockParameterType: "hex-quantity" | "block-tag" | "object" | "other" | null;
  serializedBlockParameter: string | Record<string, unknown> | null;
  inputBlockNumberType: string | null;
  attempt: number;
  responseDurationMs: number;
  httpStatus: number | null;
  jsonRpcErrorCode: number | string | null;
  providerMessage: string | null;
  validJsonRpcResponse: boolean;
  errorClass: string;
  retryable: boolean;
};

class InvalidRpcResponseError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super("Invalid JSON-RPC response received.");
    this.name = "InvalidRpcResponseError";
  }
}

export function createRpcWireRecorder(fetchImplementation: typeof fetch = fetch) {
  const records: RpcWireRecord[] = [];
  const attempts = new Map<string, number>();
  const inputBlockTypes = new Map<string, string[]>();

  const fetchFn: typeof fetch = async (input, init) => {
    const requestBody = readRequestBody(init?.body);
    const method = typeof requestBody?.method === "string" ? requestBody.method : null;
    const params = Array.isArray(requestBody?.params) ? requestBody.params : null;
    const targetAddress = readTargetAddress(method, params);
    const serializedBlockParameter = readBlockParameter(method, params);
    const key = requestKey(method, targetAddress, serializedBlockParameter);
    const attempt = (attempts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1;
    attempts.set(key, attempt);
    const record: RpcWireRecord = {
      method,
      parameterCount: params?.length ??
        (requestBody && !Object.hasOwn(requestBody, "params") ? 0 : null),
      targetAddress,
      blockParameterType: classifyBlockParameter(serializedBlockParameter),
      serializedBlockParameter,
      inputBlockNumberType: takeInputBlockType(inputBlockTypes, key),
      attempt,
      responseDurationMs: 0,
      httpStatus: null,
      jsonRpcErrorCode: null,
      providerMessage: null,
      validJsonRpcResponse: false,
      errorClass: "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE",
      retryable: false,
    };
    records.push(record);
    const startedAt = performance.now();
    try {
      const response = await fetchImplementation(input, init);
      record.httpStatus = response.status;
      const responseBody = await readResponseBody(response);
      if (responseBody) {
        record.validJsonRpcResponse = isJsonRpcResponse(responseBody, requestBody?.id);
        const rpcError = readRpcError(responseBody);
        if (rpcError) {
          record.jsonRpcErrorCode = rpcError.code;
          record.providerMessage = rpcError.message === null
            ? null
            : sanitizeProviderMessage(rpcError.message);
        }
      }
      record.responseDurationMs = Math.max(0, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));
      if (response.status < 200 || response.status >= 300) {
        applyFailureClassification(record, {
          status: response.status,
          message: record.providerMessage ?? `HTTP ${response.status}`,
        }, method);
      } else if (record.validJsonRpcResponse && record.jsonRpcErrorCode !== null) {
        applyFailureClassification(record, {
          code: record.jsonRpcErrorCode,
          message: record.providerMessage ?? "JSON-RPC error response",
        }, method);
      } else if (record.validJsonRpcResponse) {
        record.errorClass = "NONE";
      } else {
        record.errorClass = "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE";
        if (response.status >= 200 && response.status < 300) {
          throw new InvalidRpcResponseError();
        }
      }
      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      record.responseDurationMs = Math.max(0, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));
      if (error instanceof InvalidRpcResponseError) {
        record.errorClass = "INVALID_RPC_RESPONSE";
        record.retryable = false;
      } else {
        applyFailureClassification(record, error, method);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return {
    fetchFn,
    snapshot: () => records.map((record) => ({ ...record })),
    noteBlockInput(method: string, targetAddress: unknown, blockInput: unknown) {
      const serialized = serializeInputBlock(blockInput);
      const key = requestKey(method, normalizeAddress(targetAddress), serialized.value);
      const inputTypes = inputBlockTypes.get(key) ?? [];
      inputTypes.push(serialized.inputType);
      inputBlockTypes.set(key, inputTypes);
    },
  };
}

export function requireRpcBlockNumber(value: unknown): asserts value is bigint {
  if (typeof value !== "bigint" || value < BigInt(0)) {
    throw new TypeError("RPC block number must be a non-negative bigint.");
  }
}

function readRequestBody(body: BodyInit | null | undefined): JsonRpcRequest | null {
  if (typeof body !== "string") return null;
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(body);
    if (isRecord(parsed)) return parsed;
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function readTargetAddress(method: string | null, params: unknown[] | null): string | null {
  if (method === "eth_getCode" && typeof params?.[0] === "string") {
    return normalizeAddress(params[0]);
  }
  if (method === "eth_call" && isRecord(params?.[0]) && typeof params[0].to === "string") {
    return normalizeAddress(params[0].to);
  }
  return null;
}

function readBlockParameter(
  method: string | null,
  params: unknown[] | null,
): string | Record<string, unknown> | null {
  if (!params) return null;
  const position = method === "eth_getCode" ? 1
    : method === "eth_getBlockByNumber" ? 0
      : method === "eth_call" ? 1
        : null;
  if (position === null) return null;
  const value = params[position];
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  if (isRecord(value)) return value;
  return null;
}

function classifyBlockParameter(
  value: string | Record<string, unknown> | null,
): RpcWireRecord["blockParameterType"] {
  if (value === null) return null;
  if (typeof value === "object") return "object";
  if (/^0x(?:0|[1-9a-f][0-9a-f]*)$/i.test(value)) return "hex-quantity";
  if (value === "latest" || value === "earliest" || value === "pending" ||
    value === "safe" || value === "finalized") return "block-tag";
  return "other";
}

function readRpcError(
  response: Record<string, unknown>,
): { code: number | null; message: string | null } | null {
  if (!isRecord(response.error)) return null;
  const code = typeof response.error.code === "number" && Number.isInteger(response.error.code)
    ? response.error.code
    : null;
  const message = typeof response.error.message === "string" ? response.error.message : null;
  return { code, message };
}

function isJsonRpcResponse(value: unknown, requestId: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!isRecord(value) || value.jsonrpc !== "2.0" ||
    requestId === undefined || !Object.hasOwn(value, "id") || value.id !== requestId) return false;
  const hasResult = Object.hasOwn(value, "result");
  const hasError = Object.hasOwn(value, "error");
  if (hasResult === hasError) return false;
  if (!hasError) return true;
  return isRecord(value.error) &&
    typeof value.error.code === "number" &&
    Number.isInteger(value.error.code) &&
    typeof value.error.message === "string";
}

async function readResponseBody(response: Response): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  try {
    const body: unknown = await response.clone().json();
    return isRecord(body) ? body : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function serializeKey(value: unknown): string {
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value) ?? "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

function requestKey(
  method: string | null,
  targetAddress: string | null,
  blockParameter: unknown,
): string {
  return `${method ?? "unknown"}:${targetAddress ?? ""}:${serializeKey(blockParameter)}`;
}

function serializeInputBlock(value: unknown): { inputType: string; value: unknown } {
  if (typeof value === "bigint") return { inputType: "bigint", value: `0x${value.toString(16)}` };
  if (typeof value === "string") return { inputType: "string", value };
  if (isRecord(value)) return { inputType: "object", value };
  if (value === undefined) return { inputType: "undefined", value: "latest" };
  return { inputType: typeof value, value };
}

function takeInputBlockType(inputTypes: Map<string, string[]>, key: string): string | null {
  const queue = inputTypes.get(key);
  if (!queue?.length) return null;
  const inputType = queue.shift() ?? null;
  if (!queue.length) inputTypes.delete(key);
  return inputType;
}

function applyFailureClassification(
  record: RpcWireRecord,
  error: unknown,
  method: string | null,
): void {
  const diagnostic = classifyRpcFailure(error, {
    method: method ?? "unknown",
    stage: method === "eth_getBlockByNumber" || method === "eth_blockNumber" ||
      method === "eth_chainId"
      ? "BLOCK"
      : method === "eth_call"
        ? "DECIMALS"
        : "BYTECODE",
    attempt: record.attempt,
    requestDurationMs: record.responseDurationMs,
  });
  record.errorClass = diagnostic.errorClass;
  record.retryable = diagnostic.retryable;
  record.jsonRpcErrorCode = diagnostic.providerErrorCode ?? record.jsonRpcErrorCode;
  record.providerMessage = diagnostic.providerMessage ?? record.providerMessage;
}

function normalizeAddress(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(value)
    ? value.toLowerCase()
    : null;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}
import { decodeFunctionData } from "viem"
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN, isPositiveUint256 } from "./apiValidation.ts"

const erc20ApproveAbi = [{
    type: "function",
    name: "approve",
    stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    inputs: [
        { name: "spender", type: "address" },
        { name: "amount", type: "uint256" },
    ],
    outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
}] as const

export type ApprovalValidationInput = {
    tokenAddress: string
    calldata: string
    spender: string
    quoteBoundSpender: string
    trustedSpenders: readonly string[]
    expectedAmount: string
    currentAllowance: string
    resetOnly?: boolean
}

export type ApprovalValidationResult =
    | { ok: true; spender: string; amount: string; kind: "EXACT" | "ZERO_RESET" }
    | { ok: false; reason: string }

export function validateApprovalTransaction(input: ApprovalValidationInput): ApprovalValidationResult {
    if (input.tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Approval token is not the supported BSC USDT contract." }
    }
    if (
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.spender) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.quoteBoundSpender) ||
        input.spender.toLowerCase() !== input.quoteBoundSpender.toLowerCase()
    ) return { ok: false, reason: "Approval spender does not match the quote-bound spender." }
    if (!input.trustedSpenders.some((address) =>
        EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(address) && address.toLowerCase() === input.spender.toLowerCase()
    )) return { ok: false, reason: "Approval spender is not in the reviewed trusted spender list." }
    if (!isPositiveUint256(input.expectedAmount) || !/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(input.currentAllowance)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Approval amount or current allowance is invalid." }
    }
    if (!/^0x095ea7b3[0-9a-fA-F]{128}$/.test(input.calldata)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Unsupported approval selector or calldata format." }
    }

    let decoded: ReturnType<typeof decodeFunctionData<typeof erc20ApproveAbi>>
    try {
        decoded = decodeFunctionData({ abi: erc20ApproveAbi, data: input.calldata as `0x${string}` })
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Approval calldata could not be decoded." }
    }
    if (decoded.functionName !== "approve") return { ok: false, reason: "Unsupported approval function." }
    const [decodedSpender, decodedAmount] = decoded.args
    if (decodedSpender.toLowerCase() !== input.spender.toLowerCase()) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Approval calldata spender does not match the approved spender." }
    }
    if (decodedAmount === BigInt(0)) {
        if (!input.resetOnly || BigInt(input.currentAllowance) === BigInt(0)) {
            return { ok: false, reason: "Zero-reset approval is not required for this allowance." }
        }
        return { ok: true, spender: decodedSpender, amount: "0", kind: "ZERO_RESET" }
    }
    if (input.resetOnly || decodedAmount !== BigInt(input.expectedAmount)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Approval amount must equal the exact requested trade amount." }
    }
    return { ok: true, spender: decodedSpender, amount: decodedAmount.toString(), kind: "EXACT" }
}

export type ProviderExecutionRejection = {
    ok: false
    code: "UNSUPPORTED_SWAP_SCHEMA" | "UNSUPPORTED_RFQ_SCHEMA"
    reason: string
}

export function validateBinanceSwapResponse(_response: unknown): ProviderExecutionRejection {
    return {
        ok: false,
        code: "UNSUPPORTED_SWAP_SCHEMA",
        reason: "Binance SWAP transaction schema is not documented or fixture-verified; execution is disabled.",
    }
}

export function validateBinanceRfqTypedData(_typedData: unknown): ProviderExecutionRejection {
    return {
        ok: false,
        code: "UNSUPPORTED_RFQ_SCHEMA",
        reason: "Binance RFQ typed-data schema is not documented or fixture-verified; signing and submission are disabled.",
    }
}

const BSC_ENTRY_POINT_ADDRESS = "0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032"
const ENTRY_POINT = getEntryPoint("0.7")

if (ENTRY_POINT.address.toLowerCase() !== BSC_ENTRY_POINT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error("ZeroDev SDK EntryPoint v0.7 does not match the configured BSC EntryPoint.")
}

export function getAgentPublicClient() {
    const chain = getConfiguredBscChain()
    return createPublicClient({
        chain,
        transport: http(getBscRpcUrl(chain.id))
    })
}

export function estimateKernelUserOperationFees(
    publicClient: ReturnType<typeof getAgentPublicClient>
) {
    return estimateFeesPerGas(publicClient, { type: "eip1559" })
}

export async function getKernelAccountContext(signer: WalletClient) {
    const chain = getConfiguredBscChain()
    const signerAccount = signer.account
    if (!signerAccount) {
        throw new Error("Connect a wallet account before configuring an agent policy.")
    }
    if (signer.chain?.id !== chain.id) {
        throw new Error("Switch your wallet to the configured BNB Chain network.")
    }

    const publicClient = getAgentPublicClient()
    const ownerSigner = toAccount({
        address: signerAccount.address,
        async signMessage({ message }) {
            return signer.signMessage({ account: signerAccount, message })
        },
        async signTypedData() {
            throw new Error("The Kernel owner validator does not use typed-data signing.")
        },
        async signTransaction() {
            throw new Error("The Kernel owner validator does not sign transactions.")
        }
    })
    const ownerValidator = await signerToEcdsaValidator(publicClient, {
        signer: ownerSigner,
        entryPoint: ENTRY_POINT,
        kernelVersion: KERNEL_V3_1
    })
    const plugins = await toKernelPluginManager(publicClient, {
        sudo: ownerValidator,
        entryPoint: ENTRY_POINT,
        kernelVersion: KERNEL_V3_1
    })
    const account = await createKernelAccount(publicClient, {
        plugins,
        entryPoint: ENTRY_POINT,
        kernelVersion: KERNEL_V3_1
    })

    return { account, chain, publicClient }
}

export function createKernelClientFromContext(
    context: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getKernelAccountContext>>
) {
    const { account, chain, publicClient } = context
    const bundlerVariable = chain.id === 56
        ? "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_BUNDLER_RPC_URL"
        : "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_BUNDLER_RPC_URL"
    const bundlerUrl = chain.id === 56
        ? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_BUNDLER_RPC_URL
        : process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_BUNDLER_RPC_URL
    if (!bundlerUrl) {
        throw new Error(`Configure ${bundlerVariable} before submitting agent policies.`)
    }

    return createKernelAccountClient({
        account,
        chain,
        client: publicClient,
        bundlerTransport: http(bundlerUrl),
        userOperation: {
            estimateFeesPerGas: async () => estimateKernelUserOperationFees(publicClient)
        }
    })
}

export async function getKernelClient(signer: WalletClient) {
    return createKernelClientFromContext(await getKernelAccountContext(signer))
}

import type { Q } from "./quotes";
import type { RwaAssetRecord } from "./spotAssets";
import { MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT } from "./marketThresholds.js";

export { MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT } from "./marketThresholds.js";

export const OPPORTUNITY_QUOTE_TTL_MS = 30_000;
const UNAVAILABLE_MARKET_STATUSES = new Set([
  "unknown", "n/a", "na", "not available", "unavailable", "unspecified",
  "none", "null", "undefined", "pending", "not set", "-", "--", "–", "—", "status unavailable",
]);

export type VenueResult = {
  token: RwaAssetRecord;
  quote: Q;
  multiplier: number | null;
  referencePrice: number | null;
  referencePerShare: number | null;
  executablePerShare: number | null;
  referenceGap: number | null;
  stale: boolean;
  unreliable: boolean;
};

export type OpportunityRow = {
  ticker: string;
  venues: VenueResult[];
  crossVenueSpread: number | null;
  statusMismatch: boolean;
  statuses: string[];
};

export type CrossListedPair = { ticker: string; venues: RwaAssetRecord[] };

export function numberValue(value: unknown): number {
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

export function positiveNumberValue(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() === "") return null;
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : null;
}

export function normalizePerSharePrice(value: unknown, tokenToShareRatio: unknown): number | null {
  const price = positiveNumberValue(value);
  const ratio = positiveNumberValue(tokenToShareRatio);
  if (price == null || ratio == null) return null;
  const perShare = price / ratio;
  return Number.isFinite(perShare) && perShare > 0 ? perShare : null;
}

export function signedPercent(value: number): string {
  return `${value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${value.toFixed(3)}%`;
}

export function marketLabel(token: { statusInfo?: { openState?: boolean | null; marketStatus?: string | null } | null }): string {
  const status = token.statusInfo?.marketStatus;
  const normalizedStatus = typeof status === "string" ? status.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  if (normalizedStatus && !UNAVAILABLE_MARKET_STATUSES.has(normalizedStatus)) return normalizedStatus;
  if (token.statusInfo?.openState === true) return "open";
  if (token.statusInfo?.openState === false) return "closed";
  return "status unavailable";
}

export function getCrossListedPairs(tokens: RwaAssetRecord[]): CrossListedPair[] {
  const grouped = new Map<string, Map<string, RwaAssetRecord>>();

  for (const token of tokens) {
    const ticker = token.underlyingTicker.trim();
    const platform = token.platformId.trim();
    if (!ticker || !platform) continue;
    const venues = grouped.get(ticker) ?? new Map<string, RwaAssetRecord>();
    if (!venues.has(platform)) venues.set(platform, token);
    grouped.set(ticker, venues);
  }

  return Array.from(grouped.entries())
    .filter(([, venues]) => venues.size >= 2)
    .map(([ticker, venues]) => ({ ticker, venues: Array.from(venues.values()) }))
    .sort((a, b) =>
      Math.max(...b.venues.map((token) => numberValue(token.volume24H))) -
      Math.max(...a.venues.map((token) => numberValue(token.volume24H)))
    );
}

export function buildVenueResult(token: RwaAssetRecord, quote: Q, now = Date.now()): VenueResult {
  const multiplier = positiveNumberValue(token.tokenToShareRatio);
  const referencePrice = positiveNumberValue(token.referencePrice);
  const referencePerShare = normalizePerSharePrice(token.referencePrice, token.tokenToShareRatio);
  const executablePerShare = quote.ok
    ? normalizePerSharePrice(quote.usd, token.tokenToShareRatio)
    : null;
  const referenceGap = executablePerShare != null && referencePerShare != null && referencePerShare > 0
    ? (executablePerShare / referencePerShare - 1) * 100
    : null;

  return {
    token,
    quote,
    multiplier,
    referencePrice,
    referencePerShare,
    executablePerShare,
    referenceGap,
    stale: !(now - quote.ts < OPPORTUNITY_QUOTE_TTL_MS),
    unreliable: referenceGap != null && Math.abs(referenceGap) > MAX_RELIABLE_GAP_PERCENT,
  };
}

export function buildOpportunityRow(ticker: string, venues: VenueResult[]): OpportunityRow {
  const reliablePrices = venues
    .filter((venue) =>
      venue.quote.ok &&
      !venue.stale &&
      !venue.unreliable &&
      venue.referenceGap != null
    )
    .map((venue) => venue.executablePerShare)
    .filter((value): value is number => value != null && value > 0);
  const statuses = Array.from(new Set(
    venues.map((venue) => marketLabel(venue.token)).filter((status) => status !== "status unavailable")
  ));

  return {
    ticker,
    venues,
    crossVenueSpread: reliablePrices.length >= 2
      ? (Math.max(...reliablePrices) / Math.min(...reliablePrices) - 1) * 100
      : null,
    statusMismatch: statuses.length > 1,
    statuses,
  };
}

export const RWA_TABS: RwaTab[] = [...PRIMARY_TABS, ...MORE_TABS];

// Accepts the raw ?tab= value; returns a documented tabId or null (= All).
export function parseTabId(v: string | string[] | undefined): number | null {
  const s = Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v;
  if (!s || !/^\d+$/.test(s)) return null;
  const n = Number(s);
  return RWA_TABS.some((t) => t.id === n) ? n : null;
}

// Documented token tags (token-list `tags` field). Anything else is ignored.
export const TAG_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  alpha: "Alpha",
  communityRecognized: "Community Recognized",
  volumeSurge: "Volume Surge",
  volumePlunge: "Volume Plunge",
};

export function knownTags(tags: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(tags)) return [];
  return Array.from(new Set(tags.filter((t): t is string => typeof t === "string" && t in TAG_LABELS)));
}

// ---- Protections & Reports (underlying-profile `data.protections`) ----
const KNOWN_PROTECTIONS: [string, string][] = [
  ["dailyAttestationReport", "Daily Attestation Report"],
  ["monthlyAttestationReport", "Monthly Attestation Report"],
  ["collateralReport", "Collateral Report"],
];

const prettyKey = (k: string) => k.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());

export function safeReportUrl(u: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof u !== "string" || !u.trim()) return null;
  try {
    const x = new URL(u.trim());
    return x.protocol === "https:" || x.protocol === "http:" ? x.toString() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export type ProtectionRow = { key: string; label: string; url: string | null };

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

// Only entries the API returns with supported === true. url is null when missing/invalid.
export function buildProtectionRows(profile: unknown): ProtectionRow[] {
  if (!isRecord(profile) || !isRecord(profile.protections)) return [];
  const raw = profile.protections;
  const known = new Map(KNOWN_PROTECTIONS);
  const keys = [...KNOWN_PROTECTIONS.map(([k]) => k), ...Object.keys(raw).filter((k) => !known.has(k))];
  return keys.flatMap((key) => {
    const protection = raw[key];
    if (!isRecord(protection) || protection.supported !== true) return [];
    return [{ key, label: known.get(key) ?? prettyKey(key), url: safeReportUrl(protection.url) }];
  });
}
import { marketQuoteUsd } from "./quotes";
import type { RwaAssetRecord } from "./spotAssets";
import {
  buildOpportunityRow,
  buildVenueResult,
  getCrossListedPairs,
  type OpportunityRow,
} from "./opportunityMath";

export const QUOTE_AMOUNT_USDT = 100;
const MAX_CONCURRENT_QUOTES = 4;
const OPPORTUNITY_ROW_CACHE_TTL_MS = 30_000;

const rowCache = new Map<string, { row: OpportunityRow; expiresAt: number }>();
const rowInFlight = new Map<string, Promise<OpportunityRow>>();

async function mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  items: T[],
  limit: number,
  worker: (item: T) => Promise<R>
): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = [];
  let nextIndex = 0;

  async function run(): Promise<void> {
    while (nextIndex < items.length) {
      const index = nextIndex;
      nextIndex += 1;
      results[index] = await worker(items[index]);
    }
  }

  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, () => run()));
  return results;
}

function pairCacheKey(pair: { ticker: string; venues: RwaAssetRecord[] }): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    ticker: pair.ticker,
    venues: pair.venues.map((token) => ({
      address: token.tokenContractAddress.toLowerCase(),
      referencePrice: token.referencePrice,
      tokenToShareRatio: token.tokenToShareRatio,
      marketStatus: token.statusInfo?.marketStatus,
      openState: token.statusInfo?.openState,
    })),
  });
}

function refreshCachedRow(row: OpportunityRow): OpportunityRow {
  return buildOpportunityRow(
    row.ticker,
    row.venues.map((venue) => buildVenueResult(venue.token, venue.quote, Date.now()))
  );
}

async function loadPair(pair: { ticker: string; venues: RwaAssetRecord[] }, key: string): Promise<OpportunityRow> {
  const cached = rowCache.get(key);
  if (cached && cached.expiresAt > Date.now()) return refreshCachedRow(cached.row);
  if (cached) rowCache.delete(key);

  const inFlight = rowInFlight.get(key);
  if (inFlight) return inFlight;

  const pending = (async () => {
    const venues = await mapWithConcurrency(pair.venues, MAX_CONCURRENT_QUOTES, async (token) => {
      const quote = await marketQuoteUsd(token.tokenContractAddress, QUOTE_AMOUNT_USDT);
      return buildVenueResult(token, quote);
    });
    const row = buildOpportunityRow(pair.ticker, venues);
    rowCache.set(key, { row, expiresAt: Date.now() + OPPORTUNITY_ROW_CACHE_TTL_MS });
    return row;
  })().finally(() => rowInFlight.delete(key));

  rowInFlight.set(key, pending);
  return pending;
}

export async function getOpportunityRows(tokens: RwaAssetRecord[], limit = 8): Promise<OpportunityRow[]> {
  const pairs = getCrossListedPairs(tokens).slice(0, Math.max(0, limit));
  return mapWithConcurrency(pairs, MAX_CONCURRENT_QUOTES, (pair) => loadPair(pair, pairCacheKey(pair)));
}
export function resolvePublicRpcUrl(
  configuredUrl: string | undefined,
  fallbackUrl: string,
  variableName: string,
): string {
  const value = configuredUrl || fallbackUrl;
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${variableName} must be a public HTTP(S) RPC URL.`);
  }

  if (
    (url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    url.search ||
    url.hash ||
    (url.pathname !== "/" && url.pathname !== "")
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      `${variableName} must be a public HTTP(S) RPC URL without credentials, path tokens, query parameters, or fragments.`,
    );
  }
  return url.toString();
}

export function redactRpcEndpointIdentity(value: string): string {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return `${url.protocol}//${url.host}/<redacted>`;
  } catch {
    return "invalid RPC endpoint (redacted)";
  }
}

import crypto from "node:crypto"
import { BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN, isPositiveUint256 } from "./apiValidation.ts"
import { TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS } from "./tradeReadiness.ts"

export type BrowserTradeBindingInput = {
    executionId: string
    quoteId: string
    wallet: string
    chainId: 56
    direction: "BUY"
    fromToken: string
    toToken: string
    amount: string
    slippageBps: number
}

type BrowserTradeBindingPayload = BrowserTradeBindingInput & {
    issuedAt: number
    expiresAt: number
}

function bindingSecret(): string {
    const secret = process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY
    if (!secret) throw new Error("Quote binding secret is not configured")
    return secret
}

export function assertBrowserTradeBindingAvailable(): void {
    bindingSecret()
}

function sign(payload: string): string {
    return crypto.createHmac("sha256", bindingSecret()).update(payload, "utf8").digest("base64url")
}

export function createBrowserTradeBinding(input: BrowserTradeBindingInput, issuedAt = Date.now()): string {
    validateInput(input)
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(issuedAt) || issuedAt < 0) throw new Error("Invalid quote timestamp")
    const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
        ...input,
        issuedAt,
        expiresAt: issuedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS,
    }), "utf8").toString("base64url")
    return `${payload}.${sign(payload)}`
}

export function verifyBrowserTradeBinding(
    binding: string,
    expected: BrowserTradeBindingInput,
    now = Date.now(),
): { ok: true; issuedAt: number; expiresAt: number } | { ok: false; reason: string } {
    try {
        validateInput(expected)
        if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(binding)) {
            return { ok: false, reason: "Malformed trade binding" }
        }
        const [encodedPayload, providedSignature] = binding.split(".")
        const expectedSignature = sign(encodedPayload)
        const provided = Buffer.from(providedSignature, "base64url")
        const expectedBytes = Buffer.from(expectedSignature, "base64url")
        if (provided.length !== expectedBytes.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(provided, expectedBytes)) {
            return { ok: false, reason: "Trade binding signature mismatch" }
        }
        const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(encodedPayload, "base64url").toString("utf8")) as Partial<BrowserTradeBindingPayload>
        if (
            payload.executionId !== expected.executionId ||
            payload.quoteId !== expected.quoteId ||
            payload.wallet?.toLowerCase() !== expected.wallet.toLowerCase() ||
            payload.chainId !== expected.chainId ||
            payload.direction !== expected.direction ||
            payload.fromToken?.toLowerCase() !== expected.fromToken.toLowerCase() ||
            payload.toToken?.toLowerCase() !== expected.toToken.toLowerCase() ||
            payload.amount !== expected.amount ||
            payload.slippageBps !== expected.slippageBps
        ) return { ok: false, reason: "Trade binding does not match the approved intent" }
        const issuedAt = Number(payload.issuedAt)
        const expiresAt = Number(payload.expiresAt)
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(issuedAt) || !Number.isSafeInteger(expiresAt)) {
            return { ok: false, reason: "Trade binding has invalid timestamps" }
        }
        if (
            expiresAt !== issuedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS ||
            now < issuedAt ||
            now >= expiresAt
        ) return { ok: false, reason: "Trade binding expired" }
        return { ok: true, issuedAt, expiresAt }
    } catch {
        return { ok: false, reason: "Invalid trade binding" }
    }
}

function validateInput(input: BrowserTradeBindingInput): void {
    if (
        !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(input.executionId) ||
        !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(input.quoteId) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.wallet) ||
        input.chainId !== 56 ||
        input.direction !== "BUY" ||
        input.fromToken.toLowerCase() !== BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.fromToken) ||
        !EVM_ADDRESS_PATTERN.test(input.toToken) ||
        input.fromToken.toLowerCase() === input.toToken.toLowerCase() ||
        !isPositiveUint256(input.amount) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(input.slippageBps) ||
        input.slippageBps < 1 ||
        input.slippageBps > 500
    ) throw new Error("Invalid browser trade binding parameters")
}

interface TxRequest {
  from?: string;
  to: string;
  data: string;
  value?: bigint | string;
  gas?: bigint | string;
  gasPrice?: bigint | string;
  maxPriorityFeePerGas?: bigint | string;

type TypedData = Record<string, unknown>;

const sendWalletTransactionOnce = createSingleFlightGate();

type EthereumProvider = {
  request: (args: { method: string; params?: unknown[] }) => Promise<unknown>;
};

export interface WalletHookValue {
  /** Kept as `provider` for source-compat with existing call sites, which
   *  only ever used it as a truthy "do we have a signer ready" gate. Its
   *  real type is now a viem WalletClient (from wagmi), not an
   *  ethers.BrowserProvider. */
  provider: ReturnType<typeof useWalletClient>["data"] | null;
  address: string | null;
  chainId: number | undefined;
  isConnected: boolean;
  isCorrectNetwork: boolean;
  /** True only while an explicit, user-initiated connect() is in flight. */
  isConnecting: boolean;
  /** True only during wagmi's automatic reconnect-from-storage on mount. */
  isInitializing: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  walletConnectAvailable: boolean;
  connect: (wallet?: "injected" | "walletConnect") => Promise<void>;
  disconnect: () => void;
  switchToBscMainnet: () => Promise<void>;
  signTypedData: (typedData: TypedData) => Promise<string | null>;
  sendTransaction: (transaction: TxRequest) => Promise<Hash>;
  getTransactionStatus: (hash: string) => Promise<"confirmed" | "failed" | "pending" | "unverified">;
  waitForTransaction: (hash: string) => Promise<"confirmed" | "failed" | "unverified">;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function readConnectionError(error: unknown): string {
  const messages: string[] = [];
  let current = error;

  for (let depth = 0; depth < 4 && current; depth += 1) {
    if (current instanceof Error) {
      messages.push(current.message);
      current = current.cause;
    } else if (typeof current === "object") {
      const record = current as Record<string, unknown>;
      for (const key of ["message", "shortMessage", "details"]) {
        if (typeof record[key] === "string") messages.push(record[key]);
      }
      current = record.cause;
    } else if (typeof current === "string") {
      messages.push(current);
      break;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  return messages.join(" ").toLowerCase();
}

function getConnectionErrorMessage(error: unknown): string | null {
  if (!error) return null;

  const message = readConnectionError(error);
  if (/previous request is still active|request (?:is )?already pending|connection request.*pending|already processing a request/.test(message)) {
    return "Your wallet already has a connection request open. Finish or dismiss that request in the wallet, then retry once.";
  }
  if (/user rejected|user denied|request rejected|user cancelled|user canceled|code.?4001/.test(message)) {
    return "Connection request was declined. Reopen your wallet and approve the connection.";
  }
  if (/metamask(?: extension)? not found|no injected|injected provider|provider not found|no provider|connector not found/.test(message)) {
    return "No browser-wallet provider was found. Open this page in your wallet app's built-in browser, or choose WalletConnect in a regular browser.";
  }
  if (/walletconnect|relay|websocket|web socket|failed to fetch|network|timed? ?out|connection reset|connection request reset|proposal expired/.test(message)) {
    return "WalletConnect could not reach its relay. Check your connection and retry, or use the Browser wallet option inside your wallet app.";
  }
  return "Wallet connection failed. Retry, or switch between Browser wallet and WalletConnect.";
}

function getWalletTransactionError(error: unknown): string {
  const messages: string[] = [];
  let current = error;

  for (let depth = 0; depth < 4 && current; depth += 1) {
    if (typeof current === "string") {
      messages.push(current);
      break;
    }
    if (typeof current !== "object") break;

    const record = current as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const key of ["shortMessage", "message", "details"]) {
      if (typeof record[key] === "string" && record[key].trim()) {
        messages.push(record[key]);
      }
    }
    current = record.cause;
  }

  const distinctMessages = Array.from(new Set(messages));
  return (distinctMessages.join("; ") || "Wallet transaction request failed").slice(0, 500);
}

/**
 * Thin wrapper around wagmi's hooks.
 *
 * All connection state, silent reconnect-on-mount, accountsChanged /
 * chainChanged / disconnect handling, and single-source-of-truth state
 * sharing across components now live inside wagmi itself (via the single
 * <WagmiProvider> in app/providers.tsx, see lib/wagmi.ts for the config).
 * This file no longer contains ANY eth_requestAccounts / eth_accounts
 * calls, listener registration, or localStorage bookkeeping - wagmi's
 * connectors own all of that, which is what "removing the custom wallet
 * connection handler" means here. The custom implementation this replaces
 * (hand-rolled useState/useEffect + lib/wallet.ts) is gone.
 *
 * The return shape is intentionally identical to the previous
 * hand-rolled version so TradeButton.tsx, WalletSelector.tsx, and
 * app/wallet/page.tsx did not need to change.
 */
export function useWallet(): WalletHookValue {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { address, chainId, isConnected, isReconnecting } = useAccount();
  const {
    connectors,
    connectAsync,
    error: connectError,
    isPending: isConnectPending,
  } = useConnect();
  const { disconnect: wagmiDisconnect } = useDisconnect();
  const { switchChainAsync } = useSwitchChain();
  const { data: walletClient } = useWalletClient();
  const { sendTransactionAsync } = useSendTransaction();
  const publicClient = usePublicClient({ chainId: 56 });
  const { signTypedDataAsync } = useSignTypedData();
  const [connectionError, setConnectionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const connectInFlight = useRef(false);

  // Prefer an already-injected wallet (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, etc.);
  // otherwise fall back to WalletConnect. Mirrors the old lib/wallet.ts
  // fallback order. The connection targets the configured BSC chain; the
  // trading signing and submission guards below remain mainnet-only.
  const connect = useCallback(async (wallet?: "injected" | "walletConnect") => {
    if (connectInFlight.current) return;
    connectInFlight.current = true;
    setConnectionError(null);
    try {
      const injectedConnector = connectors.find((c) => c.type === "injected");
      const walletConnectConnector = connectors.find(
        (c) => c.type === "walletConnect"
      );
      const target = wallet === "walletConnect"
        ? walletConnectConnector
        : wallet === "injected"
          ? injectedConnector
          : injectedConnector ?? walletConnectConnector ?? connectors[0];
      if (!target) {
        setConnectionError(wallet === "walletConnect"
          ? "WalletConnect is not configured for this deployment. Use the Browser wallet option inside your wallet app."
          : "No browser-wallet provider was found. Open this page in your wallet app's built-in browser, or choose WalletConnect.");
        return;
      }
      await connectAsync({ connector: target, chainId: getWalletConnectChainId(pathname) });
      setConnectionError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setConnectionError(getConnectionErrorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      connectInFlight.current = false;
    }
  }, [connectors, connectAsync, pathname]);

  const disconnect = useCallback(() => {
    setConnectionError(null);
    wagmiDisconnect();
  }, [wagmiDisconnect]);

  const switchToBscMainnet = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      if (switchChainAsync) {
        await switchChainAsync({ chainId: 56 });
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // Fall through to direct wallet provider fallback below.
    }

    const ethereum = (window as unknown as { ethereum?: EthereumProvider }).ethereum;
    if (ethereum?.request) {
      try {
        await ethereum.request({
          method: "wallet_switchEthereumChain",
          params: [{ chainId: "0x38" }],
        });
        return;
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        if (!isRecord(error) || error.code !== 4902) {
          throw error;
        }

        await ethereum.request({
          method: "wallet_addEthereumChain",
          params: [{
            chainId: "0x38",
            chainName: "Binance Smart Chain Mainnet",
            nativeCurrency: {
              name: "BNB",
              symbol: "BNB",
              decimals: 18,
            },
            rpcUrls: ["https://bsc-dataseed.binance.org/"],
            blockExplorerUrls: ["https://bscscan.com"],
          }],
        });
      }
    }
  }, [switchChainAsync]);

  const signTypedData = useCallback(
    async (typedData: TypedData): Promise<string | null> => {
      if (!address) return null;
      if (chainId !== 56 || walletClient?.chain.id !== 56) {
        throw new Error("Switch to BNB Smart Chain before signing typed data");
      }
      if (walletClient.account?.address.toLowerCase() !== address.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error("Connected wallet account changed; reconnect before signing");
      }
      try {
        if (!isRecord(typedData.domain) || !isRecord(typedData.types) || !isRecord(typedData.message)) {
          throw new Error("Binance returned invalid EIP-712 typed data");
        }
        // EIP-712 typed data needs an explicit primaryType for viem/wagmi's
        // signTypedData, whereas ethers' signer.signTypedData() inferred it.
        // Use it if the API already included one, else derive it as the
        // single non-EIP712Domain key of `types`.
        const primaryType = typeof typedData.primaryType === "string"
          ? typedData.primaryType
          : Object.keys(typedData.types).find((key) => key !== "EIP712Domain");
        if (!primaryType) throw new Error("Binance typed data is missing its primary type");

        return await signTypedDataAsync({
          domain: typedData.domain,
          types: typedData.types,
          primaryType,
          message: typedData.message,
        } as Parameters<typeof signTypedDataAsync>[0]);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to sign typed data:", err);
        return null;
      }
    },
    [address, chainId, walletClient, signTypedDataAsync]
  );

  const sendTransaction = useCallback(
    async (transaction: TxRequest): Promise<Hash> => {
      if (!address) throw new Error("Wallet account is unavailable; reconnect and retry");
      if (chainId !== 56) throw new Error("Switch to BNB Smart Chain before sending the transaction");
      if (!walletClient?.account || walletClient.chain.id !== 56) {
        throw new Error("Wallet account or BNB Smart Chain connection changed; reconnect and retry");
      }
      if (walletClient.account.address.toLowerCase() !== address.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error("Connected wallet account changed; reconnect before sending the transaction");
      }
      if (transaction.from && transaction.from.toLowerCase() !== address.toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error("Transaction sender does not match the connected wallet account");
      }

      try {
        // Binance fee fields can be incomplete or stale for the connected
        // wallet. Keep its gas limit, but let Wagmi/MetaMask estimate the
        // current BSC fee tuple before opening the confirmation prompt.
        return await sendWalletTransactionOnce(() => sendTransactionAsync({
          account: walletClient.account,
          chainId: 56,
          to: transaction.to as `0x${string}`,
          data: transaction.data as `0x${string}`,
          value: transaction.value !== undefined ? BigInt(transaction.value) : undefined,
          gas: transaction.gas !== undefined ? BigInt(transaction.gas) : undefined,
        }));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Wallet transaction request failed:", err);
        const message = getWalletTransactionError(err);
        throw new Error(message);
      }
    },
    [address, chainId, walletClient, sendTransactionAsync]
  );

  const getTransactionStatus = useCallback(
    async (hash: string): Promise<"confirmed" | "failed" | "pending" | "unverified"> => {
      if (!publicClient || !/^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(hash)) return "unverified";
      try {
        const receipt = await publicClient.getTransactionReceipt({ hash: hash as Hash });
        return receipt.status === "success" ? "confirmed" : "failed";
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        if (error instanceof TransactionReceiptNotFoundError) return "pending";
        console.error("Failed to read transaction receipt from BSC:", error);
        return "unverified";
      }
    },
    [publicClient]
  );

  const waitForTransaction = useCallback(
    async (hash: string): Promise<"confirmed" | "failed" | "unverified"> => {
      const deadline = Date.now() + 120_000;
      while (Date.now() < deadline) {
        const status = await getTransactionStatus(hash);
        if (status !== "pending") return status;
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2_000));
      }
      return "unverified";
    },
    [getTransactionStatus]
  );

  return {
    provider: walletClient ?? null,
    address: address ?? null,
    chainId,
    isConnected,
    isCorrectNetwork: isBscNetworkAllowedOnPath(pathname, chainId ?? 0),
    isConnecting: isConnectPending,
    isInitializing: isReconnecting,
    error: connectionError ?? getConnectionErrorMessage(connectError),
    walletConnectAvailable: Boolean(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_PROJECT_ID),
    connect,
    disconnect,
    switchToBscMainnet,
    signTypedData,
    sendTransaction,
    getTransactionStatus,
    waitForTransaction,
  };
}
import {
  concatHex,
  createPublicClient,
  encodeAbiParameters,
  encodeFunctionData,
  getAddress,
  http,
  parseAbi,
} from "viem";
import { bscTestnet } from "viem/chains";
import { hashAgentPolicy } from "../lib/agentPolicyHash.ts";

const RPC_URL =
  process.env.BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL ||
  "https://data-seed-prebsc-1-s1.binance.org:8545";
const MAX_TRADE_VALUE = 500_000_000_000_000_000n;
const POLICY_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function isInitialized(address smartAccount) view returns (bool)",
  "function getTargetToken(address account) view returns (address)",
  "function setAccountPolicy(address smartAccount, address intentSigner, bytes32 policyHash, uint192 maxTradeValue, uint64 expiresAt)",
]);
const KERNEL_ABI = parseAbi([
  "function execute(bytes32 mode, bytes executionCalldata)",
]);
const SINGLE_CALL_MODE = `0x${"00".repeat(32)}`;

function parseArguments(argv) {
  const values = new Map();
  let confirmed = false;
  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 1) {
    const argument = argv[index];
    if (argument === "--confirm-testnet") {
      if (confirmed) throw new Error("Duplicate --confirm-testnet flag.");
      confirmed = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (!["--hook", "--account", "--target-token", "--intent-signer", "--max-trade-wei", "--expires-at"].includes(argument)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown argument: ${argument}`);
    }
    if (values.has(argument)) throw new Error(`Duplicate argument: ${argument}`);
    const value = argv[index + 1];
    if (!value || value.startsWith("--")) throw new Error(`Missing value for ${argument}.`);
    values.set(argument, value);
    index += 1;
  }
  if (!confirmed) throw new Error("Refusing to prepare policy calldata without --confirm-testnet.");
  for (const required of ["--hook", "--account", "--target-token", "--intent-signer", "--max-trade-wei", "--expires-at"]) {
    if (!values.has(required)) throw new Error(`Required argument missing: ${required}`);
  }
  return values;
}

async function main() {
  const args = parseArguments(process.argv.slice(2));
  const hookAddress = getAddress(args.get("--hook"));
  const accountAddress = getAddress(args.get("--account"));
  const targetToken = getAddress(args.get("--target-token"));
  const intentSigner = getAddress(args.get("--intent-signer"));
  const maxTradeValue = BigInt(args.get("--max-trade-wei"));
  if (maxTradeValue <= 0n || maxTradeValue > MAX_TRADE_VALUE) {
    throw new Error("--max-trade-wei must be between 1 and 0.5 BNB in wei.");
  }
  const expiresAt = BigInt(args.get("--expires-at"));
  const nowSeconds = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
  if (expiresAt <= nowSeconds || expiresAt > (1n << 64n) - 1n) {
    throw new Error("--expires-at must be a future Unix timestamp that fits uint64.");
  }
  const publicClient = createPublicClient({
    chain: bscTestnet,
    transport: http(RPC_URL),
  });
  const chainId = await publicClient.getChainId();
  if (chainId !== 97) throw new Error(`Expected BSC Testnet 97; RPC returned ${chainId}.`);
  const code = await publicClient.getBytecode({ address: hookAddress });
  if (!code || code === "0x") throw new Error("Hook address has no deployed bytecode.");

  const installed = await publicClient.readContract({
    address: hookAddress,
    abi: POLICY_ABI,
    functionName: "isInitialized",
    args: [accountAddress],
  });
  if (!installed) {
    throw new Error("The smart account must install the new policy hook before policy configuration.");
  }
  const installedTargetToken = await publicClient.readContract({
    address: hookAddress,
    abi: POLICY_ABI,
    functionName: "getTargetToken",
    args: [accountAddress],
  });
  if (installedTargetToken.toLowerCase() !== targetToken.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error(`Installed policy hook target ${installedTargetToken} does not match --target-token ${targetToken}.`);
  }
  const policyHash = hashAgentPolicy({
    targetToken,
    maxTradeValue,
    expiresAt,
    intentSigner,
  });

  const policyCall = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: POLICY_ABI,
    functionName: "setAccountPolicy",
    args: [accountAddress, intentSigner, policyHash, maxTradeValue, expiresAt],
  });
  const executionCalldata = concatHex([
    hookAddress,
    encodeAbiParameters([{ type: "uint256" }], [0n]),
    policyCall,
  ]);
  const kernelCallData = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: KERNEL_ABI,
    functionName: "execute",
    args: [SINGLE_CALL_MODE, executionCalldata],
  });

  console.log("No transaction was signed or broadcast.");
  console.log(`Chain: BSC Testnet 97`);
  console.log(`Hook: ${hookAddress}`);
  console.log(`Smart account: ${accountAddress}`);
  console.log(`Target token: ${targetToken}`);
  console.log(`Intent signer: ${intentSigner}`);
  console.log(`Policy hash: ${policyHash}`);
  console.log(`Maximum trade: ${maxTradeValue} wei`);
  console.log(`Policy expires: ${expiresAt}`);
  console.log("Submit this Kernel call through the smart account with its owner validator:");
  console.log(kernelCallData);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
