function makeHarness(options = {}) {
  const store = new BawExecutionMemoryTestStore();
  const calls = [];
  let quoteCount = 0;
  let currentNow = NOW;
  const snapshot = options.snapshot ?? makeSnapshot();
  const runner = async (args) => {
    calls.push([...args]);
    if (args[1] === "quote") {
      quoteCount += 1;
      if (options.quoteError && quoteCount > (options.quoteErrorAfter ?? 0)) throw options.quoteError;
      const direction = args[5].toLowerCase() === BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() ? "BUY" : "SELL";
      const amount = args[3];
      const outputAmount = options.changedQuote && quoteCount > 1
        ? (direction === "BUY" ? "0.099" : "9.9")
        : (options.outputAmount ?? (direction === "BUY" ? "0.1" : "10"));
      return {
        stdout: JSON.stringify({
          success: true,
          data: {
            fromCoinSymbol: direction === "BUY" ? "USDT" : "AAPLon",
            fromCoinAmount: amount,
            toCoinSymbol: direction === "BUY" ? "AAPLon" : "USDT",
            toCoinAmount: outputAmount,
            slippage: 0.01,
          },
        }),
      };
    }
    if (args[1] === "swap") {
      if (options.swapError) throw options.swapError;
      return { stdout: '{"success":true,"data":{"orderId":"1234567890"}}' };
    }
    if (args[1] === "list") {
      if (options.listError) throw options.listError;
      const swap = calls.find((call) => call[1] === "swap");
      const fromToken = swap[5];
      const toToken = swap[7];
      return {
        stdout: JSON.stringify({
          success: true,
          data: {
            total: 1,
            page: 1,
            pageSize: 20,
            list: [{
              orderType: "market",
              orderId: "1234567890",
              chain: "56",
              fromToken,
              fromTokenName: "USDT",
              fromTokenQty: swap[3],
              toToken,
              toTokenName: "AAPLon",
              ...(options.actualOutput === null ? {} : {
                toTokenActualQty: options.actualOutput ?? (swap[5].toLowerCase() === BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() ? "0.1" : "10"),
              }),
              status: options.orderStatus ?? "FINISHED",
              slippage: "1",
              txHash: `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`,
              bookTime: options.orderHistoryTime ?? "2026-04-01T23:50:10+08:00",
              updatedTime: "2026-04-01T23:50:12+08:00",
              ...(options.refund ? { refund: [{ tokenAddress: fromToken, amount: "0.1", symbol: "USDT" }] } : {}),
            }],
          },
        }),
      };
    }
    throw new Error(`Unexpected CLI command: ${args.join(" ")}`);
  };
  const dependencies = {
    store,
    runner,
    readSnapshot: async () => options.snapshot ?? snapshot,
    resolveAsset: async (address) => address.toLowerCase() === TOKEN.toLowerCase() ? (options.asset ?? asset) : null,
    now: () => currentNow,
    sleep: async () => {},
    environment: {
      VERCEL: "",
      BAW_EXECUTION_ENABLED: "true",
      BAW_EXECUTION_KILL_SWITCH: "false",
      BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_ORDER_USDT: "1000",
      BAW_EXECUTION_DAILY_LIMIT_USDT: "5000",
      BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS: "100",
      BAW_EXECUTION_MIN_BNB_RESERVE: "0.01",
    },
  };
  return {
    store,
    calls,
    runner,
    asset: options.asset ?? asset,
    dependencies,
    setNow(value) { currentNow = value; },
  };
}

async function createQuote(harness, direction = "BUY") {
  return getBawQuote({
    direction,
    tokenAddress: TOKEN,
    amount: direction === "BUY" ? "10" : "0.1",
    chainId: "56",
    slippageBps: 100,
  }, {
    runner: harness.runner,
    readSnapshot: async () => makeSnapshot(),
    resolveAsset: async () => harness.asset,
    now: () => NOW,
  });
}

function request(body, token = TOKEN_VALUE) {
  return new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/approve", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "content-type": "application/json",
      ...(token ? { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

test("BAW output remains unverified while provider units and settlement semantics are undocumented", () => {
  const outputs = [
    "123.456789",
    "1.23456789",
    "0.1",
    "123.000000",
    "0.000000",
    "999.999999",
  ];
  for (const actual of outputs) {
    const result = compareBawOutputQuantity(actual);
    assert.equal(result.state, "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED");
    assert.equal(result.actualReceivedOutput, actual);
    assert.match(result.reason, /units and independent settlement semantics are not documented/i);
  }

  assert.equal(compareBawOutputQuantity(null).actualReceivedOutput, null);
});

test("mocked BUY and SELL execution flows keep provider-reported output unverified", async (t) => {
  for (const direction of ["BUY", "SELL"]) {
    await t.test(direction, async () => {
      const harness = makeHarness();
      try {
        const quote = await createQuote(harness, direction);
        const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies);
        assert.equal(approval.trade.direction, direction);
        assert.equal(approval.trade.chainId, "56");
        assert.equal(approval.trade.minimumOutputAmount, direction === "BUY" ? "0.099" : "9.9");
        const result = await executeApprovedBawTrade({
          executionId: approval.executionId,
          approvalToken: approval.approvalToken,
          securityAuditAcknowledged: true,
        }, harness.dependencies);
        assert.equal(result.state, "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED");
        assert.match(result.failureReason ?? "", /units and independent settlement semantics/i);
        assert.equal(result.providerOrderId, "1234567890");
        assert.equal(result.actualReceivedOutput, direction === "BUY" ? "0.1" : "10");
        assert.equal(result.transactionHash, `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`);
        const swap = harness.calls.find((args) => args[1] === "swap");
        assert.equal(swap[3], direction === "BUY" ? "10" : "0.1");
        assert.equal(swap[5].toLowerCase(), direction === "BUY" ? BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase() : TOKEN.toLowerCase());
        assert.equal(swap[7].toLowerCase(), direction === "BUY" ? TOKEN.toLowerCase() : BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase());
        assert.deepEqual(swap.slice(-5), ["--mev", "true", "--gasLevel", "MEDIUM", "--json"]);
      } finally {
        harness.store.close();
      }
    });

  }
});

test("approval is single-use, short-lived, and bound to the exact quote", async (t) => {
  await t.test("reused token", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness();
    try {
      const quote = await createQuote(harness);
      const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies);
      await executeApprovedBawTrade({ ...approval, securityAuditAcknowledged: true }, harness.dependencies);
      await assert.rejects(
        executeApprovedBawTrade({ ...approval, securityAuditAcknowledged: true }, harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "APPROVAL_USED",
      );
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });

  await t.test("tampered quote output", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness();
    try {
      const quote = await createQuote(harness);
      await assert.rejects(
        createBawExecutionApproval({ ...quote, toCoinAmount: "9" }, harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "QUOTE_INVALID",
      );
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });

  await t.test("expired approval", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness();
    try {
      const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(await createQuote(harness), harness.dependencies);
      harness.setNow(approval.expiresAt + 1);
      await assert.rejects(
        executeApprovedBawTrade({ ...approval, securityAuditAcknowledged: true }, harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "APPROVAL_EXPIRED",
      );
      assert.equal((await harness.store.get(approval.executionId)).state, "EXPIRED");
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });

  await t.test("invalid approval token does not consume the valid approval", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness();
    try {
      const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(await createQuote(harness), harness.dependencies);
      const lastCharacter = approval.approvalToken.at(-1);
      const invalidToken = `${approval.approvalToken.slice(0, -1)}${lastCharacter === "x" ? "y" : "x"}`;
      await assert.rejects(
        executeApprovedBawTrade({ ...approval, approvalToken: invalidToken, securityAuditAcknowledged: true }, harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "APPROVAL_USED",
      );
      assert.equal(
        (await executeApprovedBawTrade({ ...approval, securityAuditAcknowledged: true }, harness.dependencies)).state,
        "FINISHED_UNVERIFIED",
      );
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });

  await t.test("live quote changed after display", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness({ changedQuote: true });
    try {
      const quote = await createQuote(harness);
      await assert.rejects(
        createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "QUOTE_CHANGED",
      );
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });
});

test("persistent single-flight lock rejects a second prepared approval", async () => {
  const harness = makeHarness();
  try {
    const quote = await createQuote(harness);
    await createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies);
    await assert.rejects(
      createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies),
      (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "BUSY",
    );
  } finally { harness.store.close(); }
});

test("PostgreSQL execution records survive independent store instances", { skip: !process.env.BAW_TEST_DATABASE_URL }, async () => {
  const harness = makeHarness();
  const firstStore = new BawExecutionStore(process.env.BAW_TEST_DATABASE_URL);
  let firstStoreOpen = true;
  let secondStore;
  let thirdStore;
  try {
    harness.dependencies.store = firstStore;
    const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(await createQuote(harness), harness.dependencies);
    const record = await firstStore.get(approval.executionId);
    assert.equal(record?.state, "APPROVAL_REQUIRED");
    const challengeHash = createHash("sha256").update(randomBytes(32)).digest("hex");
    const sessionId = randomUUID();
    await firstStore.createChallenge(challengeHash, WALLET, NOW + 60_000, NOW);
    await firstStore.close();
    firstStoreOpen = false;
    await assert.rejects(firstStore.get(approval.executionId));
    secondStore = new BawExecutionStore(process.env.BAW_TEST_DATABASE_URL);
    try {
      assert.equal((await secondStore.get(approval.executionId))?.state, "APPROVAL_REQUIRED");
      thirdStore = new BawExecutionStore(process.env.BAW_TEST_DATABASE_URL);
      const sessionAttempts = await Promise.all([
        secondStore.consumeChallengeAndCreateSession(challengeHash, WALLET, NOW + 1, sessionId, NOW + 60_000),
        thirdStore.consumeChallengeAndCreateSession(challengeHash, WALLET, NOW + 1, sessionId, NOW + 60_000),
      ]);
      assert.deepEqual(sessionAttempts.sort(), [false, true]);
      assert.deepEqual(await thirdStore.getSession(sessionId, NOW + 2), {
        address: WALLET,
        expiresAt: NOW + 60_000,
      });
      await secondStore.revokeSession(sessionId, NOW + 3);
      assert.equal(await thirdStore.getSession(sessionId, NOW + 4), null);
      await assert.rejects(
        secondStore.createApproval(record, "0".repeat(64), NOW + 10_000, NOW),
        (error) => error?.code === "BUSY",
      );
      const approvalHash = createHash("sha256").update(approval.approvalToken).digest("hex");
      const consumptions = await Promise.allSettled([
        secondStore.consumeApproval(approval.executionId, approvalHash, NOW),
        thirdStore.consumeApproval(approval.executionId, approvalHash, NOW),
      ]);
      assert.equal(consumptions.filter((result) => result.status === "fulfilled").length, 1);
      assert.equal(consumptions.filter((result) => result.status === "rejected").length, 1);
      assert.equal(consumptions.find((result) => result.status === "rejected")?.reason?.code, "USED");
    } finally {
      const cleanup = secondStore ? await secondStore.get(approval.executionId) : null;
      if (cleanup) {
        cleanup.state = "FAILED";
        await secondStore.update(cleanup);
      }
    }
  } finally {
    harness.store.close();
    if (thirdStore) await thirdStore.close();
    if (secondStore) await secondStore.close();
    if (firstStoreOpen) await firstStore.close();
  }
});

  const harness = makeHarness();
  try {
    harness.dependencies.environment.BAW_EXECUTION_DAILY_LIMIT_USDT = "10";

    await assert.rejects(
      createBawExecutionApproval(await createQuote(harness), harness.dependencies),
      (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "DAILY_LIMIT",
    );
  } finally {
    harness.store.close();
  }
});

  const harness = makeHarness();
  try {
    const approval = await createBawExecutionApproval(await createQuote(harness), harness.dependencies);
    const request = { ...approval, securityAuditAcknowledged: true };
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      executeApprovedBawTrade(request, harness.dependencies),
      executeApprovedBawTrade(request, harness.dependencies),
    ]);
    assert.equal(results.filter((result) => result.status === "fulfilled").length, 1);
    assert.equal(harness.calls.filter((args) => args[1] === "swap").length, 1);
  } finally {
    harness.store.close();
  }
});

test("wallet, token, chain, session, balance, and kill-switch failures fail closed", async (t) => {
  const cases = [
    ["disconnected wallet", { connected: false }, "WALLET_DISCONNECTED", "BUY"],
    ["unsupported chain", { chains: [] }, "UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN", "BUY"],
    ["expired session", { settings: { ...makeSnapshot().settings, sessionExpireTime: new Date(NOW - 1).toISOString() } }, "WALLET_SESSION_EXPIRED", "BUY"],
    ["insufficient USDT balance", { balances: [] }, "INSUFFICIENT_TRADE_BALANCE", "BUY"],
    ["insufficient selected-token balance", {
      balances: makeSnapshot().balances.filter((balance) => balance.symbol !== "AAPLon"),
    }, "INSUFFICIENT_TRADE_BALANCE", "SELL"],
    ["insufficient BNB reserve", {
      balances: makeSnapshot().balances.map((balance) => balance.symbol === "BNB" ? { ...balance, balance: "0" } : balance),
    }, "INSUFFICIENT_FEE_RESERVE", "BUY"],
  ];
  for (const [label, snapshotPatch, code, direction] of cases) {
    await t.test(label, async () => {
      const harness = makeHarness({ snapshot: makeSnapshot(snapshotPatch) });
      try {
        const quote = await createQuote(harness, direction);
        await assert.rejects(
          createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies),
          (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === code,
        );
      } finally { harness.store.close(); }
    });
  }

  await t.test("unconfigured token asset", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness();
    try {
      const quote = await createQuote(harness);
      harness.dependencies.resolveAsset = async () => null;
      await assert.rejects(createBawExecutionApproval(quote, harness.dependencies));
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });

  await t.test("kill switch", async () => {
    const harness = makeHarness();
    try {
      harness.dependencies.environment.BAW_EXECUTION_KILL_SWITCH = "true";
      await assert.rejects(
        createBawExecutionApproval({}, harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "EXECUTION_DISABLED",
      );
    } finally { harness.store.close(); }
  });
});

test("missing and excessive execution limits keep order submission disabled", async (t) => {
  const cases = [
    ["missing slippage limit", "BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS", undefined],
    ["slippage over hard cap", "BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS", "101"],
    ["order over hard cap", "BAW_EXECUTION_MAX_ORDER_USDT", "1001"],
    ["daily amount over hard cap", "BAW_EXECUTION_DAILY_LIMIT_USDT", "5001"],
    ["BNB reserve below minimum", "BAW_EXECUTION_MIN_BNB_RESERVE", "0.009"],
  ];
  for (const [label, key, value] of cases) {
    await t.test(label, async () => {
      const harness = makeHarness();
      try {
        if (value === undefined) delete harness.dependencies.environment[key];
        else harness.dependencies.environment[key] = value;
        await assert.rejects(
          createBawExecutionApproval(await createQuote(harness), harness.dependencies),
          (error) => error instanceof BawExecutionError && error.code === "EXECUTION_LIMITS_NOT_CONFIGURED",
        );
        assert.equal(harness.calls.some((args) => args[1] === "swap"), false);
      } finally { harness.store.close(); }
    });
  }
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { BawExecutionMemoryTestStore } from "../services/bawExecutionStore.testAdapter.ts";
import {
  authorizeBawWalletRequest,
  isBawBrowserWalletAllowlistConfigured,
  createBawWalletSession,
  createBawWalletSessionChallenge,
  getBawWalletSession,
  revokeBawWalletSession,
} from "../services/bawWalletAuth.ts";

const TOKEN = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";

test("authorized browser-wallet session uses a one-time challenge and revocable HttpOnly cookie", async () => {
  const account = privateKeyToAccount(`0x${"11".repeat(32)}`);
  const now = 1_800_000_000_000;
  const store = new BawExecutionMemoryTestStore();
  const authOptions = { store, authorizedWallets: account.address };
  try {
    assert.equal(isBawBrowserWalletAllowlistConfigured(""), false);
    assert.equal(isBawBrowserWalletAllowlistConfigured("not-an-address"), false);
    assert.equal(isBawBrowserWalletAllowlistConfigured(account.address), true);
    const challengeRequest = new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/session/challenge", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { origin: "https://wolv.test" },
    });
    const challenge = await createBawWalletSessionChallenge(account.address, challengeRequest, TOKEN, {
      ...authOptions,
      now,
    });
    assert.ok(challenge);
    const signature = await account.signMessage({ message: challenge.message });
    const sessionRequest = new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/session", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { origin: "https://wolv.test" },
    });
    const session = await createBawWalletSession({
      address: account.address,
      message: challenge.message,
      signature,
    }, sessionRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 1 });
    assert.ok(session);
    assert.match(session.cookie, /HttpOnly/);
    assert.match(session.cookie, /SameSite=Strict/);
    assert.match(session.cookie, /Secure/);
    assert.equal(session.cookie.includes(TOKEN), false);

    const authorizedRequest = new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/execute", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        origin: "https://wolv.test",
        cookie: session.cookie.split(";")[0],
      },
    });
    assert.equal(await authorizeBawWalletRequest(authorizedRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 2 }), "authorized");
    assert.equal((await getBawWalletSession(authorizedRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 2 }))?.address, account.address.toLowerCase());
    assert.equal(await getBawWalletSession(authorizedRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: session.expiresAt }), null);

    const [cookieName, cookieValue] = session.cookie.split(";")[0].split("=");
    const tamperedValue = `${cookieValue.slice(0, -1)}${cookieValue.endsWith("a") ? "b" : "a"}`;
    const tamperedRequest = new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/execute", {
      headers: { cookie: `${cookieName}=${tamperedValue}` },
    });
    assert.equal(await getBawWalletSession(tamperedRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 2 }), null);

    const crossSiteRequest = new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/execute", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        origin: "https://attacker.test",
        cookie: session.cookie.split(";")[0],
      },
    });
    assert.equal(await authorizeBawWalletRequest(crossSiteRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 2 }), "unauthorized");

    await revokeBawWalletSession(authorizedRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 3 });
    assert.equal(await getBawWalletSession(authorizedRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 4 }), null);

    const replay = await createBawWalletSession({
      address: account.address,
      message: challenge.message,
      signature,
    }, sessionRequest, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 5 });
    assert.equal(replay, null);
  } finally {
    await store.close();
  }
});

test("browser-wallet authentication rejects unlisted identities, altered, expired, and invalidly signed challenges", async () => {
  const account = privateKeyToAccount(`0x${"22".repeat(32)}`);
  const unlisted = privateKeyToAccount(`0x${"33".repeat(32)}`);
  const now = 1_800_000_000_000;
  const store = new BawExecutionMemoryTestStore();
  const authOptions = { store, authorizedWallets: account.address };
  try {
    const request = new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/session", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { origin: "https://wolv.test" },
    });
    assert.equal(await createBawWalletSessionChallenge(unlisted.address, request, TOKEN, {
      ...authOptions,
      now,
    }), null);

    const challenge = await createBawWalletSessionChallenge(account.address, request, TOKEN, {
      ...authOptions,
      now,
    });
    assert.ok(challenge);
    const signature = await account.signMessage({ message: challenge.message });
    assert.equal(await createBawWalletSession({
      address: account.address,
      message: `${challenge.message} altered`,
      signature,
    }, request, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 1 }), null);
    assert.equal(await createBawWalletSession({
      address: account.address,
      message: challenge.message,
      signature,
    }, request, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: challenge.expiresAt }), null);
    assert.equal(await createBawWalletSession({
      address: account.address,
      message: challenge.message,
      signature: `0x${"00".repeat(65)}`,
    }, request, TOKEN, { ...authOptions, now: now + 1 }), null);
  } finally {
    await store.close();
  }
});

const TEST_DATABASE_URL = process.env.TEST_POSTGRES_URL;

if (!TEST_DATABASE_URL) {
  console.error("PostgreSQL integration tests are blocked: set TEST_POSTGRES_URL to a disposable database URL before running npm run test:postgres.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const testUrl = new URL(TEST_DATABASE_URL);
const allowedHosts = new Set(["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"]);
const databaseName = decodeURIComponent(testUrl.pathname.slice(1));
const databaseNameParts = databaseName.toLowerCase().split(/[_-]/);
if (!["postgres:", "postgresql:"].includes(testUrl.protocol) || !testUrl.username || !testUrl.password) {
  throw new Error("TEST_POSTGRES_URL must be a PostgreSQL connection string for a disposable test database.");
}
if (
  !allowedHosts.has(testUrl.hostname) ||
  !databaseNameParts.some((part) => part === "test" || part === "testing")
) {
  throw new Error("TEST_POSTGRES_URL must target a local PostgreSQL database whose name contains a test component.");
}

const browserStore = new BrowserTradeIntentStore(TEST_DATABASE_URL);
const bawStore = new BawExecutionStore(TEST_DATABASE_URL);
const concurrentBrowserStore = new BrowserTradeIntentStore(TEST_DATABASE_URL);

before(async () => {
  await browserStore.initialize();
});

after(async () => {
  await browserStore.close();
  await concurrentBrowserStore.close();
  await bawStore.close();
  const sql = (await import("postgres")).default;
  const cleanup = sql(TEST_DATABASE_URL, { max: 1, idle_timeout: 5, connect_timeout: 3, prepare: false });
  try {
    await cleanup`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS wolv_trade_intents;`;
    await cleanup`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS wolv_trading_schema_migrations;`;
    await cleanup`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS baw_executions;`;
    await cleanup`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS baw_auth_challenges;`;
    await cleanup`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS baw_auth_sessions;`;
    await cleanup`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS baw_execution_schema_migrations;`;
    await cleanup`
      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS wolv_agent_memory_migrations, wolv_agent_market_candles,
        wolv_agent_market_observations, wolv_agent_asset_history, wolv_agent_runs,
        wolv_agent_events, wolv_agent_opportunities, wolv_agent_analyses,
        wolv_agent_policy_decisions, wolv_agent_risk_policies, wolv_agent_proposals,
        wolv_agent_control, wolv_strategy_evaluations CASCADE
    `;
    await cleanup`DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS wolv_agent_events_are_append_only();`;
    await cleanup`DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS wolv_agent_proposals_material_immutable();`;
  } finally {
    await cleanup.end({ timeout: 3 });
  }
});

test("browser trade intent store rejects expired and consumed quotes", async () => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const executionId = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";
  const quoteBinding = "expired-quote-binding";
  const intent = {
    executionId,
    quoteBindingHash: hashQuoteBinding(quoteBinding),
    quoteId: "22222222222222222222222222222222",
    walletAddress: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
    chainId: 56,
    direction: "BUY",
    inputTokenAddress: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955",
    outputTokenAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456",
    inputAmount: "1000000000000000000",
    expectedOutputAmount: "1000000000000000000",
    minimumOutputAmount: "900000000000000000",
    slippageBps: 50,
    quoteFetchedAt: now,
    expiresAt: now + 60_000,
    state: "CREATED",
    idempotencyKey: null,
    transactionHash: null,
    providerOrderId: null,
    failureCode: null,
    createdAt: 1_700_000_000_000,
    updatedAt: 1_700_000_000_000,
  };

  await browserStore.create(intent);
  await assert.rejects(() => browserStore.prepare(executionId, intent.walletAddress, intent.expiresAt + 1), /EXPIRED|CONSUMED/);
  const consumableIntent = {
    ...intent,
    executionId: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
    quoteBindingHash: hashQuoteBinding("not-expired-quote-binding"),
    quoteId: "2222222222222222222222222222222b",
  };
  await browserStore.create(consumableIntent);
  const prepared = await browserStore.prepare(
    consumableIntent.executionId,
    consumableIntent.walletAddress,
    consumableIntent.quoteFetchedAt + 1_000,
  );
  assert.equal(prepared.state, "PREPARED");
  await assert.rejects(
    () => browserStore.prepare(consumableIntent.executionId, consumableIntent.walletAddress, consumableIntent.quoteFetchedAt + 2_000),
    /CONSUMED/,
  );
});

test("browser trade intent store enforces single-use claim and idempotent submission", async () => {
  const executionId = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333";
  const quoteBinding = "concurrent-claim-quote-binding";
  const intent = {
    executionId,
    quoteBindingHash: hashQuoteBinding(quoteBinding),
    quoteId: "33333333333333333333333333333333",
    walletAddress: "0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333",
    chainId: 56,
    direction: "BUY",
    inputTokenAddress: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955",
    outputTokenAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789",
    inputAmount: "1000000000000000000",
    expectedOutputAmount: "1000000000000000000",
    minimumOutputAmount: "900000000000000000",
    slippageBps: 50,
    quoteFetchedAt: 1_700_000_000_000,
    expiresAt: 1_700_000_060_000,
    state: "CREATED",
    idempotencyKey: null,
    transactionHash: null,
    providerOrderId: null,
    failureCode: null,
    createdAt: 1_700_000_000_000,
    updatedAt: 1_700_000_000_000,
  };

  await browserStore.create(intent);
  const prepared = await browserStore.prepare(executionId, intent.walletAddress, intent.quoteFetchedAt + 100);
  const idempotencyKeys = [
    "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
    "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
  ];
  const claims = await Promise.allSettled([
    browserStore.claimSubmission(executionId, idempotencyKeys[0], prepared.quoteFetchedAt + 200),
    concurrentBrowserStore.claimSubmission(executionId, idempotencyKeys[1], prepared.quoteFetchedAt + 200),
  ]);
  const winners = claims.filter((claim) => claim.status === "fulfilled");
  assert.equal(winners.length, 1);
  assert.ok(winners[0].status === "fulfilled");
  assert.equal(winners[0].value.state, "SUBMISSION_PENDING");
  const winningKey = winners[0].value.idempotencyKey;
  assert.ok(winningKey);
  const retry = await browserStore.claimSubmission(executionId, winningKey, prepared.quoteFetchedAt + 300);
  assert.equal(retry.state, "SUBMISSION_PENDING");
  assert.equal(retry.idempotencyKey, winningKey);
  const loser = claims.find((claim) => claim.status === "rejected");
  assert.ok(loser?.status === "rejected");
  assert.match(String(loser.reason), /CONSUMED/);
  const updated = await browserStore.updateSubmission(executionId, "SUBMITTED", { transactionHash: "0x" + "a".repeat(64), providerOrderId: "order-1" }, prepared.quoteFetchedAt + 500);
  assert.equal(updated.state, "SUBMITTED");
});

    restartedStore = new AgentMemoryStore(TEST_DATABASE_URL);
    await restartedStore.initialize();
    assert.equal(await restartedStore.recoverStaleRuns(now, now - 300_000, ownerA), 1);
    assert.equal(await restartedStore.recoverStaleRuns(now, now - 300_000, ownerA), 0);
    const recoveredRun = await restartedStore.reconstructRun(interruptedRunId, ownerA);
    assert.equal(recoveredRun.run.run_status, "FAILED");
    assert.equal(recoveredRun.events.length, preRestartEventCount + 1);
    assert.equal((await restartedStore.reconstructRun(interruptedRunId, ownerB)), null);
    assert.ok(recoveredRun.events.every((event, index) =>
      Number(event.sequence_number) === index + 1 &&
      event.correlation_id === interruptedRunId));

    await restartedStore.savePolicy(ownerA, "default", policyFor("accept-v1", "100", now + 20 * 60_000), now, true);
    const successfulRun = await makeOrchestrator(restartedStore).run(runRequest("pg-successful-flow"));
    assert.equal(successfulRun.status, "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL");
    assert.ok(successfulRun.opportunityId && successfulRun.analysisId && successfulRun.proposalId);
    assert.equal(await restartedStore.getRecentProposalCount(ownerA, now - 60 * 60_000), 1);
    const successfulProposal = await restartedStore.getProposal(successfulRun.proposalId, ownerA);
    assert.equal(successfulProposal.proposal_status, "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL");
    assert.ok((await restartedStore.getPriorAnalyses(ownerA, String(successfulProposal.asset_id)))
      .some((analysis) => analysis.analysis_id === successfulRun.analysisId));
    const successfulOpportunity = (await restartedStore.listOpportunities({ ownerAddress: ownerA, limit: 20 }))
      .find((opportunity) => opportunity.opportunity_id === successfulRun.opportunityId);
    assert.ok(successfulOpportunity);
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(successfulOpportunity.evidence.observationIds));
    assert.ok(successfulOpportunity.evidence.observationIds.length >= 2);
    const successfulHistory = await restartedStore.reconstructRun(successfulRun.runId, ownerA);
    assert.ok(successfulHistory.events.some((event) => event.event_type === "ANALYSIS_RECORDED"));
    assert.ok(successfulHistory.events.some((event) => event.event_type === "POLICY_ACCEPTED"));

    const proposalSql = (await import("postgres")).default(TEST_DATABASE_URL, { max: 1, prepare: false });
    try {
      await assert.rejects(
        proposalSql`UPDATE wolv_agent_proposals SET intended_amount = intended_amount + 1 WHERE proposal_id = ${successfulRun.proposalId}`,
        /material fields are immutable/i,
      );
    } finally {
      await proposalSql.end({ timeout: 3 });
    }

    const crossOwnerRunResponse = await handleAgentRunGet(
      new Request(`https://wolv.test/api/agent/run?runId=${successfulRun.runId}`),
      {
        authorize: async () => "authorized",
        getOwnerAddress: async () => ownerB,
        createStore: () => new AgentMemoryStore(TEST_DATABASE_URL),
      },
    );
    assert.equal(crossOwnerRunResponse.status, 404);
    const crossOwnerProposalResponse = await proposalRequest(ownerB, successfulRun.proposalId, "APPROVE");
    assert.equal(crossOwnerProposalResponse.status, 404);
    const unauthenticatedRunResponse = await handleAgentRunGet(
      new Request(`https://wolv.test/api/agent/run?runId=${successfulRun.runId}`),
      {
        authorize: async () => "unauthorized",
        createStore: () => { throw new Error("Store must not be constructed before authentication."); },
      },
    );
    assert.equal(unauthenticatedRunResponse.status, 401);

    const approvalResponse = await proposalRequest(ownerA, successfulRun.proposalId, "APPROVE");
    assert.equal(approvalResponse.status, 200);
    assert.equal((await approvalResponse.json()).execution, "BLOCKED");
    const approvedHistory = await restartedStore.reconstructRun(successfulRun.runId, ownerA);
    assert.equal(approvedHistory.run.run_status, "COMPLETED");
    assert.equal(
      (await restartedStore.getProposal(successfulRun.proposalId, ownerA)).proposal_status,
      "EXECUTION_BLOCKED",
    );
    assert.ok(approvedHistory.events.some((event) => event.event_payload.to === "EXECUTION_BLOCKED"));
    const eventCountAfterApproval = approvedHistory.events.length;
    assert.equal((await proposalRequest(ownerA, successfulRun.proposalId, "APPROVE")).status, 409);
    assert.equal((await restartedStore.reconstructRun(successfulRun.runId, ownerA)).events.length, eventCountAfterApproval);

    now += 1_000;
    await restartedStore.savePolicy(ownerA, "default", policyFor("reject-v1", "1", now + 20 * 60_000), now, true);
    const policyRejectedRun = await makeOrchestrator(restartedStore).run(runRequest("pg-policy-refusal"));
    assert.equal(policyRejectedRun.status, "COMPLETED");
    assert.equal(policyRejectedRun.proposalId, null);
    assert.ok(policyRejectedRun.refusalReasons.some((reason) => /maximum/i.test(reason)));
    assert.ok((await restartedStore.getPolicyRefusals(ownerA, 20))
      .some((decision) => decision.run_id === policyRejectedRun.runId));
    const refusalHistory = await restartedStore.reconstructRun(policyRejectedRun.runId, ownerA);
    assert.ok(refusalHistory.events.some((event) => event.event_type === "POLICY_REJECTED"));
    assert.ok(!refusalHistory.events.some((event) => event.event_type === "TRADE_PROPOSAL_CREATED"));

    now += 1_000;
    await restartedStore.savePolicy(ownerA, "default", policyFor("accept-v2", "100", now + 20 * 60_000), now, true);
    const rejectedProposalRun = await makeOrchestrator(restartedStore).run(runRequest("pg-user-rejection"));
    const rejectionResponse = await proposalRequest(ownerA, rejectedProposalRun.proposalId, "REJECT");
    assert.equal(rejectionResponse.status, 200);
    assert.equal((await rejectionResponse.json()).status, "USER_REJECTED");
    assert.ok((await restartedStore.reconstructRun(rejectedProposalRun.runId, ownerA)).events
      .some((event) => event.event_payload.to === "USER_REJECTED"));

    now += 1_000;
    const expiringRun = await makeOrchestrator(restartedStore).run(runRequest("pg-expired-proposal"));
    now += 31_000;
    const expiredResponse = await proposalRequest(ownerA, expiringRun.proposalId, "APPROVE", now);
    assert.equal(expiredResponse.status, 200);
    assert.equal((await expiredResponse.json()).status, "EXPIRED");
    assert.equal((await restartedStore.getProposal(expiringRun.proposalId, ownerA)).proposal_status, "EXPIRED");
    assert.ok((await restartedStore.reconstructRun(expiringRun.runId, ownerA)).events
      .some((event) => event.event_payload.to === "EXPIRED"));

    await restartedStore.setEmergencyStop({
      ownerAddress: ownerA,
      stopped: true,
      reason: "Integration kill-switch check",
      permissionExpiresAt: null,
      updatedAt: now,
      correlationId: randomUUID(),
    });
    const controlState = await restartedStore.getControlState(now);
    assert.equal(controlState.emergency_stop, true);
    assert.equal(controlState.permission_active, false);
    await assert.rejects(
      makeOrchestrator(restartedStore).run(runRequest("pg-emergency-stop")),
      { code: "EMERGENCY_STOP" },
    );
    assert.equal((await restartedStore.listProposals(ownerB, 20)).length, 0);
  } finally {
    await restartedStore?.close();
    await store.close();
  }
});
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { buildOpportunityRow, buildVenueResult, getCrossListedPairs, marketLabel, normalizePerSharePrice, positiveNumberValue } from "../lib/opportunityMath.ts";

const now = 100_000;

function asset(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    tokenContractAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
    underlyingTicker: "WOLV",
    platformId: "ondo",
    tokenToShareRatio: 2,
    referencePrice: 200,
    volume24H: 100,
    statusInfo: { marketStatus: "open" },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function quote(usd, ts = now) {
  return { ok: true, usd, mode: "SWAP", vendor: "test", impact: 0.1, ts };
}

test("normalizes executable and reference values to per-share prices", () => {
  const result = buildVenueResult(asset(), quote(220), now);
  assert.equal(result.multiplier, 2);
  assert.equal(result.referencePerShare, 100);
  assert.equal(result.executablePerShare, 110);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(result.referenceGap - 10) < 1e-9);
  assert.equal(result.stale, false);
  assert.equal(result.unreliable, false);
});

test("excludes stale, over-cap, and reference-missing quotes from reliable spread", () => {
  const good = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "ondo" }), quote(200), now);
  const stale = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "bstock" }), quote(202, now - 30_001), now);
  const outlier = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "venue-c" }), quote(250), now);
  const noReference = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "venue-d", referencePrice: null }), quote(201), now);

  assert.equal(outlier.unreliable, true);
  assert.equal(noReference.referenceGap, null);
  assert.equal(buildOpportunityRow("WOLV", [good, stale]).crossVenueSpread, null);
  assert.equal(buildOpportunityRow("WOLV", [good, outlier]).crossVenueSpread, null);
  assert.equal(buildOpportunityRow("WOLV", [good, noReference]).crossVenueSpread, null);
});

test("computes spread only across at least two fresh, reliable, reference-backed venues", () => {
  const low = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "ondo" }), quote(200), now);
  const high = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "bstock" }), quote(210), now);
  const row = buildOpportunityRow("WOLV", [low, high]);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(row.crossVenueSpread - 5) < 1e-9);
});

test("reports market-status mismatch without suppressing the caution", () => {
  const open = buildVenueResult(asset({ statusInfo: { marketStatus: "open" } }), quote(200), now);
  const closed = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "bstock", statusInfo: { marketStatus: "closed" } }), quote(201), now);
  const row = buildOpportunityRow("WOLV", [open, closed]);
  assert.equal(row.statusMismatch, true);
  assert.deepEqual(row.statuses, ["open", "closed"]);
});

test("groups distinct venues and ranks pairs by their highest venue volume", () => {
  const pairs = getCrossListedPairs([
    asset({ underlyingTicker: "LOW", platformId: "ondo", volume24H: 20 }),
    asset({ underlyingTicker: "LOW", platformId: "bstock", volume24H: 30 }),
    asset({ underlyingTicker: "HIGH", platformId: "ondo", volume24H: 90 }),
    asset({ underlyingTicker: "HIGH", platformId: "bstock", volume24H: 80 }),
    asset({ underlyingTicker: "SINGLE", platformId: "ondo", volume24H: 999 }),
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(pairs.map((pair) => pair.ticker), ["HIGH", "LOW"]);
});

test("missing or non-positive share ratios and prices stay unavailable and cannot enter a spread", () => {
  const good = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: "ondo" }), quote(200), now);
  for (const ratio of [undefined, null, 0, "0", ""]) {
    const incomplete = buildVenueResult(asset({ platformId: `missing-${String(ratio)}`, tokenToShareRatio: ratio }), quote(201), now);
    assert.equal(incomplete.multiplier, null);
    assert.equal(incomplete.referencePerShare, null);
    assert.equal(incomplete.executablePerShare, null);
    assert.equal(incomplete.referenceGap, null);
    assert.equal(buildOpportunityRow("WOLV", [good, incomplete]).crossVenueSpread, null);
  }
  assert.equal(normalizePerSharePrice(200, undefined), null);
  assert.equal(normalizePerSharePrice(200, 0), null);
  assert.equal(normalizePerSharePrice(undefined, 2), null);
  assert.equal(normalizePerSharePrice(0, 2), null);
  assert.equal(positiveNumberValue(""), null);
  assert.equal(normalizePerSharePrice(Number.MAX_VALUE, Number.MIN_VALUE), null);
});

test("unknown market status remains unavailable rather than defaulting to closed", () => {
  assert.equal(marketLabel(asset({ statusInfo: undefined })), "status unavailable");
  assert.equal(marketLabel(asset({ statusInfo: { openState: undefined, marketStatus: null } })), "status unavailable");
  assert.equal(marketLabel(asset({ statusInfo: { openState: false } })), "closed");
  for (const marketStatus of ["UNKNOWN", "n/a", "unavailable", "unspecified", "pending", "—"]) {
    assert.equal(marketLabel(asset({ statusInfo: { openState: undefined, marketStatus } })), "status unavailable");
  }
});

import fs from "node:fs";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

const env = { ...process.env };
for (const line of fs.existsSync(".env.local")
  ? fs.readFileSync(".env.local", "utf8").split("\n")
  : []) {
  const match = line.match(/^\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/);
  if (match) env[match[1]] = match[2].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "").trim();
}

const BASE_URL = "https://web3.binance.com/build";
const USDT_ADDRESS = "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955";
const DEAD_WALLET = "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD";
const enabled = env.RUN_REAL_BINANCE_REGRESSION === "1";

async function signedGet(path, params = {}) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
  const fullPath = query ? `${path}?${query}` : path;
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  const signature = crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY ?? "")
    .update(timestamp + "GET" + "/build" + fullPath, "utf8")
    .digest("base64");
  const response = await fetch(BASE_URL + fullPath, {
    headers: {
      "X-OC-APIKEY": env.BINANCE_API_KEY ?? "",
      "X-OC-TIMESTAMP": timestamp,
      "X-OC-SIGN": signature,
      "X-OC-RECV-WINDOW": "60000",
    },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
  });
  let body;
  try {
    body = await response.json();
  } catch {
    body = null;
  }
  return { status: response.status, body };
}

test("real Binance provider parses RWA assets and indicative stock quotes", { skip: !enabled }, async () => {
  assert.ok(env.BINANCE_API_KEY, "BINANCE_API_KEY is required for real-provider verification");
  assert.ok(env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY, "BINANCE_SECRET_KEY is required for real-provider verification");

  const assetList = await signedGet("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens");
  assert.equal(assetList.status, 200, `Asset-list HTTP status; Binance code ${assetList.body?.code ?? "unknown"}`);
  assert.ok(Array.isArray(assetList.body?.data), "Asset-list data array is required");

  for (const ticker of ["NVDA", "AAPL", "TSLA"]) {
    const assets = assetList.body.data.filter((asset) =>
      String(asset.underlyingTicker ?? "").toUpperCase() === ticker
    );
    assert.ok(assets.length > 0, `${ticker} asset record was not returned`);

    for (const asset of assets.slice(0, 2)) {
      assert.match(String(asset.tokenContractAddress), /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/);
      assert.notEqual(Number(asset.tokenToShareRatio), 0);
      assert.notEqual(Number(asset.referencePrice), 0);

      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
      const quote = await signedGet("/api/v1/dex/aggregator/quote", {
        binanceChainId: "56",
        fromTokenAddress: USDT_ADDRESS,
        toTokenAddress: asset.tokenContractAddress,
        amount: "100000000000000000000",
        userWalletAddress: DEAD_WALLET,
      });
      assert.equal(quote.status, 200, `${ticker} quote HTTP status; Binance code ${quote.body?.code ?? "unknown"}`);
      const routes = Array.isArray(quote.body?.data) ? quote.body.data : [];
      assert.ok(
        routes.length > 0 || quote.body?.code === 40374,
        `${ticker} returned no routes and no documented minimum-order/provider code`,
      );

      const parsed = routes.map((route) => ({
        executionMode: route.executionMode ?? null,
        fromTokenAddress: route.fromToken?.tokenContractAddress ?? null,
        toTokenAddress: route.toToken?.tokenContractAddress ?? null,
        fromTokenAmount: route.fromTokenAmount ?? null,
        toTokenAmount: route.toTokenAmount ?? null,
        fromTokenDecimals: route.fromToken?.decimal ?? null,
        toTokenDecimals: route.toToken?.decimal ?? null,
        tokenUnitPricePresent: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(route.fromToken ?? {}, "tokenUnitPrice"),
      }));
      console.log(JSON.stringify({
        realProvider: {
          ticker,
          assetListHttpStatus: assetList.status,
          assetListCode: assetList.body?.code ?? 0,
          tokenAddress: asset.tokenContractAddress,
          quoteHttpStatus: quote.status,
          quoteCode: quote.body?.code ?? 0,
          routeCount: routes.length,
          parsed,
        },
      }));
    }
  }
});
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { generatePrivateKey, privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import {
  hashPolicyIntent,
  validatePolicyExecutionIntent,
  verifyPolicyIntentSignature,
} from "../services/policyIntent.ts";

test("policy intent accepts a valid owner signature and rejects tampering", async () => {
  const account = privateKeyToAccount(generatePrivateKey());
  const intent = {
    intentType: "WOLV_TESTNET_TRADE_INTENT",
    version: 1,
    ownerAddress: account.address,
    chainId: 97,
    smartAccountAddress: "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
    policyHash: "a".repeat(64),
    targetTokenAddress: "0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222",
    direction: "BUY",
    amountWei: "100000000000000000",
    slippageBps: 100,
    maxPriceImpactBps: 300,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + 60_000,
    nonce: "nonce-1234567890",
  };
  const { createPolicyIntentMessage } = await import("../services/policyIntent.ts");
  const signature = await account.signMessage({ message: createPolicyIntentMessage(intent) });
  const verified = await verifyPolicyIntentSignature(intent, signature);
  assert.equal(verified.ok, true);
  assert.match(hashPolicyIntent(intent), /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  assert.equal(validatePolicyExecutionIntent({ ...intent, chainId: 56 }, Date.now()).length > 0, true);

  const tampered = await verifyPolicyIntentSignature({ ...intent, amountWei: "200000000000000000" }, signature);
  assert.equal(tampered.ok, false);
});

test("US market calendar rejects missing configuration and malformed providers", async () => {
  const oldUrl = process.env.WOLV_US_MARKET_CALENDAR_URL;

  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchVerifiedUsMarketCalendar("2026-11-03", Date.now()),
    (error) => error instanceof UsMarketCalendarError && error.code === "NOT_CONFIGURED",

  process.env.WOLV_US_MARKET_CALENDAR_URL = "https://calendar.example.test/us";
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchVerifiedUsMarketCalendar("2026-11-03", Date.now(), async () => new Response("{", { status: 200 })),

  );
  if (oldUrl) process.env.WOLV_US_MARKET_CALENDAR_URL = oldUrl;
  else delete process.env.WOLV_US_MARKET_CALENDAR_URL;
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { encodePacked, keccak256 } from "viem";
import { hashAgentPolicy } from "../lib/agentPolicyHash.ts";

const TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456";
const SIGNER = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789";
const POLICY = {
  targetToken: TOKEN,
  maxTradeValue: 500_000_000_000_000_000n,
  expiresAt: 1_800_000_000n,
  intentSigner: SIGNER,
};

test("hashes policy fields using packed encoding in the documented order", () => {
  const expected = keccak256(encodePacked(
    ["address", "uint192", "uint64", "address"],
    [TOKEN, POLICY.maxTradeValue, POLICY.expiresAt, SIGNER],
  ));
  assert.equal(hashAgentPolicy(POLICY), expected);
  assert.notEqual(hashAgentPolicy(POLICY), hashAgentPolicy({
    ...POLICY,
    maxTradeValue: POLICY.maxTradeValue - 1n,
  }));
  assert.notEqual(hashAgentPolicy(POLICY), hashAgentPolicy({
    ...POLICY,
    intentSigner: TOKEN,
  }));
});

test("rejects zero policy addresses and values outside contract bounds", () => {
  assert.throws(
    () => hashAgentPolicy({ ...POLICY, targetToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" }),
    /must be nonzero/,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => hashAgentPolicy({ ...POLICY, maxTradeValue: 500_000_000_000_000_001n }),
    /0.5 BNB/,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => hashAgentPolicy({ ...POLICY, expiresAt: BigInt(1) << BigInt(64) }),
    /fit uint64/,
  );
});

test("authenticated API request returns the quote-only result without caching", async () => {
  let received;
  const response = await handleBawQuotePost(request(), {
    configuredToken: TOKEN,
    quote: async (input) => {
      received = input;
      return QUOTE;
    },
  });
  assert.equal(response.status, 200);
  assert.equal(response.headers.get("cache-control"), "no-store");
  assert.deepEqual(received, INPUT);
  assert.deepEqual(await response.json(), QUOTE);
});

test("unconfigured and invalid bearer authorization are rejected before the quote service", async (t) => {
  for (const [name, configuredToken, authorization, status] of [
    ["unconfigured", "", `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 503],
    ["missing", TOKEN, null, 401],
    ["invalid", TOKEN, "Bearer wrong", 401],
    ["wrong scheme", TOKEN, `Basic ${TOKEN}`, 401],
  ]) {
    await t.test(name, async () => {
      let called = false;
      const response = await handleBawQuotePost(request(INPUT, authorization), {
        configuredToken,
        quote: async () => {
          called = true;
          return QUOTE;
        },
      });
      assert.equal(response.status, status);
      assert.equal(called, false);
      assert.equal(response.headers.get("cache-control"), "no-store");
      assert.equal((await response.json()).status, "REJECTED");
    });
  }
});

test("invalid inputs, unsupported chains, malformed JSON, and oversized requests are rejected", async (t) => {
  const invalidCases = [
    ["unsupported chain", { ...INPUT, chainId: "CT_501" }],
    ["unsupported token address", { ...INPUT, tokenAddress: "not-an-address" }],
    ["invalid direction", { ...INPUT, direction: "SWAP" }],
    ["invalid amount", { ...INPUT, amount: "1e2" }],
    ["excess slippage", { ...INPUT, slippageBps: 501 }],
    ["extra fields", { ...INPUT, execution: true }],
  ];
  for (const [name, body] of invalidCases) {
    await t.test(name, async () => {
      let called = false;
      const response = await handleBawQuotePost(request(body), {
        configuredToken: TOKEN,
        quote: async () => {
          called = true;
          return QUOTE;
        },
      });
      assert.equal(response.status, 422);
      assert.equal((await response.json()).status, "REJECTED");
      assert.equal(called, false);
    });
  }

  await t.test("malformed JSON", async () => {
    const response = await handleBawQuotePost(request("{"), { configuredToken: TOKEN });
    assert.equal(response.status, 400);
  });

  await t.test("oversized body", async () => {
    const response = await handleBawQuotePost(request(
      { ...INPUT, extra: "x".repeat(9_000) },
      `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
    ), { configuredToken: TOKEN });
    assert.equal(response.status, 413);
  });
});

test("wallet-disconnected and BAW failures map to explicit rejected API results", async (t) => {
  const errors = [
    ["disconnected wallet", new BawQuoteError("WALLET_DISCONNECTED", "BAW wallet disconnected.", 409), 409],
    ["CLI timeout", new BawCliError("BAW_TIMEOUT", "quote"), 504],
    ["rate limit", new BawCliError("BAW_RATE_LIMITED", "quote"), 429],
    ["malformed BAW response", new BawCliError("INVALID_OUTPUT", "quote"), 502],
  ];
  for (const [name, error, status] of errors) {
    await t.test(name, async () => {
      const response = await handleBawQuotePost(request(), {
        configuredToken: TOKEN,
        quote: async () => {
          throw error;
        },
      });
      assert.equal(response.status, status);
      const body = await response.json();
      assert.equal(body.status, "REJECTED");
      assert.ok(body.error);
      assert.deepEqual(body.rejectionReasons, [body.error]);
    });
  }
});

const CATALOGUE_URL = "https://web3.binance.com/build/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens";
const PUBLIC_BSC_RPC = "https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org";
const ALLOWED_METHODS = [
  "eth_chainId",
  "eth_blockNumber",

  "eth_getCode",

export function createAuditPlan({
  primaryRpcUrl,
  secondaryRpcUrl = null,
  primaryOperator = "",
  secondaryOperator = "",
  concurrency = 1,
}) {
  const canCrossVerify = Boolean(
    secondaryRpcUrl &&
    primaryOperator.trim() &&
    secondaryOperator.trim() &&
    primaryOperator.trim().toLowerCase() !== secondaryOperator.trim().toLowerCase(),
  );
  return {
    mode: "DRY_RUN",
    network: "BNB Smart Chain mainnet",
    chainId: 56,
    catalogueRequest: {
      method: "GET",
      url: CATALOGUE_URL,
      authentication: "Signed Binance Web3 API headers; credential values are not displayed or recorded.",
    },
    eligibleAssetCount: "Unknown until the catalogue GET is explicitly authorized.",
    concurrency,
    maxRetries: 2,
    retryPolicy: "At most 2 retries for classified transient failures; same captured block and provider.",
    primaryRpcIdentity: redactRpcEndpointIdentity(primaryRpcUrl),
    secondaryRpcIdentity: secondaryRpcUrl ? redactRpcEndpointIdentity(secondaryRpcUrl) : null,
    secondaryRpcUse: canCrossVerify
      ? "Configured operator labels differ; cross-verification will be attempted."
      : secondaryRpcUrl
        ? "Not used for cross-verification: independent operator labels are absent or identical."
        : "Not configured; single-RPC verification only.",
    readOnlyRpcMethods: ALLOWED_METHODS,
    guarantees: [
      "No BAW CLI or BAW provider call.",
      "No wallet client, signing, approval, transaction-writing, deployment, or broadcast method.",
      "No arbitrary token addresses; contract reads are limited to unique eligible catalogue addresses and configured BSC USDT.",
      "RPC reads are pinned to one captured BSC block number.",
    ],
  };
}

export function requireExplicitConfirmation(answer, expectedPhrase) {
  return typeof answer === "string" && answer.trim() === expectedPhrase;
}

export function sanitizeCatalogue(response) {
  if (!isRwaAssetListResponse(response, { allowEmpty: true })) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The RWA catalogue response has an unexpected shape.");
  }
  const scalarKeys = [
    "tokenContractAddress", "underlyingTicker", "platformId", "underlyingName",
    "tokenName", "name", "symbol", "leverage", "leverageFactor",
    "tokenToShareRatio", "referencePrice", "decimals",
  ];
  return {
    data: response.data.map((record) => {
      const clean = {};
      for (const key of scalarKeys) {
        const value = record[key];
        if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" || value === null) {
          clean[key] = value;
        }
      }
      if (record.statusInfo && typeof record.statusInfo === "object" && !Array.isArray(record.statusInfo)) {
        clean.statusInfo = {
          ...(typeof record.statusInfo.openState === "boolean" ? { openState: record.statusInfo.openState } : {}),
          ...(typeof record.statusInfo.marketStatus === "string" || record.statusInfo.marketStatus === null
            ? { marketStatus: record.statusInfo.marketStatus }
            : {}),
        };
      }
      return clean;
    }),
  };
}

export function formatAuditPlan(plan) {
  return [
    "BSC asset metadata audit — DRY RUN",
    `Network: ${plan.network} (chain ID ${plan.chainId})`,
    `Catalogue request: ${plan.catalogueRequest.method} ${plan.catalogueRequest.url}`,
    `Eligible assets: ${plan.eligibleAssetCount}`,
    `Request concurrency: ${plan.concurrency}; maximum retries: ${plan.maxRetries}`,
    `Retry policy: ${plan.retryPolicy}`,
    `Primary RPC: ${plan.primaryRpcIdentity}`,
    `Secondary RPC: ${plan.secondaryRpcIdentity ?? "not configured"}`,
    `Secondary use: ${plan.secondaryRpcUse}`,
    `Read-only RPC methods: ${plan.readOnlyRpcMethods.join(", ")}`,
    ...plan.guarantees.map((item) => `- ${item}`),
    "No network request was made. Live access requires --live-read-only and interactive typed confirmations.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export async function fetchCatalogue(fetchImplementation = fetch) {
  const headers = makeBinanceAuthHeaders("GET", "/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens");
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImplementation(CATALOGUE_URL, {
      method: "GET",
      headers,
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
      cache: "no-store",
    });
  } catch {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The read-only RWA catalogue request failed.");
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError(`The read-only RWA catalogue request returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }
  let responseBody;
  try {
    responseBody = await response.json();
  } catch {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The RWA catalogue response was not valid JSON.");
  }
  if (!isRwaAssetListResponse(responseBody, { allowEmpty: true })) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("The RWA catalogue response has an unexpected shape.");
  }
  return sanitizeCatalogue(responseBody);
}

export function countEligibleAssets(catalogue) {
  return parseRwaAssetRecords(catalogue).filter(isSpotEligibleAsset).length;
}

export function formatAuditMarkdown(result) {
  const rows = [...result.assets, result.usdt].map((contract) => [
    escapeMarkdown(contract.symbol ?? "—"),
    `\`${escapeMarkdown(contract.tokenAddress)}\``,
    contract.eligibility,
    contract.contractCodePresent === null ? "unknown" : contract.contractCodePresent ? "yes" : "no",
    contract.decimals === null ? "—" : String(contract.decimals),
    contract.rpcVerificationCount,
    contract.status,
    escapeMarkdown(contract.errorClassification ?? "—"),
  ].join(" | "));
  return [
    "# BSC Asset Metadata Audit",
    "",
    `- Status: **${result.status}**`,
    `- Audit timestamp: ${result.auditTimestamp}`,
    `- Catalogue: ${result.catalogueSource}`,
    `- Sanitized catalogue SHA-256: \`${result.catalogueSnapshotSha256}\``,
    `- Eligible catalogue assets: ${result.eligibleAssetCount}`,
    `- Duplicate eligible addresses: ${result.duplicateEligibleAddressCount}`,
    `- Chain ID: ${result.chainId ?? "unverified"}`,
    `- Block: ${result.blockNumber ?? "unverified"}`,
    `- Block hash: ${result.blockHash ?? "unverified"}`,
    `- RPCs: primary \`${result.primaryRpcId}\`; secondary \`${result.secondaryRpcId ?? "not used"}\``,
    "",
    "| Symbol | Address | Eligibility | Code | Decimals | RPC count | Status | Error classification |",
    "|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|",
    ...rows,
    "",
    "This audit verifies only read-only contract metadata. It does not establish token legitimacy, share denomination, UI multiplier support, BAW quantity semantics, or provider settlement.",
    "No BAW operation, signature, approval, transaction, or broadcast was performed.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export function parseAuditArgs(args) {
  let liveReadOnly = false;
  let concurrency = 1;
  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
    if (args[index] === "--live-read-only" && !liveReadOnly) {
      liveReadOnly = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (args[index] === "--concurrency" && index + 1 < args.length) {
      const value = Number(args[index + 1]);
      if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY) {
        throw new BscMetadataAuditError(`Concurrency must be an integer from 1 to ${MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY}.`);
      }
      concurrency = value;
      index += 1;
      continue;
    }
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("Invalid audit arguments.");
  }
  return { liveReadOnly, concurrency };
}

async function main(args = process.argv.slice(2)) {
  let parsedArgs;
  try {
    parsedArgs = parseAuditArgs(args);
  } catch {
    console.error(`Usage: node --conditions=react-server --experimental-strip-types scripts/bsc-metadata-audit.mjs [--live-read-only] [--concurrency 1-${MAX_AUDIT_CONCURRENCY}]`);
    process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  const primaryRpcUrl = process.env.BSC_RPC_URL
    ? requireServerRpcUrl(process.env.BSC_RPC_URL)
    : resolvePublicRpcUrl(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL, PUBLIC_BSC_RPC, "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL");
  const secondaryRpcUrl = process.env.BSC_RPC_SECONDARY_URL
    ? requireServerRpcUrl(process.env.BSC_RPC_SECONDARY_URL)
    : null;
  const plan = createAuditPlan({
    primaryRpcUrl,
    secondaryRpcUrl,
    primaryOperator: process.env.BSC_RPC_OPERATOR ?? "",
    secondaryOperator: process.env.BSC_RPC_SECONDARY_OPERATOR ?? "",
    concurrency: parsedArgs.concurrency,
  });
  console.log(formatAuditPlan(plan));
  if (!parsedArgs.liveReadOnly) return;
  if (!process.stdin.isTTY || !process.stdout.isTTY) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("Live audit requires an interactive terminal for operator confirmations.");
  }
  await confirmInTerminal(
    "Type READ-ONLY CATALOGUE to make only the signed catalogue GET shown above:",
    "READ-ONLY CATALOGUE",
  );
  const catalogue = await fetchCatalogue();
  const eligibleCount = countEligibleAssets(catalogue);
  const rpcPlan = {
    ...plan,
    mode: "LIVE_READ_ONLY",
    eligibleAssetCount: eligibleCount,
  };
  console.log("\nCatalogue received and sanitized. No RPC request has been made yet.");
  console.log(JSON.stringify(rpcPlan, null, 2));
  await confirmInTerminal(
    "Type READ-ONLY BSC RPC to run the listed read methods for eligible catalogue assets and USDT:",
    "READ-ONLY BSC RPC",
  );
  await confirmInTerminal(
    "Type READ-ONLY FULL CATALOGUE AUDIT to inspect every eligible catalogue asset:",
    "READ-ONLY FULL CATALOGUE AUDIT",
  );

  const primary = createRpc("primary", process.env.BSC_RPC_OPERATOR ?? "", primaryRpcUrl);
  const secondary = secondaryRpcUrl && plan.secondaryRpcUse.startsWith("Configured operator labels differ")
    ? createRpc("secondary", process.env.BSC_RPC_SECONDARY_OPERATOR, secondaryRpcUrl)
    : undefined;
  const result = await auditBscCatalogueMetadata(catalogue, {
    primary,
    ...(secondary ? { secondary } : {}),
    evidenceMode: "LIVE",
    concurrency: parsedArgs.concurrency,
    maxRetries: 2,
  });
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(":", "-");
  const outputDirectory = path.resolve(__dirname, "../docs/audits");
  await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(path.join(outputDirectory, `bsc-metadata-audit-${timestamp}.json`), `${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
  await writeFile(path.join(outputDirectory, `bsc-metadata-audit-${timestamp}.md`), `${formatAuditMarkdown(result)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
  console.log(`\nSanitized audit files written under ${outputDirectory}.`);
}

async function confirmInTerminal(prompt, expectedPhrase) {
  const terminal = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  try {
    const answer = await terminal.question(`${prompt}\n> `);
    if (!requireExplicitConfirmation(answer, expectedPhrase)) {
      throw new BscMetadataAuditError("Operator confirmation did not match; no further network request was made.");
    }
  } finally {
    terminal.close();
  }
}

function createRpc(id, operator, rpcUrl) {
  const chain = defineChain({
    id: 56,
    name: "BNB Smart Chain",
    nativeCurrency: { name: "BNB", symbol: "BNB", decimals: 18 },
    rpcUrls: { default: { http: [rpcUrl] } },
  });
  return {
    id,
    operator,
    client: createPublicClient({ chain, transport: http(rpcUrl, { timeout: 10_000 }) }),
  };
}

function requireServerRpcUrl(value) {
  let url;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("Server-side BSC RPC URL is invalid; its value is redacted.");
  }
  if ((url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") || url.hash) {
    throw new BscMetadataAuditError("Server-side BSC RPC URL must use HTTP(S) without a fragment.");
  }
  return url.toString();
}

function escapeMarkdown(value) {
  return String(value).replaceAll("|", "\\|").replaceAll("\n", " ");
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  main().catch((error) => {
    console.error(error instanceof BscMetadataAuditError
      ? error.message
      : "BSC metadata audit failed; sensitive endpoint and credential details were suppressed.");
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
}

test("estimates Kernel UserOperation fees from the BSC public RPC", async () => {
  const methods = [];
  const publicClient = createPublicClient({
    chain: bscTestnet,
    transport: custom({
      request: async ({ method }) => {
        methods.push(method);
        if (method === "eth_getBlockByNumber") {
          return {
            number: "0x1",
            hash: `0x${"1".repeat(64)}`,
            parentHash: `0x${"2".repeat(64)}`,
            nonce: "0x0000000000000000",
            sha3Uncles: `0x${"3".repeat(64)}`,
            logsBloom: `0x${"0".repeat(512)}`,
            transactionsRoot: `0x${"4".repeat(64)}`,
            stateRoot: `0x${"5".repeat(64)}`,
            receiptsRoot: `0x${"6".repeat(64)}`,
            miner: `0x${"0".repeat(40)}`,
            difficulty: "0x0",
            totalDifficulty: "0x0",
            extraData: "0x",
            size: "0x1",
            gasLimit: "0x1c9c380",
            gasUsed: "0x5208",
            timestamp: "0x1",
            transactions: [],
            uncles: [],
            mixHash: `0x${"7".repeat(64)}`,
            baseFeePerGas: "0x3b9aca00",
          };
        }
        if (method === "eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas") return "0x3b9aca00";
        throw new Error(`Unexpected RPC method: ${method}`);
      },
    }),
  });

  const fees = await estimateKernelUserOperationFees(publicClient);

  assert.deepEqual(fees, {
    maxFeePerGas: 2_200_000_000n,
    maxPriorityFeePerGas: 1_000_000_000n,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(methods, ["eth_getBlockByNumber", "eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas"]);
});

test("blocks an overlapping wallet request until the active request settles", async () => {
  const runOnce = createSingleFlightGate();
  let resolveFirst;
  let duplicateCalls = 0;
  const first = runOnce(() => new Promise((resolve) => { resolveFirst = resolve; }));

  await assert.rejects(
    runOnce(async () => {
      duplicateCalls += 1;
      return "duplicate";
    }),
    /already in progress/
  );
  assert.equal(duplicateCalls, 0);

  resolveFirst("tx-hash");
  assert.equal(await first, "tx-hash");
  assert.equal(await runOnce(async () => "next-request"), "next-request");
});

test("releases the gate when a wallet request rejects", async () => {
  const runOnce = createSingleFlightGate();
  await assert.rejects(runOnce(async () => { throw new Error("wallet rejected"); }), /wallet rejected/);
  assert.equal(await runOnce(async () => "retry-after-settlement"), "retry-after-settlement");
});
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

  resolveBscTokenMetadata,
  selectTrustedBawSpotAsset,
} from "../services/bscTokenMetadata.ts";

const TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123";
const OTHER = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456";
const BLOCK = 0x1234n;

function catalogue(tokenAddress = TOKEN, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    data: [{
      tokenContractAddress: tokenAddress,
      underlyingTicker: "AAPL",
      platformId: "bStock",
      symbol: "AAPLB",
      referencePrice: "100",
      tokenToShareRatio: "1",
      statusInfo: { marketStatus: "open", openState: true },
      ...overrides,
    }],
  };
}

function rpcHarness(options = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  const values = new Map([
    [TOKEN.toLowerCase(), options.tokenDecimals ?? 8],
    [OTHER.toLowerCase(), options.otherDecimals ?? 6],
    [BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase(), options.usdtDecimals ?? 18],
  ]);
  const client = createPublicClient({
    chain: bsc,
    transport: custom({
      async request({ method, params }) {
        calls.push({ method, params });
        if (method === "eth_chainId") return options.chainId ?? "0x38";
        if (method === "eth_blockNumber") return "0x1234";
        if (method === "eth_getCode") {
          const address = params[0].toLowerCase();
          if (options.noCode?.has(address)) return "0x";
          return address === TOKEN.toLowerCase() && options.proxyCode
            ? "0x60006000"
            : "0x6080604052";
        }
        if (method === "eth_call") {
          const address = params[0].to.toLowerCase();
          if (options.revert?.has(address)) throw new Error("execution reverted");
          if (options.malformed?.has(address)) return "0x12";
          if (options.readFailure?.has(address)) throw new Error("RPC unavailable");
          const value = values.get(address);
          if (value === undefined) throw new Error("unexpected token address");
          return `0x${BigInt(value).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}`;
        }
        throw new Error(`Unexpected RPC method: ${method}`);
      },
    }),
  });
  return { client, calls, values };
}

function resolve(tokenAddress = TOKEN, options = {}) {
  const rpc = options.rpc ?? rpcHarness(options);
  const record = catalogue(tokenAddress).data[0];
  const trustedAsset = selectTrustedBawSpotAsset([record], tokenAddress);
  assert.ok(trustedAsset);
  return {
    rpc,
    promise: resolveBscTokenMetadata(trustedAsset, {
      client: rpc.client,
      now: () => options.now ?? 1_800_000_000_000,
    }),
  };
}

test("resolves selected-token and USDT decimals independently at one BSC block", async (t) => {
  for (const decimals of [0, 6, 8, 18]) {
    await t.test(`${decimals} selected-token decimals`, async () => {
      const { promise, rpc } = resolve(TOKEN, { tokenDecimals: decimals, usdtDecimals: 6 });
      const metadata = await promise;
      assert.equal(metadata.token.decimals, decimals);
      assert.equal(metadata.token.tokenAddress.toLowerCase(), TOKEN.toLowerCase());
      assert.equal(metadata.token.chainId, "56");
      assert.equal(metadata.token.resolutionSource, "BSC_ETH_CALL");
      assert.equal(metadata.token.blockNumber, BLOCK.toString());
      assert.equal(metadata.token.resolvedAt, 1_800_000_000_000);
      assert.equal(metadata.token.validationStatus, "VALIDATED");
      assert.equal(metadata.usdt.decimals, 6);
      assert.equal(metadata.usdt.tokenAddress.toLowerCase(), BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase());

      const calls = rpc.calls.filter((call) => call.method === "eth_call");
      assert.equal(calls.length, 2);
      assert.ok(rpc.calls
        .filter((call) => call.method === "eth_getCode" || call.method === "eth_call")
        .every((call) => call.params[1] === "0x1234"));
      assert.deepEqual(new Set(calls.map((call) => call.params[0].to.toLowerCase())), new Set([
        TOKEN.toLowerCase(),
        BSC_USDT_ADDRESS.toLowerCase(),
      ]));
      assert.ok(rpc.calls.every(({ method }) => [
        "eth_chainId", "eth_blockNumber", "eth_getCode", "eth_call",
      ].includes(method)));
    });
  }
});

  });
});

test("metadata resolution has no cache and never falls back after a failed refresh", async () => {
  const rpc = rpcHarness({ tokenDecimals: 6 });
  const asset = selectTrustedBawSpotAsset(catalogue().data, TOKEN);
  assert.ok(asset);
  const dependencies = { client: rpc.client, now: () => 1_800_000_000_000 };
  const first = await resolveBscTokenMetadata(asset, dependencies);
  assert.equal(first.token.decimals, 6);

  rpc.values.set(TOKEN.toLowerCase(), 8);
  dependencies.now = () => 1_800_000_061_000;
  const refreshed = await resolveBscTokenMetadata(asset, dependencies);
  assert.equal(refreshed.token.decimals, 8);
  assert.equal(rpc.calls.filter((call) => call.method === "eth_call").length, 4);

  rpc.values.delete(TOKEN.toLowerCase());
  await assert.rejects(
    resolveBscTokenMetadata(asset, dependencies),
    /decimals\(\) read failed/,
  );
});

function jsonResponse(body, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function unavailable(url) {
  return url.searchParams.get("tokenContractAddress") === RESPONSIVE_UNAVAILABLE_TOKEN;
}

if (process.env.WOLV_RESPONSIVE_FIXTURE === "1") {
  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis);
  globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => {
    const requestUrl = typeof input === "string" || input instanceof URL ? input.toString() : input.url;
    const url = new URL(requestUrl);
    if (url.hostname !== BINANCE_HOST) return originalFetch(input, init);

    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens")) {
      return jsonResponse({ success: true, data: assets });
    }
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/platforms")) {
      return jsonResponse({ success: true, data: [{ platformId: "ondo" }] });
    }
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/underlying-market")) {
      if (unavailable(url)) return jsonResponse({ success: false, code: 503, msg: "Responsive fixture: market data unavailable" }, 503);
      return jsonResponse({ success: true, data: { marketData: { peRatioTTM: 20, marketCap: 1_000_000, high52W: 120, low52W: 80 } } });
    }
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/underlying-profile")) {
      return jsonResponse({ success: true, data: { industry: "Test fixtures", country: "Test" } });
    }
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/api/v1/dex/market/candles")) {
      const now = Date.now();
      return jsonResponse({
        success: true,
        data: [
          ["99", "101", "98", "100", "1000", String(now - 3_600_000), "1"],
          ["100", "102", "99", "101", "1100", String(now), "1"],
        ],
      });
    }
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/api/v1/dex/aggregator/quote")) {
      const token = url.searchParams.get("toTokenAddress");
      if (token === RESPONSIVE_UNAVAILABLE_TOKEN) return jsonResponse({ success: true, data: [] });
      const inputAmount = url.searchParams.get("amount") ?? "100000000000000000000";
      return jsonResponse({
        success: true,
        data: [{
          quoteId: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
          binanceChainId: "56",
          executionMode: "RFQ",
          fromTokenAmount: inputAmount,
          toTokenAmount: "1000000000000000000",
          fromToken: {
            tokenContractAddress: "0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955",
            tokenUnitPrice: "1",
            decimal: "18",
          },
          toToken: {
            tokenContractAddress: token,
            decimal: "18",
          },
          vendorName: "responsive-mock",
          priceImpactPercent: "0",
        }],
      });
    }

    return jsonResponse({ success: false, code: 404, msg: "Responsive fixture: unsupported Binance endpoint" }, 404);
  };
}

test("encodes only a one-hop WBNB-to-target-token buy for the smart account", () => {
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_ID = "97";
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL = "https://rpc.example";
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_TESTNET_BUNDLER_RPC_URL =
    "https://bundler.example.test/rpc";
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ROUTER_ADDRESS =
    "0x9Ac64Cc6e4415144C455BD8E4837Fea55603e5c3";
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POLICY_HOOK_ADDRESS =
    "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123";
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_TARGET_TOKEN_ADDRESS =
    "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456";
  const config = getAgentSmartAccountConfig();
  const buildTime = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

  const call = encodeAgentBuyCall(
    {
      accountAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789",
      amountBnb: parseEther("0.001"),
    },
    100n,
    config,
  );
  const decoded = decodeFunctionData({
    abi: [{
      type: "function",
      name: "swapExactETHForTokens",
      stateMutability: "payable",
      inputs: [
        { name: "amountOutMin", type: "uint256" },
        { name: "path", type: "address[]" },
        { name: "to", type: "address" },
        { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
      ],
      outputs: [{ name: "amounts", type: "uint256[]" }],
    }],
    data: call.data,
  });

  assert.equal(call.to, config.routerAddress);
  assert.equal(call.value, parseEther("0.001"));
  assert.equal(decoded.functionName, "swapExactETHForTokens");
  assert.deepEqual(decoded.args[1], [
    config.wrappedNativeAddress,
    config.targetTokenAddress,
  ]);
  assert.equal(decoded.args[2], "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789");
  assert.equal(decoded.args[0], 100n);
  assert.ok(decoded.args[3] > BigInt(buildTime));
  assert.ok(decoded.args[3] <= BigInt(buildTime + 15));
});
