test("calculates a reserve-based quote and applies configured slippage", () => {
  const amountIn = parseEther("0.001");
  const reserves = {
    reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
    reserveOut: parseEther("1000000"),
  };
  const quote = calculateDynamicQuote(amountIn, reserves, 100, 300);
  const tighterQuote = calculateDynamicQuote(amountIn, reserves, 50, 300);

  assert.ok(quote.expectedAmountOut > quote.amountOutMin);
  assert.equal(quote.amountOutMin, quote.expectedAmountOut * 9900n / 10000n);
  assert.equal(
    tighterQuote.amountOutMin,
    tighterQuote.expectedAmountOut * 9950n / 10000n,
  );
  assert.ok(quote.priceImpactBps >= 30);
  assert.ok(quote.priceImpactBps < 300);
});

test("rejects empty pools, excessive price impact, and invalid slippage", () => {
  assert.throws(
    () => calculateDynamicQuote(1n, { reserveIn: 0n, reserveOut: 1n }),
    /reserves must both be greater than zero/,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => calculateDynamicQuote(
      parseEther("100"),
      { reserveIn: parseEther("1000"), reserveOut: parseEther("1000000") },
      100,
      300,
    ),
    /Price impact .* exceeds maximum 300 bps/,
  );
  assert.throws(
    () => calculateDynamicQuote(
      1n,
      { reserveIn: parseEther("1000"), reserveOut: parseEther("1000000") },
      501,
      300,
    ),
    /slippageBps must be an integer between 1 and 500/,
  );
});

test("records structured submitted and successful UserOperation telemetry", async () => {
  const records = [];
  const hash = `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`;
  const transactionHash = `0x${"b".repeat(64)}`;
  await runAgentExecutionWithTelemetry(
    {
      account: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789",
      targetToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456",
      amountBnb: parseEther("0.001"),
    },
    async onSubmitted => {
      onSubmitted(hash, { priceImpactBps: 35, slippageBps: 100 });
      return {
        userOperationHash: hash,
        receipt: { success: true, receipt: { transactionHash } },
        quote: { priceImpactBps: 35, slippageBps: 100 },
      };
    },
    record => records.push(record),
  );

  assert.deepEqual(records.map(({ event }) => event), [
    "attempted",
    "submitted",
    "succeeded",
  ]);
  assert.equal(records[1].userOperationHash, hash);
  assert.equal(records[2].transactionHash, transactionHash);
  assert.equal(records[2].priceImpactBps, 35);
});

test("records failed UserOperation telemetry with a stable rejection reason", async () => {
  const records = [];
  const hash = `0x${"c".repeat(64)}`;

  await assert.rejects(
    runAgentExecutionWithTelemetry(
      {
        account: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789",
        targetToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456",
        amountBnb: parseEther("0.001"),
      },
      async onSubmitted => {
        onSubmitted(hash, { priceImpactBps: 310, slippageBps: 100 });
        return {
          userOperationHash: hash,
          receipt: {
            success: false,
            reason: "UserOperation execution reverted",
            receipt: { transactionHash: `0x${"d".repeat(64)}` },
          },
        };
      },
      record => records.push(record),
    ),
    /UserOperation execution reverted/,
  );

  assert.deepEqual(records.map(({ event }) => event), [
    "attempted",
    "submitted",
    "rejected",
  ]);
  assert.equal(records[2].reasonCode, "USER_OPERATION_REVERTED");
  assert.equal(records[2].userOperationHash, hash);
});

const SECRET = "browser-trade-hardening-test-secret-at-least-32-characters";
const ORIGINAL_SECRET = process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
const TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123";
const WALLET = "0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678";
const EXECUTION_ID = "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000";
const QUOTE_ID = "00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff";
const AMOUNT = "10000000000000000000";
const NOW = 1_800_000_000_000;

before(() => {
  process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY = SECRET;
});

after(() => {
  if (ORIGINAL_SECRET === undefined) delete process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
  else process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY = ORIGINAL_SECRET;

class MemoryTradeStore {
  intents = new Map();
  initialized = false;
  failInitialize = false;

  async initialize() {
    if (this.failInitialize) throw new Error("database unavailable");
    this.initialized = true;
  }

  async close() {}

  async create(intent) {
    if (this.intents.has(intent.executionId)) throw new Error("duplicate intent");
    this.intents.set(intent.executionId, structuredClone(intent));
  }

  async get(id) {
    const intent = this.intents.get(id);
    return intent ? structuredClone(intent) : null;
  }

  async prepare(id, wallet, now) {
    const intent = this.intents.get(id);
    if (!intent || intent.walletAddress.toLowerCase() !== wallet.toLowerCase()) {
      throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_FOUND");
    }
    if (intent.expiresAt <= now) {
      intent.state = "EXPIRED";
      throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("EXPIRED");
    }
    if (intent.state !== "CREATED") {
      throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("CONSUMED");
    }
    intent.state = "PREPARED";
    return structuredClone(intent);
  }

  async reject(id, code) {
    const intent = this.intents.get(id);
    if (!intent || intent.state !== "PREPARED") throw new Error("invalid transition");
    intent.state = "REJECTED";
    intent.failureCode = code;
    return structuredClone(intent);
  }

  async claimSubmission(id, key) {
    const intent = this.intents.get(id);
    if (!intent) throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("NOT_FOUND");
    if (
      intent.idempotencyKey === key &&
      ["SUBMISSION_PENDING", "SUBMITTED", "UNKNOWN", "CONFIRMED", "OUTPUT_VERIFIED", "OUTPUT_MISMATCH", "REVERTED"].includes(intent.state)
    ) return structuredClone(intent);
    if (intent.state !== "PREPARED" || intent.idempotencyKey !== null) {
      throw new BrowserTradeIntentStoreError("CONSUMED");
    }
    intent.state = "SUBMISSION_PENDING";
    intent.idempotencyKey = key;
    return structuredClone(intent);
  }

  async updateSubmission() {
    throw new Error("not used");
  }
}

function quoteResponse(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    success: true,
    data: [{
      quoteId: QUOTE_ID,
      binanceChainId: "56",
      fromTokenAmount: AMOUNT,
      toTokenAmount: "100000",
      fromToken: {
        tokenContractAddress: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
        tokenUnitPrice: "1",
        decimal: "18",
      },
      toToken: {
        tokenContractAddress: TOKEN,
        decimal: "6",
      },
      executionMode: "RFQ",
      ...overrides,
    }],
  };
}

function dependencies(store, overrides = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  return {
    calls,
    values: {
      store,
      now: () => NOW,
      createExecutionId: () => EXECUTION_ID,
      isSpotToken: async () => true,
      getAssetList: async () => ({
        data: [{
          tokenContractAddress: TOKEN,
          underlyingTicker: "AAPL",
          platformId: "test",
          referencePrice: "100",
          tokenToShareRatio: "1",
        }],
      }),
      getQuote: async (...args) => {
        calls.push(args);
        return quoteResponse();
      },
      ...overrides,
    },
  };
}

async function createQuote(store, overrides = {}) {
  const deps = dependencies(store, overrides);
  const quote = await createBrowserTradeQuote(
    { toToken: TOKEN, amount: AMOUNT, wallet: WALLET },
    deps.values,
  );
  return { quote, calls: deps.calls, store };
}

test("mocked quote persists a BUY intent before returning the quote", async () => {
  const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
  const { quote, calls } = await createQuote(store);
  const intent = await store.get(EXECUTION_ID);

  assert.equal(store.initialized, true);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, [[TOKEN, AMOUNT, WALLET]]);
  assert.equal(quote.status, "QUOTED");
  assert.equal(quote.executionEligibility, "NOT_AVAILABLE");
  assert.equal(quote.tradeIntent.direction, "BUY");
  assert.equal(quote.tradeIntent.chainId, 56);
  assert.equal(quote.tradeIntent.fromTokenAddress, BSC_USDT_ADDRESS);
  assert.equal(quote.tradeIntent.toTokenAddress, TOKEN);
  assert.equal(quote.tradeIntent.minimumOutputAmount, "99500");
  assert.equal(intent.state, "CREATED");
  assert.equal(intent.inputAmount, AMOUNT);
  assert.equal(intent.expectedOutputAmount, "100000");
  assert.equal(intent.slippageBps, 50);
  assert.equal(intent.quoteBindingHash, hashQuoteBinding(quote.quoteBinding));
});

test("mocked quote API handler returns no-store-ready success and explicit errors", async (t) => {
  const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
  const deps = dependencies(store);
  const url = `https://wolv.test/api/quote?toToken=${TOKEN}&amount=${AMOUNT}&userWalletAddress=${WALLET}`;
  const response = await handleBrowserTradeQuoteRequest(new Request(url), deps.values);
  assert.equal(response.status, 200);
  assert.equal(response.body.status, "QUOTED");

  const missing = await handleBrowserTradeQuoteRequest(
    new Request("https://wolv.test/api/quote"),
    deps.values,
  );
  assert.equal(missing.status, 400);

  const failingStore = new MemoryTradeStore();
  failingStore.failInitialize = true;
  const failed = await handleBrowserTradeQuoteRequest(new Request(url), dependencies(failingStore).values);
  assert.equal(failed.status, 503);
  assert.match(failed.body.error, /storage is unavailable/i);
});

test("storage and input guards run before any provider quote request", async (t) => {
  await t.test("storage unavailable", async () => {
    const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
    store.failInitialize = true;
    let quoteRequested = false;
    await assert.rejects(
      createBrowserTradeQuote(
        { toToken: TOKEN, amount: AMOUNT, wallet: WALLET },
        dependencies(store, { getQuote: async () => { quoteRequested = true; return quoteResponse(); } }).values,
      ),
      (error) => error instanceof BrowserTradeQuoteError && error.status === 503,
    );
    assert.equal(quoteRequested, false);
  });

  for (const [label, input] of [
    ["invalid address", { toToken: "invalid", amount: AMOUNT, wallet: WALLET }],
    ["invalid amount", { toToken: TOKEN, amount: "1e18", wallet: WALLET }],
    ["dead wallet", { toToken: TOKEN, amount: AMOUNT, wallet: "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD" }],
  ]) {
    await t.test(label, async () => {
      const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
      let quoteRequested = false;
      await assert.rejects(
        createBrowserTradeQuote(input, dependencies(store, {
          getQuote: async () => { quoteRequested = true; return quoteResponse(); },
        }).values),
        (error) => error instanceof BrowserTradeQuoteError && error.status === 400,
      );
      assert.equal(quoteRequested, false);
    });
  }

  await t.test("unsupported asset", async () => {
    const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
    let quoteRequested = false;
    await assert.rejects(
      createBrowserTradeQuote(
        { toToken: TOKEN, amount: AMOUNT, wallet: WALLET },
        dependencies(store, {
          isSpotToken: async () => false,
          getQuote: async () => { quoteRequested = true; return quoteResponse(); },
        }).values,
      ),
      (error) => error instanceof BrowserTradeQuoteError && error.status === 400,
    );
    assert.equal(quoteRequested, false);
  });
});

test("malformed quote output and missing reference data fail closed", async (t) => {
  const cases = [
    ["missing quote id", { quoteId: undefined }, undefined],
    ["malformed quote id", { quoteId: "quote_123" }, undefined],
    ["wrong chain", { binanceChainId: "97" }, undefined],
    ["wrong execution mode", { executionMode: "SWAP" }, undefined],
    ["wrong source token", { fromToken: { tokenContractAddress: TOKEN, tokenUnitPrice: "1", decimal: "18" } }, undefined],
    ["wrong destination token", { toToken: { tokenContractAddress: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, decimal: "18" } }, undefined],
    ["missing output decimals", { toToken: { tokenContractAddress: TOKEN } }, undefined],
    ["non-string smallest-unit amount", { toTokenAmount: 100000000000000000 }, undefined],
    ["hex smallest-unit amount", { toTokenAmount: "0x16345785d8a0000" }, undefined],
    ["malformed output", { toTokenAmount: "0" }, undefined],
    ["missing reference price", {}, { data: [{ tokenContractAddress: TOKEN, referencePrice: null, tokenToShareRatio: "1" }] }],
  ];
  for (const [label, quoteOverrides, assetList] of cases) {
    await t.test(label, async () => {
      const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
      const providers = {};
      if (assetList) providers.getAssetList = async () => assetList;
      providers.getQuote = async () => quoteResponse(quoteOverrides);
      await assert.rejects(
        createBrowserTradeQuote(
          { toToken: TOKEN, amount: AMOUNT, wallet: WALLET },
          dependencies(store, providers).values,
        ),
        (error) => error instanceof BrowserTradeQuoteError && error.status === 502,
      );
      assert.equal(store.intents.size, 0);
    });
  }
});

test("browser quote binding rejects tampering, parameter substitution, and expiry", () => {
  const quoteBinding = createBrowserTradeBinding({
    executionId: EXECUTION_ID,
    quoteId: QUOTE_ID,
    wallet: WALLET,
    chainId: 56,
    direction: "BUY",
    fromToken: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
    toToken: TOKEN,
    amount: AMOUNT,
    slippageBps: 50,
  }, NOW);
  const expected = {
    executionId: EXECUTION_ID,
    quoteId: QUOTE_ID,
    wallet: WALLET,
    chainId: 56,
    direction: "BUY",
    fromToken: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
    toToken: TOKEN,
    amount: AMOUNT,
    slippageBps: 50,
  };

  assert.equal(verifyBrowserTradeBinding(quoteBinding, expected, NOW + 29_999).ok, true);
  assert.equal(verifyBrowserTradeBinding(`${quoteBinding}x`, expected, NOW).ok, false);
  assert.equal(verifyBrowserTradeBinding(quoteBinding, { ...expected, wallet: TOKEN }, NOW).ok, false);
  assert.equal(verifyBrowserTradeBinding(quoteBinding, { ...expected, chainId: 97 }, NOW).ok, false);
  assert.equal(verifyBrowserTradeBinding(quoteBinding, expected, NOW + 30_000).ok, false);
});

test("unsupported execution intent is atomically consumed and cannot be reused", async () => {
  const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
  const { quote } = await createQuote(store);
  const input = {
    executionId: quote.executionIntentId,
    quoteId: quote.quoteId,
    quoteBinding: quote.quoteBinding,
    wallet: WALLET,
    toToken: TOKEN,
    amount: AMOUNT,
    operation: "SWAP",
    now: NOW,
    store,
  };

  const rejected = await rejectUnsupportedBrowserExecution(input);
  assert.deepEqual(rejected, { ok: true, code: "UNSUPPORTED_SWAP_SCHEMA" });
  assert.equal((await store.get(EXECUTION_ID)).state, "REJECTED");
  const retry = await rejectUnsupportedBrowserExecution(input);
  assert.deepEqual(retry, {
    ok: false,
    status: 409,
    code: "CONSUMED",
    reason: "Trade intent has already been consumed.",
  });
});

test("expired bound intent is durably marked expired before rejection", async () => {
  const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
  const { quote } = await createQuote(store);
  const result = await rejectUnsupportedBrowserExecution({
    executionId: quote.executionIntentId,
    quoteId: quote.quoteId,
    quoteBinding: quote.quoteBinding,
    wallet: WALLET,
    toToken: TOKEN,
    amount: AMOUNT,
    operation: "SWAP",
    now: NOW + 30_000,
    store,
  });
  assert.equal(result.ok, false);
  assert.equal(result.status, 410);
  assert.equal((await store.get(EXECUTION_ID)).state, "EXPIRED");
});

test("intent submission is single-use, idempotent by key, and concurrent-safe in the adapter", async (t) => {
  await t.test("same idempotency key returns the existing intent", async () => {
    const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
    await createQuote(store);
    await store.prepare(EXECUTION_ID, WALLET, NOW);
    const key = "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174001";
    const first = await store.claimSubmission(EXECUTION_ID, key);
    const retry = await store.claimSubmission(EXECUTION_ID, key);
    assert.equal(first.state, "SUBMISSION_PENDING");
    assert.deepEqual(retry, first);
  });

  await t.test("different idempotency key cannot consume the same intent", async () => {
    const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
    await createQuote(store);
    await store.prepare(EXECUTION_ID, WALLET, NOW);
    await store.claimSubmission(EXECUTION_ID, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174001");
    await assert.rejects(
      store.claimSubmission(EXECUTION_ID, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174002"),
      (error) => error instanceof BrowserTradeIntentStoreError && error.code === "CONSUMED",
    );
  });

  await t.test("concurrent different keys allow exactly one claim", async () => {
    const store = new MemoryTradeStore();
    await createQuote(store);
    await store.prepare(EXECUTION_ID, WALLET, NOW);
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      store.claimSubmission(EXECUTION_ID, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174001"),
      store.claimSubmission(EXECUTION_ID, "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174002"),
    ]);
    assert.equal(results.filter((result) => result.status === "fulfilled").length, 1);
    assert.equal(results.filter((result) => result.status === "rejected").length, 1);
  });
});

test("approval calldata is exact, quote-bound, and limited to reviewed spenders", () => {
  const spender = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456";
  const trustedSpenders = [spender];
  const calldata = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: [{
      type: "function",
      name: "approve",
      stateMutability: "nonpayable",
      inputs: [{ name: "spender", type: "address" }, { name: "amount", type: "uint256" }],
      outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
    }],
    functionName: "approve",
    args: [spender, BigInt(AMOUNT)],
  });
  const input = {
    tokenAddress: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
    calldata,
    spender,
    quoteBoundSpender: spender,
    trustedSpenders,
    expectedAmount: AMOUNT,
    currentAllowance: "0",
  };

  assert.deepEqual(validateApprovalTransaction(input), { ok: true, spender, amount: AMOUNT, kind: "EXACT" });
  assert.equal(validateApprovalTransaction({ ...input, calldata: "0x1234" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateApprovalTransaction({ ...input, expectedAmount: "1" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateApprovalTransaction({ ...input, quoteBoundSpender: TOKEN }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateApprovalTransaction({ ...input, trustedSpenders: [] }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateApprovalTransaction({ ...input, tokenAddress: TOKEN }).ok, false);
});

test("approval validator supports only a necessary zero-reset approval", () => {
  const spender = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456";
  const calldata = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: [{
      type: "function",
      name: "approve",
      stateMutability: "nonpayable",
      inputs: [{ name: "spender", type: "address" }, { name: "amount", type: "uint256" }],
      outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
    }],
    functionName: "approve",
    args: [spender, 0n],
  });
  const input = {
    tokenAddress: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
    calldata,
    spender,
    quoteBoundSpender: spender,
    trustedSpenders: [spender],
    expectedAmount: AMOUNT,
    currentAllowance: "1",
    resetOnly: true,
  };
  assert.deepEqual(validateApprovalTransaction(input), { ok: true, spender, amount: "0", kind: "ZERO_RESET" });
  assert.equal(validateApprovalTransaction({ ...input, currentAllowance: "0" }).ok, false);
});

test("receipt verification requires successful status and expected token transfer", async (t) => {
  const recipientTopic = `0x${WALLET.slice(2).padStart(64, "0")}`;
  const transferLog = {
    address: TOKEN,
    topics: [
      "0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef",
      `0x${"0".repeat(64)}`,
      recipientTopic,
    ],
    data: `0x${BigInt("100").toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}`,
  };
  const base = {
    receipt: { status: "success", logs: [transferLog] },
    tokenAddress: TOKEN,
    recipientAddress: WALLET,
    minimumOutputAmount: "100",
  };

  assert.deepEqual(verifySwapReceiptOutput(base), {
    state: "OUTPUT_VERIFIED",
    receivedAmount: "100",
    reason: null,
  });
  await t.test("missing receipt", () => {
    assert.equal(verifySwapReceiptOutput({ ...base, receipt: null }).state, "UNKNOWN");
  });
  await t.test("reverted receipt", () => {
    assert.equal(verifySwapReceiptOutput({ ...base, receipt: { status: "reverted", logs: [] } }).state, "REVERTED");
  });
  await t.test("wrong recipient", () => {
    assert.equal(verifySwapReceiptOutput({
      ...base,
      receipt: { status: "success", logs: [{ ...transferLog, topics: [transferLog.topics[0], transferLog.topics[1], `0x${"0".repeat(64)}`] }] },
    }).state, "OUTPUT_MISMATCH");
  });
  await t.test("wrong token", () => {
    assert.equal(verifySwapReceiptOutput({ ...base, tokenAddress: WALLET }).state, "OUTPUT_MISMATCH");
  });
  await t.test("below minimum", () => {
    assert.equal(verifySwapReceiptOutput({ ...base, minimumOutputAmount: "101" }).state, "OUTPUT_MISMATCH");
  });
});

function createHarness(overrides = {}) {
  let now = Date.now();
  const telemetry = [];
  const failures = [];
  const sentCalls = [];
  const waitOptions = [];
  const signedTypedData = [];
  let intentSignature;
  const config = {
    chain: { id: 97 },
    rpcUrl: "https://rpc.test",
    bundlerRpcUrl: "https://bundler.test",
    routerAddress: router,
    policyHookAddress: hook,
    targetTokenAddress: TARGET,
    wrappedNativeAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
  };
  const receipt = {
    success: true,
    actualGasUsed: 200_000n,
    actualGasCost: 1_000_000n,
    receipt: { transactionHash: TX_HASH },
  };
  const accountClient = {
    account: { address: ACCOUNT },
    client: {},
    sendUserOperation: async ({ calls }) => {
      sentCalls.push(calls);
      return HASH;
    },
    waitForUserOperationReceipt: async options => {
      waitOptions.push(options);
      return receipt;
    },
  };
  const dependencies = {
    isLiveEnabled: () => true,
    getConfig: () => config,
    resolveAuthorization: async () => ({
      ownerValidator: {},
      sessionKeySigner: {},
    }),
    createIntentSigner: async () => ({
      account: {
        ...intentSigningAccount,
        signTypedData: async typedData => {
          signedTypedData.push(typedData);
          intentSignature = await intentSigningAccount.signTypedData(typedData);
          return intentSignature;
        },
      },
      getSignerData: () => INTENT_SIGNER,
    }),
    getNextIntentNonce: async account => {
      assert.equal(account, ACCOUNT);
      return INTENT_NONCE;
    },
    createAccountClient: async () => ({ account: accountClient.account, client: accountClient }),
    readValidator: async () => ({
      paused: false,
      installed: true,
      revoked: false,
      rollingVolume: parseEther("0.2"),
      policyConfigured: true,
      policyHash: POLICY_HASH,
      maxTradeValue: parseEther("0.5"),
      expiresAt: BigInt(Math.floor((Date.now() + 60_000) / 1000)),
      intentSigner: INTENT_SIGNER,
    }),
    buildBuyCall: async () => ({
      to: router,
      value: parseEther("0.1"),
      data: "0x1234",
      quote: {
        amountOutMin: 100n,
        expectedAmountOut: 120n,
        priceImpactBps: 35,
        slippageBps: 100,
        poolAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000999",
      },
    }),
    encodeBuyCall: (_request, amountOutMin) => ({
      to: router,
      value: parseEther("0.1"),
      data: `0x${amountOutMin.toString(16)}`,
    }),
    log: event => telemetry.push(event),
    onFailure: (intent, code, error) => failures.push({ intent, code, error }),
    now: () => now,
    receiptTimeoutMs: 20_000,
    receiptPollingIntervalMs: 1_000,
    ...overrides,
  };
  const intent = {
    strategyId: "aapl-entry",
    account: ACCOUNT,
    targetToken: TARGET,
    amountBnb: parseEther("0.1"),
    amountOutMin: 110n,
    priceImpactBps: 30,
    slippageBps: 100,
    maxPriceImpactBps: 300,
    sourcePriceMicros: 90_000_000n,
    createdAt: new Date(now).toISOString(),
    policyHash: POLICY_HASH,
  };

  return {
    executor: new AgentExecutor(dependencies),
    dependencies,
    intent,
    telemetry,
    failures,
    sentCalls,
    waitOptions,
    signedTypedData,
    get intentSignature() {
      return intentSignature;
    },
    receipt,
    setNow(value) {
      now = value;
    },
  };
}

test("disabled-by-default gate prevents authorization, account setup, and bundler calls", async () => {
  process.env.ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION = "false";
  let resolveCalls = 0;
  let accountCalls = 0;
  const harness = createHarness({
    isLiveEnabled: undefined,
    resolveAuthorization: async () => {
      resolveCalls += 1;
      return { ownerValidator: {}, sessionKeySigner: {} };
    },
    createAccountClient: async () => {
      accountCalls += 1;
      throw new Error("should never be called");
    },
  });

  await assert.rejects(
    harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent),
    error => error.code === "LIVE_SUBMISSION_DISABLED",
  );
  assert.equal(resolveCalls, 0);
  assert.equal(accountCalls, 0);
  assert.equal(harness.sentCalls.length, 0);
  assert.equal(harness.telemetry[0].code, "LIVE_SUBMISSION_DISABLED");
  assert.equal(harness.failures.length, 0);
});

test("submits a signed UserOperation and returns final receipt and gas accounting", async () => {
  const quoteRequests = [];
  const harness = createHarness({
    buildBuyCall: async (_client, request) => {
      quoteRequests.push(request);
      return {
        to: router,
        value: parseEther("0.1"),
        data: "0x1234",
        quote: {
          amountOutMin: 100n,
          expectedAmountOut: 120n,
          priceImpactBps: 35,
          slippageBps: request.slippageBps,
          poolAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000999",
        },
      };
    },
  });
  const result = await harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent);

  assert.equal(result.userOperationHash, HASH);
  assert.equal(result.transactionHash, TX_HASH);
  assert.equal(result.status, "success");
  assert.equal(result.gasUsed, 200_000n);
  assert.equal(result.gasCostWei, 1_000_000n);
  assert.equal(harness.sentCalls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(harness.sentCalls[0][0].to, router);
  assert.equal(harness.sentCalls[0][0].value, parseEther("0.1"));
  assert.ok(harness.sentCalls[0][0].data.startsWith("0x6e"));
  assert.ok(harness.sentCalls[0][0].data.length > 200);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData.length, 1);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].domain.verifyingContract, hook);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].primaryType, "TradeIntent");
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.smartAccount, ACCOUNT);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.policyHash, POLICY_HASH);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.router, router);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.tokenIn, harness.dependencies.getConfig().wrappedNativeAddress);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.tokenOut, TARGET);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.recipient, ACCOUNT);
  assert.ok(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.deadline > BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)));
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.amountIn, harness.intent.amountBnb);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.amountOutMin, 110n);
  assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData[0].message.nonce, INTENT_NONCE);
  assert.equal(BigInt(quoteRequests[0].deadline), harness.signedTypedData[0].message.deadline);
  assert.equal(
    await recoverTypedDataAddress({
      ...harness.signedTypedData[0],
      signature: harness.intentSignature,
    }),
    INTENT_SIGNER,
  );
  assert.equal(quoteRequests[0].slippageBps, harness.intent.slippageBps);
  assert.equal(quoteRequests[0].maxPriceImpactBps, harness.intent.maxPriceImpactBps);
  assert.equal(harness.waitOptions[0].hash, HASH);
  assert.equal(harness.waitOptions[0].timeout, 20_000);
  assert.deepEqual(harness.telemetry.map(event => event.event), [
    "userop_prepared",
    "userop_submitted",
    "userop_confirmed",
  ]);
  assert.equal(harness.failures.length, 0);
});

test("constructs the exact Kernel router call and 320-byte signed intent envelope", async () => {
  const harness = createHarness({
    buildBuyCall: async (_client, request, config) => {
      const call = encodeAgentBuyCall({
        accountAddress: ACCOUNT,
        amountBnb: parseEther("0.1"),
        deadline: request.deadline,
      }, 100n, config);
      return {
        ...call,
        quote: {
          amountOutMin: 100n,
          expectedAmountOut: 120n,
          priceImpactBps: 35,
          slippageBps: request.slippageBps,
          poolAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000999",
        },
      };
    },
    encodeBuyCall: (request, amountOutMin, config) => encodeAgentBuyCall({
      accountAddress: request.accountAddress,
      amountBnb: request.amountBnb,
      deadline: request.deadline,
    }, amountOutMin, config),
  });
  await harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent);

  const call = harness.sentCalls[0][0];
  const routerCalldata = call.data.slice(0, 2 + 228 * 2);
  const envelope = `0x${call.data.slice(2 + 228 * 2)}`;
  assert.equal((call.data.length - 2) / 2, 228 + 320);
  assert.equal(routerCalldata.slice(0, 10), "0x7ff36ab5");
  assert.equal((envelope.length - 2) / 2, 320);

  const routerCall = decodeFunctionData({
    abi: ROUTER_BUY_ABI,
    data: routerCalldata,
  });
  assert.equal(routerCall.functionName, "swapExactETHForTokens");
  assert.equal(routerCall.args[0], 110n);
  assert.deepEqual(routerCall.args[1], [
    harness.dependencies.getConfig().wrappedNativeAddress,
    TARGET,
  ]);
  assert.equal(routerCall.args[2], ACCOUNT);
  assert.equal(BigInt(routerCall.args[3]), harness.signedTypedData[0].message.deadline);

  const wordAt = (hex, byteOffset) =>
    BigInt(`0x${hex.slice(2 + byteOffset * 2, 2 + (byteOffset + 32) * 2)}`);
  assert.equal(wordAt(routerCalldata, 36), 128n);
  assert.equal(wordAt(routerCalldata, 132), 2n);

  const [policyHash, nonce, validUntil, slippageBps, maxPriceImpactBps, signature] =
    decodeAbiParameters(
      parseAbiParameters("bytes32, bytes32, uint64, uint16, uint16, bytes"),
      envelope,
    );
  assert.equal(policyHash, POLICY_HASH);
  assert.equal(nonce, INTENT_NONCE);
  assert.equal(validUntil, harness.signedTypedData[0].message.validUntil);
  assert.equal(slippageBps, harness.intent.slippageBps);
  assert.equal(maxPriceImpactBps, harness.intent.maxPriceImpactBps);
  assert.equal((signature.length - 2) / 2, 65);
  assert.equal(signature, harness.intentSignature);

  const executionCalldata = `0x${call.to.slice(2).padStart(40, "0")}${call.value.toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}${call.data.slice(2)}`;
  const kernelCallData = encodeFunctionData({
    abi: KERNEL_EXECUTE_ABI,
    functionName: "execute",
    args: [`0x${"00".repeat(32)}`, executionCalldata],
  });
  const kernelCall = decodeFunctionData({
    abi: KERNEL_EXECUTE_ABI,
    data: kernelCallData,
  });
  assert.equal(kernelCall.functionName, "execute");
  assert.equal(kernelCall.args[0], `0x${"00".repeat(32)}`);
  assert.equal(kernelCall.args[1].slice(2, 42), router.slice(2));
  assert.equal(BigInt(`0x${kernelCall.args[1].slice(42, 106)}`), call.value);
  assert.equal(kernelCall.args[1].slice(106), call.data.slice(2));
  assert.equal((kernelCall.args[1].length - 2) / 2, 52 + 228 + 320);
  const kernelArguments = `0x${kernelCallData.slice(10)}`;
  assert.equal(wordAt(kernelArguments, 0), 0n);
  assert.equal(wordAt(kernelArguments, 32), 64n);
  assert.equal(wordAt(kernelArguments, 64), 52n + 228n + 320n);

  assert.equal(
    await recoverTypedDataAddress({
      ...harness.signedTypedData[0],
      signature,
    }),
    INTENT_SIGNER,
  );
});

test("rechecks validator limits and rejects stale or malformed intents before dispatch", async t => {
  await t.test("validator cap", async () => {
    const harness = createHarness({
      readValidator: async () => ({
        paused: false,
        installed: true,
        revoked: false,
        rollingVolume: parseEther("0.95"),
      }),
    });
    await assert.rejects(
      harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent),
      error => error.code === "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
    );
    assert.equal(harness.sentCalls.length, 0);
  });

  await t.test("stale intent", async () => {
    const harness = createHarness();
    harness.setNow(Date.now() + 120_000);
    await assert.rejects(
      harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent),
      error => error.code === "INTENT_STALE",
    );
    assert.equal(harness.sentCalls.length, 0);
  });

  await t.test("intent expires while building the quote", async () => {
    const harness = createHarness();
    const buildBuyCall = harness.dependencies.buildBuyCall;
    harness.dependencies.buildBuyCall = async (...args) => {
      const call = await buildBuyCall(...args);
      harness.setNow(Date.now() + 20_001);
      return call;
    };
    await assert.rejects(
      harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent),
      error => error.code === "INTENT_STALE",
    );
    assert.equal(harness.sentCalls.length, 0);
  });
});

test("worker failure reporter trips the worker panic stop on repeated dispatch failures", async () => {
  const events = [];
  const alerts = [];
  const worker = new AgentWorker({
    strategies: [{
      id: "aapl-entry",
      account: ACCOUNT,
      targetToken: TARGET,
      amountBnb: parseEther("0.1"),
      entryPriceMicros: 100_000_000n,
      slippageBps: 100,
      maxPriceImpactBps: 300,
    }],
    readMarket: async () => { throw new Error("unused"); },
    readValidator: async () => { throw new Error("unused"); },
    log: event => events.push(event),
    alert: event => alerts.push(event),
  }, { intervalMs: 1000, maxConsecutiveFailures: 2, maxMarketAgeMs: 1000 });
  const reportFailure = createWorkerFailureReporter(worker);
  const harness = createHarness({
    onFailure: reportFailure,
    createAccountClient: async () => ({
      account: { address: ACCOUNT },
      client: {
        sendUserOperation: async () => {
          throw new Error("mock bundler rejected operation");
        },
        waitForUserOperationReceipt: async () => {
          throw new Error("should not poll");
        },
      },
    }),
  });

  for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {
    await assert.rejects(
      harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent),
      error => error.code === "BUNDLER_MEMPOOL_REJECTED",
    );
  }
  await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve));

  assert.equal(events.at(-1).reasonCode, "WORKER_PANIC_STOP");
  assert.equal(alerts.length, 1);
  assert.equal(alerts[0].priority, "high");
});

test("onchain account policy rejects missing, expired, capped, and mismatched intent bindings", async () => {
  const policyHash = `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`;
  const expiredHarness = createHarness({
    readValidator: async () => ({
      paused: false,
      installed: true,
      revoked: false,
      rollingVolume: parseEther("0.2"),
      policyConfigured: true,
      policyHash,
      maxTradeValue: parseEther("0.5"),
      expiresAt: 1n,
      intentSigner: INTENT_SIGNER,
    }),
  });

  test("refuses dispatch when the configured onchain intent signer differs from the session key", async () => {
    const harness = createHarness({
      readValidator: async () => ({
        paused: false,
        installed: true,
        revoked: false,
        rollingVolume: 0n,
        policyConfigured: true,
        policyHash: POLICY_HASH,
        maxTradeValue: parseEther("0.5"),
        expiresAt: BigInt(Math.floor((Date.now() + 60_000) / 1000)),
        intentSigner: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789",
      }),
    });
    await assert.rejects(
      harness.executor.executeUserOperation(harness.intent),
      error => error.code === "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
    );
    assert.equal(harness.signedTypedData.length, 0);
    assert.equal(harness.sentCalls.length, 0);
  });
  await assert.rejects(
    expiredHarness.executor.executeUserOperation({ ...expiredHarness.intent, policyHash }),
    error => error.code === "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
  );

  const mismatchHarness = createHarness({
    readValidator: async () => ({
      paused: false,
      installed: true,
      revoked: false,
      rollingVolume: parseEther("0.2"),
      policyConfigured: true,
      policyHash,
      maxTradeValue: parseEther("0.5"),
      expiresAt: BigInt(Math.floor((Date.now() + 60_000) / 1000)),
      intentSigner: INTENT_SIGNER,
    }),
  });
  await assert.rejects(
    mismatchHarness.executor.executeUserOperation({
      ...mismatchHarness.intent,
      policyHash: `0x${"b".repeat(64)}`,
    }),
    error => error.code === "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
  );

  const capHarness = createHarness({
    readValidator: async () => ({
      paused: false,
      installed: true,
      revoked: false,
      rollingVolume: parseEther("0.2"),
      policyConfigured: true,
      policyHash,
      maxTradeValue: parseEther("0.05"),
      expiresAt: BigInt(Math.floor((Date.now() + 60_000) / 1000)),
      intentSigner: INTENT_SIGNER,
    }),
  });
  await assert.rejects(
    capHarness.executor.executeUserOperation({ ...capHarness.intent, policyHash }),
    error => error.code === "VALIDATOR_PREFLIGHT_FAILED",
  );
});
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { buildRulesAnalysis, normalizeModelSummary, parseAnalysisRequest, readBoundedJson } from "../lib/marketAnalysis.ts";

function venue(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    platform: "ondo",
    status: "open",
    referencePerShare: 100,
    executablePerShare: 102,
    referenceGap: 2,
    quoteAgeSeconds: 5,
    stale: false,
    unreliable: false,
    quoteAvailable: true,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function analysisInput(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    ticker: "NVDA",
    spread: 2,
    statusMismatch: false,
    statuses: ["open"],
    venues: [venue(), venue({ platform: "bstock" })],
    ...overrides,
  };
}

test("analysis accepts a ticker and ignores browser-supplied market facts", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(parseAnalysisRequest({
    ticker: " nvda ",
    spread: 900,
    statusMismatch: false,
    venues: [{ referencePerShare: 1, executablePerShare: 999999 }],
  }), { ticker: "NVDA" });
});

test("analysis rejects invalid or oversized ticker identifiers", () => {
  assert.equal(parseAnalysisRequest({ ticker: "" }), null);
  assert.equal(parseAnalysisRequest({ ticker: "NVDA; buy now" }), null);
  assert.equal(parseAnalysisRequest({ ticker: "A".repeat(17) }), null);
  assert.equal(parseAnalysisRequest(["NVDA"]), null);
  assert.equal(parseAnalysisRequest(null), null);
});

test("model output must be a bounded summary without explicit trade promises", () => {
  const authoritativeText = "A 2.000% spread across 2 fresh venue quotes is informational and is not a guaranteed profit.";
  assert.equal(normalizeModelSummary({ summary: "Freshness and venue timing should be checked before acting." }, authoritativeText), "Freshness and venue timing should be checked before acting.");
  assert.equal(normalizeModelSummary({ summary: "There are 2 fresh venues at a 2.000% difference." }, authoritativeText), "There are 2 fresh venues at a 2.000% difference.");
  assert.throws(() => normalizeModelSummary({ summary: "Guaranteed profit; buy now." }, authoritativeText), /prohibited trading language/);
  assert.throws(() => normalizeModelSummary({ summary: "The spread is 25%." }, authoritativeText), /unsupported number/);
  assert.throws(() => normalizeModelSummary({ headline: "No summary" }, authoritativeText), /invalid summary/);
  assert.throws(() => normalizeModelSummary({ summary: " " }, authoritativeText), /empty summary/);
  assert.equal(normalizeModelSummary({ summary: "x".repeat(700) }, authoritativeText).length, 500);
});

test("deterministic market warnings cannot be replaced by a positive spread", () => {
  const sessionMismatch = buildRulesAnalysis(analysisInput({ statusMismatch: true, spread: 12 }));
  assert.equal(sessionMismatch.tone, "caution");
  assert.match(sessionMismatch.headline, /Session mismatch/);
  assert.match(sessionMismatch.nextStep, /Refresh/);

  const staleQuote = buildRulesAnalysis(analysisInput({
    spread: 12,
    venues: [venue(), venue({ platform: "bstock", stale: true })],
  }));
  assert.equal(staleQuote.tone, "caution");
  assert.match(staleQuote.reasons[0], /not enough fresh/);

  const outlier = buildRulesAnalysis(analysisInput({
    spread: 12,
    venues: [venue(), venue({ platform: "bstock", unreliable: true })],
  }));
  assert.equal(outlier.tone, "caution");
  assert.match(outlier.reasons[0], /reliability cap/);
});

test("deterministic read only reports a comparable spread from two usable venues", () => {
  const result = buildRulesAnalysis(analysisInput({ spread: 0.45 }));
  assert.equal(result.tone, "neutral");
  assert.match(result.reasons[0], /2 fresh venue quotes/);
  assert.match(result.reasons[1], /0\.450%/);
});

test("analysis request body parsing enforces the byte limit", async () => {
  const oversized = new Request("http://localhost/api/analyze", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-length": "2049" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ticker: "NVDA" }),
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await readBoundedJson(oversized, 2048), { ok: false, status: 413 });

  const withinLimit = new Request("http://localhost/api/analyze", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ticker: "NVDA" }),
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await readBoundedJson(withinLimit, 2048), {
    ok: true,
    value: { ticker: "NVDA" },
  });
});

test("analysis request body parser rejects malformed JSON", async () => {
  const malformed = new Request("http://localhost/api/analyze", {
    method: "POST",
    body: "{",
  });
  assert.deepEqual(await readBoundedJson(malformed, 2048), { ok: false, status: 400 });
});
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import {
  canExecuteTrade,
  displayOrderStatus,
  humanTransactionStatus,
  isFreshQuote,
  tradeErrorMessage,
  tradePhaseMessage,
  walletConnectionView,
} from "../lib/tradeReadiness.ts";

const ready = {
  isConnected: true,
  isCorrectNetwork: true,
  hasAddress: true,
  hasProvider: true,
  hasQuote: true,
  hasSwapData: true,
  quoteIsFresh: true,
  executionMode: "SWAP",
  swapSimulationStatus: "SUCCESS",
  requiresFreshQuote: false,
  isLoading: false,
  isSubmitting: false,
  isApproving: false,
  hasTransactionStatus: false,
  hasApprovalError: false,
  hasApprovalData: false,
  requiresTypedDataSignature: false,
  hasUserSignature: false,
};

test("allows direct SWAP only when its fresh quote has a successful simulation", () => {
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade(ready), true);
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...ready, swapSimulationStatus: "FAILED" }), false);
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...ready, swapSimulationStatus: undefined }), false);
});

test("blocks execution for each wallet, network, quote, approval, or pending-state blocker", async (t) => {
  const blockers = [
    ["disconnected", { isConnected: false }],
    ["wrong network", { isCorrectNetwork: false }],
    ["missing address", { hasAddress: false }],
    ["missing wallet client", { hasProvider: false }],
    ["missing quote", { hasQuote: false }],
    ["missing swap details", { hasSwapData: false }],
    ["expired quote", { quoteIsFresh: false }],
    ["fresh quote required", { requiresFreshQuote: true }],
    ["approval in progress", { isApproving: true }],
    ["submission in progress", { isSubmitting: true }],
    ["load in progress", { isLoading: true }],
    ["existing transaction state", { hasTransactionStatus: true }],
    ["approval error", { hasApprovalError: true }],
    ["approval still required", { hasApprovalData: true }],
  ];

  for (const [label, change] of blockers) {
    await t.test(label, () => assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...ready, ...change }), false));
  }
});

test("RFQ execution requires its typed-data signature, unlike a direct SWAP", () => {
  const rfqWithoutSignature = { ...ready, executionMode: "RFQ", requiresTypedDataSignature: true };
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade(rfqWithoutSignature), false);
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...rfqWithoutSignature, hasUserSignature: true }), true);
});

test("approval requires a fresh quote after approval, then the normal readiness checks apply", () => {
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...ready, hasApprovalData: true }), false);
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...ready, hasApprovalData: false, requiresFreshQuote: true }), false);
  assert.equal(canExecuteTrade({ ...ready, hasApprovalData: false, requiresFreshQuote: false }), true);
});

test("wallet connection presentation distinguishes hydration, connecting, error, disconnected, and connected", () => {
  const hydrated = { isHydrated: true, isInitializing: false, isConnecting: false, isConnected: false, hasError: false };
  assert.equal(walletConnectionView({ ...hydrated, isHydrated: false }), "checking");
  assert.equal(walletConnectionView({ ...hydrated, isInitializing: true }), "checking");
  assert.equal(walletConnectionView({ ...hydrated, isConnecting: true }), "connecting");
  assert.equal(walletConnectionView({ ...hydrated, hasError: true }), "error");
  assert.equal(walletConnectionView(hydrated), "disconnected");
  assert.equal(walletConnectionView({ ...hydrated, isConnected: true }), "connected");
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { createIntentNonceAllocator } from "../services/agentIntentNonceTracker.ts";

const ACCOUNT = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789";
const MIXED_CASE_ACCOUNT = "0xabcdef0000000000000000000000000000000789";

test("allocates a distinct padded bytes32 nonce atomically per normalized account", async () => {
  const values = new Map();
  const keys = [];
  const allocate = createIntentNonceAllocator(async key => {
    keys.push(key);
    const next = (values.get(key) ?? 0) + 1;
    values.set(key, next);
    await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve));
    return next;
  });

  const [first, second, third] = await Promise.all([
    allocate(MIXED_CASE_ACCOUNT),
    allocate(MIXED_CASE_ACCOUNT.toUpperCase().replace("0X", "0x")),
    allocate("0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000788"),
  ]);
  assert.equal(first, `0x${"0".repeat(63)}1`);
  assert.equal(second, `0x${"0".repeat(63)}2`);
  assert.equal(third, `0x${"0".repeat(63)}1`);
  assert.equal(new Set(keys).size, 2);
  assert.equal(keys[0], `wolv:agent:intent-nonce:${MIXED_CASE_ACCOUNT}`);
  assert.equal(keys[2], "wolv:agent:intent-nonce:0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000788");
});

test("fails closed on invalid addresses, failed Redis increments, and unsafe counters", async () => {
  const rejected = [
    createIntentNonceAllocator(async () => { throw new Error("offline"); })(ACCOUNT),
    createIntentNonceAllocator(async () => Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1)(ACCOUNT),
    createIntentNonceAllocator(async () => 0)(ACCOUNT),
    createIntentNonceAllocator(async () => 1)("not-an-address"),
  ];
  for (const result of rejected) {
    await assert.rejects(result, /nonce|address|Redis|counter/i);
  }
});
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { POST } from "../app/api/agent/execute/route.ts";

async function post(body, headers = { "content-type": "application/json" }) {
  return POST(new Request("http://localhost/api/agent/execute", {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
  }));
}

async function assertError(response, status, messagePattern) {
  assert.equal(response.status, status);
  const body = await response.json();
  assert.equal(body.code, status);
  assert.match(body.error, messagePattern);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(body).sort(), ["code", "error"]);
}

test("malformed JSON returns a structured 400 response", async () => {
  await assertError(await post("{"), 400, /valid UTF-8 JSON/);
});

test("oversized declared or streamed bodies return a structured 413 response", async (t) => {
  await t.test("declared Content-Length", async () => {
    await assertError(
      await post("{}", { "content-type": "application/json", "content-length": "8193" }),
      413,
      /8 KB limit/
    );
  });

  await t.test("chunked body", async () => {
    await assertError(
      await post(JSON.stringify({ naturalLanguage: "x".repeat(9_000) })),
      413,
      /8 KB limit/
    );
  });
});

  });
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createServer } from "node:net";

import os from "node:os";

const projectRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const responsiveFixturePath = path.join(projectRoot, "scripts", "responsive-fixtures.mjs");
const widths = [320, 360, 390, 414, 768, 1024, 1440];
const height = 900;
const timeoutMs = 180_000;
const serverTimeoutMs = 120_000;

function findChrome() {
  if (process.env.CHROME_BIN) return process.env.CHROME_BIN;
  for (const candidate of ["chromium", "chromium-browser", "google-chrome", "google-chrome-stable"]) {
    const result = spawnSync("which", [candidate], { encoding: "utf8" });
    if (result.status === 0 && result.stdout.trim()) return result.stdout.trim();
  }
  throw new Error("Chromium not found. Set CHROME_BIN to a headless Chromium executable.");
}

let baseUrl;
const profileDirs = [];
let chrome;
let ws;
let nextId = 0;
const pending = new Map();
let documentStatus = null;
let server;
let serverOutput = "";

function testEnvironment() {
  return {
    ...process.env,
    NODE_ENV: "production",
    NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1",
    NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_PROJECT_ID: "",
    WOLV_RESPONSIVE_FIXTURE: "",
    BAW_EXECUTION_ENABLED: "false",
    BAW_WALLET_API_TOKEN: "",
    WOLV_TRADING_DATABASE_URL: "",
    BAW_EXECUTION_DATABASE_URL: "",
  };
}

function runBuild() {
  console.log("Building the production app for responsive verification…");
  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["node_modules/next/dist/bin/next", "build", "--webpack"], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env: testEnvironment(),
    stdio: "inherit",
    timeout: 1_200_000,
  });
  if (result.error) throw result.error;
  if (result.status !== 0) throw new Error(`Production build failed with exit code ${result.status}`);
}

async function findAvailablePort() {
  const listener = createServer();
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    listener.once("error", reject);
    listener.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve);
  });
  const address = listener.address();
  assert.ok(address && typeof address !== "string");
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => listener.close((error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
  return address.port;
}

function appendServerOutput(chunk) {
  serverOutput = `${serverOutput}${chunk}`.slice(-20_000);
}

async function startProductionServer() {
  const port = await findAvailablePort();
  baseUrl = new URL(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  server = spawn(process.execPath, [
    "node_modules/next/dist/bin/next",
    "start",
    "--hostname",
    "127.0.0.1",
    "--port",
    String(port),
  ], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env: {
      ...testEnvironment(),
      PORT: String(port),
      WOLV_RESPONSIVE_FIXTURE: "1",
      BINANCE_API_KEY: "responsive-fixture-key",
      BINANCE_SECRET_KEY: "responsive-fixture-secret",
      NODE_OPTIONS: [process.env.NODE_OPTIONS, `--import=${responsiveFixturePath}`].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
    },
    stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
  });
  server.stdout.setEncoding("utf8").on("data", appendServerOutput);
  server.stderr.setEncoding("utf8").on("data", appendServerOutput);
  server.once("error", (error) => appendServerOutput(`\nServer process error: ${error.message}`));

  const startedAt = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - startedAt < serverTimeoutMs) {
    if (server.exitCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`Production server exited with code ${server.exitCode} before becoming healthy.\n${serverOutput}`);
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch(baseUrl, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3_000) });
      if (response.status === 200) {
        console.log(`Production server healthy at ${baseUrl.origin}`);
        return;
      }
      appendServerOutput(`\nHealth check returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
    } catch {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`Production server did not become healthy within ${serverTimeoutMs}ms.\n${serverOutput}`);
}

async function stopChild(child, name) {
  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) return;
  child.kill("SIGTERM");
  const exited = await Promise.race([
    new Promise((resolve) => child.once("exit", () => resolve(true))),
    new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(false), 5_000)),
  ]);
  if (!exited && child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) {
    child.kill("SIGKILL");
    await Promise.race([
      new Promise((resolve) => child.once("exit", resolve)),
      new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2_000)),
    ]);
  }
  if (child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) {
    throw new Error(`${name} did not stop after SIGTERM/SIGKILL`);
  }
}

async function startChrome() {
  const profileDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "wolv-responsive-"));
  profileDirs.push(profileDir);
  chrome = spawn(findChrome(), [
    "--headless=new",
    "--no-sandbox",
    "--disable-gpu",
    "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
    "--no-first-run",
    "--no-default-browser-check",
    "--remote-allow-origins=*",
    `--user-data-dir=${profileDir}`,
    "--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1",
    "--remote-debugging-port=0",
    "about:blank",
  ], { stdio: "ignore" });

  const portFile = path.join(profileDir, "DevToolsActivePort");
  let port;
  const waitStarted = Date.now();
  while (!port && Date.now() - waitStarted < 10_000) {
    try {
      port = Number((await readFile(portFile, "utf8")).split("\n")[0]);
    } catch {
      if (chrome.exitCode != null) throw new Error(`Chromium exited with code ${chrome.exitCode}`);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    }
  }
  if (!port) throw new Error("Chromium did not publish a DevTools port");

  const targetResponse = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/json/new?about:blank`, { method: "PUT" });
  assert.ok(targetResponse.ok, `Could not create Chromium page target: HTTP ${targetResponse.status}`);
  const target = await targetResponse.json();
  await connectDevTools(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
  await send("Page.enable");
  await send("Runtime.enable");
  await send("Network.enable");
  await send("Network.setBlockedURLs", {
    urls: [
      "*://*/api/agent/quote*",
      "*://*/api/agent/approve*",
      "*://*/api/agent/simulation*",
      "*://*/api/agent/execute*",
      "*://*/api/quote*",
      "*://*/api/swap*",
      "*://*/api/order/submit*",
      "*://*/api/approve-transaction*",
      "*://*/api/transaction/broadcast*",
    ],
  });
}

async function stopChrome() {
  for (const request of pending.values()) clearTimeout(request.timer);
  pending.clear();
  if (ws?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.close();
  ws = undefined;
  await stopChild(chrome, "Chromium");
  chrome = undefined;
  documentStatus = null;
}

function connectDevTools(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ws = new WebSocket(url);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Timed out connecting to Chromium DevTools")), 10_000);
    ws.addEventListener("open", () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve();
    }, { once: true });
    ws.addEventListener("error", () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new Error("Could not connect to Chromium DevTools"));
    }, { once: true });
    ws.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
      const message = JSON.parse(typeof event.data === "string" ? event.data : String(event.data));
      if (message.id) {
        const request = pending.get(message.id);
        if (!request) return;
        pending.delete(message.id);
        clearTimeout(request.timer);
        if (message.error) request.reject(new Error(message.error.message));
        else request.resolve(message.result);
      } else if (message.method === "Network.responseReceived" && message.params.type === "Document") {
        documentStatus = message.params.response.status;
      }
    });
  });
}

function send(method, params = {}) {
  const id = ++nextId;
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      pending.delete(id);
      reject(new Error(`DevTools command timed out: ${method}`));
    }, timeoutMs);
    pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timer });
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
  });
}

async function evaluate(expression) {
  const result = await send("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true });
  if (result.exceptionDetails) {
    throw new Error(result.exceptionDetails.text || "Page evaluation failed");
  }
  return result.result.value;
}

async function waitForPage(pathname, expected) {
  const started = Date.now();
  let lastState;
  while (Date.now() - started < timeoutMs) {
    try {
      const state = await evaluate(`(() => ({
        ready: document.readyState,
        path: location.pathname,
        title: document.title,
        bodyText: document.body?.innerText?.slice(0, 5000) ?? ""
      }))()`);
      lastState = state;
      if (state.ready !== "loading" && state.path === pathname && expected.test(state.bodyText)) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
        return state;
      }
    } catch {
      // Navigation destroys the old execution context; retry against the new document.
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(
    `Timed out waiting for page ${pathname}; last page state: ${JSON.stringify(lastState ?? null)}; ` +
    `document HTTP status: ${documentStatus ?? "unknown"}.\n${serverOutput}`,
  );
}

async function navigate(url, expected) {
  documentStatus = null;
  const pathname = new URL(url).pathname;
  const result = await send("Page.navigate", { url });
  if (result.errorText) throw new Error(`Navigation failed for ${url}: ${result.errorText}`);
  const state = await waitForPage(pathname, expected);
  if (documentStatus != null) assert.ok(documentStatus < 400, `${url} returned HTTP ${documentStatus}`);
  assert.ok(!/Internal Server Error|Application error: a server-side exception/i.test(state.bodyText), `${url} rendered a server error`);
  return state;
}

async function waitForCondition(expression, label, timeout = timeoutMs) {
  const started = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - started < timeout) {
    try {
      const result = await evaluate(expression);
      if (result) return result;
    } catch {
      // The client may replace the execution context while rendering.
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for ${label}`);
}

async function clickButton(label) {
  const clicked = await evaluate(`(() => {
    const button = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("button")).find((item) => item.innerText.trim().startsWith(${JSON.stringify(label)}));
    if (!button || button.disabled) return false;
    button.click();
    return true;
  })()`);
  assert.equal(clicked, true, `Could not click enabled "${label}" button`);
}

  await evaluate(`(() => { window.__WOLV_QUOTE_MODE = "expired"; })()`);
  await clickButton("Get Quote");
  await waitForCondition(`document.body.innerText.includes("EXPIRED")`, "expired quote refusal");
  assert.equal(await evaluate(`Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("button")).some((button) => /Sign & Execute Trade|Approve USDT|Sign Typed Data/.test(button.innerText))`), false);
  console.log("PASS trade UI · expired quote remains non-executable");

  await evaluate(`(() => { window.__WOLV_QUOTE_MODE = "error"; })()`);
  await clickButton("Get fresh quote");
  await waitForCondition(`document.body.innerText.includes("Responsive mock quote unavailable")`, "quote error state");
  const prohibitedCalls = await evaluate(`(() => ({
    wallet: window.__WOLV_WALLET_CALLS.filter((method) => /sendTransaction|signTypedData|personal_sign/.test(method)),
    api: window.__WOLV_API_CALLS.filter((pathname) => pathname !== "/api/quote")
  }))()`);
  assert.deepEqual(prohibitedCalls.wallet, [], "A wallet signing or transaction method was called");
  assert.deepEqual(prohibitedCalls.api, [], "A transaction/approval endpoint was called");
  console.log("PASS trade UI · quote error shown · no signing, approval, swap, or broadcast attempted");
}

async function run() {
  const fixedRoutes = [
    { path: "/", expected: /TOKENIZED STOCKS|Find the price/ },
    { path: "/gap", expected: /Cross-venue price discovery|Listed vs Indicative Estimate/ },
    { path: "/markets", expected: /Browse tokenized markets|BSC spot directory/ },
    { path: "/trade", expected: /Select an Asset to Trade/ },
    { path: "/wallet", expected: /Wallet Address|Connect your wallet|Checking wallet connection/ },
    { path: "/agent", expected: /(?=.*Deterministic risk policy)(?=.*Quote only — no transaction submitted)/s },
  ];

  for (const width of widths) {
    await startChrome();
    await send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
      width,
      height,
      deviceScaleFactor: 1,
      mobile: width < 768,
    });

    for (const route of fixedRoutes) {
      const url = new URL(route.path, baseUrl).href;
      const state = await navigate(url, route.expected);
      assert.match(state.bodyText, route.expected, `${route.path} did not render its expected product content at ${width}px`);
      const layout = await evaluate(`(() => ({
        viewport: window.innerWidth,
        clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        scrollWidth: Math.max(document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.body.scrollWidth),
        title: document.title,
        navTargets: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('nav[aria-label="Primary navigation"] a')).map((link) => {
          const { left, right, width, height } = link.getBoundingClientRect();
          return { left, right, width, height };
        })
      }))()`);
      assert.ok(layout.scrollWidth <= layout.clientWidth + 1, `${route.path} overflows horizontally at ${width}px (${layout.scrollWidth}px content in ${layout.clientWidth}px viewport)`);
      if (width < 768 && layout.navTargets.length > 0) {
        assert.ok(layout.navTargets.every((target) => target.width >= 48 && target.height >= 48), `${route.path} has a primary-navigation touch target below 48px at ${width}px`);
        assert.ok(layout.navTargets.every((target) => target.left >= 0 && target.right <= layout.viewport), `${route.path} has a clipped primary-navigation target at ${width}px`);
      }

      console.log(`PASS ${width}px ${route.path} · ${layout.scrollWidth}/${layout.clientWidth}px`);
    }

    for (const route of [
      { path: `/stock/${fixtureTokenAddress}`, expected: /Live asset signal/i },
      { path: `/trade/${fixtureTokenAddress}`, expected: /Trade TEST|Connect your wallet|Checking wallet connection/ },
      { path: "/stock/not-a-contract", expected: /Token not found/ },
      { path: "/trade/not-a-contract", expected: /Asset not found/ },
      { path: `/stock/${missingTokenAddress}`, expected: /Token not found/ },
      { path: `/trade/${missingTokenAddress}`, expected: /Asset not found/ },
      { path: `/stock/${unavailableTokenAddress}`, expected: /Live asset signal.*(?:Indicative )?quote unavailable.*(?:no route|no valid market route)/is },
    ]) {
        const url = new URL(route.path, baseUrl).href;
        const state = await navigate(url, route.expected);
        assert.match(state.bodyText, route.expected, `${route.path} did not render expected detail content at ${width}px`);
        const layout = await evaluate(`(() => ({ clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth, scrollWidth: Math.max(document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.body.scrollWidth) }))()`);
        assert.ok(layout.scrollWidth <= layout.clientWidth + 1, `${route.path} overflows horizontally at ${width}px (${layout.scrollWidth}px content in ${layout.clientWidth}px viewport)`);
        console.log(`PASS ${width}px ${route.path} · ${layout.scrollWidth}/${layout.clientWidth}px`);
    }
    await stopChrome();
  }

  await startChrome();
  await send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
    width: 390,
    height,
    deviceScaleFactor: 1,
    mobile: true,
  });
  await runTradeRefusalChecks();
  await stopChrome();
  await startChrome();
  await send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
    width: 390,
    height,
    deviceScaleFactor: 1,
    mobile: true,
  });
  await runAgentRefusalChecks();
  console.log(`Responsive smoke passed for ${baseUrl.origin} at ${widths.join(", ")}px. All provider data was mocked; no signature or transaction was submitted.`);
}

try {
  runBuild();
  await startProductionServer();
  await run();
} finally {
  try {
    await stopChrome();
  } finally {
    try {
      await stopChild(server, "Next.js production server");
    } finally {
      await Promise.all(profileDirs.map((profileDir) => rm(profileDir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 200 })));
    }
  }
}

const TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123";
const WALLET = "0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678";
const TOKEN_SYMBOL = "AAPLon";

function metadata(tokenAddress, decimals, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    chainId: "56",
    tokenAddress,
    decimals,
    resolutionSource: "BSC_ETH_CALL",
    blockNumber: BLOCK_NUMBER,
    resolvedAt: RESOLVED_AT,
    validationStatus: "VALIDATED",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

before(() => {
  process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY = SECRET;
});

after(() => {
  if (ORIGINAL_SECRET === undefined) delete process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
  else process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY = ORIGINAL_SECRET;
});

const asset = {
  tokenContractAddress: TOKEN,
  underlyingTicker: "AAPL",
  symbol: TOKEN_SYMBOL,
  decimals: 18,
  decimalMetadata: metadata(TOKEN, 18),
  usdtDecimalMetadata: metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18),
  referencePrice: "100",
  tokenToShareRatio: "1",
  statusInfo: { marketStatus: "open", openState: true },
};

const connectedSnapshot = {
  connected: true,
  fetchedAt: new Date(1_000).toISOString(),
  chains: [{ binanceChainId: "56", name: "BNB Smart Chain", simpleName: "BSC" }],
  addresses: [{ binanceChainId: "56", chainName: "BSC", address: WALLET }],
  balances: [],
  settings: null,
  errors: [],
};

function request(direction = "BUY", overrides = {}) {
  return {
    direction,
    tokenAddress: TOKEN,
    amount: direction === "BUY" ? "10" : "0.1",
    chainId: "56",
    slippageBps: 100,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function cliResponse(direction, overrides = {}) {
  const data = direction === "BUY"
    ? {
        fromCoinSymbol: "USDT",
        fromCoinAmount: "10",
        toCoinSymbol: TOKEN_SYMBOL,
        toCoinAmount: "0.1",
        slippage: 0.01,
      }
    : {
        fromCoinSymbol: TOKEN_SYMBOL,
        fromCoinAmount: "0.1",
        toCoinSymbol: "USDT",
        toCoinAmount: "10",
        slippage: 0.01,
      };
  return JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { ...data, ...overrides } });
}

function dependencies(direction, options = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  return {
    calls,
    dependencies: {
      now: () => options.now ?? 1_000,
      readSnapshot: async () => options.snapshot ?? connectedSnapshot,
      resolveAsset: async () => options.asset === undefined ? asset : options.asset,
      runner: async (args) => {
        calls.push([...args]);
        if (options.runnerError) throw options.runnerError;
        return { stdout: options.stdout ?? cliResponse(direction, options.outputOverrides) };
      },
    },
  };
}

test("strict request parsing normalizes human quantities and validates direction, chain, address, amount and slippage", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(parseAgentQuoteInput(request("BUY", { amount: "10.000" })), {
    ok: true,
    input: { ...request("BUY"), amount: "10" },
  });
  for (const invalid of [
    { ...request(), direction: "buy" },
    { ...request(), tokenAddress: "0x123" },
    { ...request(), chainId: "97" },
    { ...request(), amount: "1e2" },
    { ...request(), amount: "0" },
    { ...request(), amount: "1.0000000000000000001" },
    { ...request(), slippageBps: 0 },
    { ...request(), slippageBps: 501 },
    { ...request(), slippageBps: "100" },
    { ...request(), extra: true },
  ]) {
    assert.equal(parseAgentQuoteInput(invalid).ok, false, JSON.stringify(invalid));
  }
});

test("BUY and SELL map explicitly to USDT and selected token using BAW human-readable quantities", async (t) => {
  const cases = [
    { direction: "BUY", amount: "10", from: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, to: TOKEN },
    { direction: "SELL", amount: "0.1", from: TOKEN, to: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS },
  ];
  for (const entry of cases) {
    await t.test(entry.direction, async () => {
      const harness = dependencies(entry.direction);
      const result = await getBawQuote(request(entry.direction), harness.dependencies);
      assert.equal(result.status, "QUOTED");
      assert.equal(result.eligibility, "ELIGIBLE");
      assert.equal(result.fromTokenAddress, entry.from);
      assert.equal(result.toTokenAddress, entry.to);
      assert.equal(result.tokenPriceUsd, 100);
      assert.equal(
        verifyQuoteBinding(result.quoteBinding, {
          toToken: entry.to,
          fromToken: entry.from,
          amount: entry.amount,
          wallet: WALLET,
          quoteId: result.quoteBindingId,
          chainId: "56",
          direction: entry.direction,
          slippageBps: 100,
        }, result.quoteFetchedAt).ok,
        true,
      );
      assert.deepEqual(harness.calls[0], [
        "market-order", "quote",
        "--fromTokenQty", entry.amount,
        "--fromToken", entry.from,
        "--toToken", entry.to,
        "--binanceChainId", "56",
        "--slippage", "1",
        "--json",
      ]);
      assert.equal(result.execution.transactionSubmitted, false);
      assert.equal(result.execution.signingRequested, false);
    });
  }
});

  const catalogue = {

test("validated token decimals reach BUY and SELL quote command construction without executing", async (t) => {
  for (const decimals of [0, 6, 8, 18]) {
    await t.test(`${decimals} decimals`, async () => {
      const buyHarness = dependencies("BUY", {
        asset: { ...asset, decimals, decimalMetadata: metadata(TOKEN, decimals) },
        outputOverrides: { fromCoinAmount: "100", toCoinAmount: "1" },
      });
      const buyQuote = await getBawQuote(request("BUY", { amount: "100" }), buyHarness.dependencies);
      assert.equal(buyQuote.tokenDecimals, decimals);
      assert.equal(buyQuote.fromTokenMetadata.tokenAddress, BSC_USDT_ADDRESS);
      assert.equal(buyQuote.fromTokenMetadata.decimals, 18);
      assert.equal(buyQuote.toTokenMetadata.tokenAddress, TOKEN);
      assert.equal(buyQuote.toTokenMetadata.decimals, decimals);
      assert.equal(buyHarness.calls.length, 1);
      assert.deepEqual(buyHarness.calls[0], [
        "market-order", "quote",
        "--fromTokenQty", "100",
        "--fromToken", BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
        "--toToken", TOKEN,
        "--binanceChainId", "56",
        "--slippage", "1",
        "--json",
      ]);
      assert.equal(parseBawMarketQuoteArgs(buyHarness.calls[0]).direction, "BUY");

      const sellHarness = dependencies("SELL", {
        asset: { ...asset, decimals, decimalMetadata: metadata(TOKEN, decimals) },
        outputOverrides: { fromCoinAmount: "1", toCoinAmount: "100" },
      });
      const sellQuote = await getBawQuote(request("SELL", { amount: "1" }), sellHarness.dependencies);
      assert.equal(sellQuote.tokenDecimals, decimals);
      assert.equal(sellQuote.fromTokenMetadata.tokenAddress, TOKEN);
      assert.equal(sellQuote.fromTokenMetadata.decimals, decimals);
      assert.equal(sellQuote.toTokenMetadata.tokenAddress, BSC_USDT_ADDRESS);
      assert.equal(sellQuote.toTokenMetadata.decimals, 18);
      assert.equal(sellHarness.calls.length, 1);
      assert.deepEqual(sellHarness.calls[0], [
        "market-order", "quote",
        "--fromTokenQty", "1",
        "--fromToken", TOKEN,
        "--toToken", BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
        "--binanceChainId", "56",
        "--slippage", "1",
        "--json",
      ]);
      assert.equal(parseBawMarketQuoteArgs(sellHarness.calls[0]).direction, "SELL");
      assert.equal(
        buyHarness.calls.concat(sellHarness.calls).some((args) => args[1] === "swap"),
        false,
      );
    });
  }
});

test("invalid or conflicting asset metadata is rejected before quote command construction", async (t) => {
  for (const [label, tokenMetadata, usdtMetadata] of [
    ["missing asset metadata", null, metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["null asset metadata", null, metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["negative decimals", metadata(TOKEN, -1), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["non-integer decimals", metadata(TOKEN, 6.5), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["unsupported decimal range", metadata(TOKEN, 19), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["wrong metadata chain", metadata(TOKEN, 6, { chainId: "97" }), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["wrong asset address", metadata("0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456", 6), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["untrusted metadata source", metadata(TOKEN, 6, { resolutionSource: "CATALOGUE" }), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["malformed block number", metadata(TOKEN, 6, { blockNumber: "latest" }), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
    ["missing USDT metadata", metadata(TOKEN, 18), null],
    ["wrong USDT address", metadata(TOKEN, 18), metadata(TOKEN, 18)],
    ["conflicting mirrored decimals", metadata(TOKEN, 6), metadata(BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, 18)],
  ]) {
    await t.test(label, async () => {
      const harness = dependencies("BUY", {
        asset: {
          ...asset,
          decimals: label === "conflicting mirrored decimals" ? 8 : tokenMetadata?.decimals ?? null,
          decimalMetadata: tokenMetadata,
          usdtDecimalMetadata: usdtMetadata,
        },
      });
      await assert.rejects(
        getBawQuote(request(), harness.dependencies),
        (error) => error instanceof BawQuoteError && error.code === "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN",
      );
      assert.equal(harness.calls.length, 0);
    });
  }

  await t.test("asset address conflicts with requested token", async () => {
    const harness = dependencies("BUY", {
      asset: {
        ...asset,
        tokenContractAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456",
        decimals: 6,
        decimalMetadata: metadata("0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456", 6),
      },
    });
    await assert.rejects(
      getBawQuote(request(), harness.dependencies),
      (error) => error instanceof BawQuoteError && error.code === "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN",
    );
    assert.equal(harness.calls.length, 0);
  });
});

test("SELL input precision is exact and never rounded to token decimals", async (t) => {
  await t.test("accepts exactly six fractional digits for a six-decimal asset", async () => {
    const harness = dependencies("SELL", {
      asset: { ...asset, decimals: 6, decimalMetadata: metadata(TOKEN, 6) },
      outputOverrides: { fromCoinAmount: "0.123456", toCoinAmount: "12.3456" },
    });
    const quote = await getBawQuote(request("SELL", { amount: "0.123456" }), harness.dependencies);
    assert.equal(quote.eligibility, "ELIGIBLE");
    assert.equal(harness.calls[0][3], "0.123456");
  });

  await t.test("rejects a non-zero digit beyond six decimals before CLI invocation", async () => {
    const harness = dependencies("SELL", { asset: { ...asset, decimals: 6, decimalMetadata: metadata(TOKEN, 6) } });
    await assert.rejects(
      getBawQuote(request("SELL", { amount: "0.1234561" }), harness.dependencies),
      (error) => error instanceof BawQuoteError && error.code === "INVALID_REQUEST",
    );
    assert.equal(harness.calls.length, 0);
  });

  await t.test("normalizes redundant trailing zeros without changing quantity", async () => {
    const harness = dependencies("SELL", {
      asset: { ...asset, decimals: 0, decimalMetadata: metadata(TOKEN, 0) },
      outputOverrides: { fromCoinAmount: "1", toCoinAmount: "100" },
    });
    const quote = await getBawQuote(request("SELL", { amount: "1.000" }), harness.dependencies);
    assert.equal(quote.eligibility, "ELIGIBLE");
    assert.equal(harness.calls[0][3], "1");
  });
});

test("quote expiry and HMAC tampering are detected by the existing binding and freshness checks", () => {
  const originalSecret = process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
  process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY = SECRET;
  try {
    const bindingInput = {
      toToken: TOKEN,
      fromToken: BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
      amount: "10",
      wallet: WALLET,
      quoteId: "local-quote-id",
      chainId: "56",
      direction: "BUY",
      slippageBps: 100,
    };
    const issuedAt = 10_000;
    const binding = createQuoteBinding(bindingInput, issuedAt);
    assert.equal(verifyQuoteBinding(binding, bindingInput, issuedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS - 1).ok, true);
    assert.deepEqual(
      verifyQuoteBinding(binding, bindingInput, issuedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS),
      { ok: false, reason: "Quote binding expired" },
    );
    const [payload, signature] = binding.split(".");
    const tampered = `${payload}.${signature.startsWith("A") ? "B" : "A"}${signature.slice(1)}`;
    assert.equal(verifyQuoteBinding(tampered, bindingInput, issuedAt + 1).ok, false);
    assert.equal(verifyQuoteBinding(binding, { ...bindingInput, wallet: TOKEN }, issuedAt + 1).ok, false);
    assert.equal(isFreshQuote({ quoteFetchedAt: issuedAt }, issuedAt + TRADE_QUOTE_TTL_MS), false);
    assert.equal(MINIMUM_ORDER_WEI, BigInt("5000000000000000000"));
  } finally {
    if (originalSecret === undefined) delete process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
    else process.env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY = originalSecret;
  }
});
