import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import {
  createPublicClient,
  createWalletClient,
  decodeFunctionResult,
  encodeFunctionData,
  http,
} from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { bscTestnet } from "viem/chains";

const ROUTER = "0xD99D1c33F9fC3444f8101754aBC46c52416550D1";
const ENTRY_POINT = "0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032";
const RPC_URL =
  process.env.BSC_TESTNET_RPC_URL ||
  "https://data-seed-prebsc-1-s1.binance.org:8545";

function requirePrivateKey() {
  const privateKey = process.env.PRIVATE_KEY?.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "");
  if (!privateKey) {
    throw new Error("PRIVATE_KEY is not set in this terminal environment.");
  }
  const normalizedPrivateKey = /^0x/i.test(privateKey)
    ? privateKey
    : `0x${privateKey}`;
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(normalizedPrivateKey)) {
    throw new Error("PRIVATE_KEY must be a 32-byte hex value prefixed with 0x.");
  }
  return normalizedPrivateKey;
}

async function compileContract() {
  const source = await readFile(
    new URL("../contracts/TradingAgentPolicyValidator.sol", import.meta.url),
    "utf8",
  );
  const input = {
    language: "Solidity",
    sources: {
      "TradingAgentPolicyValidator.sol": { content: source },
    },
    settings: {
      optimizer: { enabled: true, runs: 200 },
      outputSelection: {
        "*": {
          "*": ["abi", "evm.bytecode.object"],
        },
      },
    },
  };

  const result = spawnSync("solc", ["--standard-json"], {
    cwd: process.cwd(),
    input: JSON.stringify(input),
    encoding: "utf8",
    maxBuffer: 20 * 1024 * 1024,
  });
  if (result.error) throw result.error;
  if (result.status !== 0) {
    throw new Error(result.stderr || `solc exited with status ${result.status}`);
  }

  const output = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
  const errors = output.errors?.filter((error) => error.severity === "error") ?? [];
  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(errors.map((error) => error.formattedMessage).join("\n"));
  }

  const contract =
    output.contracts?.["TradingAgentPolicyValidator.sol"]
      ?.TradingAgentPolicyValidator;
  if (!contract?.abi || !contract.evm?.bytecode?.object) {
    throw new Error("Failed to compile TradingAgentPolicyValidator.");
  }
  return { abi: contract.abi, bytecode: `0x${contract.evm.bytecode.object}` };
}

async function main() {
  const privateKey = requirePrivateKey();
  const account = privateKeyToAccount(privateKey);
  const publicClient = createPublicClient({
    chain: bscTestnet,
    transport: http(RPC_URL),
  });
  const walletClient = createWalletClient({
    account,
    chain: bscTestnet,
    transport: http(RPC_URL),
  });

  const chainId = await publicClient.getChainId();
  if (chainId !== 97) throw new Error(`Expected BSC Testnet 97, got ${chainId}.`);

  const [routerCode, entryPointCode, deployerBalance] = await Promise.all([
    publicClient.getBytecode({ address: ROUTER }),
    publicClient.getBytecode({ address: ENTRY_POINT }),
    publicClient.getBalance({ address: account.address }),
  ]);
  if (!routerCode || routerCode === "0x") throw new Error("Router has no bytecode.");
  if (!entryPointCode || entryPointCode === "0x") {
    throw new Error("EntryPoint has no bytecode.");
  }
  if (deployerBalance === 0n) {
    throw new Error("Deployer has no testnet BNB for gas.");
  }

  const factoryCall = await publicClient.call({
    to: ROUTER,
    data: encodeFunctionData({ abi: [{ type: "function", name: "factory", inputs: [], outputs: [{ type: "address" }], stateMutability: "view" }] }),
  });
  if (!factoryCall.data || factoryCall.data === "0x") {
    throw new Error("Router factory() call returned no data.");
  }
  const factory = decodeFunctionResult({
    abi: [{ type: "function", name: "factory", inputs: [], outputs: [{ type: "address" }], stateMutability: "view" }],
    data: factoryCall.data,
    functionName: "factory",
  });
  const factoryCode = await publicClient.getBytecode({ address: factory });
  if (!factoryCode || factoryCode === "0x") {
    throw new Error("Router factory address has no bytecode.");
  }

  const { abi, bytecode } = await compileContract();
  console.log(`Deployer: ${account.address}`);
  console.log(`Balance: ${deployerBalance.toString()} wei`);
  console.log(`Router: ${ROUTER}`);
  console.log(`EntryPoint: ${ENTRY_POINT}`);
  console.log(`Factory: ${factory}`);

  const hash = await walletClient.deployContract({
    abi,
    bytecode,
    args: [ROUTER, ENTRY_POINT],
    account,
  });
  console.log(`Transaction: ${hash}`);

  const receipt = await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({
    hash,
    confirmations: 1,
    timeout: 120_000,
  });
  if (receipt.status !== "success") {
    throw new Error(`Deployment reverted: ${hash}`);
  }
  if (!receipt.contractAddress) {
    throw new Error(`Deployment receipt had no contract address: ${hash}`);
  }

  const deployedCode = await publicClient.getBytecode({
    address: receipt.contractAddress,
  });
  if (!deployedCode || deployedCode === "0x") {
    throw new Error("Deployment address has no runtime bytecode.");
  }

  console.log(`Contract: ${receipt.contractAddress}`);
  console.log(`Block: ${receipt.blockNumber}`);
  console.log(`Guardian: ${account.address}`);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
import fs from "fs";
import crypto from "crypto";
const env = {};
for (const l of fs.readFileSync(".env.local", "utf8").split("\n")) {
  const m = l.match(/^\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/);
  if (m) env[m[1]] = m[2].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "");
}
const BASE = "https://web3.binance.com/build";
const USDT = "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955";
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function get(path, params = {}) {
  await sleep(350);
  const q = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
  const full = q ? `${path}?${q}` : path;
  const ts = new Date().toISOString();
  const sig = crypto.createHmac("sha256", env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY).update(ts + "GET" + "/build" + full, "utf8").digest("base64");
  const r = await fetch(BASE + full, { headers: { "X-OC-APIKEY": env.BINANCE_API_KEY, "X-OC-TIMESTAMP": ts, "X-OC-SIGN": sig } });
  const j = await r.json();
  if (!j.success && j.code !== 0) throw new Error(`API error ${j.code}: ${j.msg}`);
  return j;
}
async function execTok(addr) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    try {
      const r = await get("/api/v1/dex/aggregator/quote", {
        binanceChainId: "56", fromTokenAddress: USDT, toTokenAddress: addr,
        amount: "100" + "0".repeat(18), userWalletAddress: "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD",
      });
      const rt = (r.data ?? []).filter((x) => x?.toTokenAmount).sort((a, b) => Number(b.toTokenAmount) - Number(a.toTokenAmount));
      if (!rt[0]) return null;
      const px = parseFloat(rt[0].fromToken?.tokenUnitPrice ?? "1") || 1;
      return (100 * px) / (Number(rt[0].toTokenAmount) / 1e18);
    } catch (e) {
      if (i === 0 && String(e).includes("42900")) { await sleep(1500); continue; }
      return null;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
const list = (await get("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens")).data ?? [];
const odd = list.filter((t) => Math.abs(parseFloat(t.tokenToShareRatio) - 1) > 0.5).slice(0, 40);
console.log("odd-multiplier tokens:", odd.length);
for (const t of odd) {
  const m = parseFloat(t.tokenToShareRatio), lp = parseFloat(t.tokenPrice), rf = parseFloat(t.referencePrice);
  const ex = await execTok(t.tokenContractAddress);
  if (!ex) { console.log(t.underlyingTicker, t.platformId, "mult", m.toFixed(3), "no quote"); continue; }
  const a = ex / lp, b = ex / rf;
  const v = Math.abs(a - 1) < 0.03 ? "list matches trade" : Math.abs(b - 1) < 0.03 ? "REFERENCE matches trade (per-token)" : "neither";
  console.log(t.underlyingTicker, t.platformId, "mult", m.toFixed(3), "exec/list", a.toFixed(3), "exec/ref", b.toFixed(3), "=>", v);
}

function jsonPayload(data) {
    return JSON.stringify({ success: true, data });
}

function createRunner(outputs) {
    const calls = [];
    return {
        calls,
        runner: async (args) => {
            calls.push(args.join(" "));
            const key = args.slice(0, 2).join(" ");
            const next = outputs[key];
            if (next === undefined) {
                throw Object.assign(new Error("unexpected command"), { code: "ENOENT" });
            }
            return { stdout: jsonPayload(next) };
        },
    };
}

];

    ],
};

function connectedRunner(overrides = {}) {
    return createRunner({
        "wallet status": { status: "CONNECTED" },
        "wallet chains": CHAINS,
        "wallet address": ADDRESSES,
        "wallet balance": BALANCES,
        "wallet settings": SETTINGS,
        ...overrides,
    });
}

async function createStubBinary(t, source) {
      const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "wolv-baw-stub-"));
      t.after(() => rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }));
      const binary = join(directory, "baw-stub");
      await writeFile(binary, `#!/usr/bin/env node\n${source}`, { mode: 0o700 });
      return { binary, directory };
}

test("readWalletSnapshot short-circuits to connected=false without further commands when unconnected", async () => {
    const { calls, runner } = createRunner({ "wallet status": { status: "UNCONNECTED" } });
    const snapshot = await readWalletSnapshot({ runner, now: () => 1_000 });
    assert.equal(snapshot.connected, false);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot.chains, []);
    assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
});

test("readWalletSnapshot aggregates sanitized sections for a connected wallet", async () => {
    const { calls, runner } = connectedRunner();
    const snapshot = await readWalletSnapshot({ runner, now: () => 1_000 });
    assert.equal(snapshot.connected, true);
    assert.equal(snapshot.fetchedAt, new Date(1_000).toISOString());
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot.chains, CHAINS);
    assert.equal(snapshot.addresses.length, 2);
    assert.equal(snapshot.addresses[0].address, "0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678");
    assert.equal(snapshot.addresses[1].address, "EhFh6YfvcCMuFjRbnxT3pFvixWJF9YVXTscMJLCwTbA");
    assert.equal(snapshot.balances.length, 2);
    assert.equal(snapshot.balances[0].valueUsd, "1000.50");
    assert.equal(snapshot.settings.dailyLimit, 50000);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot.errors, []);
    const expected = ["wallet status --json", "wallet chains --json", "wallet address --json", "wallet balance --json", "wallet settings --json"];
    assert.deepEqual(calls, expected);
});

test("readWalletSnapshot continues on a failing section and records a structured error", async () => {
    const base = connectedRunner();
    const runner = async (args) => {
        if (args[0] === "wallet" && args[1] === "balance") {
            return { stdout: JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: "balance lookup failed" }) };
        }
        return base.runner(args);
    };
    const snapshot = await readWalletSnapshot({ runner, now: () => 1_000 });
    assert.equal(snapshot.connected, true);
    assert.equal(snapshot.balances.length, 0);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot.errors, [{ section: "balances", code: "BAW_COMMAND_FAILED" }]);
});

test("runJson rejects non-JSON, success=false, and malformed envelopes as INVALID_OUTPUT or BAW_COMMAND_FAILED", async () => {
    const malformed = createRunner({ "wallet status": { status: "CONNECTED" } });
    malformed.runner = async (args) => {
        if (args[0] === "wallet" && args[1] === "status") return { stdout: "not json" };
        return connectedRunner().runner(args);
    };
    await assert.rejects(readWalletSnapshot({ runner: malformed.runner, now: () => 0 }), /INVALID_OUTPUT/);

    const failure = createRunner({ "wallet status": { status: "CONNECTED" } });
    failure.runner = async (args) => {
        if (args[0] === "wallet" && args[1] === "status") return { stdout: JSON.stringify({ success: false }) };
        return connectedRunner().runner(args);
    };
    await assert.rejects(readWalletSnapshot({ runner: failure.runner, now: () => 0 }), /BAW_COMMAND_FAILED/);
});

    ]);

    assert.equal("devMode" in parsed, false);

    assert.throws(() => parseSettings({ ...SETTINGS, tradeAllTokens: "false" }), /INVALID_OUTPUT/);

});

test("createBawRunner executes the offline CLI stub and blocks every non-allowlisted command", async (t) => {
    const marker = join(tmpdir(), `wolv-baw-calls-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}`);
    const responses = {
        status: jsonPayload({ status: "CONNECTED" }),
        chains: jsonPayload(CHAINS),
        address: jsonPayload(ADDRESSES),
        balance: jsonPayload(BALANCES),
        settings: jsonPayload(SETTINGS),
    };
    const { binary } = await createStubBinary(t, `
const fs = require("node:fs");
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
fs.appendFileSync(${JSON.stringify(marker)}, args.join(" ") + "\\n");
const responses = ${JSON.stringify(responses)};
process.stdout.write(responses[args[1]]);
`);
    t.after(() => rm(marker, { force: true }));

    const runner = createBawRunner({ BAW_BIN: binary }, 2_000);
    const snapshot = await readWalletSnapshot({ runner, now: () => 1_000 });
    assert.equal(snapshot.connected, true);
    assert.equal(snapshot.addresses.length, 2);
    assert.equal(snapshot.balances.length, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(
        (await readFile(marker, "utf8")).trim().split("\n"),
        ["wallet status --json", "wallet chains --json", "wallet address --json", "wallet balance --json", "wallet settings --json"],
    );

    await assert.rejects(
        runner(["wallet", "send", "--recipient", "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "--json"]),
        /BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED/,
    );
    assert.equal((await readFile(marker, "utf8")).trim().split("\n").length, 5);
});

    await assert.rejects(runner(["wallet", "status", "--json"]), /BAW_TIMEOUT/);

test("market-order swap and status commands accept only the documented exact argument shapes", () => {
    const token = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123";
    const swap = buildBawMarketSwapArgs({
        direction: "BUY",
        tokenAddress: token,
        amount: "5",
        chainId: "56",
        slippagePercent: "0.5",
    });
    assert.equal(parseBawMarketSwapArgs(swap).direction, "BUY");
    assert.deepEqual(swap, [
        "market-order", "swap",
        "--fromTokenQty", "5",
        "--fromToken", "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955",
        "--toToken", token,
        "--binanceChainId", "56",
        "--slippage", "0.5",
        "--mev", "true",
        "--gasLevel", "MEDIUM",
        "--json",
    ]);
    assert.equal(parseBawMarketSwapArgs([...swap.slice(0, -5), "--mev", "false", "--gasLevel", "MEDIUM", "--json"]), null);
    for (const invalid of [
        { direction: "BUY", tokenAddress: token, amount: "1e2", chainId: "56", slippagePercent: "0.5" },
        { direction: "SELL", tokenAddress: token, amount: "1", chainId: "97", slippagePercent: "0.5" },
        { direction: "SELL", tokenAddress: token, amount: "1", chainId: "56", slippagePercent: "auto" },
    ]) {
        assert.throws(() => buildBawMarketSwapArgs(invalid), /BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED/);
    }

    const listArgs = buildBawMarketOrderListArgs("1234567890");
    assert.deepEqual(listArgs, ["market-order", "list", "--orderId", "1234567890", "--json"]);
    assert.equal(parseBawMarketOrderListArgs(listArgs), "1234567890");
    assert.equal(parseBawMarketOrderListArgs(["market-order", "list", "--status", "PENDING", "--json"]), null);
    assert.throws(() => buildBawMarketOrderListArgs("123 --json"), /BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED/);

    const historyArgs = buildBawMarketOrderReconciliationArgs({
        fromToken: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955",
        toToken: token,
        startTime: 1_800_000_000_000,
        endTime: 1_800_000_000_100,
    });
    assert.equal(historyArgs[1], "list");
    assert.equal(historyArgs.at(-1), "--json");
    assert.throws(() => buildBawMarketOrderReconciliationArgs({
        fromToken: token,
        toToken: token,
        startTime: 2,
        endTime: 1,
    }), /BAW_COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED/);
});

test("market-order submission and order-list responses parse only documented fields", () => {
    assert.equal(parseBawMarketOrderSubmitOutput('{"success":true,"data":{"orderId":"1234567890"}}'), "1234567890");
    for (const malformed of [
        '{"success":true,"data":{"orderId":"123","extra":"unexpected"}}',
        '{"success":true,"data":{"orderId":123}}',
        '{"success":false,"data":{"orderId":"123"}}',
    ]) assert.throws(() => parseBawMarketOrderSubmitOutput(malformed), /INVALID_OUTPUT/);

    const order = {
        orderType: "market",
        orderId: "1234567890",
        chain: "56",
        fromToken: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955",
        fromTokenName: "USDT",
        fromTokenQty: "10",
        toToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123",
        toTokenName: "AAPLon",
        toTokenActualQty: "0.1",
        status: "FINISHED",
        slippage: "0.5000",
        txHash: `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`,
        bookTime: "2026-04-01T23:50:10+08:00",
        updatedTime: "2026-04-01T23:50:12+08:00",
        refund: [{ tokenAddress: "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955", amount: "0.01", symbol: "USDT" }],
    };
    const result = parseBawMarketOrderListOutput(JSON.stringify({
        success: true,
        data: { total: 1, page: 1, pageSize: 20, list: [order] },
    }), {
        orderId: order.orderId,
        fromToken: order.fromToken,
        toToken: order.toToken,
        amount: "10",
    });

    assert.equal(result.status, "FINISHED");
    assert.equal(result.toTokenActualQty, "0.1");
    assert.equal(result.refund[0].symbol, "USDT");
    assert.throws(() => parseBawMarketOrderListOutput(
        JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { list: [{ ...order, status: "CANCELLED" }] } }),
        { orderId: order.orderId, fromToken: order.fromToken, toToken: order.toToken, amount: "10" },
    ), /INVALID_OUTPUT/);
    const history = parseBawMarketOrderHistoryOutput(JSON.stringify({
        success: true,
        data: { total: 1, page: 1, pageSize: 20, list: [order] },
    }));
    assert.equal(history[0].orderId, order.orderId);
    assert.throws(() => parseBawMarketOrderHistoryOutput(JSON.stringify({
        success: true,
        data: { list: [{ ...order, status: "UNKNOWN" }] },
    })), /INVALID_OUTPUT/);
});

const amount = "100000000000000000000";

test("accepts a finite route whose input amount matches the request", () => {
  const result = validateQuote({
    fromTokenAmount: amount,
    toTokenAmount: "2000000000000000000",
    fromTokenDecimals: "18",
    toTokenDecimals: "18",
    tokenUnitPrice: 1,
    expectedFromTokenAmount: amount,
  });

test("normalizes provider amounts using 6, 8, and 18 decimal token metadata", () => {
  for (const [decimals, outputAmount] of [
    ["6", "2000000"],
    ["8", "200000000"],
    ["18", "2000000000000000000"],
  ]) {
    const result = validateQuote({
      fromTokenAmount: amount,
      toTokenAmount: outputAmount,
      fromTokenDecimals: "18",
      toTokenDecimals: decimals,
      tokenUnitPrice: 1,
      expectedFromTokenAmount: amount,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(result, { ok: true, usd: 50, referenceGap: null });
  }
});

test("rejects malformed or mismatched route amounts", () => {
  const route = {
    fromTokenAmount: amount,
    toTokenAmount: "2000000000000000000",
    fromTokenDecimals: "18",
    toTokenDecimals: "18",
    tokenUnitPrice: 1,
  };
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, toTokenAmount: "not-an-integer" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, fromTokenAmount: "200000000000000000000", expectedFromTokenAmount: amount }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, expectedFromTokenAmount: `0x${BigInt(amount).toString(16)}` }).ok, true);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, expectedFromTokenAmount: "0x2" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, expectedFromTokenAmount: "not-an-integer" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, toTokenDecimals: undefined }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, toTokenDecimals: "6.0" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ ...route, toTokenDecimals: "256" }).ok, false);
  assert.equal(validateQuote({ usd: Infinity }).ok, false);
});

test("rejects isolated reference-price outliers", () => {
  assert.equal(isQuoteReferenceReliable(100, 100, 1), true);
  assert.equal(isQuoteReferenceReliable(121, 100, 1), false);
  assert.equal(isQuoteReferenceReliable(10_000, 100, 1), false);
});

  assert.equal(selectBestRouterQuote([
    { effectiveUsd: 1, selectable: false },
    { effectiveUsd: 2, selectable: false },
  ]), undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(selectBestRouterQuote([
    { effectiveUsd: 1, selectable: false },
    { effectiveUsd: 2, selectable: true },
  ]), { effectiveUsd: 2, selectable: true });
});

import { normalizeCandles } from "../lib/candles.ts";

test("normalizes Binance Market API candle arrays using close index 3 and timestamp index 5", () => {
  const response = {
    data: [
      [770, 776, 768, 774, 76956, 1710000000000, 14],
      [774, 779, 772, 778, 70000, 1710003600000, 16],
    ],
  };

  const points = normalizeCandles(response, 776);
  assert.equal(points.length, 2);
  assert.equal(points[0].value, 774);
  assert.equal(points[0].timestamp, 1710000000000);
  assert.equal(points[1].value, 778);
});

test("sorts candles chronologically and rejects a volume-as-price series", () => {
  const response = {
    data: [
      [774, 779, 772, 778, 70000, 1710003600000, 16],
      [770, 776, 768, 774, 76956, 1710000000000, 14],
    ],
  };

  const points = normalizeCandles(response, 776);
  assert.deepEqual(points.map((point) => point.value), [774, 778]);

  const badResponse = {
    data: [
      [770, 776, 768, 76956, 774, 1710000000000, 14],
      [774, 779, 772, 70000, 778, 1710003600000, 16],
    ],
  };
  assert.deepEqual(normalizeCandles(badResponse, 776), []);
});

test("supports named close and timestamp fields", () => {
  const response = {
    data: [
      { open: "770", high: "776", low: "768", close: "774", timestamp: 1710000000000 },
      { open: "774", high: "779", low: "772", closePrice: "778", timestamp: 1710003600000 },
    ],
  };

  assert.deepEqual(normalizeCandles(response, 776).map((point) => point.value), [774, 778]);
});

test("returns no chart for too few or implausible points", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(normalizeCandles({ data: [[770, 776, 768, 774, 1, 1710000000000, 1]] }, 776), []);
  assert.deepEqual(normalizeCandles({ data: [[77000, 77001, 76999, 77000, 1, 1710000000000, 1], [78000, 78001, 77999, 78000, 1, 1710003600000, 1]] }, 776), []);
});

export const RPC_SEMANTICS_CONFIRMATION = "READ-ONLY RPC SEMANTICS PROBE";
const TARGET_ADDRESSES = [
  BSC_USDT_ADDRESS,
  "0xe614e2fc6c787035ff51f452e8e826bfd32d5283",

export function formatRpcSemanticsPlan(rpcIdentity, { liveRequested = false } = {}) {
  return [
    liveRequested
      ? "BSC historical RPC request-semantics probe — READ-ONLY PLAN, CONFIRMATION REQUIRED"
      : "BSC historical RPC request-semantics probe — DRY RUN",
    "Network: BNB Smart Chain mainnet (chain ID 56)",
    `Primary RPC: ${rpcIdentity}`,
    `Recorded block: ${RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK} (${RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH})`,
    `Permitted targets: ${TARGET_ADDRESSES.join(", ")}`,
    "Requests after confirmation: eth_chainId; eth_blockNumber; eth_getBlockByNumber at latest and recorded blocks; eth_getCode for each target at latest and recorded blocks.",
    "eth_call(decimals()) is limited to valid non-empty bytecode at the recorded block.",
    "No retries; no endpoint switching; no archive endpoint; no Binance or BAW call; no transaction method.",
    `Live requests require --live-read-only and exact confirmation: ${RPC_SEMANTICS_CONFIRMATION}.`,
    liveRequested
      ? "No request will be sent unless the exact confirmation is entered."
      : "No network request was made.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export function requireRpcSemanticsConfirmation(answer) {
  return typeof answer === "string" && answer.trim() === RPC_SEMANTICS_CONFIRMATION;
}

export function createInstrumentedArchiveClient(client, recorder) {
  return {
    getChainId: (...args) => client.getChainId(...args),
    getBlockNumber: (...args) => client.getBlockNumber(...args),
    getBlock: (parameters) => {
      recorder.noteBlockInput(
        "eth_getBlockByNumber",
        null,
        parameters.blockNumber ?? parameters.blockTag,
      );
      return client.getBlock(parameters);
    },
    getBytecode: (parameters) => {
      recorder.noteBlockInput(
        "eth_getCode",
        parameters.address,
        parameters.blockNumber ?? parameters.blockTag,
      );
      return client.getBytecode(parameters);
    },
    readContract: (parameters) => {
      recorder.noteBlockInput(
        "eth_call",
        parameters.address,
        parameters.blockNumber ?? parameters.blockTag,
      );
      return client.readContract(parameters);
    },
  };
}

export async function readRpcSemanticsTargets(auditPath = AUDIT_PATH) {
  let audit;
  try {
    audit = JSON.parse(await readFile(auditPath, "utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("The recorded audit JSON could not be loaded or parsed.");
  }
  return getRecordedProbeTargets(audit);
}

export function resolveRpcSemanticsUrl(environment = process.env) {
  const url = environment.BSC_RPC_URL
    ? requireServerRpcUrl(environment.BSC_RPC_URL)
    : resolvePublicRpcUrl(
      environment.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL,
      PUBLIC_BSC_RPC,
      "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL",
    );
  return { url, identity: redactRpcEndpointIdentity(url) };
}

async function main(args = process.argv.slice(2)) {
  if (args.some((argument) => argument !== "--live-read-only") || args.length > 1) {
    console.error("Usage: node --conditions=react-server --experimental-strip-types scripts/bsc-rpc-semantics-probe.mjs [--live-read-only]");
    process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  const endpoint = resolveRpcSemanticsUrl();
  const liveRequested = args.includes("--live-read-only");
  console.log(formatRpcSemanticsPlan(endpoint.identity, { liveRequested }));
  if (!liveRequested) return;
  if (!process.stdin.isTTY || !process.stdout.isTTY) {
    throw new Error("Live request-semantics probe requires an interactive terminal for typed confirmation.");
  }
  const targets = await readRpcSemanticsTargets();
  await confirmRpcSemanticsProbe();

  const recorder = createRpcWireRecorder();
  const chain = defineChain({
    id: 56,
    name: "BNB Smart Chain",
    nativeCurrency: { name: "BNB", symbol: "BNB", decimals: 18 },
    rpcUrls: { default: { http: [endpoint.url] } },
  });
  const client = createInstrumentedArchiveClient(createPublicClient({
    chain,
    transport: http(endpoint.url, {
      timeout: 10_000,
      retryCount: 0,
      fetchFn: recorder.fetchFn,
    }),
  }), recorder);
  const result = await diagnoseArchiveState({
    primary: {
      client,
      identity: endpoint.identity,
      operator: "primary",
    },
    targets,
  });
  const output = {
    auditTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...result,
    wireRequests: recorder.snapshot(),
  };
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(":", "-");
  const outputDirectory = path.resolve(__dirname, "../docs/audits");
  await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(
    path.join(outputDirectory, `bsc-rpc-semantics-probe-${timestamp}.json`),
    `${JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)}\n`,
    { mode: 0o600 },
  );
  console.log(`Probe status: ${result.status}; sanitized results written under ${outputDirectory}.`);
}

async function confirmRpcSemanticsProbe() {
  const terminal = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  try {
    const answer = await terminal.question(
      `Type ${RPC_SEMANTICS_CONFIRMATION} to issue only the displayed read-only requests:\n> `,
    );
    if (!requireRpcSemanticsConfirmation(answer)) {
      throw new Error("Request-semantics confirmation did not match; no RPC request was made.");
    }
  } finally {
    terminal.close();
  }
}

function requireServerRpcUrl(value) {
  let url;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Server-side BSC RPC URL is invalid; its value is redacted.");
  }
  if ((url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") || url.hash) {
    throw new Error("Server-side BSC RPC URL must use HTTP(S) without a fragment.");
  }
  return url.toString();
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  main().catch((error) => {
    console.error(error instanceof Error && (
      error.message.startsWith("Request-semantics confirmation") ||
      error.message.startsWith("Live request-semantics probe requires")
    )
      ? error.message
      : "BSC request-semantics probe failed; sensitive endpoint and credential details were suppressed.");
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
}

test("strict policy template is conservative, time-bounded, and execution-independent", () => {
  const now = 1_000;
  const policy = createStrictAgentPolicyTemplate({
    approvedAssets: [ADDRESSES[0]],
    now,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(validateRiskPolicy(policy, now), []);
  assert.deepEqual(policy.approvedDirections, ["BUY"]);
  assert.equal(policy.maxOrderValue, "0.5");
  assert.equal(policy.maxDailyExposure, "1");
  assert.equal(policy.maxProposalsPerHour, 1);
  assert.equal(policy.maxSlippageBps, 100);
  assert.equal(policy.maxReferenceDeviationPercent, 1);
  assert.equal(policy.quoteTtlMs, 30_000);
  assert.equal(policy.permissionExpiresAt, now + 15 * 60_000);
  assert.equal(policy.emergencyStop, false);
  assert.throws(
    () => createStrictAgentPolicyTemplate({ approvedAssets: [], now }),
    /Strict policy approval/,
  );
});

test("autonomous trading gate fails closed before policy or network submission", () => {

  const policy = createStrictAgentPolicyTemplate({
    approvedAssets: [ADDRESSES[0]],
    now,
  });
  const intent = {
    ownerAddress: ADDRESSES[0],
    assetAddress: ADDRESSES[0],
    direction: "BUY",
    notional: "0.1",
    dailyExposure: "0.1",
    recentProposalCount: 0,
    slippageBps: 100,
    referenceDeviationPercent: 0.5,

    availableBalance: "1",
    session: "US_REGULAR",
    chainId: 97,

      ENABLE_LIVE_USEROP_SUBMISSION: "true",

        ENABLE_MAINNET_AGENT_TRADING: "false",

});

        spreadPercent: null,
        currency: "USD",
        priceKind: "INDICATIVE",
        source: "fixture",
        providerTimestamp: now - 120_000,
        ingestedAt: now,
        freshnessMs: 60_000,
        verificationStatus: "VERIFIED",
        provenance: {},
      };
    },
  };
  const collector = new MarketDataCollector(store, adapter, { enabled: true, now: () => now });
  const result = await collector.collectWatchlist([ADDRESSES[0]], OWNER_ADDRESS);
  assert.equal(result.observationsStored, 0);
  assert.equal(store.observations.length, 0);
  assert.match(result.failures[0].reason, /stale/i);
});

test("fixture-driven workflow records evidence, detects a deduplicated opportunity, and keeps approval blocked", async () => {
  let now = 1_700_000_000_000;
  const store = createFakeStore(() => now);
  const adapter = {
    providerId: "controlled-fixture",
    async loadCatalogue(watchlist) {
      return watchlist.map((tokenAddress, index) => ({
        chainId: 56,
        tokenAddress,
        ticker: "TST",
        platform: index === 0 ? "venue-a" : "venue-b",
        decimals: null,
        shareDenomination: null,
        metadataSource: "controlled-fixture",
        observedAt: now,
        blockNumber: null,
        blockHash: null,
        metadata: { tokenName: "Test Spot Asset" },
      }));
    },
    async observe(asset) {
      return {
        price: asset.platform === "venue-a" ? "100" : "101",
        referencePrice: asset.platform === "venue-a" ? "100" : "101",
        bid: null,
        ask: null,
        spreadPercent: null,
        currency: "USD",
        priceKind: "INDICATIVE",
        source: "controlled-fixture",
        providerTimestamp: now,
        ingestedAt: now,
        freshnessMs: 60_000,
        verificationStatus: "VERIFIED",
        provenance: { fixture: true },
      };
    },
  };
  const collector = new MarketDataCollector(store, adapter, { enabled: true, now: () => now });
  const analysisProvider = {
    async analyze(input) {
      return {
        modelIdentifier: "deterministic-test-fixture",
        modelVersion: "1",
        interpretation: "The fixture contains two verified indicative observations.",
        opportunityExplanation: input.opportunity.reason,
        historicalComparison: "No prior observations are available.",
        upsideScenario: "The observed spread could narrow.",
        downsideScenario: "The observed spread could widen.",
        risks: ["Indicative values are not executable."],
        dataLimitations: ["The fixture is deterministic test data."],
        invalidatingConditions: ["A current executable quote differs."],
        suggestedNextAction: "Review evidence and policy.",
        evidenceReferences: input.opportunity.evidenceIds,
        assumptions: [],
      };
    },
  };
  const policy = {
    version: "fixture-policy-v1",
    approvedAssets: ADDRESSES,
    approvedDirections: ["BUY"],
    maxOrderValue: "100",
    maxDailyExposure: "1000",
    maxProposalsPerHour: 4,
    maxSlippageBps: 100,
    maxReferenceDeviationPercent: 2,
    allowedSessions: ["US_REGULAR"],
    minimumBalance: "1",
    quoteTtlMs: 60_000,
    permissionExpiresAt: now + 120_000,
    emergencyStop: false,
  };
  store.policy = policy;
  const orchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator(store, collector, analysisProvider, {
    enabled: true,
    now: () => now,
    policyContext: async () => ({
      slippageBps: 50,
      referenceDeviationPercent: 0,
      dataFresh: true,
      quoteExpiresAt: now + 30_000,
      availableBalance: "500",
      session: "US_REGULAR",
      quoteReference: "fixture-reference",
      expectedInput: "5",
      expectedOutput: "0.05",
    }),
  });
  const request = {
    ownerAddress: OWNER_ADDRESS,
    agentId: "fixture-agent",
    watchlist: ADDRESSES,
    strategyConfiguration: {
      minimumAbsoluteSpreadPercent: 0.5,
      intendedAmount: "0.05",
      notionalValue: "5",
      maximumSlippageBps: 50,
    },
  };

  const first = await orchestrator.run(request);
  assert.equal(first.status, "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL");
  assert.deepEqual(store.recoveryCalls, [{ now, staleBefore: now - 5 * 60_000 }]);
  assert.ok(first.opportunityId);
  assert.ok(first.analysisId);
  assert.ok(first.proposalId);
  assert.equal(store.observations.length, 2);
  assert.equal(store.proposals.get(first.proposalId).direction, "BUY");
  assert.equal(store.proposals.get(first.proposalId).assetId, `fixture-asset-${ADDRESSES[0]}`);

  const approval = await orchestrator.decideProposal(first.proposalId, OWNER_ADDRESS, "APPROVE");
  assert.equal(approval.status, "EXECUTION_BLOCKED");
  assert.equal(store.runs.get(first.runId).run_status, "COMPLETED");
  assert.ok(store.events.some((event) => event.payload.to === "EXECUTION_BLOCKED"));
  assert.equal(store.executionCalls, 0);

  const duplicate = await orchestrator.run(request);
  assert.equal(duplicate.status, "COMPLETED");
  assert.equal(duplicate.proposalId, null);
  assert.equal(store.analyses, 1);
});

test("operator control enablement is explicitly time-limited and stop persists a kill-switch event", async () => {
  const originalEnabled = process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED;
  process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED = "true";
  const now = 1_700_000_000_000;
  const store = createFakeStore(now);
  try {
    const enableResponse = await handleAgentControlPost(jsonRequest({
      action: "ENABLE",
      reason: "operator test",
      permissionTtlMs: 15 * 60_000,
    }), {
      authorize: async () => "authorized",
      getOwnerAddress: async () => OWNER_ADDRESS,
      createStore: () => store,
      now: () => now,
    });
    assert.equal(enableResponse.status, 200);
    assert.equal(store.control.permissionExpiresAt, now + 15 * 60_000);
    const stopResponse = await handleAgentControlPost(jsonRequest({
      action: "STOP",
      reason: "operator test stop",
    }), {
      authorize: async () => "authorized",
      getOwnerAddress: async () => OWNER_ADDRESS,
      createStore: () => store,
      now: () => now + 1,
    });
    assert.equal(stopResponse.status, 200);
    assert.equal(store.control.emergency_stop, true);
    assert.ok(store.globalEvents.some((event) => event.eventType === "EMERGENCY_STOP_ACTIVATED"));
  } finally {
    if (originalEnabled === undefined) delete process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED;
    else process.env.WOLV_AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED = originalEnabled;
  }
});

test("proposal decision endpoint validates the payload and reports blocked execution", async () => {
  const proposalId = randomUUID();
  const runId = randomUUID();
  const store = createFakeStore(1_000);
  store.runs.set(runId, { run_id: runId, run_status: "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL" });
  store.proposals.set(proposalId, {
    proposal_id: proposalId,
    run_id: runId,
    runId,
    proposal_status: "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL",
    proposal_hash: "a".repeat(64),
    user_decision: null,
  });
  const response = await fetchProposal(proposalId, store);
  assert.equal(response.status, 200);
  const body = await response.json();

  assert.equal(body.execution, "BLOCKED");
  assert.equal(store.executionCalls, 0);
});

test("policy API refuses malformed policy data and activates only a validated explicit version", async (t) => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const store = createFakeStore(now);
  const policy = {
    version: "test-policy",
    approvedAssets: ADDRESSES,
    approvedDirections: ["BUY"],
    maxOrderValue: "100",
    maxDailyExposure: "1000",
    maxProposalsPerHour: 4,
    maxSlippageBps: 100,
    maxReferenceDeviationPercent: 2,
    allowedSessions: ["US_REGULAR"],
    minimumBalance: "1",
    quoteTtlMs: 60_000,
    permissionExpiresAt: now + 120_000,
    emergencyStop: false,
  };
  await t.test("invalid order value", async () => {
    const response = await handleAgentPolicyPost(jsonRequest({
      name: "default",
      policy: { ...policy, maxOrderValue: "0" },
      activate: true,
    }, "https://wolv.test/api/agent/policy"), {
      authorize: async () => "authorized",
      getOwnerAddress: async () => OWNER_ADDRESS,
      createStore: () => store,
      now: () => now,
    });
    assert.equal(response.status, 422);
  });
  await t.test("valid explicit activation", async () => {
    let received;
    store.savePolicy = async (ownerAddress, name, value, createdAt, active) => {
      received = { ownerAddress, name, value, createdAt, active };
      return randomUUID();
    };
    const response = await handleAgentPolicyPost(jsonRequest({
      name: "default",
      policy,
      activate: true,
    }, "https://wolv.test/api/agent/policy"), {
      authorize: async () => "authorized",
      getOwnerAddress: async () => OWNER_ADDRESS,
      createStore: () => store,
      now: () => now,
    });
    const responseBody = await response.json();
    assert.equal(response.status, 201, JSON.stringify(responseBody));
    assert.deepEqual(received, { ownerAddress: OWNER_ADDRESS, name: "default", value: policy, createdAt: now, active: true });
  });
});

function jsonRequest(body, url = "https://wolv.test/api/agent/control") {
  return new Request(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

async function fetchProposal(proposalId, store) {
  const { handleAgentProposalPost } = await import("../services/agentControlHttp.ts");
  return handleAgentProposalPost(jsonRequest({ proposalId, action: "APPROVE" }), {
    authorize: async () => "authorized",
    getOwnerAddress: async () => OWNER_ADDRESS,
    createStore: () => store,
    now: () => 2_000,
  });
}

function createFakeStore(nowSource) {
  const getNow = typeof nowSource === "function" ? nowSource : () => nowSource;
  const store = {
    assets: new Map(),
    observations: [],
    events: [],
    globalEvents: [],
    opportunities: new Map(),
    proposals: new Map(),
    runs: new Map(),
    observationKeys: new Map(),
    policy: null,
    analyses: 0,
    executionCalls: 0,
    recoveryCalls: [],
    control: {
      emergency_stop: false,
      stop_monitoring: false,
      reject_new_opportunities: false,
      stop_reason: "fixture control",
      permissionExpiresAt: getNow() + 300_000,
    },
    async initialize() {},
    async close() {},
    async getControlState(now = getNow()) {
      return {
        emergency_stop: this.control.emergency_stop,
        stop_monitoring: this.control.stop_monitoring,
        reject_new_opportunities: this.control.reject_new_opportunities,
        stop_reason: this.control.stop_reason,
        permission_expires_at: this.control.permissionExpiresAt,
        permission_active: !this.control.emergency_stop && this.control.permissionExpiresAt > now,
      };
    },
    async createRun(input, runId = randomUUID()) {
      this.runs.set(runId, { ...input, run_id: runId, run_status: "INITIALIZING" });
      this.events.push({ runId, payload: { from: "IDLE", to: "INITIALIZING" } });
      return runId;
    },
    async transitionRun(runId, nextState, event) {
      const run = this.runs.get(runId);
      assert.ok(run);
      run.run_status = nextState;
      this.events.push({ runId, eventType: event.eventType, payload: { ...event.payload, to: nextState } });
    },
    async appendEvent(runId, event) {
      if (runId === null) this.globalEvents.push(event);
      else this.events.push({ runId, ...event });
      return randomUUID();
    },
    async recordAssetVersion(input) {
      const assetId = `fixture-asset-${input.tokenAddress.toLowerCase()}`;
      this.assets.set(assetId, input);
      return { assetId, created: true };
    },
    async recordObservation(input) {
      const existing = this.observationKeys.get(input.idempotencyKey);
      if (existing) return { observationId: existing, created: false };
      const observationId = randomUUID();
      this.observations.push({ ...input, observation_id: observationId });
      this.observationKeys.set(input.idempotencyKey, observationId);
      return { observationId, created: true };
    },
    async recordCandle() {
      return { candleId: randomUUID(), created: true };
    },
    async listActivity() {
      return { items: [], nextCursor: null };
    },
    async listProposals() {
      return [];
    },
    async getPolicyRefusals() {
      return [];
    },
    async listOpportunities() {
      return [];
    },
    async listAnalyses() {
      return [];
    },
    async getStrategyEvaluations() {
      return [];
    },
    async getOpportunityEvidence() {
      return this.observations.map((observation) => {
        const asset = this.assets.get(observation.assetId);
        return {
          currency: observation.currency,
          price: observation.price,
          reference_price: observation.referencePrice,
          provider_timestamp: observation.providerTimestamp,
          ingested_at: observation.ingestedAt,
          freshness_ms: observation.freshnessMs,
          verification_status: observation.verificationStatus,
          price_kind: observation.priceKind,
          asset_id: observation.assetId,
          observation_id: observation.observation_id,
          token_address: asset.tokenAddress,
          ticker: asset.ticker,
          platform: asset.platform,
          normalized_share_price: observation.price,
        };
      });
    },
    async getRecentObservations() {
      return [];
    },
    async recordOpportunity(input) {
      const existing = this.opportunities.get(input.detectionKey);
      if (existing) return { opportunityId: existing, created: false };
      this.opportunities.set(input.detectionKey, input.opportunityId);
      return { opportunityId: input.opportunityId, created: true };
    },
    async recordAnalysis() {
      this.analyses += 1;
      return randomUUID();
    },
    async getDailyExposure() {
      return "0";
    },
    async getRecentProposalCount() {
      return 0;
    },
    async getActivePolicy() {
      return this.policy;
    },
    async savePolicy() {
      return randomUUID();
    },
    async recordPolicyDecision() {},
    async createProposal(input, proposalId) {
      this.proposals.set(proposalId, {
        ...input,
        proposal_id: proposalId,
        proposal_hash: "b".repeat(64),
        proposal_status: "AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL",
        user_decision: null,
      });
      return { proposalId, proposalHash: "b".repeat(64) };
    },
    async getProposal(proposalId) {
      return this.proposals.get(proposalId) ?? null;
    },
    async expirePendingProposals() {
      return 0;
    },
    async expireOpportunities() {
      return 0;
    },
    async recoverStaleRuns(now, staleBefore) {
      this.recoveryCalls.push({ now, staleBefore });
      return 0;
    },
    async decideProposal(proposalId, ownerAddress, action) {
      const proposal = this.proposals.get(proposalId);
      assert.ok(proposal);
      if (action === "APPROVE") {
        proposal.proposal_status = "EXECUTION_BLOCKED";
        proposal.user_decision = "APPROVED";
        const run = this.runs.get(proposal.runId);
        run.run_status = "USER_APPROVED";
        this.events.push({ runId: run.run_id, payload: { to: "USER_APPROVED" } });
        run.run_status = "EXECUTION_BLOCKED";
        this.events.push({ runId: run.run_id, payload: { to: "EXECUTION_BLOCKED" } });
        run.run_status = "COMPLETED";
        this.events.push({ runId: run.run_id, payload: { to: "COMPLETED" } });
        return { status: "EXECUTION_BLOCKED", decision: "APPROVED" };
      }
      proposal.proposal_status = "USER_REJECTED";
      proposal.user_decision = "REJECTED";
      return { status: "USER_REJECTED", decision: "REJECTED" };
    },
    async setEmergencyStop(input) {
      this.control.emergency_stop = input.stopped;
      this.control.stop_monitoring = input.stopped;
      this.control.reject_new_opportunities = input.stopped;
      this.control.stop_reason = input.reason;
      this.control.permissionExpiresAt = input.permissionExpiresAt;
      this.globalEvents.push({
        eventType: input.stopped ? "EMERGENCY_STOP_ACTIVATED" : "EMERGENCY_STOP_CLEARED",
      });
    },
  };
  return store;
}
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

const baseUrl = (process.env.BASE_URL || "https://wolv-stock.vercel.app").replace(/\/$/, "");

async function request(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, { ...options, redirect: "manual" });
  const text = await response.text();
  return { response, text };
}

async function expectStatus(name, path, expected, options) {
  const { response, text } = await request(path, options);
  assert.equal(response.status, expected, `${name}: expected HTTP ${expected}, got ${response.status}: ${text.slice(0, 240)}`);
  return text;
}

for (const path of ["/", "/gap", "/trade", "/wallet", "/agent"]) {
  const text = await expectStatus(`page ${path}`, path, 200);
  assert.ok(text.length > 500, `page ${path}: response is unexpectedly small`);
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { encodeAgentBuyCall } from "../lib/smartAccount.ts";
import {
  handleAgentTransactionSimulationPost,
  simulateAgentTransaction,
} from "../services/agentTransactionSimulation.ts";
import { parseEther } from "viem";

const OWNER = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789";
const ROUTER = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000123";
const TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456";
const WRAPPED = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001";
const CONFIG = {
  chain: { id: 97 },
  rpcUrl: "https://rpc.example",
  bundlerRpcUrl: "https://bundler.example",
  routerAddress: ROUTER,
  policyHookAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000321",
  targetTokenAddress: TOKEN,
  wrappedNativeAddress: WRAPPED,
};

function harness(overrides = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  const gasEstimates = [];
  const rpc = {
    getChainId: async () => 97,
    getBlockNumber: async () => 123n,
    getBalance: async () => parseEther("1"),
    getGasPrice: async () => 3n,
    estimateGas: async (transaction) => {
      gasEstimates.push(transaction);
      return 100_000n;
    },
    call: async (transaction) => {
      calls.push(transaction);
      return { data: "0x" };
    },
    ...overrides.rpc,
  };
  const dependencies = {
    getConfig: () => CONFIG,
    createPublicClient: () => ({}),
    createRpc: () => rpc,
    buildBuyCall: async (_client, request) => ({
      ...encodeAgentBuyCall(
        { accountAddress: request.accountAddress, amountBnb: request.amountBnb },
        1_000n,
        CONFIG,
      ),
      quote: {
        expectedAmountOut: 1_100n,
        amountOutMin: 1_000n,
        priceImpactBps: 40,
        slippageBps: request.slippageBps,
        poolAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000999",
      },
    }),
    now: () => Date.now(),
    ...overrides.dependencies,
  };
  return { calls, gasEstimates, rpc, dependencies };
}

test("simulation validates a BSC testnet route, balance, gas, and performs only read calls", async () => {
  const { calls, gasEstimates, dependencies } = harness();
  const result = await simulateAgentTransaction(
    { amountBnb: "0.1", slippageBps: 100 },
    OWNER,
    dependencies,
  );

  assert.equal(result.status, "SIMULATION_PASSED");
  assert.equal(result.chainId, 97);
  assert.equal(result.blockNumber, "123");
  assert.equal(result.account, OWNER);
  assert.equal(result.router, ROUTER);
  assert.equal(result.targetToken, TOKEN);
  assert.equal(result.minimumAmountOut, "1000");
  assert.equal(result.estimatedNetworkFeeWei, "300000");
  assert.equal(result.execution.signingRequested, false);
  assert.equal(result.execution.transactionBroadcast, false);
  assert.equal(result.execution.executionEnabled, false);
  assert.equal(gasEstimates.length, 1);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(calls[0].account, OWNER);
});

test("simulation endpoint requires authorization and strict bounded inputs", async (t) => {
  const makeRequest = (body, headers = { "content-type": "application/json" }) =>
    new Request("https://wolv.test/api/agent/simulation", {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });

  await t.test("unauthorized", async () => {
    let rpcCreated = false;
    const response = await handleAgentTransactionSimulationPost(
      makeRequest({ amountBnb: "0.1", slippageBps: 100 }),
      {
        authorize: async () => "unauthorized",
        createRpc: () => { rpcCreated = true; throw new Error("unexpected"); },
      },
    );
    assert.equal(response.status, 401);
    assert.equal(rpcCreated, false);
  });

  await t.test("extra fields", async () => {
    let rpcCreated = false;
    const response = await handleAgentTransactionSimulationPost(
      makeRequest({ amountBnb: "0.1", slippageBps: 100, recipient: TOKEN }),
      {
        authorize: async () => "authorized",
        getOwnerAddress: async () => OWNER,
        createRpc: () => { rpcCreated = true; throw new Error("unexpected"); },
      },
    );
    assert.equal(response.status, 422);
    assert.equal(rpcCreated, false);
  });
});
import fs from "fs";
import crypto from "crypto";

const env = { ...process.env };
for (const line of (fs.existsSync(".env.local") ? fs.readFileSync(".env.local", "utf8") : "").split("\n")) {
  const m = line.match(/^\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/);
  if (m) env[m[1]] = m[2].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "");
}
const KEY = env.BINANCE_API_KEY, SECRET = env.BINANCE_SECRET_KEY;
if (!KEY || !SECRET) { console.error("Missing BINANCE_API_KEY / BINANCE_SECRET_KEY in .env.local"); process.exit(1); }

const BASE = "https://web3.binance.com/build";
const USDT = "0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955";
const N = 8, EVERY_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000, USDT_IN = 100;
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
let last = 0;

async function get(path, params = {}) {
  const wait = Math.max(0, last + 300 - Date.now());
  if (wait) await sleep(wait);
  last = Date.now();
  const q = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
  const full = q ? `${path}?${q}` : path;
  const ts = new Date().toISOString();
  const sig = crypto.createHmac("sha256", SECRET).update(ts + "GET" + "/build" + full, "utf8").digest("base64");
  const res = await fetch(BASE + full, { headers: { "X-OC-APIKEY": KEY, "X-OC-TIMESTAMP": ts, "X-OC-SIGN": sig } });
  const j = await res.json();
  if (!j.success && j.code !== 0) throw new Error(`API error ${j.code}: ${j.msg}`);
  return j;
}

async function quote(addr) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    try {
      const r = await get("/api/v1/dex/aggregator/quote", {
        binanceChainId: "56",
        fromTokenAddress: USDT,
        toTokenAddress: addr,
        amount: String(USDT_IN) + "0".repeat(18),
        userWalletAddress: "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD",
      });
      const routes = (r.data ?? []).filter((x) => x?.toTokenAmount);
      routes.sort((a, b) => Number(b.toTokenAmount) - Number(a.toTokenAmount));
      const b = routes[0];
      if (!b) throw new Error(r.msg || "no route");
      const out = Number(b.toTokenAmount) / 1e18;
      const px = parseFloat(b.fromToken?.tokenUnitPrice ?? "1") || 1;
      return { execUsd: (USDT_IN * px) / out, vendor: b.vendorName, mode: b.executionMode, impact: b.priceImpactPercent, routes: routes.length };
    } catch (e) {
      const m = String(e.message ?? e);
      if (i === 0 && m.includes("42900")) { await sleep(1500); continue; }
      return { err: m.slice(0, 160) };
    }
  }
  return { err: "rate limited" };
}

let picked = process.env.TICKERS ? process.env.TICKERS.split(",") : null;
async function cycle() {
  const list = (await get("/api/v1/dex/market/rwa/tokens")).data ?? [];
  if (!picked) {
    const by = {};
    for (const t of list) if (t.underlyingTicker) ((by[t.underlyingTicker] ??= {})[t.platformId] ??= t);
    const vol = (v) => Math.max(...Object.values(v).map((x) => Number(x.volume24H) || 0));
    picked = Object.entries(by)
      .filter(([, v]) => Object.keys(v).length >= 2)
      .sort((a, b) => vol(b[1]) - vol(a[1]))
      .slice(0, N)
      .map(([tk]) => tk);
    console.log("tracking:", picked.join(","));
  }
  const ts = new Date().toISOString();
  let ok = 0, bad = 0;
  const lines = [];
  for (const tk of picked) {
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const t of list) {
      if (t.underlyingTicker !== tk || seen.has(t.platformId)) continue;
      seen.add(t.platformId);
      const q = await quote(t.tokenContractAddress);
      const mult = parseFloat(t.tokenToShareRatio) || 1;
      lines.push(JSON.stringify({
        ts, tk, plat: t.platformId,
        listUsd: Number(t.tokenPrice), ref: Number(t.referencePrice), mult,
        mkt: t.statusInfo?.marketStatus ?? null, open: t.statusInfo?.openState ?? null, reason: t.statusInfo?.reasonCode ?? null,
        ...q, execPerShare: q.execUsd ? q.execUsd / mult : null,
      }));
      if (q.err) bad++;
      else ok++;
    }
  }
  fs.mkdirSync("data", { recursive: true });
  fs.appendFileSync("data/snapshots.jsonl", lines.join("\n") + "\n");
  console.log(ts, "quotes ok:", ok, "err:", bad);
}

const once = process.argv.includes("--once");
process.on("unhandledRejection", (e) => console.log("unhandled:", String(e)));
while (true) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try { await cycle(); } catch (e) { console.log(new Date().toISOString(), "cycle error:", String(e.message ?? e)); }
  if (once) break;
  await sleep(Math.max(1000, EVERY_MS - (Date.now() - t0)));
}
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";

} from "../lib/bscMetadataProbe.ts";

  __dirname,
  "../docs/audits/bsc-metadata-audit-2026-11-01T08-14-16.554Z.json",

export const ARCHIVE_PROBE_CONFIRMATION = "READ-ONLY ARCHIVE STATE PROBE";
export const ARCHIVE_INDEPENDENCE_CONFIRMATION = "I_CONFIRM_SEPARATE_OPERATORS";
const TOKEN_ADDRESSES = [
  "0xe614e2fc6c787035ff51f452e8e826bfd32d5283",
  "0x282973969118f9fe39bf2ff3d8dd1efee82ccb11",

export function formatArchiveProbePlan({
  primaryIdentity,
  archiveIdentity,
  operatorIndependence,
  primaryOnly = false,
}) {
  const methods = archiveIdentity && !primaryOnly
    ? "eth_chainId, eth_blockNumber (primary only), eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getCode, eth_call (decimals() only after non-empty valid code)"
    : "eth_chainId, eth_blockNumber, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_getCode, eth_call (decimals() only after non-empty valid code)";
  return [
    "BSC archive state verification — DRY RUN",
    "Network: BNB Smart Chain mainnet (chain ID 56)",
    `Primary RPC identity: ${primaryIdentity}`,
    `Archive RPC identity: ${primaryOnly
      ? "excluded by --primary-only"
      : archiveIdentity ?? "not configured (BSC_RPC_ARCHIVE_URL is unset)"}`,
    `Provider independence: ${operatorIndependence}`,
    `Target block: ${RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK} (${RECORDED_METADATA_BLOCK_HASH})`,
    `Permitted addresses: ${[BSC_USDT_ADDRESS, ...TOKEN_ADDRESSES].join(", ")}`,
    `Read-only methods: ${methods}`,
    "No Binance catalogue or BAW call; no wallet operation or transaction method.",
    `Live requests require --live-read-only and exact confirmation: ${ARCHIVE_PROBE_CONFIRMATION}.`,
    "No network request was made.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export function requireArchiveProbeConfirmation(answer) {
  return typeof answer === "string" && answer.trim() === ARCHIVE_PROBE_CONFIRMATION;
}

export async function readArchiveProbeTargets(auditPath = AUDIT_PATH) {
  let audit;
  try {
    audit = JSON.parse(await readFile(auditPath, "utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("The recorded audit JSON could not be loaded or parsed.");
  }
  return getRecordedProbeTargets(audit);
}

export function resolveArchiveProbeConfig(environment = process.env) {
  const primaryUrl = environment.BSC_RPC_URL
    ? requireServerRpcUrl(environment.BSC_RPC_URL, "BSC_RPC_URL")
    : resolvePublicRpcUrl(
      environment.NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL,
      PUBLIC_BSC_RPC,
      "NEXT_PUBLIC_BSC_RPC_URL",
    );
  const archiveUrl = environment.BSC_RPC_ARCHIVE_URL
    ? requireServerRpcUrl(environment.BSC_RPC_ARCHIVE_URL, "BSC_RPC_ARCHIVE_URL")
    : null;
  const primaryOperator = environment.BSC_RPC_OPERATOR ?? "";
  const archiveOperator = environment.BSC_RPC_ARCHIVE_OPERATOR ?? "";
  const distinctOperators = Boolean(
    primaryOperator.trim() &&
    archiveOperator.trim() &&
    primaryOperator.trim().toLowerCase() !== archiveOperator.trim().toLowerCase(),
  );
  const operatorIndependenceConfirmed =
    environment.BSC_RPC_ARCHIVE_INDEPENDENCE_CONFIRMED === ARCHIVE_INDEPENDENCE_CONFIRMATION;
  return {
    primaryUrl,
    archiveUrl,
    primaryIdentity: redactRpcEndpointIdentity(primaryUrl),
    archiveIdentity: archiveUrl ? redactRpcEndpointIdentity(archiveUrl) : null,
    primaryOperator,
    archiveOperator,
    operatorIndependenceConfirmed,
    operatorIndependence: distinctOperators && operatorIndependenceConfirmed
      ? "operator attestation configured; not independently verified"
      : "not established (operator labels missing or identical)",
  };
}

async function main(args = process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const allowedArgs = new Set(["--live-read-only", "--primary-only"]);
  if (args.some((argument) => !allowedArgs.has(argument)) ||
    new Set(args).size !== args.length ||
    (args.includes("--primary-only") && !args.includes("--live-read-only"))) {
    console.error("Usage: node --conditions=react-server --experimental-strip-types scripts/bsc-archive-probe.mjs [--live-read-only [--primary-only]]");
    process.exitCode = 2;
    return;
  }
  const config = resolveArchiveProbeConfig();
  const primaryOnly = args.includes("--primary-only");
  const activeConfig = primaryOnly
    ? {
      ...config,
      archiveUrl: null,
      archiveIdentity: null,
      archiveOperator: "",
      operatorIndependenceConfirmed: false,
      operatorIndependence: "not established (primary-only diagnostic)",
      primaryOnly: true,
    }
    : { ...config, primaryOnly: false };
  console.log(formatArchiveProbePlan(activeConfig));
  if (!args.includes("--live-read-only")) return;
  if (!process.stdin.isTTY || !process.stdout.isTTY) {
    throw new Error("Live archive probe requires an interactive terminal for typed confirmation.");
  }
  const targets = await readArchiveProbeTargets();
  await confirmArchiveProbe();

  const chain = defineChain({
    id: 56,
    name: "BNB Smart Chain",
    nativeCurrency: { name: "BNB", symbol: "BNB", decimals: 18 },
    rpcUrls: { default: { http: [activeConfig.primaryUrl] } },
  });
  const result = await diagnoseArchiveState({
    primary: {
      client: createPublicClient({ chain, transport: http(activeConfig.primaryUrl, { timeout: 10_000 }) }),
      identity: activeConfig.primaryIdentity,
      operator: activeConfig.primaryOperator,
    },
    ...(activeConfig.archiveUrl
      ? {
        archive: {
          client: createPublicClient({
            chain: defineChain({
              id: 56,
              name: "BNB Smart Chain",
              nativeCurrency: { name: "BNB", symbol: "BNB", decimals: 18 },
              rpcUrls: { default: { http: [activeConfig.archiveUrl] } },
            }),
            transport: http(activeConfig.archiveUrl, { timeout: 10_000 }),
          }),
          identity: activeConfig.archiveIdentity,
          operator: activeConfig.archiveOperator,
          independenceAttested: activeConfig.operatorIndependenceConfirmed,
        },
      }
      : {}),
    targets,
  });
  const output = { auditTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(), ...result };
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(":", "-");
  const outputDirectory = path.resolve(__dirname, "../docs/audits");
  await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(
    path.join(outputDirectory, `bsc-archive-probe-${timestamp}.json`),
    `${JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)}\n`,
    { mode: 0o600 },
  );
  console.log(`Probe status: ${result.status}; sanitized results written under ${outputDirectory}.`);
}

async function confirmArchiveProbe() {
  const terminal = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  try {
    const answer = await terminal.question(
      `Type ${ARCHIVE_PROBE_CONFIRMATION} to issue only the displayed read-only requests:\n> `,
    );
    if (!requireArchiveProbeConfirmation(answer)) {
      throw new Error("Archive probe confirmation did not match; no RPC request was made.");
    }
  } finally {
    terminal.close();
  }
}

function requireServerRpcUrl(value, variableName) {
  let url;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${variableName} is invalid; its value is redacted.`);
  }
  if ((url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") || url.hash) {
    throw new Error(`${variableName} must use HTTP(S) without a fragment.`);
  }
  return url.toString();
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  main().catch((error) => {
    console.error(error instanceof Error && (
      error.message.startsWith("Archive probe confirmation") ||
      error.message.startsWith("Live archive probe requires")
    )
      ? error.message
      : "BSC archive probe failed; sensitive endpoint and credential details were suppressed.");
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
}
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import {
  AgentWorker,
  MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB,
  MAX_TRADE_BNB,
} from "../services/agentWorker.ts";
import { parseEther } from "viem";

const strategy = {
  id: "aapl-entry",
  account: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000789",
  targetToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000456",
  amountBnb: parseEther("0.1"),
  entryPriceMicros: 100_000_000n,
  slippageBps: 100,
  maxPriceImpactBps: 300,
};
const POLICY_HASH = `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`;
const INTENT_SIGNER = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000788";

function validPolicyState(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    paused: false,
    installed: true,
    revoked: false,
    rollingVolume: parseEther("0.2"),
    policyConfigured: true,
    policyHash: POLICY_HASH,
    maxTradeValue: parseEther("0.5"),
    policyExpiresAt: BigInt(Math.floor((Date.now() + 60_000) / 1000)),
    intentSigner: INTENT_SIGNER,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function createHarness(overrides = {}, options = {}) {
  const telemetry = [];
  const alerts = [];
  const intents = [];
  const dependencies = {
    strategies: [strategy],
    readMarket: async () => ({
      priceMicros: 90_000_000n,
      reserves: {
        reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
        reserveOut: parseEther("1000000"),
      },
      observedAt: Date.now(),
    }),
    readValidator: async () => validPolicyState(),
    log: event => telemetry.push(event),
    alert: event => alerts.push(event),
    onIntent: intent => intents.push(intent),
    ...overrides,
  };
  return {
    worker: new AgentWorker(dependencies, {
      intervalMs: 1000,
      maxConsecutiveFailures: 2,
      maxMarketAgeMs: 20_000,
      ...options,
    }),
    telemetry,
    alerts,
    intents,
  };
}

test("passes preflight then publishes a bounded intent and capacity telemetry", async () => {
  const { worker, telemetry, intents } = createHarness();
  await worker.evaluateOnce();

  assert.equal(telemetry[0].reasonCode, "VALIDATOR_PASS");
  assert.equal(telemetry[0].cumulativeVolumeBnb, parseEther("0.2").toString());
  assert.equal(
    telemetry[0].remainingCapacityBnb,
    (MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB - parseEther("0.2")).toString(),
  );
  assert.equal(telemetry[0].attemptedTradeBnb, strategy.amountBnb.toString());
  assert.ok(telemetry[0].priceImpactBps > 0);
  assert.equal(intents.length, 1);
  assert.equal(intents[0].amountOutMin > 0n, true);
  assert.equal(intents[0].slippageBps, strategy.slippageBps);
  assert.equal(intents[0].maxPriceImpactBps, strategy.maxPriceImpactBps);
  assert.equal(intents[0].policyHash, POLICY_HASH);
  assert.equal("intentNonce" in intents[0], false);
  assert.equal(worker.hasPendingIntent, true);
});

test("anchors intent age to local market-data receipt time", async () => {
  const receivedAt = Date.now() - 3_000;
  const { worker, intents } = createHarness({
    readMarket: async () => ({
      priceMicros: 90_000_000n,
      reserves: {
        reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
        reserveOut: parseEther("1000000"),
      },
      observedAt: Date.now(),
      receivedAt,
    }),
  });
  await worker.evaluateOnce();

  assert.equal(intents.length, 1);
  assert.equal(intents[0].createdAt, new Date(receivedAt).toISOString());
});

test("does not construct an intent when the price trigger is not met", async () => {
  const { worker, telemetry, intents } = createHarness({
    readMarket: async () => ({
      priceMicros: 101_000_000n,
      reserves: {
        reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
        reserveOut: parseEther("1000000"),
      },
      observedAt: Date.now(),
    }),
  });
  await worker.evaluateOnce();

  assert.equal(telemetry[0].reasonCode, "TRIGGER_NOT_MET");
  assert.equal(intents.length, 0);
});

test("fails closed when market data reaches the 20-second age limit", async () => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const harness = createHarness({
    now: () => now,
    readMarket: async () => ({
      priceMicros: 90_000_000n,
      reserves: {
        reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
        reserveOut: parseEther("1000000"),
      },
      observedAt: now - 20_000,
    }),
  });
  await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();

  assert.equal(harness.telemetry[0].reasonCode, "RPC_FAILURE");
  assert.equal(harness.intents.length, 0);
});

test("preflights cumulative and per-trade limits before creating an intent", async () => {
  const cumulative = createHarness({
    readValidator: async () => validPolicyState({
      rollingVolume: MAX_ROLLING_VOLUME_BNB - parseEther("0.05"),
    }),
  });
  await cumulative.worker.evaluateOnce();
  assert.equal(cumulative.telemetry[0].reasonCode, "CAP_EXCEEDED");
  assert.equal(cumulative.intents.length, 0);

  const oversize = createHarness({
    strategies: [{ ...strategy, amountBnb: MAX_TRADE_BNB + 1n }],
  });
  await oversize.worker.evaluateOnce();
  assert.equal(oversize.telemetry[0].reasonCode, "TRADE_CAP_EXCEEDED");
  assert.equal(oversize.intents.length, 0);
});

test("refuses paused, revoked, or uninstalled accounts", async t => {
  for (const [label, state, expectedReason] of [
    ["paused", { paused: true }, "CIRCUIT_BREAKER_PAUSED"],
    ["revoked", { revoked: true }, "SESSION_REVOKED"],
    ["uninstalled", { installed: false }, "SESSION_NOT_INSTALLED"],
  ]) {
    await t.test(label, async () => {
      const harness = createHarness({
        readValidator: async () => validPolicyState({ rollingVolume: 0n, ...state }),
      });
      await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();
      assert.equal(harness.telemetry[0].reasonCode, expectedReason);
      assert.equal(harness.intents.length, 0);
    });
  }
});

test("refuses accounts without a configured on-chain policy signer", async () => {
  const harness = createHarness({
    readValidator: async () => validPolicyState({
      policyConfigured: false,
      intentSigner: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    }),
  });
  await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();
  assert.equal(harness.telemetry[0].reasonCode, "POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  assert.equal(harness.intents.length, 0);
});

test("rejects high price impact and does not create an intent", async () => {
  const { worker, telemetry, intents } = createHarness({
    readMarket: async () => ({
      priceMicros: 90_000_000n,
      reserves: {
        reserveIn: parseEther("1"),
        reserveOut: parseEther("1000"),
      },
      observedAt: Date.now(),
    }),
  });
  await worker.evaluateOnce();

  assert.equal(telemetry[0].reasonCode, "SLIPPAGE_HIGH");
  assert.equal(intents.length, 0);
});

test("panic-stops on consecutive RPC failures, alerts, and clears pending intent", async () => {
  let shouldFail = false;
  const harness = createHarness({
    readMarket: async () => {
      if (shouldFail) throw new Error("mock RPC unavailable");
      return {
        priceMicros: 90_000_000n,
        reserves: {
          reserveIn: parseEther("1000"),
          reserveOut: parseEther("1000000"),
        },
        observedAt: Date.now(),
      };
    },
  });

  await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();
  assert.equal(harness.worker.hasPendingIntent, true);
  shouldFail = true;
  await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();
  await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();

  assert.equal(harness.worker.isRunning, false);
  assert.equal(harness.worker.hasPendingIntent, false);
  assert.equal(harness.alerts.length, 1);
  assert.equal(harness.alerts[0].priority, "high");
  assert.ok(harness.telemetry.some(event => event.reasonCode === "WORKER_PANIC_STOP"));

  const recordsBeforeRetry = harness.telemetry.length;
  await harness.worker.evaluateOnce();
  assert.equal(harness.telemetry.length, recordsBeforeRetry);
});

test("does not prepare duplicate intents while an intent is pending", async () => {
  const { worker, telemetry, intents } = createHarness();

  assert.equal(intents.length, 1);
  assert.equal(telemetry[1].reasonCode, "INTENT_PENDING");
  assert.equal(worker.getPendingIntent().strategyId, strategy.id);
